N KA BAARA — BAMANANKAN NA
Bamanankan na fasaralen sɛbɛn
Taamasiyɛn 5,924 bɛɛ; waatiw ni user ka fasariw marala.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-10-01 22:33:25 CEST
Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman

A bɛ tile 4 bɔ

Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara : Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔko jɔnjɔnw ni latigɛw – a digest :

✅ Denbaya 13000 ni kɔ minnu bɛ mara 56 kɔnɔ, olu bɛna se k’u ka so ni gazi rezow cɛsiri ani ka minɛnw sɔrɔ minnu ka kan. Gofɛrɛnaman bɛ ka wari miliyari 1,2 wɛrɛ di gazi sɔrɔli porogaramu ma. Nin dɛmɛ in dabɔra denbayabaw kama, sɔrɔdasi baara kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen senfɛmɔgɔw n’u ka denbayaw, kulu fɔlɔ fiyentɔw, mɔgɔ minnu ka sɔrɔ man bon, ani minnu bɛ denmisɛnw ladon minnu ka kɛnɛyako gɛlɛyara.

✅ Jamanakuntigi ka baara bɛna yiriwa ka da fɛɛrɛ kuraw jusigilan kan. Gofɛrɛnaman ye izini yiriwali porogaramu kura ye fo ka se san 2050. A bɛ tali kɛ bi minɛnw na, fɛɛrɛ minnu tɛ mɔgɔ bolo, ani nizɛrikan na ; bolomafara kura yiriwali ; kɔɔri chimie ni baarakɛcogo jugumanba yiriwali; ani baarakɛyɔrɔ lakanani ɲɛnabɔli. Labɛnw bɛ senna walasa ka dɔ fara kɔɔri bɔli kan ni 50% ye san 2050 kɔnɔ.

✅ Gofɛrɛnaman ye fédéral ka baarakɛnafolo bolodalen sɔn san 2027–2029. Sosiyete ka wajibiw dafali bɛ to ka kɛ fɔlɔfɔlɔko jɔnjɔn ye. Nafolo bilala sen kan walasa ka denbayaw dɛmɛ minnu bɛ ni denmisɛnw ye ani ka kɛnɛyako ni kalan yiriwa. Jateminɛ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen bɛna kɛ jamana ka laɲiniw dafali la, o la, fɛɛrɛbɔ ɲɛmɔgɔya sɔrɔli fana sen bɛ o la. Dɛmɛ bɛna to marabolow la san 2026 hakɛw la.

Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman

A bɛ tile 4 bɔ

Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara : Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔko jɔnjɔnw ni latigɛw – bɛ Kuntaalasurunya kɔnɔ:

✅ Denbaya 13000 ni kɔ minnu bɛ mara 56 kɔnɔ, olu bɛna se k’u ka so ni gazi jɔw cɛsiri ani ka minɛnw sɔrɔ minnu ka kan. Gofɛrɛnaman bɛ ka rubulu miliyari 1,2 wɛrɛ di gazi sɔrɔli waleyali kama. Nin dɛmɛ in dabɔra denbayabaw kama, kɛlɛdenya baara kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen senfɛmɔgɔw n’u ka denbayaw, ani nalomanya bana kulu fɔlɔw, ani mɔgɔ minnu ka sɔrɔ ka dɔgɔ, ani minnu bɛ denmisɛnw ladon minnu ka kɛnɛyako gɛlɛyara.

✅ Ka bɔ ŋaniya talenw na Finfin baara bɛna yiriwa ka da fɛɛrɛ kuraw jusigilan kan. Yɔrɔla Gofɛrɛnaman wuli la k'a jɔ ni nin baarada in yiriwali waleya kurayali ye fo ka se san 2050 ma. Wa a bɛ tali kɛ minɛn kuraw donni fɛɛrɛ la, ani fɛɛrɛ minnu bɛ k'u yɛrɛma, ani jatedenya yɔrɔw; ani dogolen kuraw yiriwali; ani finfin chimie yɔrɔw ni konaya furakɛli; ani baarakɛyɔrɔ lakanani ɲɛnabɔli. I n'a fɔ labɛnw bɛ senna walasa ka dɔ fara finfin bɔli kan ni 50% ye ni san 2050 seli ye.

✅ Gofɛrɛnaman ye foroba ka baarakɛnafolo bolodalen sɔn san 2027–2029. Sigida ka jaakuya dafali bɛ to ka kɛ fɔlɔfɔlɔko jɔnjɔn ye. Nafolo bilala sen kan walasa ka denbayaw dɛmɛ minnu bɛ ni denmisɛnw ye ani ka kɛnɛyako ni kalan yiriwa. Jateminɛ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen bɛna kɛ jamana ka laɲiniw dafali la, o la, fɛɛrɛbɔ ɲɛmɔgɔya sɔrɔli fana sen b'o la. Ka fara marabolow bɛɛ ka dɛmɛ toli kan i n'a fɔ a tun bɛ ka cogo min san 2026 kɔnɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-09-27 10:17:29 CEST
Cogo caman bɛna dabɔ Irisi jamana na, baarakɛlaw ye minnu bɛ baara kɛ filimu, dɔnkilida, dilancogo ani daɲɛw dilanni baara wɛrɛw la. Gofɛrɛnaman ye fɛɛrɛ dɔ ta walasa ka daɲɛw sɔrɔ yiriwali siratigɛ la fo ka se san 2036. Yɔrɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw, yiriwali baaradaw, ani daɲɛw kuluw bɛna sigi senkan maraw kɔnɔ. Kalan waleyali, stage, ani baarakɛlaw yiriwali porogaramuw bɛna bonya kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la. Hakilila-jɔ-sɛbɛnw lakanani fana bɛna barika sɔrɔ walasa ka mɔgɔ wɛrɛw ka baara kɛcogo kɛlɛ ka ɲɛ. Irisi animation studiow bɛna dɛmɛ wɛrɛ sɔrɔ, n’u ka tɔnw ka sɔrɔta impositi hakɛ bɛna dɔgɔya ka se 3% ma. An b’a jira ko an bɛna Irisi filimu ɲumanw ye minnu ka bon kosɛbɛ denbaya lamɛnbagaw ye sinemasow la, telewisɔn na ani ɛntɛrinɛti kan. Ka fɛn dilanni baara kura daminɛ ani ka waridonna sama, o bɛna nɔgɔya Irisi jamana na. Mikhail Mishustin ye fɛɛrɛbɔ dɔ kɛ jamana ka jagokɛlaw ka ɲɛtaa kan. Fɛɛrɛ fɔlɔ min bɛ kɛ ka nafolodonni nisɔndiya bonya, o ye jamana ka misali ye, min ye laɲini cogoyaw ye jago kɛli kama ; nin misali in bɛ dɛmɛ don ka jagokɛyɔrɔ ɲuman dilan ani ka dɔ bɔ marako gɛlɛyaw la. Nafolodon siratigɛ kura daminɛni tora a ɲɛnakoba ye. Walasa k’o sɔrɔ, an ka kan ka t’a fɛ ka cogoya nɔgɔmanw, minnu bɛ se ka fɔ ka ɲɛ, ka ɲɛsin waridonnaw ​​ma, ka jateminɛ kɛ jagokɛlaw ka ɲininiw na, an ka maraw magow, ani jamana bɛɛ ka nafaw. Taama kɛli Crimée jamana lamini na, o bɛna nɔgɔya ka taa a fɛ. Sira min bɛ Tavrida fédéral siraba cɛ ka taa Crimea saheliyanfan kɔgɔjida la, o bɛ ka jɔ kokura o gun kan, ni ruble miliyari 3,5 bilala o baara in na. O sira bɛna tɛmɛ Simferopol, Alushta ani Yalta fɛ. O desizɔn in bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka bolifɛnw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ siraw ɲɛ ka taa a fɛ Kirime duguw ni dugubaw cɛ, k’a sɔrɔ a bɛna taama sira ɲumanw di turisiw ma gun in kɔnɔ. San kura seliw bɛna kɛ tile 11 kɔnɔ; Irisikaw bɛna lafiɲɛbɔ waati daminɛ desanburukalo tile 31 ka se Zanwuyekalo tile 10. Mikhail Mishustin ye a bolonɔ bila sariya dɔ la min ɲɛsinnen bɛ foroba lafiɲɛ donw ni lafiɲɛ donw ma san 2027. Feburuyekalo la, lafiɲɛ don saba bɛ tugu ɲɔgɔn na k’a ta tile 21 na ka se tile 23 ma. Marisikalo la, lafiɲɛbɔ bɛ daminɛ 6nan na ka Taa 8nan na. Mɛkalo seliw bɛɛ lajɛlen bɛna kɛ tile wɔɔrɔ ye, u tilalen don waati fila ye: Mɛkalo tile 1–3 ani Mɛkalo tile 8–10. Tile saba lafiɲɛbɔ wɛrɛ bɛna kɛ zuwɛnkalo la, k’a ta tile 12 la ka se tile 14 ma. Nowanburukalo la, lafiɲɛ don naani bɛna kɛ, k’a ta tile 4 na ka se tile 7 ma.

Hakilila-jɔ-sɛbɛnw lakanani fana bɛna barika sɔrɔ walasa ka mɔgɔ wɛrɛw ka baara kɛcogo ta k'a sɔrɔ a tigi ma sɔn o bɛna kɛlɛ ka ɲɛ. Irisi ja lamagata dilannikɛyɔrɔw bɛna dɛmɛ wɛrɛ sɔrɔ, n’u ka tɔnw ka sɔrɔta saalenw hakɛ bɛna dɔgɔya ka se kɛmɛsaradala saba ma. An b’a jira k'an bɛna Irisi filimu ɲumanw ye minnu suguya ɲɛ kɔrɔtalen don kosɛbɛ minnu ɲɛsinnen bɛ denbayaw ma sinemasow la, telew la ani bɔlɔlɔ kan. Ka fɛn dilanni baara kura daminɛ ani ka waridonna sama, o bɛna nɔgɔya Irisi jamana na. Mikhail Mishustin ye fɛɛrɛbɔ dɔ kɛ jamana ka jagokɛlaw ka ɲɛtaa kan. Fɛɛrɛ fɔlɔ min bɛ kɛ ka nafolodonni nisɔndiya bonya, o ye jamana ka misali ye, min ye laɲini cogoyaw ye jago kɛli kama ; nin misali in bɛ dɛmɛ don ka jagokɛyɔrɔ ɲuman dilan ani ka dɔ bɔ marako gɛlɛyaw la. Nafolodon siratigɛ kura daminɛni tora a ɲɛnakoba ye. Walasa k’o sɔrɔ, an ka kan ka t’a fɛ ka cogoya nɔgɔmanw, minnu bɛ se ka fɔ ka ɲɛ, ka ɲɛsin waridonnaw ma, ka jateminɛ kɛ jagokɛlaw ka ɲininiw na, an ka maraw magow, ani jamana bɛɛ ka nafaw. Taama kɛli Crimée mara lamini na, o bɛna nɔgɔya ka taa a fɛ. Sira min bɛ Tavrida foroba siraba cɛ ka taa Crimea woroduguanfan kɔgɔjida la, o bɛ ka jɔ kokura o gun kan, ni rubulu miliyari saba n'a kunkanfɛn duuru bilala o baara in na. O sira bɛna tɛmɛ Simferopol, Alushta ani Yalta fɛ. Nin ŋaniya in bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka bolifɛnw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ siraw ɲɛ ka taa a fɛ Kirime duguw ni dugubaw cɛ, k’a sɔrɔ a bɛna taama sira ɲumanw di yaala yaalakɛlaw ma gun in kɔnɔ. San kura ɲɛnajɛw bɛna kɛ tile 11 kɔnɔ; Irisikaw bɛna lafiɲɛbɔ waati daminɛ desanburukalo tile 31 ka se Zanwuyekalo tile 10. Mikhail Mishustin ye a bolonɔ bila sariya dɔ la min ɲɛsinnen bɛ foroba lafiɲɛ donw ni lafiɲɛ donw ma san 2027. Feburuyekalo la, lafiɲɛ don saba bɛ tugu ɲɔgɔn na k’a ta tile 21 na ka se tile 23 ma. Marisikalo la, lafiɲɛbɔ bɛ daminɛ wɔɔrɔnan na ka Taa seeginnan ma. Mɛkalo ɲɛnajɛw bɛɛ lajɛlen bɛna kɛ tile wɔɔrɔ ye, u tilalen don waati fila ye: Mɛkalo tile 1–3 ani Mɛkalo tile 8–10. Tile saba lafiɲɛbɔ wɛrɛ bɛna kɛ zuwɛnkalo la, k’a ta tile 12 la ka se tile 14 ma. Nowanburukalo la, lafiɲɛ don naani bɛna kɛ, k’a ta tile 4 na ka se tile 7 ma.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 11 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-09-15 17:42:52 CEST
Faransi jamana kɔkankow kunnafoni labanw

Tiɲɛ jɔnjɔnw ka surun (ka se san 2026 sɛtanburukalo tile 15 ma):

Finlande farala Faransi ka nukliyɛri balili baara ɲɛtaa kan foroba la (a kɛra jamana 10nan ye min sen bɛ o la).

O wale in laɲini ye ka Erɔpu jamanaw ka balili barika bonya k’a sɔrɔ a ma OTAN bila a nɔ na ani k’a sɔrɔ a ma nukliyɛri marifaw bila Finlande jamana kɔnɔ hɛrɛ waatiw la.

Jamanakuntigi Macron ni Kanada minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ Mark Carney ka lajɛ dɔ bolodara sɛtanburukalo tile 20 Saint-Pierre ani Miquelon walasa ka jɛkafɔ sabati fanga, lafasali ani fɛnɲɛnamafagalan nafamaw na, ka sɔrɔ ka sinsin jamana ka yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya kan.

Faransi ye yafa ɲini foroba la, a ka poste dɔ la min bɛ U.S. ka hadamadenw ka josariyaw sɛbɛn kɔrɔfɔ walasa k’a ka lasigiden kura sigili la Washinton.

Dɛmɛ min bɛ senna Ukraine (Ukraine) la, ka Irisi jamana ka wuli-wuliw jalaki Baltik kɔgɔji la, ani fɛɛrɛw minnu bɛ kɛ ka fɛnw laɲini minnu bɛ bɔ Israɛl sigiyɔrɔw la.

Olu ye tiɲɛ jɔnjɔnw ye minnu sɛgɛsɛgɛra ka ɲɛsin Faransi jamana kɔkankow ma sisan.

Jɛɲɔgɔnya ni Angletɛri cɛ : Jɛɲɔgɔnya bɛna sabati Bayeux finiko jirali fɛ, k’a sɔrɔ gɛlɛyaw bɛ senna ka ɲɛsin mɔgɔw ka bɔli ma cogo la min tɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ Manche kɔnɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 59 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-22 14:22:48 CEST
Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman

16 tɛmɛnen kɔ 18h03 waati

Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara. Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔko jɔnjɔnw ni latigɛ minnu kɛra Digest kɔnɔ:

Mikhail Mishustin y'a sen don Irisi jamana bɛɛ ka forobajɛkulu la min tɔgɔ ye ko "Dugu misɛnninw ni tariku sigiyɔrɔw yiriwali." Lajɛba in na, minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ y’a jira ko yɔrɔ 120.000 ɲɔgɔn ɲɛnabɔra jamana fanga ka porozɛ « Ka dugu sigida lafiyalen dilan » waleyali senfɛ. Mikhail Mishustin fana ye forobaciyɛn in ka jirali lajɛ, min ye ɲɛtaa porozɛw jira mara kura ni dankan na.

Sɔrɔko hɔrɔnyalen mara fanga bonyalen don ka Bɛlgorod, Bryansk ani Kursk maraw bɛɛ lajɛlen minɛ. Jagokɛlaw bɛna se ka wariko porozɛw waleya fɛn dilanni ni sɛnɛko siratigɛ la, ka kɛɲɛ ni fɛɛrɛ ɲumanw ye.

Gofɛrɛnaman ye fɛɛrɛ tigɛ walasa ka kɔrɔnfɛla yɔrɔjan jamanaden hakɛ politiki fɛɛrɛ tigɛ fo san 2030. Sigidamɔgɔw bɛna t’a fɛ ka nafa sɔrɔ bonbonsi porogaramuw la minnu ka fisa, u den fɔlɔ bangeli sarali, ani marabolo ka bangekɔlɔsi waribonw den filanan bangeli kama.  Walasa ka baarakɛlaw sama ka na yɔrɔjanw na, porogaramu minnu bɛ wele ko « Zemsky Dɔgɔtɔrɔ », « Zemsky furakɛlikɛla », « Zemsky karamɔgɔ », « Zemsky ka laadala baarakɛla » ani « Zemsky degelikɛnɛ » fana bɛna t’a fɛ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 92 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-14 05:16:05 CEST
Kuma dafalen min bɛ wideyo kɔnɔ (kumasen min bɛ nɔrɔ jaw la, o cogoya min bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ ani min bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ):
Jɔn y’a fɔ i ye ko nafolotigiw ni faantanw ye kelen ye?
Ayi, papa.. u bɛ bɛn Ala ɲɛ na, nka nin diɲɛ in na, u tɛ kelen ye.
Nin diɲɛ in kɔnɔ:
Nafolotigiw bɛ dumuni kɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni u diya ye, faantanw bɛ dumuni kɛ walasa k’u ka kɔngɔ wasa...danfara bɛ yen.
Nafolotigiw bɛ fini don walasa k’u yɛrɛ cɛɲi, ani faantanw bɛ fini don walasa k’u farikolo yɔrɔw datugu...danfara bɛ yen.
Nafolotigiw bɛ sunɔgɔ walasa ka sunɔgɔ diyabɔ, ka sunɔgɔ dɛsɛlenw ka lafiɲɛ sɛgɛn fɛ...danfara bɛ yen.
Nafolotigiw bɛ taa taama na walasa ka sigida Changer ani ka diɲɛ ye, ani faantanw bɛ taa taama na walasa k’u ka ɲɛnamaya ɲɛ...danfara bɛ yen.
Kana na a fɔ n ye ko nafolotigi ni faantan ye kelen ye.. Ayi, u tɛ kelen ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 95 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-14 00:09:38 CEST
Moritani jamanakuntigi Mohamed Ould Cheikh Ghazouani bɛ ka forobaciyɛn kare kura dɔ ta faaba kɔnɔ, Nouakchott.

Fɛn kolomaw

Kɔrɔɲɔgɔnma : Sɛgɛsɛgɛli taama walima dugubaw kɔnɔ bolifɛnw karew kulu kura Daminɛ, forobaciyɛnko tɔn ta.

Cikan : Nin ja in kun ye ka ɲɛmɔgɔyaso ka majigin n’a gɛrɛli Fasodenw na, ka fara a kan, ka bolifɛnko siratigɛ la kurayali jira ani ka bolifɛn sira ɲumanw di Moritanikaw ma.

Bilasirabagaw: kɛlɛbolo ni jama ɲɛmɔgɔ caman bɛ bɔ jamanakuntigi fɛ taama senfɛ kare kɔnɔ.

Kuma surun na, wuli ka jɔ dɔ min bɛ kɛ ka ɲɛsin mɔgɔw laseli ni kunnafonidilaw ma, min bɛ jamanakuntigi ka cɛsiri jira, ka baara jɔnjɔnw ni mɔbiliko siratigɛw yiriwa Faso kɔnɔ.

Nin bɛ i n’a fɔ Python kode min bɛ bamanankan sɛbɛnni-ni-kumasenw sinsin — nka nin ye Glide ye, n’o ye ɛntɛrinɛti porogaramuw ni kɔnɔna baarakɛminɛnw jɔli yɔrɔ ye, a tɛ Python/ML waleyali sigida ye.

N tɛ se ka Python sɛbɛnniw baara, ka PyTorch modɛliw doni, walima ka odio filew dilan yan.

I bɛ se ka min ɲini:

Walasa ka nin kode in baara — i mago tun bɛna kɛ sigida Python sigida la walima sankaba kaye (Google Colab, Kaggle, Hugging Face Spaces) ni GPU dɛmɛni ye.
Walasa ka ɛntɛrinɛti porogaramu dɔ jɔ Bambara TTS lamini na — n bɛ se k’i dɛmɛ ka Glide porogaramu dɔ jɔ min bɛ TTS API labanyɔrɔ dɔ wele (misali la, i bɛ min ladon Hugging Face Spaces walima Replicate kan), ni sɛbɛnni doncogo ni fɔlikan fɔcogo ye.
Yala o sira fila la kelen bɛna nafa sɔrɔ wa

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 121 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-13 15:41:11 CEST
Présidence Mali 

Mali minisiriw ka tɔnba (awirilikalo tile 12, san 2026) min ɲɛmɔgɔya bɛ jenerali Assimi Goita bolo :

Lakanali gundola bɛnkanw sariyasun b’a ladilan.

A ye bere dɔ sigi sen kan min kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen don dugukoloko sɔsɔliw la.

A sɔnna juru dɔ ma min bɛ bɛn CFA miliyari 19,7 ma walasa ka kuran yiriwa.

A ye mobilizasiyɔn siwili fɛɛrɛ dɔ ta.

Foroba nafa fɔ ka ɲɛsin detour sira baara ma awiyɔnbonda ni awiyɔn jɔyɔrɔ lamini na.

A ye mɔgɔ caman sigi cidenyabaara la.

Aw ye kunnafoniw lamɛn kasobonw politiki kan, AES ka baarakɛjɛkulu, kungo kɔnɔko kɛlɛli lajɛba, DANBE BULON sankololabɔli, 

Dengue banakisɛ sɔrɔli dɔgɔyali.

A ye mobilizasiyɔn siwili fɛɛrɛ dɔ ta.

Foroba nafa fɔ ka ɲɛsin detour sira baara ma awiyɔnbonda ni awiyɔn jɔyɔrɔ lamini na.

A ye mɔgɔ caman sigi cidenyabaara la.

Aw ye kunnafoniw lamɛn kasobonw politiki kan, AES ka baarakɛjɛkulu, kungo kɔnɔko kɛlɛli lajɛba, DANBE BULON sankololabɔli, 

Dengue banakisɛ sɔrɔli dɔgɔyali.

Ruble miliyari saba bilala samiyɛ kɛnɛyako ni ɲɛnajɛ lafiɲɛbɔw kama Krasnodar mara la, turisimu sabatili porogaramu senfɛmɔgɔw denw ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 134 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-13 11:50:50 CEST
Mikhail Mishustin ye baara taama dɔ dafa ka taa kɔrɔnfɛla yɔrɔjan ani Siberi maraw la.
Gorno-Altaisk dugu kɔnɔ, minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ ye lajɛ dɔ kɛ turisimu yiriwali ni jatigila baara yiriwali kan.
Ɲinan tilancɛ fɔlɔ la, turisiw ye taama miliyɔn 43 ni kɔ Kɛ Irisi jamana bɛɛ la.

Taama miliyɔn 3 ni kɔ Kɛra dunanw fɛ minnu Bɔra jamana wɛrɛw la.
Gofɛrɛnaman bɛ ka taa a fɛ ka dɛmɛ don turisimu yiriwali la.
Boloci porogaramu dɔ bɛ yen min ka fisa ni tɔw ye lotɛli, skiyɔrɔw ani ɲɛnajɛyɔrɔw jɔli kama.

San fila nataw kɔnɔ, ruble miliyari 9 bɛ bila turisimu yiriwali kama maraw kɔnɔ.
seliw kɛli , tariku dugu cɛmancɛw ɲɛnabɔli , turisimu siraw dabɔli .
Lajɛ in kɔfɛ, Mikhail Mishustin ye siraba minnu jira turisimu yiriwali siratigɛ la.

Olu dɔw ye sigida, denmisɛnw ani funankɛninw ka turisimu yiriwali ye.
Baara wɛrɛ ye ka lakɔlidenw ni kalandenw dɛmɛ u ka lafiɲɛ lafiya la seli waatiw la.
Ruble miliyari 3 bilala samiyɛ ɲɛnajɛ lafiɲɛbɔw kama Krasnodar mara la SVO senfɛmɔgɔw denmisɛnw ye, ka fara denbayabaw kɔnɔ denmisɛnw kan.

Gofɛrɛnaman fana bɛna t’a fɛ ka turisimu baara dɛmɛ Crimée jamana na, yɔrɔ min na ɲinan a tun ka kan ka selikɛlaw bisimilali jɔ.
Ruble miliyari 4 ni kɔ bilala sen kan kaban walasa turisimu baarakɛlaw ka se k’u ka kuluw mara, ka taa a fɛ ka baara kɛ.

Ni an bɛ turisimu yiriwa an ka jamana kɔnɔ, an ka kan ka an jigi da jamanadenw ka ɲininiw kan tuma bɛɛ, ka izini cidenw ka hakilinaw jateminɛ, walasa ka dɔ fara a jirali kan, n b’a fɔ ko
an ka Irisi maraw ka seko belebeleba.

Lajɛ dɔ senfɛ ni Altai jamana ɲɛmɔgɔ ye, n’o ye Andrei Turchik ye, Mikhail Mishustin fana ye kuma ta o mara in ka sigida ni sɔrɔ yiriwali kan.
Eurasie jamanaw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ jɛkulu ka lajɛ dɔ kɛra Chelponat dugu kɔnɔ.
Sani lajɛba in ka daminɛ, cidenjɛkulu ɲɛmɔgɔw ye ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ ni Kirgistan jamanakuntigi Sadyr Japarov ye.
Gofɛrɛnamanw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ jɛkulu ka lajɛ senfɛ, EAEU jamanaw ka gɔfɛrɛnaman ɲɛmɔgɔw ye yɔrɔ kolomaw lajɛ jɛkafɔ yiriwali siratigɛ la.

Hali ni diɲɛ gɛlɛyaw bɛ yen, EAEU ka sɔrɔkoba jiralanw bɛ fanga ɲuman jira.
PIB lakika bonyalen don Zanwuyekalo-mɛkalo la.
Sɛnɛfɛnw ni sɛnɛko ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ jago fana bɛ ka bonya jira.

An bɛ baara kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ walasa ka jɛkafɔ senfɛ mɔgɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ seko dɔn kosɛbɛ walasa k’an ka jamanadenw ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲɛ.
Ne dalen b’a la ko tɔnba ka yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya n’an ka sɔrɔko dafalen bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka nin sɔrɔ.

Lajɛ in kɔfɛ, desizɔn damadɔw kɛra.
EU jamanaw bɛna ɲɔgɔn ka kalan tɔgɔw dɔn.
Nafolodonni jɛ-ka-baara fana bɛ ka bonya.

Eurasie sɔrɔko tɔnba jamanaw ka dilanbagaw bɛna se ka u sen don jago la jamana duuru bɛɛ ka fɛnw falenfalenni kan.
Walasa ka e-commerce ka fɛnw kan CEE kɔnɔna sugu bɛna sariyaw sigi senkan minnu bɛ kɛ kelen ye ani minnu bɛ jɛya.
Jamanadenw bɛna se ka fɛn caman sɔrɔ suguw la ani ɛntɛrinɛti jagokɛyɔrɔw la.

✅Mikhail Mishustin ye baara taama dɔ dafa ka taa kɔrɔnfɛla yɔrɔjan ani Siberi maraw la Altai jamana na. Gorno-Altaisk dugu kɔnɔ, gɔfɛrɛnaman ɲɛmɔgɔ ye lajɛ dɔ kɛ turisimu yiriwaliko ni jatigila baara yiriwali kan, a ye siraba minnu jira o baara yiriwali siratigɛ la. Kungo tasumaba minnu kɛra Gironde (France saheli-tlebi fɛ) Zuluyekalo laban na: Macron y’a jira k’u ye tasuma juguba ye kabini diɲɛ kɛlɛba filanan, a taara bɔ o yɔrɔ la, ka tasumafagalanw kɔlɔsi.

Sosiyete ka kunnafonidilanw dabila minnu si tɛ san 15 bɔ : a sɔnna zuluyekalo la, wa a bolodara ka daminɛ sɛtanburukalo la.

Diplomasi jɛɲɔgɔnya kɔsa in na : ni Mohamɛdi bin Salman (mara lakanani), Iraki minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ, ani Sisi.

Irisi jamana ka binkanniw jalaki Kiev (awirilikalo tile 5) ani ka wele bila ka sankɔrɔta wɛrɛw kɛ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 167 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-11 19:15:06 CEST
Faransi jamanakuntigi (Macron) ka kibaruya labanw ka surun (fo ka se Awirilikalo tile 11, san 2026):

Kungo tasumaba minnu kɛra Gironde (France saheli-tlebi fɛ) Zuluyekalo laban na: Macron y’u wele ko tasuma juguba minnu kɛra kabini diɲɛ kɛlɛba filanan, a taara bɔ o yɔrɔ la ani ka tasumafagalanw kɔlɔsi.

Denmisɛn minnu si tɛ san 15 bɔ, olu ka kunnafonidilanw (médias sociaux) bali : a sɔnna zuluyekalo la, wa a labɛnna ka waleya sɛtanburukalo la.

Diplomasi jɛɲɔgɔnya kɔsa in na : ni Mohamɛdi bin Salman (mara lakanani), Iraki minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ ani Sissi.

Irisi jamana ka binkanniw jalaki Kiev (Awirilikalo tile 5) ani ka wele bila ka sankɔrɔta wɛrɛw kɛ.

Tariku taama in kɛra Siri jamana kan zuluyekalo la walasa ka Ahmed al-Sharia kunbɛn hali ni bɔnbuw binna a kɛrɛfɛ.

2027 sàn kalataw : Awirilikalo tle 18 ani Mɛkalo tle 2 ; Marine Le Pen y'a ka kandida laseli hali ni jalaki b'a kan.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 198 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-10 22:45:35 CEST
Sɛnɛko nafolo minisiriso 

Afiriki sɛnɛko jiginni tɔnba (AGRA) ka jɛkafɔ jateminɛni n’a seginnkanni kan Mali kɔnɔ san 20 kɔnɔ.

Rapport kɔnɔkow minnu nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ:
Raporo sababu : Lajɛ dɔ labɛnni min bɛ AGRA, sɛnɛko ni nafolo minisiriso ani seko ni dɔnko dɔnnikɛlaw lajɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ walasa ka san 20 baara ni ɲɔgɔndɛmɛ kɔlɔlɔw lajɛ.

Jɛɲɔgɔnya ka ɲɛtaa sɔrɔlenw :

Kalan dɛmɛni ni kalan : Ka dɛmɛ don wariko la ani ka sɛnɛko karamɔgɔ caman ni ɲininikɛla caman dege (master’s ni doctorat degrees) walasa ka sɛnɛko dɔnniya ɲininiw yiriwa.

Sɛnɛkɛlaw ni sɛnɛfɛnw dilanni dɛmɛni : Bi fɛɛrɛ kuraw dicogo, kisɛw ɲɛnabɔli, ani sɛnɛfɛnw sɛnɛcogo cakɛda ɲɛnabɔli walasa ka dɔ fara sɔrɔ kan ani ka dumuniko dɛmɛ.

Sɛnɛ minisiri ka kuma fɔlen : Dɔgɔtɔrɔ Ibrahim Samaki (Mali sɛnɛko minisiri) ye AGRA ka cɛsiriw ni fɛɛrɛw tanu sɛnɛkɛlaw ma ani sɛnɛko ni baganmara siratigɛ yiriwali jamana kɔnɔ, k’a jira k’a b’a fɛ ka t’a fɛ nin jɛkafɔ in na walasa ka sɛnɛ sabatili yiriwa.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 204 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-08-10 22:13:14 CEST
Sinuwaw ka Sɛnɛko

Kuma surun (San 2026 marisikalo laban): Jamana kɔnɔ, tiga fɔlɔ 65% ɲɔgɔnna de lamɔna, wa 10% ɲɔgɔn sɛnɛna.

Guangdong dugu kɔnɔ, mu miliyɔn 13 ni kɔ (hectare 867.000 ɲɔgɔn) donna sɛnɛfɛnw falen waati la, ni suguya ɲumanw yiriwali ye ani sɛnɛ hakɛ bɛnnen (mu kelen sɔrɔta bɛ se ka caya Qingyuan jiralikɛnɛ na ni 10% ɲɔgɔn ye).

Yunxiao, Zhangzhou, Fujian, izini cogo la, jirisunw ladonni bɛ baara kɛ ka ɲɛ (sarɛti 500 ɲɔgɔn lɛrɛ kɔnɔ, ka mu 30 (hectare 2 ɲɔgɔn) di). Ni ɲɛjirali yɔrɔ 400 ni kɔ bɛ mara kɔnɔ, mu 66.000 ɲɔgɔn (hectare 4.400 ɲɔgɔn) de sɛnɛna o waati la. Sɔgɔsɔgɔninjɛ bɛ ka taa ɲɛ cogo labɛnnen na fɛn bɛɛ lajɛlen na, wa jirisunw ladonni cɛmancɛ la, o ye fɛɛrɛ jɔnjɔn ye min bɛ se ka kɛ sababu ye ka ɛkitɛri sabati.

Kuma surunna (San 2026 Marisikalo laban): Jamana kɔnɔ, 65% ɲɔgɔnna de sɛnɛna kaban ka bɔ malosiɲɛ joonaw na, wa 10% ɲɔgɔn tara ka taa dugukoloko kan.

Guangdong dugu kɔnɔ, a ka ca ni miliyɔn 13 ye, o donna jirituru dancɛ la, wa suguya ɲumanw + jirituru camanba bɛnnenw bɛ yiriwa (Qingyuan jirali foro mu kelen sɔrɔta bɛna caya ni 10% ɲɔgɔn ye).
Yunxiao izini min bɛ Zhangzhou, Fujian, o bɛ baara kɛ ka ɲɛ (sarɛti 500 ɲɔgɔn lɛrɛ kɔnɔ, a bɛ se ka 30 acres dilan), ni ɲɛjirali yɔrɔ 400 ni kɔ ye mara kɔnɔ, ani tiga 66.000 ɲɔgɔn sɛnɛna o waati la.  Sɔgɔsɔgɔninjɛ bɛ ka taa ɲɛ cogo labɛnnen na a bɛɛ lajɛlen na, wa jirisunw sɛnɛni caman ye fɛɛrɛ jɔnjɔn ye walasa ka yɔrɔ sabati.

Sɛnɛko cogoya cilen laban min bɔra sɛnɛko ni togodalakow minisiriso la, o b’a jira ko sisan, jamana ka tiga fɔlɔ 65% bɛ lamɔ, wa tiga fɔlɔ 10% ɲɔgɔn bɛ sɛnɛ foronto ɲɔ, foronto pɔmitɛri, foronto malo, ani foroba soja danni bɛ ka taa ɲɛ cogo labɛnnen na; nɛnɛ malokisɛw cogoya bɛ ka ɲɛ ka taa a fɛ , wa foro sɛnɛni ni foroko ɲɛnabɔli bɛ ka taa ɲɛ.

Waati: 2026-08-10 20:45:57 CEST
Sɛnɛko cogoya cilen laban min bɔra sɛnɛko ni togodalakow minisiriso la, o b’a jira ko sisan, jamana ka tiga fɔlɔ 65% bɛ lamɔ, wa tiga fɔlɔ 10% ɲɔgɔn bɛ sɛnɛ foronto ɲɔ, foronto pɔmitɛri, foronto malo, ani foroba soja danni bɛ ka taa ɲɛ cogo labɛnnen na; nɛnɛ malokisɛw cogoya bɛ ka ɲɛ ka taa a fɛ , wa foro sɛnɛni ni foroko ɲɛnabɔli bɛ ka taa ɲɛ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 221 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-10 19:57:15 CEST
Sinuwa Sɛnɛko cogoya jaabi laban min bɔra Sɛnɛko ni togodalakow minisiriso fɛ, o b’a jira ko tiga fɔlɔ sɛnɛni hakɛ jamana kɔnɔ, o sera 60% ma, k’a sɔrɔ tiga tilancɛ sɛnɛni hakɛ bɛ se 10% ɲɔgɔn ma. Sɔgɔsɔgɔninjɛ, foronto pɔmitɛri, foroba malo ani foroba soja bɛ sɛnɛ cogo labɛnnen na, kɔrɔnfɛla malokisɛw cogoya bɛ ka ɲɛtaa sɔrɔ. Sɔgɔma foro sɛnɛni ni a ɲɛnabɔli fana bɛ ka taa ɲɛ. An ka daminɛ ni tiga joona ye. Tiga fɔlɔ ye sɛnɛfɛn filanan ye an ka jamana ka san o san sɛnɛfɛnw sɛnɛni na. Sisan, tiga sɛnɛ fɔlɔ bɛ a dan na tiga sɛnɛyɔrɔba kɔnɔntɔn kɔnɔ jamana fan bɛɛ la. Guangdong mara la, tiga fɔlɔ mu miliyɔn 13 ni kɔ donna sɛnɛfɛnw dɛsɛba waati la. Ɲinan, sigida gɔfɛrɛnaman b’a sinsin tiga suguya tan yiriwali kan minnu ka ɲi kosɛbɛ ani minnu bɛ baara kɛ ka ɲɛ ani fɛɛrɛ kɔrɔ wolonwula minnu bɛ se ka kɛ ka ɲɛ, tiga sɛnɛcogo hakilitigiw fana sen bɛ o la. Qingyuan dugu kɔnɔ, tigaforo yɔrɔ min ka ca ni mu 1600 ye, tigakisɛ hakɛ cayara mu kelen na ka bɔ 12000 na ka se 16000 ma, k’a sababu kɛ tiga sɛnɛcogo ɲɛtaa ye. Sɛnɛ hakɛ jateminɛlen mu kelen na (Sinuwa jamana yɔrɔ kelen, a bɛ bɛn 0,165 acres ma) bɛ se ka caya ni 10% ɲɔgɔn ye ni jirisun 10000 ye. Cɛmancɛ sɛnɛni ɲɛfɛ, o bɛ jirisunw ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲɛ kosɛbɛ, wa o ye fɛɛrɛ nafama ye walasa ka jirisunw sɛnɛyɔrɔ sabati.

Denbaya ka foro dɔ la Qudou dugu kɔnɔ, Yunxiao mara la, Changzhou, Fujian, fɛn dilanni sira min bɛ baara kɛ ni otomatiki dafalen ye, k’a ta jiko la ka taa a bila jirituru ɲɛfɛ, o bɛ baara kɛ ni baarakɛcogo ɲuman ye, ka baara kɛtaw dafa i n’a fɔ a jɛnsɛnni, a falenni ani a jibɔ sen kelen kɔnɔ. Kisɛw sanubɔlanw bɛ dilan joona ka kɛ kuluw ye. Nin sɛnɛfɛnw dilanni sira in bɛ se ka sanubɔlan 500 ni kɔ baara lɛrɛ kɔnɔ, o bɛ se ka kɛ sababu ye ka jirisunw di u ma, minnu bɛ se ka kɛ mu 30 ye (sanubɔlan yɔrɔ kelen, o bɛ bɛn 0,5 acre ma). Sisan, ɲininiw bɛ ɲini ka ban.

Kisɛw bɔlen kɔ sɛnɛyɔrɔ la, u bɛ dibi ni falencogo dɔ kɛ, o kɔfɛ, u bɛ taa denso dɔ la. O yɔrɔ la, sigida jiralanw i n’a fɔ funteni ni nɛnɛ bɛ ladilan o baara bɛɛ kɔnɔ. Kisɛw bɛ dɔn ni u ka kɛ kelen ye, u ju barika ka bon ani u yiriwara, ani u bɛ kɛ cogo ɲuman na. Sisan, jirisunw sɛnɛni piloti yɔrɔ 400 ni kɔ sigira senkan Fujian mara bɛɛ kɔnɔ, ni jirituru fɔlɔ hakɛ ye mu 66.000 ye (Sinuwaw ka sumanikɛlan dɔ, o bɛ bɛn ɛkitɛri 10.000 ɲɔgɔn ma).

Waati: 2026-08-10 19:55:22 CEST
Sɛnɛko cikan laban min bɔra sɛnɛko ni togodalakow minisiriso la, o b’a jira ko tiga sɛnɛ fɔlɔ 60% bɛ jamana kɔnɔ sisan
Tiga tilancɛ-sɔrɔ-sɛnɛ danfara bɛ Taa 10% ɲɔgɔn na, foronto ɲɔ, foronto pɔmitɛri, foronto malo ani foroba soja bɛ Sɛnɛ.
Walasa ka malokisɛw cogoya caman wuli ka taa a fɛ Sinuwa kɔrɔnyanfan fɛ, foro sɛnɛni ni forobaciyɛn marali bɛ ka taa ɲɛ.
Aw ye tiga fɔlɔ lajɛ. Tiga fɔlɔ ye Sinuwa jamana ka san o san suman sɛnɛ waati filanan ye. Sisan, sɛnɛfɛnba 9 bɛ yen jamana kɔnɔ.

Tiga sɛnɛni fɔlɔ marabolo minnu bɛ sɛnɛfɛnw bɔ, o bɛ senna kosɛbɛ
Tiga fɔlɔ min bɛ Guangdong, o ka ca ni 1300 acres ye, o donna balawu kuncɛyɔrɔ la. Ɲinan sigidamɔgɔw ka sinsinnan
Tiga suguya 10 minnu ka ɲi kosɛbɛ ani minnu bɛ baara kɛ kosɛbɛ ani fɛɛrɛ kɔrɔ 7 minnu bɛ tiga labɛnni hakilitigi ni gundo la, olu yiriwa.

Kɔrɔbɔli fɛɛrɛ kɔrɔlen in kɛra ka ɲɛ tigaforow la minnu ka ca ni mɛtɛrɛ 1600 ye Qingyuan dugu kɔnɔ, gundo bɛnnenw sababu fɛ.
Tigajiri hakɛ cayara akere kelen na ka bɔ 1 na.
jiri 20.000 cayara ka se 1 ma.

Faransi: Champagne, suman tigɛ daminɛna Awirilikalo tile 10, o ye waati ye min ma deli ka kɛ fɔlɔ ni i y’a suma ni san tɛmɛnnenw ye (u tun bɛ daminɛ yɔrɔ min na caman na sɛtanburukalo la).

O kun : Funteni jugumanba ni funteni min tun bɛ kɛ tuma caman na, o ye rezɛn mɔli teliya, o ye siran bila suman tigɛcogo tiɲɛni na walima jeninida la tile fɛ ni suman tigɛ waati tɛmɛna.

Gɛlɛyaw ni ladamuni fɛɛrɛw:

Waati: Baara daminɛna joona, sɔgɔma 6 waati, walasa tile funteni kana tɛmɛ 38°C kan.

Baara : Gɛlɛya min bɛ pickers sɔrɔli la samiyɛ cɛmancɛ la, o ye baarakɛla dɔw wajibiya o seko ni dɔnko la, u ka segin joona, ka wele bila ka fanga di u ma.

Kunnafoni : Nin waati gɛlɛya in bɛ na waati min na, Champagne dilannikɛlaw bɛ ka tɔɔrɔ sɔrɔ u ka feereli dɔgɔyali la kaban kabini san damadɔ.

Baara : Gɛlɛya min bɛ pickers sɔrɔli la samiyɛ cɛmancɛ la, o ye baarakɛla dɔw wajibiya o seko ni dɔnko la, u ka segin joona, ka wele bila ka fanga di u ma.

Kunnafoni : Nin waati gɛlɛya in bɛ na waati min na, Champagne dilannikɛlaw bɛ ka tɔɔrɔ sɔrɔ u ka feereli dɔgɔyali la kaban kabini san damadɔ.
User ye fasari min ta, o marala:
Faransi: Npegu tigɛ waati (vindage) waati daminɛna Champagne mara la Utikalo tile 10, wa o ye daminɛ joona ye min ma se ka tɛmɛn san tɛmɛnnenw kan (k’a sɔrɔ a tun bɛ daminɛ tuma caman na sɛtanburukalo la).

O kun : Funteni hakɛ kɔrɔtali ni kalaya camanba (canicule) i min ye npegu mɔli teliya, o ye siran bonya  sɛnɛfɛnw tiɲɛni na walima jenini na tile kɔrɔ ni kanni sumaya la.

Gɛlɛyaw ni bɛrɛbɛn fɛɛrɛw:

Waati cogoya: Baara daminɛna joona, sɔgɔma 6h waati, walasa tile funteni kana tɛmɛ degere 38 kan.

Baaradenw: Gɛlɛya bɛ suman tigɛlaw sɔrɔli la tilema lafiɲɛbɔ cɛmancɛ la, o ye baarada baarakɛla dɔw jaakuya ka segin joona ka wele bila fanga ma dɛmɛ kama.

Kunnafoni : Nin waati gɛlɛya in bɛ na waati la, waati min na Champagne bɔlikɛlaw bɛ ka degun feereli dɔgɔya fɛ kaban kabini san damadɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 250 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-10 17:51:37 CEST
O Champagne rezɛnsun minnu si bɛ san ba kelen bɔ, suman tigɛ tun ma daminɛ ten samiyɛ daminɛ na ten.

An bɛ kɛsu fa ka ɲɛ, rezɛn caman bɛ yen.

Awirilikalo tile 10, nin yɔrɔ in kama, a bɛ se ka kɛ 3 ye, kalo kelen ka kɔn o ɲɛ,
tariku sɛbɛn ye ani kabako ye suman tigɛlaw bolo ka lajɛ samiyɛ kɔnɔna na.

N y’o kɛ siɲɛ fɔlɔ min na, o kɛra sɛtanburukalo la.
Nka dɔɔni dɔɔni, donw bɛ segin ka jigin.
A bɛ kɛ sababu ye ka funteni wuli.

A jiriden mɔna kaban, a ka di.

An bɛ na a minɛ.
A mɔcogo dafalen b’a la, n’o ye rɛzɛn ye.
An bɛ se ka sumanw ye, u ɲɛ ye sanu ye dɔɔnin.
A dafalen don ka kɔrɔtɔ, i y’a ye, a bɛ taa a yɛrɛ ma.

A tɛ se ka kɛ ka Stéphanie Doué makɔnɔ tugun.
O yɔrɔ la, i bɛ taa, dafalen.
Tile kelen funteni wɛrɛ bɛ se ka nin rezɛn ninnu tobi kaban.

O bɛ sɔrɔ tile fɛ barisa tile jan ni funteni bɛ an bolo.
Funteni minnu dalajɛlen don, olu bɛɛ bɛ rezɛnsunw tɔɔrɔ tiɲɛ na.

Teliya man kan ka dɔgɔya.
O de don, yala aw bɛɛ ye kɛsu fa wa?
Degere 38 ni kɔ fɔra dɔgɔkun in kɔnɔ ani bi sɔgɔma, tile bɛ ka bin daminɛ kaban.
Yala a bɛ ka taa ɲɛ wa?

I ka kɛnɛ wa.
A ma funteni kojugu wa?
A man suma kojugu.

O la sa, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la ɲinan, aw bɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ sɔgɔma 6 waati rezɛn nakɔw la.

An bɛna kura ɲini joona, o la, an wajibiyalen don ka ladamu waati cogoya kura la.

Nka a ka gɛlɛn ka baarakɛlaw sɔrɔ samiyɛ fɛ, waati min na jirisunw tigɛbaga fanba bɛ lafiɲɛbɔ la hali bi.
Eva Magloire, min ye ʃampan dilanni jɛkulu dɔ ka baarakɛla ye, ale seginna ka bɔ lafiɲɛbɔ la joona walasa ka bolo di o baara ma.

Fɛn dɔ farala n kan i n’a fɔ barika bonya bawo kɔgɔli tun bɛ taa ɲɛ tiɲɛ na.
O la, ikomi n ye sigida mɔgɔ ye, n bɛ na n dɛmɛ.

Nin suman tigɛ joona in ye gɛlɛya kura ye ʃampan dilannikɛlaw bolo minnu bɛ ka dɔgɔya u ka feereli la kaban kabini san damadɔ.
feere.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 255 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-08-10 13:16:30 CEST
U.S. Sɛnɛko minisiri Brooke Rollins bɛ kuma a ka cɛsiriw kan kabini a ye fanga ta:

A y’a daminɛ ni lajɛ tilennenw kɛli ye ni sɛnɛkɛlaw ni baganmaralaw ye walasa k’u magow faamuya ani k’u baara kɛwalew la.

A ye ko gɛlɛn dɔ ciyɛn ta : a jiginna ka bɔ sɛnɛko jago tɔnɔ na ka taa dɛsɛ jateminɛlen na min bɛ se miliyari 50 ɲɔgɔn ma, ka fara sɛnɛ musakaw jiginni kan ani biroko tɛmɛnen.

A ye min kɛ : A ye jagokɛɲɔgɔnya 20 kɛ, ka sugu kura da wuli, ka dɛmɛ miliyari 40 ni kɔ di sɛnɛkɛlaw ma, ka sɛnɛ lakanani sira barika bonya, ka sɛnɛfɛnw asiransi bonya, ka taabolo nɔgɔya, ka musakaw dɔgɔya, ka sɛnɛ lakana ka bɔ bagabagali la i n’a fɔ New World Screwworm.

O kɔlɔlɔ: Jagokɛyɔrɔ caman, musakaw dɔgɔyali, lakana sira barikama, ani Sɛnɛko Minisiri min bɛ sɛnɛkɛlaw lamɛn.

Sɛnɛkɛlaw sendon sɛnɛko minisiriso ka sɛgɛsɛgɛliw la, o jigira ka bɔ 85-90% na ka se 40% ɲɔgɔn ma. O de kama, a bɛ baara kɛ walasa ka kunnafonidi fɛɛrɛw kuraya walasa ka dɔ bɔ doni na sɛnɛkɛlaw kan ani ka tiɲɛni ni jɛlenya yiriwa, ka kɛɲɛ ni ɲɔgɔnyew ye sɛnɛko kɛnɛbaw ni ko kɛtaw la.

Dɔgɔtɔrɔso kura, dɔgɔtɔrɔsow ani kɛnɛyaso kura bɛna jɔ Irisi jamana mara suguya caman na.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 291 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-08 16:43:57 CEST
Dɔgɔtɔrɔso kura, dɔgɔtɔrɔsow ani kɛnɛyaso wɛrɛw bɛna jɔ Irisi maraw kɔnɔ. San saba nataw kɔnɔ, gɔfɛrɛnaman bɛna ruble miliyari 6 ni kɔ bila o baara ninnu na Mordovie, Kabardino-Balkaria, Magadan, Pskov, Rostov ani Chelyabinsk maraw la, ka fara Kamchatka ni Krasnoyarsk maraw kan.

A nafa ka bon an ka jamanadenw ka furakɛli kɛcogo ɲuman sɔrɔ waati bɛnnen na, u sigiyɔrɔ walima u sigiyɔrɔ mana kɛ min o min ye.

Jamana kɔnɔ awiyɔn baarakɛlaw ka kurunba bɛna t’a fɛ ka fɛn kuraw sɔrɔ, wa pankurunw bɛna kɛ fɛn ye min bɛ se ka sɔrɔ kosɛbɛ.

Ɲinan, gɔfɛrɛnaman bɛna ruble miliyari 250 ni kɔ bila walasa ka porogaramuba dɔ sigi senkan awiyɔn baarakɛlaw yiriwali kama.

Nafolo in bɛna kɛ ka awiyɔn ni ɛlikopɛri kura dilan, ka awiyɔn baarakɛlaw ka fɛn dilanni seko bonya. Ka fara o kan, ɲinan, gɔfɛrɛnaman bɛna dɔrɔmɛ miliyari 2,6 di walasa ka Il-114-300 awiyɔn saba fɔlɔw dafalenw dilan. Jɔrɔnanko porogaramu dɔ bɛna daminɛ awiyɔn baarakɛlaw ma minnu bɛ MS-21 awiyɔnw jate. Ka fara o kan, Mi-8 ɛlikopɛri 72 dilanni, n’olu bɛ kɛ ka mɔgɔ ta, o bɛna kɛ wari ye ka fara bolifɛnw, fiɲɛ anpuluw ani kisi baara kan yɔrɔjanw na ani yɔrɔ minnu tɛ se ka sɔrɔ.

An bɛna t’a fɛ ka fɛn bɛɛ kɛ walasa pankurunw ka kɛ jamana fan bɛɛ la ka se ka sɔrɔ an ka jamanadenw bolo.

Gofɛrɛnaman ye fanga di fɛɛrɛw ma walasa ka sɛnɛfɛnw di jamana kɔnɔ sugu ma. Dankarili min kɛra sɛnɛfɛn suguya dɔw bɔli la jamana kɔkan, o janyalen don fo san nata zanwuyekalo laban. Desizɔn dɔ fana tara min bɛna sɛnɛkɛlaw dɛmɛ foro baara senfɛ, ka sɔrɔ ka tiɲɛni bali jamana ni minisiriso baaradaw ma. Mikhail Mishustin taara bɔ kɔrɔnfɛla yɔrɔ janw ni Siberi maraw la. Yakutsk dugu kɔnɔ, gɔfɛrɛnaman ɲɛmɔgɔ ye Repibiliki ka kansɛri furakɛli dɔgɔtɔrɔso sɛgɛsɛgɛ, a ye baarakɛyɔrɔw ni laboratuwaraw ka baara dɔn yen, ka fara a ka kuma kan ni ŋaniyajira jɛkulu ka lasigidenw ye min tɔgɔ ye ko “Anti-Cancer.

Dɛmɛ don mɔgɔ kisilenw ma."

“Mɔgɔw ​​dɔrɔn de bɛ yan minnu bɛ ɲɛnamaya kɛ ni kɔnɔnajɛya ye walasa ka cogoyaw bɛɛ labɛn walasa ka baara kɛcogo ɲumanw sɔrɔ.”

Mikhail Mishustin fana taara dabɔjɛkulu la min tɔgɔ ye ko « Quarter of Labor ». Baarakɛda minnu bɛ baara kɛ filimu dilanni na, animation (ɲɛnamaya) la, wideyow tulonkɛ la, kunnafonidilanw na ani daɲɛw dilanni baara wɛrɛw la, olu bɛ yan. Gofɛrɛnaman ɲɛmɔgɔ ye kuma ta ni kulu in sigibagaw ye, ka dɛmɛ don fɛɛrɛ in na walasa ka kunnafonidilan dɔ sigi senkan kɔrɔnfɛla yɔrɔjanw kama Yakutia.

Gundo tɛ bi ko kunnafonidilanw, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la kunnafonidilan minnu bɛ se ka baara kɛ ani ka kɛ kulu ye, olu ye san kɛmɛ 21nan tulu kura, platini, fɛnɲɛnamafagalan kura ye. Tiɲɛ don, an ka kan k’o kɛ. Hakilila-jɔ-baarakɛlaw ka baarakɛminɛnw minnu bɛ baara kɛ kosɛbɛ, tiɲɛ don, olu mago bɛ kɔrɔnfɛla kulu kɔnɔ. An b’o dɛmɛ kosɛbɛ.

Taama laban na, Mikhail Mishustin ye baro kɛ Yakutia jamana ka sɔrɔko ni sigida yiriwali ni mara ɲɛmɔgɔ ye, n’o ye Aisen Nikolaev ye. Mikhail Mishustin ka baarakɛyɔrɔ taama nata kɛra Tyva jamana ye. Kyzyl dugu kɔnɔ, gɔfɛrɛnaman ɲɛmɔgɔ taara bɔ izini dɔ la, min bɛ kɛ ka bɛton barikamaw dilan. Repibiliki ka ladilikan ni sɛgɛsɛgɛli yɔrɔ la, gɔfɛrɛnaman ɲɛmɔgɔ ye baarakɛyɔrɔw sɛgɛsɛgɛ, ɲinini ni sɛgɛsɛgɛli suguya caman bɛ kɛ yɔrɔ minnu na, ka fara furakɛli ɲɛnabɔli yɔrɔ dɔ kan, u bɛ dɛmɛ don SVO lajɛbagaw ma yɔrɔ min na.

Jamanakuntigi ka porogaramu min ɲɛsinnen bɛ furakɛli fɔlɔw labɛnni ma bi, o y’a to kɛnɛyaso kura ba 6,5 ​​jɔli furakɛli fɔlɔw la nin san damadɔ in kɔnɔ. Ani fana, yɔrɔ ba 8 ɲɔgɔn jɔra kokura pewu ani ka kɛ bi ta ye.

Mikhail Mishustin fana taara bɔ cɛmancɛkalanso dɔ la min jɔra jamana ka porozɛ « Kalan » hukumu kɔnɔ. A ye kalansow, gafemarayɔrɔw, ani fana dumunikɛyɔrɔw sɛgɛsɛgɛ, lakɔlidon kalanso denmisɛnw bɛ tilelafana dun yɔrɔ min na.

lakɔli kura 1700 jɔra pewu, lakɔli 6500 ɲɔgɔn dilanna ka bila sira kan.

Mikhail Mishustin ye baro kɛ o mara in ka sigida ni sɔrɔ yiriwali kan ni Tyva jamana ɲɛmɔgɔ ye, n’o ye Vladislav Khovalyg ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 292 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-08 16:43:43 CEST
Dɔgɔtɔrɔso kura, dɔgɔtɔrɔsow ani kɛnɛyaso wɛrɛw bɛna jɔ Irisi maraw kɔnɔ. San saba nataw kɔnɔ, gɔfɛrɛnaman bɛna ruble miliyari 6 ni kɔ bila o baara ninnu na Mordovie, Kabardino-Balkaria, Magadan, Pskov, Rostov ani Chelyabinsk maraw la, ka fara Kamchatka ni Krasnoyarsk maraw kan.

A nafa ka bon an ka jamanadenw ka furakɛli kɛcogo ɲuman sɔrɔ waati bɛnnen na, u sigiyɔrɔ walima u sigiyɔrɔ mana kɛ min o min ye.

Jamana kɔnɔ awiyɔn baarakɛlaw ka kurunba bɛna t’a fɛ ka fɛn kuraw sɔrɔ, wa pankurunw bɛna kɛ fɛn ye min bɛ se ka sɔrɔ kosɛbɛ.

Ɲinan, gɔfɛrɛnaman bɛna ruble miliyari 250 ni kɔ bila walasa ka porogaramuba dɔ sigi senkan awiyɔn baarakɛlaw yiriwali kama.

Nafolo in bɛna kɛ ka awiyɔn ni ɛlikopɛri kura dilan, ka awiyɔn baarakɛlaw ka fɛn dilanni seko bonya. Ka fara o kan, ɲinan, gɔfɛrɛnaman bɛna dɔrɔmɛ miliyari 2,6 di walasa ka Il-114-300 awiyɔn saba fɔlɔw dafalenw dilan. Jɔrɔnanko porogaramu dɔ bɛna daminɛ awiyɔn baarakɛlaw ma minnu bɛ MS-21 awiyɔnw jate. Ka fara o kan, Mi-8 ɛlikopɛri 72 dilanni, n’olu bɛ kɛ ka mɔgɔ ta, o bɛna kɛ wari ye ka fara bolifɛnw, fiɲɛ anpuluw ani kisi baara kan yɔrɔjanw na ani yɔrɔ minnu tɛ se ka sɔrɔ.

An bɛna t’a fɛ ka fɛn bɛɛ kɛ walasa pankurunw ka kɛ jamana fan bɛɛ la ka se ka sɔrɔ an ka jamanadenw bolo.

Gofɛrɛnaman ye fanga di fɛɛrɛw ma walasa ka sɛnɛfɛnw di jamana kɔnɔ sugu ma. Dankarili min kɛra sɛnɛfɛn suguya dɔw bɔli la jamana kɔkan, o janyalen don fo san nata zanwuyekalo laban. Ɲɛfɔli surun
Tariku ja gɛlɛya min kɛra Virijini (Zunikalo san 2026):
Jamana 100% bɛ ja la (ka kɛɲɛ ni salon 0% ye).
Sɛnɛkɛla David Holla bɔnɛna a ka ɲɔsɛnɛ 15% ɲɔgɔn na k’a sababu kɛ jirisunw dɛsɛ ye jirisunba kan.
Ja in bɛ sen na kabini san 2025, o ye waati juguba filanan ye (Ɔkutɔburukalo-mɛkalo) kabini san 1940-41.
Sanji dɛsɛ ≈ 8 inch, jamana mago bɛ 8-12 inch walasa ka se ka kɛnɛya.
Dugukolo tila sabanan tɛ se ka jigin, wa ji kɔgɔ ka ca, o bɛ soja bila farati la.
Baganmarayɔrɔw ka dɔgɔ kosɛbɛ yɔrɔw la minnu ka ca ni 50% ye.
A kunba ye : Mangoro sɛnɛfɛn ‘ka ɲi nka a man ɲi’, o ye haminankoba ye soja la.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 318 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-06 17:53:22 CEST
Nin ye Bamanankan ASR Benchmark ye ka bɔ MALIBA-AI — jateminɛ kunnafonidilan min ka ɲi kosɛbɛ bamanankan kuma dɔnni kama. A kɔnɔ, sariyasunba sɛbɛnni yɔrɔ 500 bɛ sɔrɔ a kɔnɔ minnu sɛbɛnna studio la (~lɛrɛ 1) minnu fɔra cɛ kumalasela kelen fɛ.
I b’a fɛ ne ka mun kɛ ni nin ye? Ne bɛ se ka:
Donanw sɛgɛsɛgɛli — k’a doni ani ka waati janya jira, daɲɛw jatebɔ, misali lamɛntaw/sɛbɛnni fila-fila
Aw k’a lajɛ i ɲɛ na — segin janya jatew, daɲɛw fɔcogo, fɔlikan fɔcogo
A baaracogo ɲɛfɔ — ASR modɛli jateminɛni walima a labɛnni ɲuman kama
Aw k’a suma — n’aw ka TTS magow ye (kɔlɔsili: nin ye ASR data ye, TTS kanw tɛ)
Walima ni baara kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen dɔ b’i hakili la, i k’o fɔ n ye

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 321 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-06 12:15:07 CEST
O sɛnɛkɛlaw tɛ dugukolo kelen sɔrɔ walima hali kɔ, nka kabako don, u bɛ jɛgɛ ba caman lamɔ jirisunw kɔnɔ minnu bɛ panpan ji sanfɛ. Walasa ka o jɛgɛmarayɔrɔw jɔ minnu bɛ panpan, baarakɛlaw bɛ nɛgɛdaga gɛlɛnw jɔ ani ka plastiki barika belebele tan ni caman siri u jukɔrɔ walasa plateformew ka to ka pan ji sanfɛ. O kɔfɛ, u bɛ jɛgɛ barikamanbaw siri jirisunw duguma, ka ji jukɔrɔla jirisunba belebelebaw dilan minnu bɛ se ka jɛgɛ ba caman minɛ ani ka jikuruw ni jikuru barikamaw muɲu. Nafa min ka bon kosɛbɛ, o ye ji bɔli ye tuma bɛɛ ka tɛmɛn kaburuw kɔnɔ; Kɔgɔji walima bajiw bɛ na ni oksizɛni ye tuma bɛɛ ani ka nɔgɔw ko, o bɛ dɛmɛ don ka ji jogo sabati. Ni jɛgɛ bɛ balo tuma bɛɛ ani ka a mara cogo bɛnnen na, jɛgɛ bɛ falen joona nin sɛnɛ kɛcogo la min ɲɔgɔn tɛ yen min bɛ panpan.”

Nafa min ka bon kosɛbɛ, o ye ji bɔli ye tuma bɛɛ ka tɛmɛn kaburuw kɔnɔ; Kɔgɔji walima bajiw bɛ na ni oksizɛni ye tuma bɛɛ ani ka nɔgɔw ko, o bɛ dɛmɛ don ka ji jogo sabati. Ni jɛgɛ bɛ balo tuma bɛɛ ani ka a mara cogo bɛnnen na, jɛgɛ bɛ falen joona nin sɛnɛ kɛcogo la min ɲɔgɔn tɛ yen min bɛ panpan.”

Waati: 2026-08-06 11:11:18 CEST

White House y’a jaabi ko Trump “bɛ baganmaralaw kanu”, nka ko dɔ farali ye fɛnw sɔrɔli kan, o de ye sɔngɔw dɔgɔyali fɛɛrɛ ɲuman ye.  Sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛ ka dɛmɛnko layidu talen in kunnafoni makɔnɔ hali bi, o min bilala kɔfɛ ka da gɔfɛrɛnaman ka baara dabila kan.

Sinuwa ye sɛgɛsɛgɛli daminɛ san 2024 Awirilikalo la, Erɔpu nɔnɔfɛnw (foromazi ni krɛmɛ tulumafɛnw) dɛmɛni kan, k’a kɛ UE ka tarifuw waleɲumandɔn ye Sinuwa kuran mɔbiliw kan.

Desanburukalo san 2025: Waatilatigɛ tarifuw kɛra 21,9%–42,7% ye.

San 2026 feburuyekalo: Tarifu labanw jigira ka se 7,4%–11,7% ma san duuru kɔnɔ.

Kuran mɔbiliw ta fan fɛ : UE ka tarifu labanw san 2024 ɔkutɔburukalo la (fo ~35%), o kɔfɛ, bɛnkansɛbɛn dɔ kɛra san 2026 zanwuyekalo la min bɛ sira di “sɔngɔ fitininw layidu talenw” ma, k’a kɛ fɛɛrɛ wɛrɛ ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 356 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-08-05 18:09:15 CEST
Grégoire Cardon ye jɛgɛmarala ye Sarthe, Faransi, a ka baara kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen don Azi koi jɛgɛ masirilenw ladonni na kabini san 20 ɲɔgɔn.

A bɛ dumuni di u ma sɔgɔma o sɔgɔma.

Jɛgɛ denmisɛnninw (u si bɛ kalo 10 ɲɔgɔn bɔ) .

U bɛ tila kɔfɛ: minnu cɛ ka ɲi kosɛbɛ, olu bɛ lamɔ, dɔw bɛ feere.

Sugu dan ye (foro 10 ɲɔgɔn dɔrɔn de bɛ Faransi), wa a sɔngɔ bɛ daminɛ ɛrɔ damadɔ la ka se ɛrɔ 5000 ma jɛgɛ kelen na.

Jɛgɛ masirilenw bɛ a ka sɔrɔ 40% bɔ, wa a bɛ feere fana ɛntɛrinɛti kan.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 367 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-05 11:03:46 CEST
Sɔgɔma o sɔgɔma, Gregoire Cardon bɛ tugu o laadalakow kelen de kɔ. Balo daga dɔ min bɛ kɛ ka koi jɛgɛ balo, Azi jɛgɛ masirilen dɔ. Baganmara bɛ daminɛ nin kɔ in na, min bɛ ni ji kɔnɔ kɔnɔw kɛlɛli nɛgɛ ye, bawo koiw barika ka dɔgɔ hali bi nin waati in na.

Jɛgɛ ninnu si bɛ kalo tan ɲɔgɔn Bɔ. A bangera Mɛkalo/Zunikalo san 2013. A bɛna ɲini, ka lajɛ ani ka tilatila sɔɔni. Dɔw, minnu cɛ ka ɲi, olu bɛna segin kɔ la ka falen, dɔw bɛna feere. Olu ye jɛgɛw ye minnu ma Se u sàn fɔlɔ ma fɔlɔ.

A bɛ san mugan bɔ, jɛgɛmarala dɔ denkɛ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen don nin suguba in na. Olu tan dɔrɔn de bɛ Faransi. A ka kanuya min bɛ nin jɛgɛ kulɛri caman ninnu na, o ye wari bilali ye min bɛ nafa lase a ma. Jɛgɛ dɔw bɛ feere ɛrɔ damadɔ la, dɔw sɔngɔ ka gɛlɛn dɔɔnin, jɛgɛ bisaba ɲɔgɔn bɛ feere 5000 na.

Nin ye "hi utsuri" jɛgɛ ye; O kɔrɔ ye ko bilen ni nɛrɛma Zapɔnkan na. A ka ɲi kosɛbɛ, taamasiyɛn nɛrɛmaw jɛlen don kosɛbɛ, i n’a fɔ u jalen don tigitigi kosɛbɛ. Kulɛriw bɛ sabati wa u tɛ ban. Tiɲɛ na, jɛgɛ min ka ɲi kosɛbɛ, wa a bɛ feere ɛrɔ 150 ɲɔgɔn na.

Sannikɛlaw ye jɛgɛ lajɛbagaw ni dɔnnikɛlaw ye minnu bɛ Bɔ Bɛliziki walima Faransi. Sugu bɛ ka bonya tuma bɛɛ. Jɛgɛmaralaw yɛrɛ b’u feere ɛntɛrinɛti kan.

Kunnafonidila dɔ ye koi jɛgɛ 10 kulu dɔ komandi, u janya bɛ santimɛtɛrɛ 7 ni 10 cɛ. O la, an bɛna u labɛn ani k’u kɛ kɛsu kɔnɔ, u labɛnnen don ka ci teliya la.

Bi, koi ni jɛgɛ masirilen wɛrɛw bɛ Gregoire Cardon ka feereli 40% bɔ. Jɛgɛ min sɔngɔ ka gɛlɛn kosɛbɛ, o sɔngɔ bɛ se ka se ɛrɔ 5000 ma.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 368 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-05 11:03:43 CEST

Jɛgɛ ninnu si bɛ kalo tan ɲɔgɔn Bɔ. A bangera Mɛkalo/Zunikalo san 2013. A bɛna ɲini, ka lajɛ ani ka tilatila sɔɔni. Dɔw, minnu cɛ ka ɲi, olu bɛna segin kɔ la ka falen, dɔw bɛna feere. Olu ye jɛgɛw ye minnu ma Se u sàn fɔlɔ ma fɔlɔ.

A bɛ san mugan bɔ, jɛgɛmarala dɔ denkɛ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen don nin suguba in na. Olu tan dɔrɔn de bɛ Faransi. A ka kanuya min bɛ nin jɛgɛ kulɛri caman ninnu na, o ye wari bilali ye min bɛ nafa lase a ma. Jɛgɛ dɔw bɛ feere ɛrɔ damadɔ la, dɔw sɔngɔ ka gɛlɛn dɔɔnin, jɛgɛ bisaba ɲɔgɔn bɛ feere 5000 na.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 369 — Kuma fasaralen

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 371 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-05 10:08:08 CEST
Sogo bilenman sɔngɔ sera Ameriki jamana na, a hakɛ min ma deli ka sɔrɔ fɔlɔ. Jamanakuntigi Trump y’a jira k’a b’a fɛ ka dɔ fara kosɛbɛ misisogo dontaw kan ka bɔ Arzantine (a bɛ se ka kɛ u siɲɛ naani ye) walasa ka sɔngɔ dɔgɔya feerekɛlaw bolo, k’a jate ko Arzantine ye jɛɲɔgɔn ɲuman ye.

O laseli in kɛra sababu ye ka misiw sɔngɔ dɔgɔya kosɛbɛ Ameriki kɔnɔ.

CBS kunnafonisɛbɛn cibaa Lana Zak ye kunnafoni di sɛnɛkɛlaw ka kɛwale kan Iowa (Amerika sɛnɛko dusukun na):
Caterpillars i n’a fɔ Perlin ani Pete Wopter labanna ka tɔnɔ sɔrɔli makɔnɔ san caman bɔnɛ kɔfɛ, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, soja ni ɲɔ sɔngɔw ye nɔba bila jago kɛlɛ la ni Sinuwa ye.

U y’a jate ko Trump ka latigɛ in ye bɔnɛ ye u bolo, k’a fɔ ko a ka « Ameriki fɔlɔ » politiki n’a ka tarifuw laɲini ye ka jamana kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw dɛmɛ, nka ko fɛnw donna jamana kɔnɔ ka caya, o bɛ ka tiɲɛni kɛ u la.

Brian Wiley, n’o ye Iowa misitigiw ka tɔn ɲɛmɔgɔ ye, o y’a jira ko nin hakɛ faralen in bɛna kɛ Ameriki ka sɔrɔ bɛɛ lajɛlen kɛmɛsarada la fitinin dɔrɔn ye (2,5% ɲɔgɔn) wa a tɛna dɔ bɔ kosɛbɛ suguba sɔngɔw la.

White House y’a jaabi ko Trump “bɛ baganmaralaw kanu”, nka ko dɔ farali ye fɛnw sɔrɔli kan, o de ye sɔngɔw dɔgɔyali fɛɛrɛ ɲuman ye.  Sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛ ka dɛmɛnko layidu talen in kunnafoni makɔnɔ hali bi, o min bilala kɔfɛ ka da gɔfɛrɛnaman ka baara dabila kan.

Nka jamanakuntigi Trump ka cɛsiri ka misisogo ladon ka bɔ Arzantine walasa ka musaka dɔgɔya, o ye misisogo ye min bɛ ka bonya Heartland kɔnɔ. Hee yen, Jericka. I n’a fɔ aw b’a dɔn cogo min na, tarifuw ni jago kɛlɛw ye soja sɔngɔ tiɲɛ pewu, nka misiw tun bɛ ka segin a cogo kɔrɔ la. O kɔrɔ ye ko fo ka na Se bì ma. Don. Don. San damadɔw wari bɔnɛnen kɔfɛ misiw la, Berlin ni Pete Wobetter tun bɛ ka tɔnɔ sɔrɔ. U bɛ ɲɔ ni soja fana sɛnɛ, o feereli minnu tiɲɛna jago kɛlɛ min bɛ senna ni Sinuwa ye. A nafa ka bon i bolo cogo di ko misiw ka sɔrɔ i la k’a sɔrɔ soja ni ɲɔ tɛ taa ɲɛ kosɛbɛ?

Ayiwa, a bɛna bɔ san de la, nka ɲinan, o de ye fɛn kelen ye min bɛna wari suguya bɛɛ sɔrɔ an ye.

 O la, Wobetterw kabakoyara tuma min na jamanakuntigi Trump y’a jira k’a b’a fɛ ka misisogo dontaw caya siɲɛ naani ka bɔ Arzantine.

N’an y’o kɛ, o bɛna an ka misisogo sɔngɔ jigin. A tun bɛna Arzantine dɛmɛ, an b’a jate jamana ɲumanba ye, jɛɲɔgɔn ɲumanba.

A ka kumaw ye misiw sɔngɔw bila ka jigin kosɛbɛ. Suguba kɔnɔ, sogo sɔngɔ wulila san fɛ san tɛmɛnnen kɔnɔ. Misi sogo mugulen wulila ka se 13% ma, sogo wulilen wulila 16%.

Aw ka kan ka fɛnw dilancogo bɛɛ lajɛlen lajɛ.

Bryan Whaley ye Iowa misitigiw ka tɔn ɲɛmɔgɔba ye. A ko Amerikikaw tɛna dumuniko bolomafara ye tiɲɛ na ka bɔ misisogo dontaw caya la.

Tiɲɛ na, a bɛna kɛ 2,5% ɲɔgɔn ye an ka misisogo bɛɛ lajɛlen na. Tiɲɛ na, a tɛna danfaraba don.

Wobetterw n'u sigiɲɔgɔnw ko u jigi tigɛlen don ko jamanakuntigi ka Ameriki fɔlɔ jago bolodalen tɛ u sen don a la.

Tarifuw kun bɛɛ tun ye ka sɛnɛfɛnw lasegin so.  Donc (o la) an bɛ misisogo Bɔ yan, sisan a b’a ɲini ka dɔ Kɛ k’o sɛnɛfɛn in Tiɲɛ.

An bɛ baara kɛ ni an ye ani ka an tɔɔrɔ i n’a fɔ fɛn dilannikɛlaw.

A bɛ kɛ i n’a fɔ an ye piyɔniye ye tulon dɔ la an tɛna se sɔrɔ min kan.

Sisan, White House kunnafonidilaw ka sekeretɛri ko jamanakuntigi Trump “bɛ baganmaralaw kanu”, nka ko dɔ farali misisogo sɔrɔli kan, o de ye sɔngɔw jigincogo ɲuman ye. O waati kelen na, sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛɛ bɛ ka o dɛmɛn layidu talen in kunnafoni makɔnɔ hali bi, min bilala sen kan k’a sababu kɛ gɔfɛrɛnaman ka baara dabila ye. Jericka ye?

A ka ɲi, Lana Zak anw ye bi su in na. A' ni cɛ.

N tun ye kamalennin ye tuma min na...an donna Faransi sɔrɔdasiw la. U y’an bila ka taa Vietnam. An tun bɛ marifaw ta... N ye Faransi faama dɔ faga, an y’an labɛn ka boli. O kɔ, u y’an ɲininka an bɛ mun kɛ ni faransikaw ye, an y’a fɔ u ye ko marifaw b’an bolo. N tun bɛ baara kɛ ni n ka marifa ye... a bɛ marifa 250 ci lɛrɛ kɔnɔ... N tun bɛ baara kɛ n’a ye ka Vietnamkaw faga. U ye n ɲininka ko: «I ye mɔgɔ dɔ faga wa?» Ne y’u jaabi ko: “Ne ye mɔgɔ caman faga.” U y'a fɔ n ye ko : "Nin tɛ i ka jalaki ye, Faransi fanga tɛ yen." E min tun bɛ i n’a fɔ wuluwulu kunkolo fila, ka an joli min ani i ta... Nka sisan, i nana an fɛ, an y’i bisimila. An tora u fɛ... N banna... tiɲɛ yɛrɛ la, an ye nipaya dege Vietnam. Vietnam musow minnu bɛ Maroc, olu sigilen bɛ n’u somɔgɔw ye dugu misɛnnin dɔ la min tɔgɔ ye ko “Chinese Roundabout” Sinuwaw ka dugu la, Sidi Yahya El Gharb. Ne kelen bɛ ni wulu caman ye... Muso bɛ to so dɔrɔn de la, ka tobili kɛ, ka dumuni kɛ.

Waati: 2026-08-04 20:50:53 CEST
Jaamu kɔnɔ kuma fasaralen ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 422 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-04 20:46:24 CEST
Tuma min n tun bɛ kamalenya la waati min... an donna ka Faransi kɛlɛdenya la. U ye an ci ka taa Biyɛtnamu. Marifa b'an fɛ... ne ye Faransi faama dɔ faga u la, an ye an labɛn ka boli. O kɔfɛ an donda Biyɛtnamukɛw cɛma, u ye an sɔrɔ ka an bisimila, u ye an deli an ka maana fɔ u ye. An ye u fɔ u ye ko Faransi ye an ka masakɛ gɛn, wa an tun tɛ foyi dɔn fo Ala, faso, ni Masakɛ. O kɔfɛ u ye an ɲinika an tun bɛ mun kɛ Faransikɛw fɛ, an y'a fɔ u ye ko an tun bɛ marifaw ta. Ne tun bɛ ne ka marifa baara... a bɛ kisɛ 250 ci sanga kelen kɔnɔ... ne tun bɛ Biyɛtnamukɛw sɔrɔ n'a ye. U ye ne ɲinika: "I ye mɔgɔ faga wa?" Ne ye u jaabi: "Ne ye mɔgɔ caman faga." U ye a fɔ ne ye ko: "O te i juru ye, ayi Faransi ka nɔ don." O Min tun bɛ i n'a fɔ koronkosa kun fila, a bɛ an ni aw joli min... nka ni aw nana an fɛ sisan, an ye aw bisimila. An tola u fɛ... u tun tɛ sɔn dunaw k'u ka furu kɛ Biyɛtnam musow la, nka u sɔnna o ma anw ye , ani Alizerikaw ni Tinizikaw ye. Ninnu Marɔkukaw ka maana  ye a damanako ye kosɛbɛ... u ye Kɛlɛ kɛ ɛndusinuwa kɛlɛ la (1946-1954). Ka fara Faransi kan fɔlɔ, o kɔfɛ a juguya la... saani u ka segin Marɔku an' u ka Biyɛtnam musow. San 1972 kɔnɔ... kulu fɔlɔ sera Marɔku U ye ne ni ne denw lase ne somaaw ka so... den naani tun bɛ ne fɛ o waati... an tun ye mɔgɔ wɔɔrɔ ye. An kɛra dunaw ye n somaaba dɔ fɛ... o tun ka ca... Wa Don dɔ ne taara Rabati. Wa tuma min na ni Ne tun bɛ n ka maana lakali ... u tun bɛ wari dɔ di ne ma nka ne tun bɛ ban... Ka da a kan ne tun bɛ baara dɔ ɲini n bɛ n ka siniɲɛsigi dilan ni min ye  Wa U y' a jira n na ko n ka kɔlɔsili baara kɛ... ka baara kɛ kɔsɛbɛ ... ne ma sɔn o ma... Tiɲɛ na an ye nibaya dɔn Biyɛtnam. Biyɛtnam musow bɛ balo Marɔku ni u ka somɔgɔw ye dugu misɛn dɔ kɔnɔ... a tɔgɔ ko "Douar Chinois" sinuwa dugu Sidi Yahya El Gharb mara kɔnɔ. Ne kelen ye alikaama caman kan... a bɛ i n'a fɔ cɛ... ne kɛra cɛ ye ne cɛ salen kɔfɛ. Marɔku kɔnɔ, bɛɛ bɛ a jigi da cɛw kan... nka Biyɛtnamkaw, ayi... cɛ ni muso bɛ baara kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ... Faransi fana bɛ ten... muso bɛ to so kɔnɔ, ka tobili kɛ ani ka dumuni kɛ dɔrɔn.

Ka i wele, Mariyama, i ka ɲɛtaa kosɔn. Kantigiya la i ka siniɲɛsigi la, an bɛɛ bɛna kɛ kelen ye. Dɔgɔkun, laɲini, dannaya, ka ɲɛnamaya kɛ Afiriki kelenyalen kɔnɔ. Ni suw banna Wa anw, ni u tɛ yen, an jijalen don ka sa yen. Afiriki ta fan fɛ ani e fɛ, Mali, an ka darapo ye hɔrɔnya ye.

Afiriki ta fan fɛ ani e fɛ, Mali, an ka kɛlɛ de ye kɛlɛ ye. Mali la bi, Mali la sini. Dɔnkiliw bɛ falen ni jigiya ye, kɛlɛcɛw bɛ fiɲɛ jeni.

Cɛw, jamanakuntigi tɛmɛnenw, jamanakuntigiw, jamanadenw ka seliba laban. Aw ka na a lajɛ! Subtitling Société Radio-Canada.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 448 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-03 05:41:19 CEST
ɲɔgɔn

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 449 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-03 05:40:49 CEST
Walasa ka binkɛnɛw lakana, Mongoli kɔnɔna na, binkɛnɛ miliyɔn 970 donna dɔɔnin dɔɔnin kaban baganmara waati la k’a daminɛ awirilikalo tile fɔlɔ. Chagan, min ye baganmarala ye Jinnar dugu la, Ujimqin kɔrɔnyanfan fɛ, baganmarayɔrɔ bɛ yen min ka ca ni 13 000 acres ye. Misi 100 ni kɔ ni saga 200 ni kɔ bɛ lamɔ jɔnya la, wa sagaden 200 ni kɔ de ta kɛra sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli waati la. A tun bɛ balo bin tɔni kelen dɔrɔn de dun tile kɔnɔ, wa a ma mɛn, danfara donna. O kɔfɛ, a ye dumunifɛnw ɲagaminen dafalenw kulu dɔ san Knight Grass Processing and Disaster Disaster Distribution Center fɛ. Nin dumuni ɲagaminen dafalen in ye ka shɔ, fɛnɲɛnamafagalan, jolisegindumuniw ani witaminiw ɲagami ɲɔgɔn na pewu ka kɛɲɛ ni dɔnniya formula ye. Ni aw ye misiw balo ni nin dumuni nafama in ye, o bɛ se ka kɛ sababu ye ka kilo fila fo kilo naani girinya don o don. Dumuni kɛcogo bɛ surunya ni tila ye. Kungolo kelen ka fasa nafa bɛ bonya ni yuan 3000 ni kɔ ye. Sisan, Dongwuzhu The Muqinqi Forage Processing and Disaster Resistance Distribution Center bɛ se ka dumunikɛminɛnw ɲagaminen dafalen tɔni 120 dilan don o don. Nafa jɛlenw bɛ dumuni dafalenw ɲagaminen na musakaw ni balofɛnw hakɛ dɔgɔyali la, ani dɔnniya siratigɛ la, u bɛ dumuni duman ɲɛ. Jatebɔ baara kama, an ye a daminɛ na, fɛnw lasecogo fu sigi senkan kilomɛtɛrɛ 45 kɔnɔ. Narisu y’a jira kunnafonidilaw la ko laadala yɛrɛladonni fɛɛrɛw tiɲɛni hakɛ bɛ 5% ɲɔgɔn na caman na. Dumuni dafalenw ɲagaminen bɛ se ka dɔ bɔ a nafa la ka se 1% ma, o ye fɛn ye min bɛ se ka kɛ sababu ye ka baganmara ni bin lakanani kɛ. Kɛlɛ : Reserve basigiyɔrɔ bi duuru ani baarakɛyɔrɔ 18 jɔra Wuzhumuqin kɔrɔnyanfan fɛ walasa ka baganmara ni a dicogo dɔ sigi senkan min bɛ kɛ kulu saba kɔnɔ. San o san nafolo maralen seko ye tɔni 24.000 ye, ani baarakɛcogo ni fɛn caman tigɛli seko ye tɔni 400.000 ye. Ni an y’an jigi da jamana ka Hegacha jɛ-ka-baara baganmarayɔrɔ kan, bin tigɛyɔrɔ bɛ se mɛtɛrɛ 600.000 ɲɔgɔn ma san kɔnɔ, san kɔnɔ, balo ɲuman tɔni 40.000 ɲɔgɔn bɛ sɔrɔ. Nafolo bilali laɲinitaw bɛ kɛ walasa ka marabolow ka waati balodɛsɛw ni sɔngɔ jiginniw kunbɛn, walasa ka bin sɔngɔ juguw kunbɛn ni caya ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 461 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-02 23:43:57 CEST
Sɔgɔma baganmara dabila : Baganmara dabila/lafiɲɛbɔ waati bɛ daminɛ baganmarayɔrɔ miliyɔn 970 na Mongoli kɔnɔna na walasa ka sigida lakana.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 462 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-02 23:41:24 CEST
Sɔgɔma baganmara dabila : Baganmara dabila/lafiɲɛbɔ waati bɛ daminɛ baganmarayɔrɔ miliyɔn 970 na Mongoli kɔnɔna na walasa ka sigida lakana.

Yɛlɛma donna kalanko la dankarili waati la: 

Baganmaralaw bɛ wuli ka taa balo la jirisunw kɔnɔ ni Totally Mixed Forage (TMR) ye .

Nafa minnu bɛ balo ɲagaminen na (TMR):

A bɛ dɔ fara misiw girinya kan don o don ani ka fasa waati surunya ni tila ye.

Kungolo kelen tɔnɔ bɛ bonya ka tɛmɛ 3000 yuan kan.

A bɛ balo tiɲɛni dɔgɔya ka bɔ 5% na ka se 1% ma.

Dɛmɛ ni fɛnw dilancogo:

Ka fɛn marayɔrɔ 50 sigi sen kan ani ka baarakɛyɔrɔ 18 sigi senkan minnu ka baarakɛcogo ka bon kosɛbɛ.

Balo lasecogo fu dili ma kilomɛtɛrɛ 45 kɔnɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 463 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-08-02 23:41:16 CEST
Sɔgɔma baganmara dabila : Baganmara dabila/lafiɲɛbɔ waati bɛ daminɛ baganmarayɔrɔ miliyɔn 970 na Mongoli kɔnɔna na walasa ka sigida lakana.

Yɛlɛma donna kalanko la dankarili waati la: 

Baganmaralaw bɛ wuli ka taa balo la jirisunw kɔnɔ ni Totally Mixed Forage (TMR) ye .

A bɛ dɔ fara misiw girinya kan don o don ani ka fasa waati surunya ni tila ye.

Kungolo kelen tɔnɔ bɛ bonya ka tɛmɛ 3000 yuan kan.

A bɛ balo tiɲɛni dɔgɔya ka bɔ 5% na ka se 1% ma.

O de kosɔn, Port Douglas min bɛ Arizona, o dabɔra kokura baganw ladonni kama (a yɔrɔ ka jan bana in bɔyɔrɔ la) ni kɔlɔsili gɛlɛn ye min tora senna, nka k’a sɔrɔ a ma sebaaya laban fɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 551 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-31 22:23:53 CEST
Sɛnɛ kanpaɲi 2026-2027, mara kɔlɔsili cidenyabaara dɔ bɔra Kita, o taara bɔ ɲɔ, manje ani bɔgɔ foro dɔw la walasa ka kanpaɲi daminɛcogo ɲuman kɔlɔsi ani k’a jateminɛ mara kɔnɔ ani fana ka ko kɛlenw sɛgɛsɛgɛ. Mahamadi Aliou Barry, bataki cilen.

Nin taama in bɔra mara ɲɛmɔgɔba Daouda Maïga fɛ ka na ɲininkali kɛ san 2026-2027 sɛnɛko kanpaɲi ɲɛtaa kan Kita mara kɔnɔ. O cogo la, a ye baro kɛ ni bololabaarakɛlaw ni sɛnɛfɛnw dilannikɛlaw ye sɛnɛfɛnw marali kan minnu bɛ dɛmɛ sɔrɔ. Kɔlɔsili fɔlɔ ye ko sɛnɛfɛnw cogoya bɛ mɔgɔ hakili sigi hali ni sanji tilatilali man ɲi.

An nisɔndiyara kosɛbɛ nin taama in na ka bɔ jamanakuntigi fɛ. O la, an bɛ dɛmɛ ɲini faamaw fɛ walasa ka fɛnw lase teliya la.

Ne dalen b’a la ko jamanakuntigi ka taama in sababu fɛ, anw sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛna jaabi ɲuman sɔrɔ, bawo cotton sɛnɛfɛnw bɛ bɔli tilancɛ la.

Cidenjɛkulu sera k’o ye u yɛrɛ ɲɛ na, u kɛlen ka taa Amarou Diara ni Mamby Kamisoko ka ɲɔ, manje ani bɔgɔdaga forow la. Dunanw ko u ye min ye, o ye u kabakoya.

Kanpaɲi in ye waati dɔɔnin sɔrɔ n’i y’a suma ni san 2025 kanpaɲi ye. O sababu bɛ bɔ sanjiko cogoya la sisan, bawo sɛnɛfɛnw dilannikɛlaw bɛ ka danni kɛ sanjiko cogoya hakɛ la.

An ye sanji fɔlɔw sɛbɛn Mɛkalo la, nka hali bi an ye ja waati damadɔ sɔrɔ Zuwɛnkalo la. Nka o tɛ foyi ye, ni sanfɛla danfaralenw sɛbɛnni ye, uh, sanji, sɛnɛfɛnw dilannikɛlaw cɛsirilen don sɛnɛfɛnw sɛnɛni na.

An nana o de kama, k’a fɔ sɛnɛkɛlaw ye ko an bɛ fɛn o fɛn kɛ, an ka sɔrɔ bɛ fɛn o fɛn sɔrɔ, o bɛɛ bɛ bɔ u ka baara de la kosɛbɛ. O la, walasa k’u jija, an bɛ min kɛ ɲɛmɔgɔyaso la, aw k’o fɔ u ye, ka jagɛlɛya ni yɛrɛsara caman fana ɲini u fɛ walasa ɲinan kanpaɲi ka yeelen bɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 588 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-30 19:11:17 CEST
Nafolo minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ ka lajɛ kuncɛlen (san 2026 zuluyekalo tile 29): A ɲɛmɔgɔya tun bɛ: Jenerali Asimi Goita bolo.

Desizɔn minnu ka bon kosɛbɛ : Ka Nafolo finiko tɔn sigi senkan walasa ka cotton caman sɛmɛntiya sigida la (a bɛ se ka tɔni ba 40 kɛ san o san) walasa ka nafa faralen ni baarakɛyɔrɔw di.
Mɔgɔ caman sigili lafasali la, marabolow marali la (Lesgo, Diwela ani Kutiala prefetw), jamana kɔkankow, kɛnɛyako, kalanko sanfɛla, ani sɛnɛko la.

Kumaɲɔgɔnya kunbabaw : Gofɛrɛnaman ka baarakɛta bolodalen waleyali san 2025-2026 : 43,43% dafara.
Ka bolonɔ bila bɛnkan 21 na ni Maroko ye.
Mali bɛ segin ka sugandi ka kɛ Afiriki jɛkafɔ tɔnba ɲɛmɔgɔso la.
Dengue banakisɛw bɛ dɔgɔya, wele bila ka bana kunbɛn.
Kamalenninw ka ko kɛtaw hɛrɛ ni lakana kan Awirilikalo la.

Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman
Zuluyekalo tile 26, nɛgɛ kanɲɛ 18:00
Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara. Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔko jɔnjɔnw ni latigɛw digest kɔnɔ:

✅Gofɛrɛnaman bɛna Belgorod mara dɛmɛ walasa a ka fanga sɔrɔyɔrɔw baara sabatili ka sabati. O mara in bɛna ruble miliyari 8,6 ni kɔ sɔrɔ ka ɲɛsin modulari bojiw sanni ma, mobili modulari substations, ani kuran transformateurw sanni na.

✅Sɛnɛyɔrɔ kura ni baarakɛyɔrɔ kura bɛna bɔ Khakassia ni Tatarstan. Gofɛrɛnaman ye dɛmɛ don fɛɛrɛ fila ma sɔrɔko yɔrɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw yiriwali kama.

✅Irisi jamana bɛna dɔ fara jamana kɔnɔ fɛn ɲumanw sɔrɔli kan. O kama, gɔfɛrɛnaman ye jamana ka porogaramu ladilan sɛnɛ yiriwali kama. Foro misɛnnin minnu b’a fɛ ka porozɛw kɛ walasa ka nɔnɔ sɛnɛ teliya, olu bɛna dɛmɛ sɔrɔ min bɛ se miliyɔn 265 ma. O nafolo ninnu bɛ se ka kɛ ka dɔ fara sagakulu hakɛ kan, ka minɛnw san, ani ka balo dɛsɛw ɲɛnabɔ.  Ka fara o kan, dɛmɛ bɛ di sɛnɛkɛlaw ma minnu bɛ bɔ dankan maraw la ani sɛnɛfɛnw dilannikɛlaw minnu sen bɛ SVO la.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 609 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-30 11:17:31 CEST
Gofɛrɛnaman bɛna Belgorod mara dɛmɛ walasa a ka fanga ni nafamafɛnw baara sabatili ka se ka kɛ. O mara in bɛna tɛmɛ ruble miliyari 8,5 kan, ka ɲɛsin boji modulari sow sanni ma, mobili modulari substation ani kuran transformateurw sanni na.

Gofɛrɛnaman bɛ dɛmɛ wajibiyalenw di walasa ka sɛnɛfɛnw, fanga ni sow ani sigida baarakɛyɔrɔw ka baara kɛ, walasa sow, denmisɛnninw ka lakɔlisow, denmisɛnw ka dɔgɔtɔrɔsow, dɔgɔtɔrɔsow ani baarada wɛrɛw minnu nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ dugudenw bolo, kuran, ji ani funteni ka sɔrɔ.

Industriw ni baara kura bɛna bɔ Khakassia ani Tatarstan. Gofɛrɛnaman ye dɛmɛ don fɛɛrɛ fila ma sɔrɔko yɔrɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw yiriwali kama. Sɔrɔko yɔrɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen kura “Khakassian Technological Valley” bɛna dabɔ Sayanogorsk mara la ani Beysky minisiriso mara la. Sosiyete duuru bɛna kɛ a sigibagaw ye. U bɛna baara kɛ aliminiyɔmu baara la, ka fara papiye ni bololanɛgɛw dilanni kan. San 2035 laban na, waridon hakɛ bɛna tɛmɛ ruble miliyari 25 kan.

 Baarakɛyɔrɔ 900 ɲɔgɔn bɛna dabɔ. Sɔrɔko yɔrɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen “Green Valley” min bɛ Tatarstan, o fana bɛna bonya. A bolodara ka porozɛ 8 waleya o yɔrɔ kura in kan, minnu bɛ tali kɛ biyoteknoloji, petoroli ani fɛnɲɛnamafagalanw baara jugumanba siratigɛ la. Sigida mɔgɔ kuraw ka wari bilalen hakɛ bɛna se miliyari 300 ɲɔgɔn ma. Baarakɛyɔrɔ 1800 ni kɔ bɛna dabɔ sɛnɛko la.

Porozɛ minnu bɛ waleya nin minɛn in sababu la, tiɲɛ na, olu bɛ nɔ ɲuman bila an ka jamana sɔrɔko yiriwali la san caman kɔnɔ, o la, dɛmɛ don ka waridonnaw ​​sama ka na maraw kɔnɔ, ka baarakɛda kuraw da yen, ka dɔ fara baarakɛyɔrɔw hakɛ kan, wa o kɔrɔ ye ka mɔgɔw ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲɛ.

 So kɔnɔ fɛn minnu ka ɲi kosɛbɛ, olu bɛna caya Irisi jamana na. O kama, gɔfɛrɛnaman ye jamana ka porogaramu ladilan sɛnɛ yiriwali kama. Foro misɛnnin minnu b’a fɛ ka porozɛw kɛ walasa ka nɔnɔforo teliya, dɛmɛ bɛna di olu ma, min hakɛ bɛ se miliyɔn 265 ma. O nafolo ninnu bɛ se ka kɛ sababu ye ka dɔ fara baganw hakɛ kan, ka minɛnw san ani ka balo sɔrɔcogo ko ɲɛnabɔ. Sɛnɛkɛla minnu bɛ baara kɛ dankan maraw la, olu bɛna se ka gɔfɛrɛnaman ka dɛmɛ sɔrɔ nɔnɔ dilanni na.

Sɛnɛkɛla minnu bɛ SVO la, olu bɛna sɔn ka bolomafaraw baara waati janya ni kalo 12 ye, o la, n’u ye nafolo sɔrɔ togodala burufefeereso fitinin dɔ dabɔli kama, sɛnɛ yiriwali, sɛnɛko turisimu ani nɔnɔforo teliya.

An jigi b’a kan ko fɛn minnu bɛna wuli, olu bɛna dɛmɛ ka baarakɛcogo ɲuman sabati sɛnɛko siratigɛ la, ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli hakɛ kan sɛnɛko la, walasa an ka jamanadenw ka se ka jamana kɔnɔ dumunifɛn ɲumanw sugandi.

Porozɛ minnu bɛ waleya nin minɛn in sababu la, tiɲɛ na, olu bɛ nɔ ɲuman bila an ka jamana sɔrɔko yiriwali la san caman kɔnɔ, o la, dɛmɛ don ka waridonnaw ​​sama ka na maraw kɔnɔ, ka baarakɛda kuraw da yen, ka dɔ fara baarakɛyɔrɔw hakɛ kan, wa o kɔrɔ ye ka mɔgɔw ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲɛ.

So kɔnɔ fɛn minnu ka ɲi kosɛbɛ, olu bɛna caya Irisi jamana na. O kama, gɔfɛrɛnaman ye jamana ka porogaramu ladilan sɛnɛ yiriwali kama. Foro misɛnnin minnu b’a fɛ ka porozɛw kɛ walasa ka nɔnɔforo teliya, dɛmɛ bɛna di olu ma, min hakɛ bɛ se miliyɔn 265 ma. O nafolo ninnu bɛ se ka kɛ sababu ye ka dɔ fara baganw hakɛ kan, ka minɛnw san ani ka balo sɔrɔcogo ko ɲɛnabɔ. Sɛnɛkɛla minnu bɛ baara kɛ dankan maraw la, olu bɛna se ka gɔfɛrɛnaman ka dɛmɛ sɔrɔ nɔnɔ dilanni na.

Sɛnɛkɛla minnu bɛ SVO la, olu bɛna sɔn ka bolomafaraw baara waati janya ni kalo 12 ye, o la, n’u ye nafolo sɔrɔ togodala burufefeereso fitinin dɔ dabɔli kama, sɛnɛ yiriwali, sɛnɛko turisimu ani nɔnɔforo teliya.

An jigi b’a kan ko fɛn minnu bɛna wuli, olu bɛna dɛmɛ ka baarakɛcogo ɲuman sabati sɛnɛko siratigɛ la, ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli hakɛ kan sɛnɛko la, walasa an ka jamanadenw ka se ka jamana kɔnɔ dumunifɛn ɲumanw sugandi.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 611 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-30 11:16:11 CEST
Gofɛrɛnaman bɛna Belgorod mara dɛmɛ walasa a ka fanga ni nafamafɛnw baara sabatili ka se ka kɛ. O mara in bɛna tɛmɛ ruble miliyari 8,5 kan, ka ɲɛsin boji modulari sow sanni ma, mobili modulari substation ani kuran transformateurw sanni na.

Gofɛrɛnaman bɛ dɛmɛ wajibiyalenw di walasa ka sɛnɛfɛnw, fanga ni sow ani sigida baarakɛyɔrɔw ka baara kɛ, walasa sow, denmisɛnninw ka lakɔlisow, denmisɛnw ka dɔgɔtɔrɔsow, dɔgɔtɔrɔsow ani baarada wɛrɛw minnu nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ dugudenw bolo, kuran, ji ani funteni ka sɔrɔ.

Industriw ni baara kura bɛna bɔ Khakassia ani Tatarstan. Gofɛrɛnaman ye dɛmɛ don fɛɛrɛ fila ma sɔrɔko yɔrɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw yiriwali kama. Sɔrɔko yɔrɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen kura “Khakassian Technological Valley” bɛna dabɔ Sayanogorsk mara la ani Beysky minisiriso mara la. Sosiyete duuru bɛna kɛ a sigibagaw ye. U bɛna baara kɛ aliminiyɔmu baara la, ka fara papiye ni bololanɛgɛw dilanni kan. San 2035 laban na, waridon hakɛ bɛna tɛmɛ ruble miliyari 25 kan.

Baarakɛyɔrɔ 900 ɲɔgɔn bɛna dabɔ. Sɔrɔko yɔrɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen “Green Valley” min bɛ Tatarstan, o fana bɛna bonya. #CIGMA #KUNNAFONIW | Baara ni baarakɛcogo kalan : yɛrɛbaarakɛminɛn 500 ani kalansɛbɛn 349 bɛ di kamalenninw ma minnu bɛ nafa sɔrɔ

Bamakɔ, zuluyekalo tile 28, san 2026

Madamu Oumou Sall Seck, n’o ye jamana ka baarakɛlaw, baara ani baarakɛlaw ka kalanko minisiri ye, ale de ye seli ɲɛminɛ, taratadon zuluyekalo tile 28 san 2026, walasa ka yɛrɛdɔn ni jagokɛminɛn 500 di ka fara kalansɛbɛn 349 kan baara ɲinini fɛɛrɛw (TRE), baarakɛlaw ni kunnafoniko siratigɛ la.

Kiti 500 ninnu bɛ seko ni dɔnko layidu talen caman ɲɛfɔ, i n’a fɔ sɛnɛfɛnw dilanni, sugu nakɔko, sapon, kalali, tulumafɛnw, kɔnɔw sɛnɛni, tigɛ ni sɔgɔli, minisiriso, pɔmpi, fototalan ani wuluwulufɛnw.

A ka kuma kɔnɔ, Madamu minisiri y’a jira kokura ko gɔfɛrɛnaman ka laɲini ye ka kamalenninw ka bɔnsɔn jɔ, minnu bɛ se kosɛbɛ, minnu bɛ se ka baara kɛ, ani minnu bɛ nafolo sɔrɔ, ka kɛɲɛ ni a ka yelifɛn ye, n’o ye sɔrɔdasi jenerali Assimi GOÏTA ye, n’o ye Tɛmɛsira ɲɛmɔgɔ ye, jamanakuntigi.

U.S. ka baarakɛyɔrɔ la. fɛɛrɛbɔ nafolo bɛ wuli ka taa a fɛ ka taa cɛmancɛ kɔrɔnfɛla fan fɛ

Ameriki ka sɔrɔdasi ni diplomasi nafolo sirilen dòn ka t’a fɛ Moyen-Orient (Moyen-Orient) la. Ameriki gofɛrɛnaman tun bɛ ka sɔrɔdasi-kɛlɛbolo dɔ jateminɛ fɔlɔ JNIM kan, n'o ye "base" bolofara ye Mali kɔnɔ, nka a ka fɔlɔfɔlɔko bilala kɔ kosɛbɛ. marabolow ka diplomasi sigida bɛ to ka sabati

Marabolo diplomasi sigida min tun bɛ Mali lamini na, o tun bɛ nɔgɔya la. Ameriki y’a ka ɲɛmajɔba sinsin Moyen-Orient jamana kan, wa fanga wɛrɛ t’a la ka don Afiriki tilebinyanfan koɲɛw la. Ni an y’a fara ɲɔgɔn kan ka tɛmɛ, Trump ka ɲɔgɔnye dafalenw kan ni Netanyahu ni Zelensky ye White House la, zuluyekalo tile 28 san 2026, nin lajɛ fila in nɔ min bɛ Trump yɛrɛ ka nafolo la, o bɛ ye kosɛbɛ nin ko ninnu na:

lakana faratiw dɔgɔyara cɛmancɛ kɔrɔnfɛla nafolo la
Ka kɔn o ɲɛ, Iran ye Trump denbaya ka nafolo kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bɛɛ jate Moyen-Orient jamanaw na k’u kɛ sariya laɲiniw ye, o min kɛra sababu ye k’a ɲɛsin nafolo minnu bɛ tali kɛ o ko la, olu ka jago nafa dɔgɔya. A ni Netanyahu ka ɲɔgɔnye kɔnɔ, a jɛlen don ko Trump banna k’a siri Israɛl la, k’a sen don kɛlɛba la min kɛra Irak jamana kama, o min ye ko in bali ka bɔ a yɛrɛ la pewu, ka dɔ bɔ binkanni tilennenw na a ka cɛmancɛ kɔrɔnfɛla jago porozɛw la fo ka se hakɛ dɔ ma, n’u bɛɛ lajɛlen hakɛ bɛ tɛmɛ Ameriki dɔrɔmɛ miliyari 10 kan Oman, Dubaï ani yɔrɔ wɛrɛw la, ani ka nafolo suguya jɔnjɔn sabati min bɛ tali kɛ a ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ.
kriptowari jago ka sɔrɔ basigilen sabatili
Lajɛ in tɛmɛnen kɔ, Ameriki jamana y’a ka teriya politiki tɛmɛn ka ɲɛsin cɛmancɛ kɔrɔnfɛla faabaw ma i n’a fɔ Arabu jamanaw. Trump denbaya ka kriptowari jago, n’o ye Emira Arabu Uniw ka faaba sen bɛ min na kosɛbɛ, o y’a to a ka sɔrɔ ka ca ni Ameriki dɔrɔmɛ miliyari 1,4 ye san 2025 kɔnɔ, o kɛra sababu ye k’a kɛ a ka nafolo sɔrɔyɔrɔba ye. Politiki minnu bɛ tali kɛ o ko la, olu tɛmɛnen kɔfɛ, o bɛ kɛ sababu ye ka jago in sɔrɔ sabatilen sɔrɔ kɔfɛ, wa a bɛ tanga jɛkafɔ minnu bɛ tali kɛ o ko la, olu tiɲɛni ma, k’a sababu kɛ Moyen-Orient jamanaw ka ɲagami ye.
Aw ye aw yɛrɛ tanga farati dogolen ma min bɛ sɔrɔ nafolosɔrɔbaliya kɔ-dunni na aw yɛrɛ ka nafolo la
Ni Ameriki jamana samara ka don kɛlɛ dafalen na Moyen-Orient, a bɛna diɲɛ petoroli sɔngɔw ni Ameriki jamana kɔnɔ nafolosɔrɔbaliya wuli k’a ɲɛsin Ameriki jamana ma, o bɛna nɔ bila Ameriki ka bolomafara sugu la. Trump ka nafolo bonya san 2025, o bɛna bɔ kosɛbɛ U.S. ka bolomafara suguya wulilen na. Dankarili minnu kɛra Israɛl kan nin lajɛ in senfɛ, olu ye u yɛrɛ tanga ɲagami ma min kɛra Ameriki ka bolomafara sugu la, min sababu bɔra petoroli sɔngɔ jiginniba fɛ, wa a ye gafe nafoloba min sɔrɔ a jigi da wariko sugu kan, o mara.
Nafolo sɔrɔcogo sabatilen min bɛ tali kɛ dugukoloko la
Trump ka dugukoloko, gɔlf kuluw ani nafolo wɛrɛw bɛ u jigi da diɲɛ jagokɛyɔrɔ sabatilen kan. "Kɔrɔsili danma" fɛɛrɛ min labanna nin lajɛ fila in na, o ye dɔ bɔ fɛn caman sɛgɛsɛgɛli la diɲɛ kɔnɔ fɛnsɔrɔko siratigɛ la, k’a ka dugukoloko porozɛw baara sabatili sabati yɔrɔ caman na diɲɛ kɔnɔ, wa a y’a yɛrɛ tanga jatebɔ ni taamasiyɛnw ka lase sɔrɔta dɔgɔyaliba ma ka bɔ nafolo la min bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na.
Kunnafoni minnu bɛ tali kɛ o ko la, olu sinsinnen bɛ kunnafoniw kan minnu bɔra zuluyekalo san 2026. Fɛn dɔw ma fɔ ka ɲɛ. A bɛ fɔ ko kunnafoni ofisiyali minnu bɛ bɔ kɔfɛ, olu de bɛna se sɔrɔ.

Nin ɲɔgɔnye fila minnu kɛra White House la, Trump ni Netanyahu ni Zelensky cɛ, olu ye nɔ tilennen bila yɔrɔ caman na, Moyen-Orient jamanaw ka ko kɛlenw na sisan:

U.S.-Israel politiki sira min ɲɛsinnen bɛ Iran ma , o bɛ ka jɛya
Lajɛ in kɔfɛ, Ameriki ni Israɛl y’u ka jɛkafɔ jira kokura Iran ka nukliyɛri bɔli la. Nka, Israɛl ka cɛsiriw ka Ameriki (Amerika) Gɛn walasa k’a ka sɔrɔdasi-walew Dɔgɔya Iran kan, o ma Se ka Kɛ kosɛbɛ. Ameriki bɛ hali bi fanga la Irak kɛlɛ teliya la, a bɛ t’a fɛ ka fɛɛrɛ tigɛ min ye "ka kumaɲɔgɔnya sabati ni kɛlɛ ye" walasa a kana a sen don kosɛbɛ kɛlɛw la Moyen-Orient. O ye dɔ bɔ kɛlɛba la min bɛ se ka kɛ Moyen-Orient jamanaw na.
Kɛlɛ min bɛ Irisi ni Ukraine cɛ , o sirilen don kosɛbɛ Moyen-Orient jamanaw ka ko la
O lajɛ in senfɛ, Zelensky ye Trump ka sɔnni sɔrɔ a kɔnɔna na, Ukraine ka binkanni in na Iran ka fɛnw dilanyɔrɔw kan Kaspian kɔgɔji la. Ukrayina dronw bɛ ka taa a fɛ ka bagabagali kɛ Irisi ni Iran cɛ bolifɛnko siraba jɔnjɔnw na, ka Irisi ni Ukraine kɛlɛ in nɔfɛkow lasegin k’a ɲɛsin cɛmancɛ kɔrɔnfɛla maraba ma, ka dugukoloko tulon gɛlɛya juguya ka taa a fɛ Moyen-Orient jamanaw na.
“Jɛmukanw ni jɛmukanw ɲɔgɔn falen-falen” cogoya min bɛ marabolow ka kɛlɛw la, o bɛ senna
Lajɛ in kɔfɛ, Trump y’a jira foroba la ko ale tɛna ban ka binkanni wɛrɛw kɛ Iran ka marabolow ka lasigidenw kan. Ameriki ni Iran ka nɔgɔya waati kunkurunnin kɔnɔ, o kɛra degun ye. Moyen-Orient bɛna to ka fanga dɔgɔya cogoya la min bɛ taa a fɛ ka kɛlɛ kɛ. A ka gɛlɛn ka marifaci dabila bɛɛ lajɛlen sɔrɔ waati kunkurunnin kɔnɔ, wa marabolow ka ko kɛlenw dankarili cayara ka taa a fɛ.
Israɛl ka marabolo kan ladilanna
O lajɛ in kɔfɛ, Israɛl ka lobbying fanga dɔgɔyara kosɛbɛ U.S. Moyen-Orient politiki la. Ameriki Kɛra ɲɛmaa dafalen ye kὲlɛ siratigɛ la Moyen-Orient. Israɛl tun bɛ dankan na Iran ko la, o fana ye nɔ bila Israɛl, Liban ani Siri la cogo la min tɛ ɲɛ.

N b’a fɛ fɔlɔ ka n ka foli lase jamanakuntigi Goïta ma, a ka bisimilali duman ni balimaya la. I n’a fɔ a bɛ kɛ cogo min na, an bisimila Mali jatigila hakili lakika la. Aw b’a dɔn, Senegali ni Mali bɛ tariku jɛɲɔgɔnyaw kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ, teriya ni balimaya. Olu ye sigiɲɔgɔnya ɲuman jɛɲɔgɔnyaw ye, somɔgɔw, joli, teriya, ladamu ani jɛ-ka-baara.

Wa o jɛɲɔgɔnyaw, n’u farala dugukoloko kan ani an ka tariku jɛlen kan, olu de bɛ kɛ jɛɲɔgɔnya kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen ni misali ye, an ka jamana fila bɛ min kɔnɔ. Ne ka kɛli Bamakɔ bi o la, a bɛɛ bɛ nin balimaya hukumu kɔnɔ. N nana ka taa bɔ a ye ni bonya ye, ka kuraya, a n’a ka gɔfɛrɛnaman ma, ka fara balima Maliden kan, an ka dususalo bɔlenw kɔfɛ, binkanni jugu minnu kɛra kɔsa in na, minnu ye sɔrɔdasi damadɔw faga.

An bɛ an biri u hakili la ani ka delili kɛ u niw ka lafiɲɛ kama.  N y’a jira fana jamanakuntigi Goïta Senegali ka jalakiba la, min tɛ se ka wuli, ani min tɛ wuli ka bɔ a nɔ na, ​​nin wale juguw, siranɲɛko, ani barbariko ninnu na, minnu bɛ ka caya. Ale n’a balima Maliden bɛɛ, n bɛ foli lase cɛsiriw ni nafolomafɛnw ma minnu bilala sen kan, ka fara saraka minnu kɛra, walasa ka hɛrɛ ni lakana sabati nin balimaya jamana in kɔnɔ.

An b'an biri bonya kɔsɔn u kosumani na ani ka Ala delili k'u datugu n'a ka hinɛ fɛrɛlen ye. I n'a fɔ N y’a jira fana jamanakuntigi Goïta la Senegali ka jalakiba la, min tigɛlen don, ani min tɛ wuli ka bɔ a nɔ na, nin wale jugu in na, ani jitɔya ni baganya, o min bɛ ka juguya ka taa fɛ, N b’a ni balima Maliden denkɛw bɛɛ tanu, Cɛsiri ni nafolo minnu kɛra, ani saraka minnu kɛra, walasa ka hɛrɛ ni lafiya sabati nin balima jamana in kɔnɔ.

Wa tiɲɛna, an ye tuma sɔrɔ ka baro kɛ hakilina wɛrɛw kan an fila ka ɲɔgɔnye senfɛ, minnu ɲɛsinnen bɛ hɛrɛ ni lakanako ma marabolo fitininw kɔnɔ, nka kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, fɛɛrɛw n’a kɛcogo minnu bɛ se ka jatigɛwale kɛlɛ ka ɲɛ, o min bɛ ka taa a fɛ ka jɛnsɛn ani ka an ka jamanadenw bɛɛ bagabaga. Bari, i n’a fɔ n y’a fɔ cogo min na ka tɛmɛ, Senegali labɛnnen don ka ban ka Mali dɛmɛ nin gɛlɛya in na, fo an jɛlen ka se ɲɔgɔn fɛ ka gɛlɛyaw ni bagabagaliw minnu bɛ hɛrɛ ni basigibaliya kunbɛn, mara fan bɛɛ kɔnɔ, o to yen ani Saheli mara bɛɛ kɔnɔ, i k'a dɔn nin bagabagali ninnu, i n’a fɔ an bɛnna a kan cogo min na, a tɛ danyɔrɔ dɔn, wa a bɛ ka juguya ka da an ka farali kan.

I n'a fɔ An ye baro kɛ fana jɛkafɔ sinsinni siraw kan walasa ka gɛlɛyaw kunbɛn ɲɔgɔn fɛ, jamana fila ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ ani marabolo jɛkuluw kɔnɔ, Mali ni Senegali ye minnu kɔnɔmɔgɔw ye. Wa bɛ n nisɔndiya kosɛbɛ jamanakuntigi ka hakilinaw lajɛlen dafalen na an ye baro kɛ ko kunbaba minnu kan, ni balimaya ni ye ani jɛɲɔgɔnya, an ka cɛsiriw kɛli kelen ye fɛ.

N y’a fɔ jamanakuntigi Goïta ye ko a bɛ se k'a banban Senegali ka dɛmɛn kan min tɛ wuli. Wa N y’a gɛlɛya kokura an sɔrɔli n’an ka cɛsiri jira Mali la, wa b'o cogo la ka fara jamana tɔw bɛɛ kan, walasa ka ɲɔgɔn ka gɛlɛyaw ɲɛnabɔ ɲɔgɔn fɛ. I n'a fɔ An ye baro kɛ fana UEMOA ni OMVS ka ko taasira kan, wa an bɛnna a kan ka baara kɛ n’an jɛɲɔgɔnw ye minnu bɔra balima jamana wɛrɛw la, walasa ka jamanakuntigiw ka lajɛba dɔ sigi senkan, joona, walasa ka wariko ni sɔrɔko jɛ-ka-baara sabati, ka fara ji nafolo ɲɛnabɔli kan, ba jurujan fɛ o min b'an ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 664 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-28 22:23:56 CEST
Maison Blanche (Maison Blanche) ye

San tan caman kɔnɔ, diɲɛnatigɛlamɔgɔw ye Michigan mobili baarakɛlaw janfa, ka baarakɛyɔrɔw bila jamana kɔkan ani ka iziniw datugu. Jamanakuntigi tɛmɛnen bɛɛ ye layidu ta k’a bɛna a dabila, nka u si ma u ka kuma labato.

Sisan, barika Ala ye

@POTUS ye

Michigan jamanatigi dɔ bɛ yen min bɛ baarakɛlaw kɛlɛ ani ka Ameriki bila jɔyɔrɔ fɔlɔ la. Ameriki ka fɛn dilanni seginna!

Kɔrɔba : O poste in bɛ segin barikama di Michigan mobili baarakɛlaw ma k’a sababu kɛ jamanakuntigi Trump ka politiki ni tarifuw ye, k’u faranfasi ni jamanakuntigi kɔrɔw ka dɛsɛw ye.

Tiɲɛ surunyalen na: Nafolo laselilenba dɔw bɛ ka bɔ GM ni Ford fɛ (dɔrɔmɛ miliyari caman ani baara ba caman), ani feereli barikama minnu bɛna kɛ san 2025 kɔnɔ, nka mobili baara bɛɛ lajɛlen bɛ Misigini, o bɛ kɛ fla ye walima ka dɔgɔya dɔɔnin (~170.000 baara tilennenw) k’a sababu kɛ otomatiki ye, kuran mɔbiliw jiginni, ani tarifu minnu bɛ ka musakaw caya.

Kunnafoni : Tariku baara dɔgɔyali bɛ senna kabini san tan caman (bɔnɛba bɛ saheli fan fɛ), wa tarifuw bɛ ka dusu don jamana kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw na nka a bɛ se ka nɔ jugu bila fɛnw dilancogo cakɛdaw la ni Kanada ye. Tiɲɛ ye kuma fɔcogo ɲumanw ni sugu jiginni ɲagaminen ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 668 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-28 21:24:26 CEST
Dunanw ka kibaruya labanw bɔra Senegali (Zuluyekalo tile 28, san 2026):

Faye ka taama Bamakɔ: Ka jɛkafɔ sabati CEDEAO ni Sahel jamanaw (Mali) cɛ.

Macky Sall dɛmɛni: Senegali ye jamanakuntigi kɔrɔ ka kandili dɛmɛ ONU sekeretɛri zenerali (Diplomatic Shift).

Dancɛko gɛlɛya ni Gambia: Ko min kɛra Buluk, ani Senegalikaw ka welekan ka ɲɛsin hɛrɛko ɲɛnabɔli ma.

Jamana fila ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ jɛɲɔgɔnya : Ka jɛkafɔ sabati ni Alizeri (Enerji ni Jago) ani Nizeriya ye, ani kɔgɔji lakanani jɛkafɔ ni Faransi.

CEDEAO: Senegali ye jkulu ni a ka komisiyɔn ɲɛmɔgɔya ta.

Kɔlɔsili: Diplomasi jɛkafɔba kɛli juruko gɛlɛya cɛma ani san 2026 Dakari lajɛba labɛnni.

Jamanakuntigi Bassiro Diomêne Faye taara Bamakɔ bi (zuluyekalo tile 28, san 2026) ka tile kelen baara ni jɛkafɔ taama kɛ Mali jamanakuntigi Assimi Goïta ka weleli kan.

Laɲini : Ka jamana fila ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ jɛɲɔgɔnyaw sabati ani ka baro kɛ sigida koɲɛw kan (kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la CEDEAO ni Sahel jamanaw cɛ).

 Nafa : A ka taama fɔlɔ min kɛra CEDEAO ɲɛmɔgɔ kura ye, o min jatera k’a ɲini ka marabolow ka gɛlɛyaw nɔgɔya.

O kɔlɔlɔ : Lajɛ fila ni ɲɔgɔn bonyalen, o kɔfɛ a seginna Dakar wula fɛ.

Viziti min ɲɛnabɔra ani min tun bɛ makɔnɔn.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 678 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-27 19:16:36 CEST
San duuru tεmεgε waati jirali sen kan Mali la, fanga ni jiko minisiri, Karamɔgɔ Tiémoko Traoré y’a jira ko :

Kuranko sɔrɔlenw : Gouina jiko barazi (140 MW), Serakoro funteni-sɛnɛyɔrɔ (100 MW), kuran jɛɲɔgɔnya ni Gine, ani tile kuran sɛnɛyɔrɔ yiriwali teliya.

Ji : Jamana ka jiko politiki fɔlɔ tali (awirilikalo san 2026) walasa ka mara sabati.

Yɛlɛmaba minnu kɛra : Kuran ni ji sɔngɔ sabatili k’a sɔrɔ dɔ ma fara a kan (hali ni sɛnɛfɛnw sɔngɔ bɛ ka wuli).

"Take or Pay" siratigɛ bɔli; sarali bɛ kɛ sisan fɛn min bɛ dun dɔrɔn de la.

Nin ye kumasen in kuncɛlen ofisiyali ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 683 — Kuma fasaralen

Ameriki ni Saudi Arabia ka nukliyɛri bɛnkan (zuluyekalo san 2026) ye tiɲɛ ye, wa a sinsinnen bɛ jɛkafɔ kan reactorw, kalan, ani wariko, min ni Saudi Arabia normalisation ni Israɛl bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na.

Fɛn kolomaw:

Israɛl b’a bisimila k’a kɛ Iran kɛlɛli fɛɛrɛ ye, nka Israɛl dɔnnikɛlaw ye lasɔmini kɛ marabolow ka nukliyɛri marifatigiw ka ɲɔgɔndan kan, Israɛl ka sɔrɔdasi-dakun bɔnɛni, ani Palestina ko seginni ka kɛ Saudi Arabia cogoya ye.

Waati: 2026-07-17 21:49:06 CEST
U.S. ni Tcheki sɔrɔdasi minnu tun bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ Litwanie (Pabradė mara la) olu tun sinsinnen bɛ kɛlɛ kɛrɛfɛtaw kan ni degeliw marifaw ye minnu bɛ kɛ cogo la (min tɛ ɲɛnama ye).

U.S. sɔrɔdasiw ni OTAN jɛɲɔgɔnw ka jɛ-ka-baara kɛcogo kɔrɔ dɔ ye Baltik jamanaw na walasa ka jɛ-ka-baara ni labɛnni sabati.

Dalilu si tɛ yen min b’a jira ko sɔrɔdasi baara kɛra tiɲɛ na walima ko a wulila teliya la; foroba kunnafonidi wale dɔrɔn de don walasa ka jɛkafɔ jira.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 720 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-14 17:15:08 CEST
Nin ye ɲɛfɔli tannan ye, min bɛ tali kɛ sekeretɛri zenerali Xi Jinping ka jɛmukan nafama kalanni n’a waleyacogo kuncɛlen na, Sinuwa jamana ka kominisitɔn sigili san 105nan seli la.

Kuncɛli lakika ka surun:

Nin ye Siniwa jamana ka propagande rapɔɔri ofisiyali ye min bɛ Siniwa jamana ka kominisitɔn ka san 105nan seli kan (Zuluyekalo tile fɔlɔ, san 2026). Tiɲɛ jɔnjɔnw: Xi Jinping ye jɛmukan nafama dɔ kɛ o seliba la.

"Zuluyekalo tile fɔlɔ medayi" dira mɔgɔ kelen-kelen dɔw ma.

Jɛmukan in tun sinsinnen bɛ : ka Parti ka tariku bonya, ka sinsin a ka « cidenyabaara fɔlɔ » kan, ka wele bila kelenya ma a ka ɲɛmɔgɔya lamini na, ani ka t’a fɛ «sosiyalisimu ni Sinuwa jogo» (i n’a fɔ sisan sigida).

Tiɲɛ : Seli in ye ko ye min bɛ kɛ Pati fɛ o waati suguw la, a bɛ kɛ ka sariyatigiya ni kantigiya sabati, ani ka segin "ɲɛnabɔlibaw" lakalicogo ofisiyali kan, k’a sɔrɔ gɛlɛya walima kɔrɔfɔli si ma jate walima k’a dɔgɔya. Fɛn kura si tɛ a kɔnɔ jogo ta fan fɛ; o ye politiki kumasenw tɛmɛnen dɔrɔn ye min bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ Xi ka fanga kɔrɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 724 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-14 12:01:36 CEST
U.S. ka fanga minisiriso

U.S. sɔrɔdasiw ni jamanakuntigi Trump ka cɛsiriw sababu la, petoroli bɛ ka taa ni a ye hali bi Hormuz kɔgɔjida la.

Kunu, petoroli barili miliyɔn 8,5 tɛmɛna o kɔgɔjida la, o bɛ bɛn kɔsa in na. O bɛ na ni petoroli min bɛ taa Pɛrɛsi kɔgɔjida la, o bɛɛ lajɛlen bɛ se barili miliyɔn 15 ɲɔgɔn ma tile kɔnɔ.

U.S. sɔrɔdasiw bɛna a lajɛ ko petoroli ka taa ɲɛ, ni Iran ye walima ni Iran tɛ, walasa ka sɔrɔ bɛrɛbɛrɛ mara suguw la.

A kunba ye nin ye:

Ameriki fanga minisiriso ka fɔta fɔlɔ b’a Jira ko barili miliyɔn 8,5 tɛmɛni bɛ senna tile kɔnɔ (a kɛra kɔsa in na) hali ni gɛlɛyaw bɛ Iran ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ, k’a sababu Kɛ Ameriki sɔrɔdasiw ka dɛmɛ ye Trump ka fanga kɔrɔ.

Tiɲɛ don : Sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli bɛ a tariku hakɛ danmadɔ jukɔrɔ (~21 miliyɔn barili tile kɔnɔ) k’a sababu kɛ tiɲɛniw ye minnu bɛ senna, wa suguw bɛ to ka wuli ka bɔ u nɔ na, ​​ni 50% dɔrɔn de bɛ segin u cogo kɔrɔ la san 2026 laban na.

Ameriki ka fanga minisiriso

Ameriki kɛlɛbolo ni jamanakuntigi Trump ka cɛsiriw sababu la, taji bɛ ka ta ka tɛmɛ Babɔlɔn koronyɔrɔ fɛ.

Wa tiɲɛ na Kunu, taji barikon miliyɔn 8,5 tɛmɛna koronyɔrɔ fɛ, wa i k'a dɔn o bɛ bɛn kɔsa in na bɛrɛ ma. An'o sababu la taji ɲufan ɲufanni bɛ bɛ se Arabu Babɔlɔn yɔrɔ la ka se barikon miliyɔn 15 ɲɔgɔn ma tile kɔnɔ.

Wa Ameriki kɛlɛbolo bɛna a janto taji tɛmɛni ɲufan ɲufanni na, a kɛra Iran bɛ yen wo walima n'a tɛ, walasa ka sɔrɔ bɛrɛbɛrɛ mara suguw ye.

Tiɲɛ kuntaalasurun:

Foroba kunnafoni don ka bɔ Ameriki ka fanga minisiriso fɛ k'a gɛlɛya ko barikon miliyɔn 8,5 tɛmɛni bɛ senna tile kɔnɔ (a kɛra kɔsa in na) hali ni basigibaliya bɛ Iran ni ye, k’a sababu Kɛ Ameriki kɛlɛbolo ka dɛmɛ ye Trump ka fanga kɔrɔ.

Tiɲɛ : fɛnw bɔli ka dogo ka tɛmɛ tariku bɛrɛ kan (barikon~miliyɔn 21 tile kɔnɔ) k’a kun kɛ tɔɔrɔw ye minnu bɛ senna, wa suguw ma wuli u bɛ basigibaliya la ka fara jigidaw kan seginna a cogoya la a, ni 50% niyɔrɔ dɔrɔn ye san 2026 laban na.

Waati: 2026-07-13 14:31:21 CEST
Ameriki jamana na, Delaware Iniwɛrisite kalandenw bɛ baganw ladonni dege misisogo ni saga sɛnɛ kalan dɔ la.

Kuma surun na: Delaware Iniwɛrisite la Ameriki, kalansen dɔ bɛ yen min bɛ wele ko "Beef Cattle and Sheep Production".

Tiɲɛ jɔnjɔnw : Kalandenw (a ka c’a la, u ka san fɔlɔ la) bɛ baganmaracogo bɛɛ lajɛlen dege, min bɛ kɛ ni bolo ye.

Kalan in bɛ tali kɛ : kɛnɛya, balodɛsɛ, baganmara, bangekɔlɔsi kɛnɛya, boloci, bange, so, baganmara, ani ɲɛnabɔli bɛɛ lajɛlen.

A bɛ kalan tiɲɛ na foro dɔ la min bɛ kalanso kɔnɔ.

Kalandenw ye fɛn o fɛn kalan ka tɛmɛ (farikoloɲɛnajɛ, farikoloɲɛnajɛ, balodɛsɛ, a ɲɔgɔnnaw) bɛ o bɛɛ waleya bagan lakikaw kan.

O kalan in lakodɔnnen don kosɛbɛ ko a bɛ mɔgɔ su ji la kosɛbɛ ani ko a bɛ se ka kɛ, wa a bɛ jate waleyali kalan barikama dɔ ye baganw ka dɔnniya porogaramu kɔnɔ.
