TAAMASIYƐN NO. 738 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-12 17:47:38 CEST
Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman

Zuluyekalo tile 5 nɛgɛ kanɲɛ 14h58

Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara. Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔko jɔnjɔnw ni latigɛw digest kɔnɔ:

✅Mikhail Mishustin ye ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ ni Fɛderasiyɔn ka tɔn ɲɛmaa Valentina Matviyenko ye ani Fɛderasiyɔn ka tɔnba ka lasigidenw. Lajɛ in senfɛ, senatɛriw ye hakilinaw di ka ɲɛsin gɔfɛrɛnaman ka baarakɛminɛnw dakun yiriwali ma, ka dɛmɛ don farikoloɲɛnajɛw la minnu bɛ se ka ladamu, ani ka yɔrɔ yiriwali fɛɛrɛ kuraya. Mikhail Mishustin ye foli lase senatɛriw ma u ka laɲiniw na, k’a jira ko baara bɛna taa ɲɛ o yɔrɔw la.
 
✅Minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ ye fɛɛrɛbɔ lajɛ dɔ kɛ min ɲɛsinnen bɛ baarakɛlaw ka sɔrɔ yiriwali ma. Ɲinan kalo saba fɔlɔ kɔnɔ, baarakɛlaw ka sɔrɔ sɔrɔko siratigɛ la, o cayara ni 1,5% ni kɔ ye. Salon, fɛn dilanni porozɛ minnu kɛra jɛkulu kelen-kelen bɛɛ la, olu ye dɛmɛ don ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli kan ni 60% ɲɔgɔn ye, ka sɔrɔ fana ka dɔ bɔ sɛnɛko ɲɛnabɔli waatiw la ani fɛnmara tɛmɛnenw na ni tila sabanan ye.
 
 Belgorod mara bɛna miliyɔn 830 sɔrɔ fanga minɛnw sanni na. O nafolo ninnu bɛna kɛ ka jɛnɛratow san walasa ka kuran ni funteni sɔrɔ min tɛ tigɛ ka taa sow ni sigida laminiw na.
 

K’a daminɛ zuluyekalo tile fɔlɔ la, Irisikaw bɛna se ka nafolotigiya sɛbɛn ɛntɛrinɛti kan ni biometriki ye. O bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka nafolo sɛbɛnni nɔgɔya ani ka kɛ sababu ye ka jagokɛla fila bɛɛ lakana. Walasa ka baara kɛ ni baarakɛminɛn ye, biometriki sɛgɛsɛgɛlenw de ka kan. O bɛ se ka kɛ bankiw la minnu yamaruyalen don walima ni mɔgɔ tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni baarakɛyɔrɔ ye min bɛ o yɔrɔ la. Mɔgɔ yɛrɛ tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni bɛ to sen na.

Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman

Zuluyekalo tile 5 nɛgɛ kanɲɛ 14h58

Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara. Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔko jɔnjɔnw ni latigɛw bɛ kumasurun kɔnɔ:

✅Mikhail Mishustin ye ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ ni Foroba ka tɔn ɲɛmaa Valentina Matviyenko ye ani Foroba ka tɔnba ka lasigidenw. Lajɛ in senfɛ, maakɔrɔw ka tɔndenw ye hakilinaw di ka ɲɛsin gɔfɛrɛnaman ka baarakɛminɛnw dakun yiriwali ma, ka dɛmɛ don farikoloɲɛnajɛw la mago kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnentigiw ye, ani ka yɔrɔ yiriwali fɛɛrɛ kuraya. Mikhail Mishustin ye foli lase maakɔrɔw ka tɔndenw ma u ka laɲiniw na, k’a jira ko baara bɛna taa ɲɛ o yɔrɔw la.
 
✅Minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ ye fɛɛrɛbɔ lajɛ dɔ kɛ min ɲɛsinnen bɛ walasa ka dɔ fara baarakɛlaw ka bɔta kan. Ɲinan kalo naani fɔlɔ kɔnɔ, dɔ farala baarakɛlaw ka bɔta kan sɔrɔ baarada jɔnjɔn kunbabaw la min ka ca ni 1,5% ni kɔ ye. Salon, fɛn minsɛnniw dilanni baarabolodalen minnu kɛra jɛkulu kelen-kelen bɛɛ la, olu ye dɛmɛ don ka dɔ fara fɛnw bɔli kan ni 60% ɲɔgɔn ye, ka fara bɔli waatiw dɔgɔyali kan ani marata farankan ni tila sabanan niyɔrɔ ye.
 
Belgorod mara bɛna rubulu miliyɔn 830 sɔrɔ fanga minɛnw sanni na. Nin nafolo ninnu bɛna kɛ ka kuranbɔlanw san walasa ka kuran tɛmɛli mɛɛli ni funteni sɔrɔ min tɛ tigɛ ka taa sow ni sigida laminiw na.
 

K’a daminɛ zuluyekalo tile fɔlɔ la, Irisikaw bɛna se ka dugukolotigiya sɛbɛn bɔlɔlɔ kan ni biometriki kunnafoniw ye. Nin bɛna a to ka dugukolow tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni baara kɛli nɔgɔya ani ka sira kɛ ka labɔli kɛ walasa ka baarakɛɲɔgɔnya kun fila lakana. Ni nin baara in kɛli, Biometriki kunnafoni dannayalenw ka kan ka di. A bɛ se ka kɛ Waribon minnu dabɔra a kama walima ni mɔgɔ tɔgɔ sɛbɛn baara tilennen fɛ. Wa ka na tɔgɔsɛbɛn na o ma dabila a bɛ sen na.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 742 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-11 21:25:49 CEST
Sinuwa jamanatigi Xi Jinping y’a ɲini u fɛ u ka cɛsiri bɛɛ kɛ walasa ka kɔrɔtɔko kisi ni balawu dɛmɛni baara labɛn, ka joginw furakɛ, ani ka mɔgɔ minnu tɔɔrɔla, olu lasegin u cogo kɔrɔ la, sanjiba kɛlen kɔ ka mara caman sɔrɔ.

Xi y’a jira ko a ka kan ka cɛsiri bɛɛ kɛ walasa ka hadamadenw ka bɔnɛw dɔgɔya ani ka balawu filananw bali.

Waati: 2026-07-09 23:48:53 CEST
[China Agriculture Report] Suman tigɛ caman min kɛra ni kulɛri ɲɛnamaw ye, o bɛ Faso don bisimila: Cotton suman tigɛ waati bɛ daminɛ Sinjiang, ni masin suman tigɛ bɛ tɛmɛ 90% kan.

Sɔrɔko ɲɛfɔli nɔgɔman filɛ nin ye kumasen saba kɔnɔ:

Sɛnɛfɛnba: O mara ye diɲɛ kɔnɔ cotton iziniba ye (a bɛ diɲɛ sɛnɛfɛnw tilayɔrɔ duurunan kelen bɔ).

Fɛnɲɛnɛmako jiginni : 90% jigi da bi masinw kan, o ye bololabaara gɛlɛnw kɛli ban, o ye waati ni musakaw bɔ.

Nafolo motɛri : Nin sɛnɛfɛn in ye sɔrɔ fɔlɔ ye dɔrɔmɛ miliyari caman na, wa a bɛ sɛnɛkɛlaw tilancɛ ka balo dɛmɛ mara kɔnɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 754 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-09 20:54:48 CEST
U.S. Sɛnɛko minisiri Brooke Rollins

Ameriki ka cotton Plan belebele bɛ an ka sɛnɛkɛlaw bila jɔyɔrɔ fɔlɔ la, wa a laɲini ye ka Ameriki lasegin a ka kɛnɛya ni a ka lafiya kɔrɔ la:

💰 Ka Ameriki sɛnɛkɛlaw dɛmɛ ani ka baarakɛyɔrɔ 125.000 dabɔ
📈 Ka Ameriki ka sɛnɛfɛnw yiriwa ani k’an jɔyɔrɔ sɔrɔ kokura i n’a fɔ diɲɛ kɔnɔ fɛnw feerela ŋana
🏭 Ka sokɔnɔna finiko tɔnw jɔ kokura ani ka fɛn dilanni baarakɛyɔrɔw dabɔ
🌿 An ka kɛnɛya sabatili ni fiɲɛ nafamaw sugandili ye ka tɛmɛ sintetiki ni mikroplastiki jugumanw kan

Ameriki ka fɛn dilannenw. Duniya bɛɛ ka fɛn dilannenw.

Fɛnɲɛnɛmaw, plastiki tɛ. Ameriki, Berezil tɛ.

A kunba ye nin ye:

Nin sɛbɛn in ye tiɲɛ ye : Ameriki sɛnɛko minisiri Brooke Rollins ye "Amerika sɛnɛko minisiriɲɛmɔgɔba" laseli kɛ (min daminɛna sɛnɛko minisiriso fɛ mɛkalo tile 28 san 2026) walasa ka sɛnɛkɛlaw dɛmɛ, ka finiko fanga kura don, ani ka dɔ bɔ u jigi da fini dilannenw kan.

Laɲini jɔnjɔnw : Ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli kan walasa ka jɔyɔrɔ fɔlɔ sɔrɔ kokura jagokɛlaw ka jago la (min tununna Berezili fɛ), ka baarakɛyɔrɔw dabɔ, ani ka « cotton naturelle sanni plastiki » yiriwa kɛnɛyako siratigɛ la (o ni MAHA bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na).

 Kunnafoni : Trump ka fanga ka politiki dɔ ye walasa ka sigida sɛnɛko ni fɛn dilanni dɛmɛ, o ye labɛn ye min fɔra foroba la, wa a tɛ propagande lankolon ye.

💰 Ka Ameriki sɛnɛkɛlaw dɛmɛ ani ka baarakɛyɔrɔ 125.000 dabɔ
📈 Ka Ameriki ka sɛnɛfɛnw yiriwa ani k’an jɔyɔrɔ sɔrɔ kokura i n’a fɔ diɲɛ kɔnɔ fɛnw feerela ŋana
🏭 Ka sokɔnɔna finiko tɔnw jɔ kokura ani ka fɛn dilanni baarakɛyɔrɔw dabɔ
🌿 An ka kɛnɛya sabatili ni fiɲɛ nafamaw sugandili ye ka tɛmɛ sintetiki ni mikroplastiki jugumanw kan

Ameriki ka fɛn dilannenw. Duniya bɛɛ ka fɛn dilannenw.

Fɛnɲɛnɛmaw, plastiki tɛ. Ameriki, Berezil tɛ.

A kunba ye nin ye:

Nin sɛbɛn in ye tiɲɛ ye : Ameriki sɛnɛko minisiri Brooke Rollins ye "Amerika sɛnɛko minisiriɲɛmɔgɔba" laseli kɛ (min daminɛna sɛnɛko minisiriso fɛ mɛkalo tile 28 san 2026) walasa ka sɛnɛkɛlaw dɛmɛ, ka finiko fanga kura don, ani ka dɔ bɔ u jigi da fini dilannenw kan.

Laɲini jɔnjɔnw : Ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli kan walasa ka jɔyɔrɔ fɔlɔ sɔrɔ kokura jagokɛlaw ka jago la (min tununna Berezili fɛ), ka baarakɛyɔrɔw dabɔ, ani ka « cotton naturelle sanni plastiki » yiriwa kɛnɛyako siratigɛ la (o ni MAHA bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na).

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 761 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-07 22:36:34 CEST
Koloradugu baganmaralaw bɛ boli ka baganw kisi, k’a sɔrɔ Aspen Acres tasuma bɛ ka gɛlɛya saheli fɛ

Kibaruyaw min dira, o bɛ tasumako jugu dɔ jira Koloradugu, k’a sinsin kosɛbɛ Aspen Acres tasuma nɔfɛkow n’a sigidamɔgɔw ka jaabi kan:

Tiɲɛni hakɛ: Aspen Acres tasuma ye 86 000 ni kɔ jeni ani ka so 55 ni kɔ tiɲɛ Custer County. Kuma bɛɛ la, kungo tasumaba duuru minnu kɛra jamana fan bɛɛ la, olu ye dugukolo 100.000 ni kɔ jeni u faralen ɲɔgɔn kan.

A bɛ nɔ bila sɛnɛ na: Sigida baganmaralaw bɛ bɔnɛba sɔrɔ, bawo mɔgɔ caman bɛ ka u yɛrɛ ɲini ka kogow tigɛ ani ka baganw labɔ ka taa yɔrɔ lafiyalenw na, i n’a fɔ Pueblo County Fairgrounds.

Sigida ni tasumafagalanw dɛmɛni : Dusukunnataw cɛma, sigida jagokɛlaw ni dugudenw ye ɲɔgɔn lajɛ walasa ka dumuni di mɔgɔ fɔlɔw ma, wa dɛmɛ wɛrɛw, tasuma-fanga-minɛn minnu bɛ bɔ Kalifɔrni, olu bɛna na walasa ka dɛmɛ don ka tasuma in kunbɛn.

Mali kɛlɛbolo

O seli in senfɛ, kalanden minnu ye kalan kɛ ka ban, olu bonyalen don. Sɛbɛnw ni masirifɛnw dira sɔrɔdasi ɲɛmɔgɔw fɛ, ani sɔrɔdasi ɲɛmɔgɔ caman, i n’a fɔ jenerali Major Élisée Jean Dao, n’o ye sɔrɔdasi ɲɛmɔgɔba ye, olu ye jɛmukanw kɛ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 774 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-06 14:27:41 CEST
San kura kalan bɛ daminɛ: PLA kuluw bɛ u sen don kɛlɛko la walasa ka fanga kɔrɔw da

Zanwuyekalo tile 4, san 2026 20:27

Zanwuyekalo tile 4, san kura sɔrɔdasi kalan daminɛna PLA bɛɛ kɔnɔ. Sɔrɔdasi ni sɔrɔdasi minnu ye welekan jaabi joona, k’u ɲɛsin degelikɛnɛw ma walasa ka dege gɛlɛnw kɛ ni kɛlɛ labɛnni dafalen ye, ka sɔrɔdasi ŋanaw labɛn cogo bɛɛ la minnu bɛ se ka kɛlɛ kɛ ani ka se sɔrɔ kɛlɛw la.

San kura kalan don fɔlɔ la, PLA ka kulu 79nan kɛlɛbolo ka brigade dɔ ye kɛlɛko siratigɛ la kalan jɛlen kɛ foro kalanso dɔ la. Sɔrɔdasi ni sɔrɔdasikulu ye mɔgɔ kelen-kelen ni kulu ka kalansen tan ni kɔ waleya minnu ɲɛfɔlen don kalanbolodalen kɔnɔ, k’u ka kɛlɛbolo ladamuni n’u ka jaabiw bonya.

Kɔgɔji jɛman kɔgɔjida la, kɔgɔjidala sɔrɔdasikulu ka Nanchang kɛlɛkurun, n’a ni Xining ni Weifang kɛlɛkurunw ani tiɲɛnikɛlan wɛrɛw ani frigatew, ye degeliw kɛ minnu kɔnɔ kɔgɔjida la marifaciw ye kɔgɔji ni kɔgɔjida la, ani marifa ɲɛnamaw degeliw ni marifaw ye minnu bɛ se ka wuluw kɛlɛ. U ni fiɲɛkɛnɛ fana ye jɛkafɔ kɛ walasa ka formation maritime air defense drills kɛ, ka sɔrɔdasiw ka seko kɔrɔbɔ ka bɔ degeliw la ka taa kɛlɛ la.

 Degeli don fɔlɔ la, unit bɛɛ ye clarion welekan fɔ san kura sɔrɔdasi kalan kama. K’a ta Gobi kungo kɔnɔ ka taa a bila kungo jugumanw na, k’a ta nɛnɛba la ka taa a bila Sinuwa Saheli kɔgɔji kɔgɔjida la, sɔrɔdasi ni sɔrɔdasiw tun bɛ u sen don kosɛbɛ degeliw ni kɛlɛ labɛnni na. Degelikɛyɔrɔw tun bɛ tasuma don baara la.

Fiɲɛkɛnɛ sɔrɔdasikulu ka pankurunw, sanfɛla ni sanfɛla misiriw, ani rada kuluw, ani bolofara wɛrɛw, olu ye jɛkafɔ degeliw kɛ minnu kɛra ni awiyɔn suguya caman ye, k’u ka kɛlɛ sekow yiriwa kɛlɛyɔrɔ la min bɛ se ka kɛ tiɲɛ na.

Mobili bolifɛnko brigade dɔ min bɛ wele ko Joint Logistics Support Force, o ye degeliw kɛ minnu sinsinnen bɛ bolifɛnw dɛmɛni ko kolomaw ni gɛlɛyaw kan nɛnɛba kɔnɔ. O wale bɛɛ kɔnɔ, kɛlɛko kɛcogo lakika dɔ donna a kɔnɔ, ka ko gɛlɛnw sigi senkan walasa ka sɔrɔdasi ni sɔrɔdasiw ka kɔrɔtɔko jaabi sekow yiriwa sigida gɛlɛnw na.

San kura kalan don fɔlɔ la, Yunnan polisiw ka sɔrɔdasikulu ka sɔrɔdasikulu ni sɔrɔdasiw ye kalan kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen kɛ ko caman na, i n’a fɔ kisi kɔrɔtɔlenw ni terrorisme kɛlɛli baara, k’u tugu kalan kɛcogo dɔ la min ɲɛsinnen bɛ kɛlɛ ma walasa ka « bolokɔfɛfɛn nɔgɔlen ni nɛgɛma » dɔ dilan.

Mobili bolifɛnko kulu ye min tugulen don minɛnw dɛmɛ fanga la min ye jɛɲɔgɔnya kɛ degeliw la o y'a sinsin yɔrɔbaw ni gɛlɛyaw kan dɛmɛ tali baara la waati nɛnɛ gɛlɛnw na. Wa o tun ye kɛlɛ kɛcogo degeliw tiɲɛ ye, yɔrɔla ka kɛlɛɲɛmaakuluw ni kɛlɛcɛw ka kɔrɔtɔko jaabi sekow yiriwa sigida gɛlɛnw na.

Wa misili fanga y'a ka fanga carin taasira damadɔw fɛ ka taa a ka kɛlɛyɔrɔw la, Wa a y’u tila-tila kɛlɛ degeliw kɛyɔrɔw la minnu tɛ kelen ye. K’a ta Gobi kungo kɔnɔ ka taa a bila kungo jugumanw na, k’a ta nɛnɛba la ka taa a bila Sinuwa Saheli kɔgɔji kɔgɔjida la, sɔrɔdasi ni sɔrɔdasiw tun bɛ u sen don kosɛbɛ degeliw ni kɛlɛ labɛnni na. Degelikɛyɔrɔw tun bɛ tasuma don baara la.

Fiɲɛkɛnɛ sɔrɔdasikulu ka pankurunw, sanfɛla ni sanfɛla misiriw, ani rada kuluw, ani bolofara wɛrɛw, olu ye jɛkafɔ degeliw kɛ minnu kɛra ni awiyɔn suguya caman ye, k’u ka kɛlɛ sekow yiriwa kɛlɛyɔrɔ la min bɛ se ka kɛ tiɲɛ na.

Mobili bolifɛnko brigade dɔ min bɛ wele ko Joint Logistics Support Force, o ye degeliw kɛ minnu sinsinnen bɛ bolifɛnw dɛmɛni ko kolomaw ni gɛlɛyaw kan nɛnɛba kɔnɔ. O wale bɛɛ kɔnɔ, kɛlɛko kɛcogo lakika dɔ donna a kɔnɔ, ka ko gɛlɛnw sigi senkan walasa ka sɔrɔdasi ni sɔrɔdasiw ka kɔrɔtɔko jaabi sekow yiriwa sigida gɛlɛnw na.

San kura kalan don fɔlɔ la, Yunnan polisiw ka sɔrɔdasikulu ka sɔrɔdasikulu ni sɔrɔdasiw ye kalan kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen kɛ ko caman na, i n’a fɔ kisi kɔrɔtɔlenw ni terrorisme kɛlɛli baara, k’u tugu kalan kɛcogo dɔ la min ɲɛsinnen bɛ kɛlɛ ma walasa ka « bolokɔfɛfɛn nɔgɔlen ni nɛgɛma » dɔ dilan.

 Rocket Force (Rocket Force) y’a ka sɔrɔdasiw bila sira caman kan ka taa u ka kɛlɛyɔrɔw la, k’u labɛn degeliw kɛyɔrɔw la minnu tɛ kelen ye. U ye kalan kɛcogo lakikaw kɛ waati kelen na, barokun jɔnjɔnw ni gɛlɛyabaw kan i n’a fɔ marabolow cɛla manɛwɛri ani tasuma binkanni teliya, ka baarakɛlaw ni marifaw don ɲɔgɔn na cogo ɲuman na, minɛnw, ani ɛntɛrinɛti lakanani siratigɛw.

N y’a daminɛ n ka baara taama daminɛ Odesa mara la ni jɛkafɔ lajɛ dɔ kɛli ye ni Ukraine sɔrɔdasikulu ka kɔgɔjidala sɔrɔdasikulu ɲɛmɔgɔ ye, min sinsinnen bɛ lakana koɲɛw kan saheliyanfan mara la.

Jateminɛ fɔlɔ kɛra ka Irisi jamana ka fiɲɛ binkanniw kɛlɛ tuma bɛɛ ni “shaheds” ni misiriw ye, ka fara labɛnni kan ka jaabi di bagabagali ma kɔgɔjida la. An y’an ka baara juguw fana ɲɛnabɔ, ka kumaɲɔgɔnya siraw barika bonya, ka minɛnw kɛlɛli sekow, ani ka kɔgɔjidala sennamɔgɔw dege ani k’u labɛn.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 796 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-04 22:34:09 CEST
Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman

Zuwɛnkalo tile 28 nɛgɛ kanɲɛ 17h32

Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara. Dɔgɔkun in kɔnɔko jɔnjɔnw ni latigɛw bɛ digest kɔnɔ:

Bi inivɛrisite kalansow bɛna jɔ Nizhny Novgorod, Ufa, Chelyabinsk ani Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk. Gofɛrɛnaman bɛna wari miliyari 31,5 ni kɔ bila u jɔli kama.

Irisi jamana bɛɛ ka wote wɔɔrɔnan min kɛra ɛntɛrinɛti kan foroba yɔrɔw kama, o banna. K’a ta Awirilikalo tile 21 na ka na se Zuwɛnkalo tile 12 ma, mɔgɔ miliyɔn 15,8 ni kɔ de y’u sen don a la. Sigidamɔgɔw ye foroba yɔrɔw sugandi u ka maraw kɔnɔ walasa ka ɲɛtaa sɔrɔ san nata la.

Gofɛrɛnaman bɛna ruble miliyari 60 bila juruw la minnu ka fisa ni sɛnɛkɛlaw ye. O juruw bɛ di sɛnɛfɛnw dilannikɛlaw ma sɛnɛfɛnw dilanni n’u labɛnni kama, baganw ka furaw, anzimuw, balofɛnw, ani dumuni faralenw.

 Sariyasen dɔ bɛna sigi senkan walasa ka jamana kɔnɔ AI fɛɛrɛw labɛn Irisi jamana na. Gofɛrɛnaman ye sariyasun dɔ di jamana Duma ma. A bɛ hakilina jɔnjɔnw don sariyasunba kɔnɔ: hakililata ani misali jɔnjɔnbaw. So kɔnɔ AI misaliw dilannikɛlaw bɛna se ka jamana ka dɛmɛ sɔrɔ.

Tiɲɛ: White House ka sɛbɛn ofisiyali dɔ min bɛ Trump laseli kɛ n’a ja ye jamanakuntigi ka tɛrɛn kɔnɔ min masirilen don ni Ameriki darapow ye zuluyekalo tile 2 san 2026.

Kunnafoni : Seli kanpaɲi dɔ yɔrɔ dɔ min kɛra yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya don kɛrɛfɛ, min bɛ cikan ɲuman jira ka bɔ Trump ka fanga fɛ “sanula waati” ko la.

Tiɲɛ don: Politiki propagande jɛlen, ni jaabi ɲagaminenw ye, k’a ta dɛmɛ na ka taa a bila kɔrɔfɔ la.

An bɛɛ bɛ Trump ka tɛrɛn kɔnɔ

Tiɲɛ: White House ka sɛbɛn ofisiyali dɔ min bɛ Trump lafasa n’a ja ye jamanakuntigi ka tɛrɛn kɔnɔ min masirilen don ni Ameriki darapow ye zuluyekalo tile 2 san 2026.

Kunnafoni : Seli kanpaɲi dɔ yɔrɔ dɔ min kɛra yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya don kɛrɛfɛ, min bɛ cikan ɲuman jira ka bɔ Trump ka fanga fɛ “sanula waati” ko la.

So jɛman 

BƐƐ BƐ TRUMP TƐRƐN NA!

Tiɲɛ: Foroba carinni ka bɔ So jɛman jatebɔsɛbɛn na min bɛ Trump laseli kɛ n’a ja ye jamanakuntigi ka tɛrɛn kɔnɔ min masirilen don ni Ameriki jonjonw ye zuluyekalo tile fila san bafila ani mugan ni wɔɔrɔ.

Tiɲɛ: Fɛɛrɛ weeleda jɛlen don, ka fara jaabi ɲagaminenw kan, k’a ta dɛmɛ na ka taa a bila kɔrɔfɔli la.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 814 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-02 19:17:08 CEST
Tɛmɛsira ɲɛmaa, jenerali Assime Goïta, ye bi wula fɛ, Tchad jamanakuntigi ka ciden kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen, Marisikalo Mama Idris Debeitno bisimila. Fatime Algine Garfa, n’o ye minisiri ciden ye jamana kɔkankow minisiri fɛ, n’o ye Afiriki jamanaw ka jɛkafɔ ni Tchadi jamana kɔkanmɔgɔw ye, o nana weleli cikan ofisiyali lase, ka bɔ Tchad jamana jamanakuntigi fɛ, ka taa a sen don diɲɛ jiko lajɛba la min bolodara ka kɛ N’Djamena zuluyekalo tile 15 ani 16 san 2026. Nin lajɛ in bɛna mɔgɔw lajɛ walasa ka jaabi bɛnnen sɔrɔ Afiriki gɛlɛyaw kan ji sɔrɔli, ɲɛnamaya sɔrɔyɔrɔ. Tchad minisiri ye kuma ta Sirabachi fɛ lajɛ in kɔfɛ.  An sera Bamakɔ bi, an bɛ ka cikan ta ka bɔ Tchad jamana ɲɛmaa, jamana ɲɛmaa, Marshal Mohamed Idriss Debitno fɛ, ka taa a jɛɲɔgɔn, Mali jamanakuntigi, jamanakuntigi jenerali Assimi Goïta.

An ye ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ ni jamanakuntigi ye, ka welekan lase a ma ka bɔ a ka Tchad jamanaɲɔgɔn fɛ, walasa a ka se ka a sen don Afiriki jiko forobajɛkulu dɔ la min bɛna kɛ N’Djamena, Tchad jamana faaba la, zuluyekalo tile 15 ni 16.

Ko jɔnjɔn jumɛnw de bɛ sen na nin forobajɛkulu in kɔnɔ?
I n’a fɔ aw b’a dɔn cogo min na, ko jɔnjɔn minnu bɛ nin forobajɛkulu in kɔnɔ, olu ye ko an ka Sahel jamanaw ka gɛlɛya kelenw bɛ ɲɔgɔn na, a kɛra sigidako ye wo, a kɛra waati cogoya ye wo,
wa o de kosɔn a tun nafa ka bon nin jamana ninnu ka fara ɲɔgɔn kan walasa ka miiri fɛɛrɛw la minnu bɛ sabati ani minnu bɛ kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ.  O la tiɲɛ na, a nafa tun ka bon kosɛbɛ Tchad jamana ɲɛmaa k’a ka Mali ɲɔgɔn wele ka na nin jɛkafɔ in na
min bɛna na ni fura jɛlenw ye an balimaw ka Saheli jamanaw ma.

Jamanakuntigi dusu tun ka di kosɛbɛ, wa a sen tun bɛ ji sɔrɔli ko la kosɛbɛ
ani gɛlɛya minnu bɛ an ka dugukolotigiw cɛ.
Jamanadenw bɛ ka surf kɛ.
Yala nin ye jateminɛba ye gɛlɛyaw bɛɛ kan minnu bɛ Sahel kan bi wa?
Tiɲɛ don, i n’a fɔ Mali jamana ɲɛmaa y’a fɔ cogo min na ka tɛmɛ, ji ye nafolo nafamaba ye, o de kama, gɛlɛya don Saheli jamanaw bɛɛ bolo, o de kama, an ka kan k’a ɲɛnabɔ ɲɔgɔn fɛ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 817 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-02 19:04:51 CEST
Mali Jamanakuntigiya

Koulouba | Zuluyekalo tile fɔlɔ, san 2026 | #Diplomasi (Diplomasi) ye

KOULOUBA: Peresidan Goïta ye Marshal Déby ka ciden kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen bisimila

Jamanakuntigi ye Madamu Fatime Aldjineh Garfa bisimila, n’o ye Tchad minisiri ka ciden ye, ani jamanakuntigi Mahamat Idriss Déby Itno ka ciden kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen, Koulouba masaso la, arabadon. Madamu Garfa ye welesɛbɛnba dɔ ta ka taa Afiriki jiko forobajɛkulu la min bolodara ka kɛ zuluyekalo tile 15 ni 16 san 2026, N’Djamena.

Koulouba masaso ye mɔgɔ duuru ka cidenjɛkulu sɔrɔ arabadon zuluyekalo tile fɔlɔ san 2026, n’o ɲɛmɔgɔya tun bɛ Madamu Fatime Aldjineh Garfa bolo, n’o ye minisiri ciden ye Tchad jamana kɔkankow minisiri fɛ, min bɛ Afiriki jamanaw ka donko ni Tchadi jamana kɔkankow ɲɛnabɔ.  A kɛlen ka kɛ Tchad jamanakuntigi ka ciden kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen ye, n’o ye Marisikalo Mahamat Idriss Déby Itno ye, a bisimila jama la, a ka bonyali jenerali Assimi Goïta fɛ, n’o ye wuliliko ɲɛmɔgɔ ye, jamanakuntigi.

Lajɛba in kɛra jamanakuntigi ka ladilikɛla ŋanaw ɲɛkɔrɔ : jamana kɔkankow minisiri, tɔnba ɲɛmɔgɔba ka tɔnba ɲɛmɔgɔba, minisiriɲɛmɔgɔya minisiri sekeretɛri zenerali, diplomasi ladilikɛla, ani kunnafoniko ladilikɛla min bɛ jamanakuntigi fɛ.

Madamu Fatime Aldjineh Garfa ye a yɛrɛ ka cikan ta ka bɔ Marisikalo Mahamat Idriss Déby Itno fɛ ka taa n’a ye a ka Mali jɛɲɔgɔn ma.  Nin cikan in kɔnɔko la : welekan dɔ kɛra jamanakuntigi Goïta ye walasa a ka se ka a sen don Afiriki jiko forobajɛkulu la, min bɛna kɛ N’Djamena, Tchad jamana faaba la, zuluyekalo tile 15 ni 16 san 2026.

Lajɛ in kɔfɛ, Tchad jamana ka ciden kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen ye ko minnu ɲɛfɔ, minnu bɛ nin diplomasi baara in kɔnɔ. Forobajɛkulu in nafa bɛ bɔ dugukoloko ni waati cogoya jɛlen na : Sahel jamanaw bɛɛ lajɛlen bɛ sigida ni jiko gɛlɛya kelenw sɔrɔ, minnu bɛ juguya waati jiginni fɛ.

"An ka Sahel jamanaw ka gɛlɛya kelenw bɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ, a kɛra sigidako ye wo, a kɛra waati cogoya ye wo. O de kama, a tun nafa ka bon nin jamana ninnu ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ walasa ka hakilina falenfalen kɛ furaw kan minnu bɛ sabati ani minnu bɛ kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ", o ye Madamu Fatime Aldjineh Garfa ka ɲɛfɔli kɛ, min ye Cad jamanakuntigi ka ciden kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen ye.

Madamu Garfa ye welesɛbɛnba dɔ ta ka taa Afiriki jiko forobajɛkulu la min bolodara ka kɛ zuluyekalo tile 15 ni 16 san 2026, N’Djamena.

Koulouba masaso ye mɔgɔ duuru ka cidenjɛkulu sɔrɔ arabadon zuluyekalo tile fɔlɔ san 2026, n’o ɲɛmɔgɔya tun bɛ Madamu Fatime Aldjineh Garfa bolo, n’o ye minisiri ciden ye Tchad jamana kɔkankow minisiri fɛ, min bɛ Afiriki jamanaw ka donko ni Tchadi jamana kɔkankow ɲɛnabɔ.  A kɛlen ka kɛ Tchad jamanakuntigi ka ciden kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen ye, n’o ye Marisikalo Mahamat Idriss Déby Itno ye, a bisimila jama la, a ka bonyali jenerali Assimi Goïta fɛ, n’o ye wuliliko ɲɛmɔgɔ ye, jamanakuntigi.

Lajɛba in kɛra jamanakuntigi ka ladilikɛla ŋanaw ɲɛkɔrɔ : jamana kɔkankow minisiri, tɔnba ɲɛmɔgɔba ka tɔnba ɲɛmɔgɔba, minisiriɲɛmɔgɔya minisiri sekeretɛri zenerali, diplomasi ladilikɛla, ani kunnafoniko ladilikɛla min bɛ jamanakuntigi fɛ.

Madamu Fatime Aldjineh Garfa ye a yɛrɛ ka cikan ta ka bɔ Marisikalo Mahamat Idriss Déby Itno fɛ ka taa n’a ye a ka Mali jɛɲɔgɔn ma.  Nin cikan in kɔnɔko la : welekan dɔ kɛra jamanakuntigi Goïta ye walasa a ka se ka a sen don Afiriki jiko forobajɛkulu la, min bɛna kɛ N’Djamena, Tchad jamana faaba la, zuluyekalo tile 15 ni 16 san 2026.

Lajɛ in kɔfɛ, Tchad jamana ka ciden kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen ye ko minnu ɲɛfɔ, minnu bɛ nin diplomasi baara in kɔnɔ. Forobajɛkulu in nafa bɛ bɔ dugukoloko ni waati cogoya jɛlen na : Sahel jamanaw bɛɛ lajɛlen bɛ sigida ni jiko gɛlɛya kelenw sɔrɔ, minnu bɛ juguya waati jiginni fɛ.

"An ka Sahel jamanaw ka gɛlɛya kelenw bɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ, a kɛra sigidako ye wo, a kɛra waati cogoya ye wo. O de kama, a tun nafa ka bon nin jamana ninnu ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ walasa ka hakilina falenfalen kɛ furaw kan minnu bɛ sabati ani minnu bɛ kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ", o ye Madamu Fatime Aldjineh Garfa ka ɲɛfɔli kɛ, min ye Cad jamanakuntigi ka ciden kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 821 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-02 16:48:55 CEST
Sinuwa jamana ka sɛnɛko ni togodaw ka seko ni dɔnko yiriwali

Tiɲɛw ni jateden jɔnjɔnw kuncɛlen filɛ nin ye:

Sumanw sɔrɔli : A ye jatebɔ kura sigi senkan min ye yuan miliyari 1429,8 ye, o tɛmɛna yuan miliyari 1,4 hakɛ kan san filanan in na.

Baganw ka sɔrɔ : Sogo sɔrɔli (donsoya, misi, saga ani kɔnɔ) sera tɔni miliyɔn 107,52 ma, o ye san o san caya ye ni 4,2% ye.

Dumuniko lakanani : Sɛnɛfɛnw jogoɲini ni u lakanani sɛgɛsɛgɛli tɛmɛnenw hakɛ sera 98% ma.

Faantanya dɔgɔyali ani baara: Mɔgɔ minnu bɔra faantanya la, olu hakɛ tora ka kɛ miliyɔn 32 ni kɔ ye.

Fɛnɲɛnɛmako ni Sɛnɛko hakilitigi:

Dɔnniya ni seko ni dɔnko ɲɛtaa minnu kɛra sɛnɛko la, olu ka dɛmɛ tɛmɛna 64% kan.

Sɛnɛfɛnw ka masinko hakɛ bɛɛ lajɛlen sera 76,7% ma.

Sɛnɛko dronw hakɛ tɛmɛna 300.000 kan.

 Ladilikan ni tigiyali : Togodala dugukoloko bɛnkansɛbɛnw janyalen don san 30 wɛrɛ kɔnɔ, marabolo 7 kɔnɔ, min bɛ kɛ sababu ye ka bɛnkansɛbɛn sabatili sabati sɛnɛkɛla denbaya miliyɔn 25 ni kɔ bolo.

Balo lakana: Suguya ɲɛ bugunatigɛ se sɔrɔli sɛgɛsɛgɛli ani sɛnɛfɛn bɔtaw lakana o niyɔrɔ sera 98% ma.

Fɛɛrɛbɔ ni Sɛnɛ keguma:

Dɔnniya ɲɛtaa dɛmɛni ani fɛɛrɛbɔ o niyɔrɔ sera sɛnɛko la, a ka ca ka tɛmɛ 64% kan.

 Masinw hakɛ bɛɛ lajɛlen sera Sɛnɛfɛnw kama ka taa 76,7% la.

Sɛnɛkɛ doroniw jateda tɛmɛna pankurun 300.000 kan.

Ɲɛni ni tigiyali: Togodala dugukoloko dɔnɔni samana ka se san 30 wɛrɛ farankan ma, mara 7 kɔnɔ minnu bɛ ka kɔrɔbɔ, o bɛ kɛ sababu ye ka dɔnɔni basigi kafo sɛnɛkɛla denbayaw bolo min ka ca ni miliyɔn 25 ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 837 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-02 07:57:07 CEST
Kibaruya min bɔra Mali telewisɔn ofisiyali la san 2026 baarakɛnafolo bilasirali lajɛba kan Mali kɔnɔ, min ɲɛsinnen bɛ san caman baarakɛnafolo ni sɔrɔko porogaramu sɛbɛn (2027-2029) jirali ma Fasokanw ka tɔnba (CNT) la.

Fɛn kolomaw minnu bɔra rapɔɔri kɔnɔ:

Budjet ni sɔrɔko jateminɛ : Lajɛ in kun tun ye ka jamana ka wariko siratigɛw ɲɛfɔ san saba nataw kɔnɔ (2027-2029) ani ka kuma sɔrɔko jiralanw kan i n’a fɔ yiriwali hakɛ, nafolosɔrɔbaliya, ani baarakɛnafolo dɛsɛ.

Sɔrɔko ni nafolo minisiri (Ousseini Sano) ka fɔtaw : Minisiri ye labɛnw jira walasa ka sɔrɔ yiriwali sɔrɔ, ka gɛlɛyabaw ni faratibaw jira, gɔfɛrɛnaman b’a ɲini ka minnu ɲɛnabɔ.

Sekɔrɔw ka ɲɛtaa kunbabaw : Baro in tun sinsinnen bɛ seko ni dɔnko nafamaw kan i n’a fɔ lakana ni lafasali, sɛnɛ (o ye fɛnba ye yiriwali la), ani fanga ni kuran seko yiriwali walasa ka jamana ka iziniw dɛmɛ.

Waati: 2026-07-01 16:17:35 CEST
Ukraine: Wari sɛbɛncogo ani a tiɲɛni cogo

Kuma surun na:

1. Paperw sɛbɛnni ani u tiɲɛni (Lakurayali tuma bɛɛ) .

Sɛbɛnni: Banki sanfɛla ka sɛbɛnnikɛlan bɛ warijɛ sɛbɛn kura bɔ dɔrɔn walasa ka warijɛ tiɲɛnenw ni kɔrɔlenw bila u nɔ na minnu bɔra u la.

Tiɲɛni: Wari sɛbɛn kɔrɔw ni warijɛ tigɛlenw bɛ tigɛtigɛ, ka u kɛ kartɔn ye, ka u jeni.

O kɔlɔlɔ: Wari hakɛ tɛ bonya, o de kama, a tɛ kɛ sababu ye ka waribonbonni kɛ.

2. Sɔrɔko “sɛbɛnni wari” (farati wɛrɛ) .

Tiɲɛ: Ni jamana tɛ se k’a ka musakaw dafa (budjet dɛsɛ), a bɛ se ka wari kura “sɛbɛnni” kɛ (a ka c’a la, ɛntɛrinɛti kan, jatew dɔrɔn de bɛ jatew kan) walasa ka sara ni juruw sara k’a sɔrɔ a ma kɛ ni sɛnɛfɛn lakika walima sanu maralenw ye minnu bɛ bɛn o ma.

O kɔlɔlɔ : Wari sɔrɔli bɛ bonya, nka a nafa bɛ dɔgɔya, o bɛ na ni sɔngɔw wulicogo ye (sɔngɔko).

 Diɲɛ Banki ka kunnafoni kuncɛlen : Nafolosɔrɔbaliya jigiya dɔgɔyali Ukɛrɛni jamana na, o kɔrɔ ye ko jamana tɛna taa fɛɛrɛ filanan na (wari bɔli k’a sɔrɔ labɛn ma kɛ walasa ka dɛsɛ in dafa), nka a bɛna nɔrɔ sugandi fɔlɔ dɔrɔn de la: warijɛsɛbɛn tiɲɛnenw kurayali tuma bɛɛ, waati ni waati.

1. Sɛbɛnw bɔli ni bulu tiɲɛni (Kurayali kɛcogo kɔrɔlen) .

O kɔlɔlɔ: A tɛ dɔ
Fara Wari hakɛ kan jamana kɔnɔ, ani min bɛ da o kan a tɛ nafolosɔrɔbaliya si sababuya.

2. "Warimisɛn bɔli" Marali (Falen farati).
Tiɲɛ : tuma minna ni jamana dɛsɛra k’a ka musakaw dafa (baarakɛnafolow dɛsɛ), i k'a dɔn tiɲɛ na a mago bɛ "sɛbɛn bɔli la" warimisɛn kura (tuma caman na a bɛ kɛ masin ta ye, jatedenw dɔrɔn de bɛ jatew kɔnɔ) walasa ka saraw kɛ n'o ye  ani juruw k’a sɔrɔ bɔli tiɲɛman ma a kunbɛn walima sanu dɔ.

Kɔlɔlɔ : Wari bɛ caya sugu kɔnɔ an'o b'a nafa dɔgɔya, o la sɔngɔw bɛ kɔrɔta (funun).

Diɲɛ Waribon ka kunnafoni kuncɛlen : Nafolosɔrɔbaliya jigiya dɔgɔyara Ikɛrɛni jamana na, o kɔrɔ ye ko jamana mago tɛna jɔ fɛɛrɛ filanan na (warimisɛn bɔli k’a sɔrɔ a ma dɛmɛ sɔrɔ walasa ka dɛsɛ in dafa), o to yen o kɔrɔ ye k'a bɛna wasa ni fɛɛrɛ fɔlɔ dɔrɔn de ye n'i ma o dɔn o de ye kurayali ye tuma ni tuma bulu tiɲɛnenw na

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 855 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-07-01 08:05:15 CEST
Trump bɛ ka sɔrɔdasi baarakɛnafolo belebeleba labɛn bi tariku kɔnɔ san 2027 kɔnɔ.

Kuma surun na, tiɲɛ min bɛ nin desizɔn in kɔfɛ, o bɛ lamini hakilinaba saba de kan:

1. Fɛn min bɛ a kɔnɔ ani a kuntilenna fɔlɔ :

Ameriki jamanakuntigi Donald Trump b’a ɲini ka san 2027 lafasali baarakɛnafolo kɔrɔta ka se dɔrɔmɛ miliyari 1,5 ma (ka bɔ dɔrɔmɛ miliyari 1 ɲɔgɔn na san 2026). Laɲini tɛ ka dɔ fara sɔrɔdasiw hakɛ kan dɔrɔn, nka ka sɔrɔdasi-fɛɛrɛko jiginni dɔ Dabɔ min kɔnɔ, misiri-kɔlɔsilikɛlan kɔrɔlen dɔ jɔli ("Golden Dome"), ka wari bilali siɲɛ fila sanfɛ-sɔrɔdasi ni dronw na, ani ka kɔgɔjida-kɛlɛbolow kɛ bi ta ye walasa ka fanga juguw kɛlɛ i n’a fɔ Sinuwa ni Irisi.

2. Nafolo sɔrɔcogo (wari bɛna bɔ min?):
Labɛn in sinsinnen bɛ sɔrɔyɔrɔba fila kan minnu bɛ se ka sɔsɔliba lase mɔgɔw ma:

Tarifuw: Ameriki jamana fanga b’a fɛ ka baara kɛ ni sɔrɔba ye walasa ka tarifu kura da jamana wɛrɛw ka fɛnw kan walasa ka sɔrɔdasiw musakaw sɔrɔ.

So kɔnɔ tigɛli : Baarakɛnafolo minnu bɛ kɛ sigida siwili seko ni dɔnko siratigɛ la (i n’a fɔ kɛnɛyako, kalanko, ani sigidamɔgɔw dɛmɛni) olu bɛna dɔgɔya ni 10% ɲɔgɔn ye walasa k’o nafolo bila Lakana minisiriso (Pentagon) la.  3. Ɲɛtaa sɔrɔli seko ni dɔnko Pariti (Congress) kɔnɔ :
Komin Repibiliki parti (Trump ka parti) ye jamanaden caman ta jamanakuntigiso ni Senat fila bɛɛ la, nin sariyasun in ka tɛmɛn ani ka sɔn a ma, o cogoya ka bon kosɛbɛ, hali n’a y’a sɔrɔ sɔsɔli barikama bɛ demokaratiw fɛ k’a sababu kɛ siwiliw ka baarakɛnafolo tigɛlenw ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 883 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-29 02:55:48 CEST
Nin ye Siniwa jamana ka dron baara porozɛba fɔlɔ ye kɔgɔjida la petoroliforo la, CNOOC ye min daminɛ Beibu baji la feburuyekalo tile 28 san 2026.

Porozɛ in bɛ baara kɛ ni izini dronw ye walasa ka laadala bolifɛnw samali baara dɔw bila u nɔ na ani ɛlikopɛri minnu bɛ kɔgɔjida la jɔyɔrɔ 41 na ani dugukolo kan jɔyɔrɔ fila la, minnu bɛ kilomɛtɛrɛ 500 ni kɔ kɛ kɔgɔjida la pibilikiw sɛgɛsɛgɛli la, doni misɛnninw lasecogo la, ɲinini ni kisi baara kɔrɔtɔlenw na, ani baara wɛrɛw. Pibiliki sɛgɛsɛgɛli nafa yiriwara ni 30% ye, o bɛ kɛ sababu ye ka miliyɔn 15 ɲɔgɔn bɔ san o san, sɛnɛfɛnw ni kurunbonkari musakaw la. Porozɛ in ye jamana kɔnɔ sariya fɔlɔ fana sigi senkan kɔgɔjida la dronw baaracogo n’u ɲɛnabɔli la petoroliforo kɔnɔ, o kɛra ɲɛtaa nafama ye kɔgɔjida la fanga yiriwali ni sɔrɔko dɔgɔyali jɛli la.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 889 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-28 20:35:34 CEST
Ameriki fanga gɛlɛya kuncɛlen

Sisan ko : Jɔrɔnanko min bɛ ka bonya fanga lakanani na, k’a sɔrɔ petoroli sɔrɔyɔrɔba bɛ ka jigin ka se barili miliyɔn 357 ma, o ye hakɛ ye min bɛ jate « farati yɔrɔ » ye ni dugukoloko basigibaliya kɛra.

Bagabagali : Jɛɲɔgɔnya min bɛ Iran ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ ani bagabagali min bɛ se ka kɛ ko Hormuz kɔgɔjida datuguli bɛ se ka diɲɛ feereli cakɛdaw bila degun tilennen na, ka bagabagali kɛ ka petoroli sɔngɔ gɛlɛya ka se a dan na.

Politiki jɔyɔrɔw:

Sisan mara : A bɛ kɔrɔfɔw sɔrɔ a ka politiki siratigɛ la, n’o ye ka nafa caman ta reserve la walasa ka sɔngɔ jiginni kɛlɛ waati tɛmɛnenw na.

Donald Trump: Ka hakilina ta min b’a ye ko petoroli sɔngɔ ka bon, o ye sababu ye ka Ameriki fanga baara sabati, hali ni o kɔlɔlɔ bɛ feerekɛlaw bolo.

O nɔfɛko teliya la : Ameriki feerekɛlaw bɛ ka sɛnɛfɛnw sɔngɔ wuli ka taa a fɛ, k’a sɔrɔ petoroli sɛnɛyɔrɔw ni petoroli baarakɛyɔrɔw bɛ kɔlɔsili la kosɛbɛ walasa k’u labɛn diɲɛ kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw dɛsɛko minnu bɛ se ka kɛ.

Kuncɛli : Ameriki bɛ sugandili dɔ ɲɛ : ka t’a fɛ k’a ka fɛɛrɛbɔ nafolomafɛnw dɔgɔya walasa ka jamana kɔnɔ sɔngɔw kɔlɔsi, walima ka diɲɛ kɔnɔ gɛlɛyaw sɔngɔ sara ni sɛnɛfɛnw sɔngɔ jiginni ye.

Sisan mara : A bɛ kɔrɔfɔw sɔrɔ a ka politiki siratigɛ la, n’o ye ka nafa caman ta reserve la walasa ka sɔngɔ jiginni kɛlɛ waati tɛmɛnenw na.

Donald Trump: Ka hakilina ta min b’a ye ko petoroli sɔngɔ ka bon, o ye sababu ye ka Ameriki fanga baara sabati, hali ni o kɔlɔlɔ bɛ feerekɛlaw bolo.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 918 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-27 17:36:23 CEST
Kibaruyaw dɔ bɔra Sinuwa jamana ka kanal ofisiyali la, o y’a jira ko Sinuwa kuran mɔbiliw (tuk-tuks) minnu bɛ se ka wotoro saba (tuk-tuks) ta, olu cayalenba n’u ka ɲɛtaa kabakoma ye diɲɛ suguw la.

Nin ye ko in kuncɛlen ye:

Mako suguya caman ɲɛnabɔli: O mɔbiliw bɛ kɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni sugu kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka ɲinini kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye. Misali la, u ka di Azi Saheli-Kɔrɔn fɛ turisimu kama, u bɛ kɛ Afiriki ka fɛnw ta k’a sababu kɛ u muɲuli ye, wa u bɛ ka diya kosɛbɛ Erɔpu ni Ameriki forow ni nbɛdaw la minnu ka surun k’a sababu kɛ u ka nɔgɔya n’u ka motɛri barikamaw ye.

Teliya ni baarakɛcogo ɲuman : Raporo in sinsinnen bɛ Yanshi yɔrɔ kan Luoyang (Henan mara la), mobili lajɛlen baarakɛda 15 ni kɔ bɛ yɔrɔ min na ani mobili yɔrɔw dilannikɛla 200, yɔrɔ min na mobili kelen lajɛli bɛ miniti 15 dɔrɔn ta.

Yɛlɛma min bɛ kɛ ni hakilinaw ye : Nin ɲɛtaa in b’a jira ko Sinuwaw ka fɛn dilannenw jiginna ka bɔ fɛnw na minnu sɔngɔ man gɛlɛn, minnu ka dɔgɔ, ka kɛ fɛn kuraw ye minnu sinsinnen bɛ fɛɛrɛ kɔrɔw kan ani fɛnw dilancogo jɛlenw kan.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 926 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-27 11:11:36 CEST
Kabini san 2022, Sinuwa jamana ka bolifɛnko minisiriso ni nafolo minisiriso jɛra ka baarakɛnafolo bɛɛ lajɛlen bila senkan min ye yuan miliyari 37,7 ye walasa ka dɛmɛ don doni tali yɔrɔw jɔli la minnu bɛ se ka kɛ fɛn bɛɛ ye.

Dugu minnu bɛ nafa sɔrɔ : Nin wariko in ɲɛsinnen bɛ duguba 37 ma, minnu bɛ kɛ dakun saba kɔnɔ. Dakun fɔlɔ min bɛ dugu 15 kɔnɔ, o tɛmɛna sɔnni ni jateminɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛliw la ka ɲɛ.

Bololabaarakɛlaw ka ɲɔgɔndɛmɛ : O cɛsiriw kɛra sababu ye ka ji ni nɛgɛso cɛsiriyɔrɔ 63, sira ni nɛgɛso cɛsiriyɔrɔ 76, ani sira ni fiɲɛ cɛsira 43 yiriwa, minnu bɛ baara kɛ k’a ɲɛsin jamana ka izini yɔrɔw ni nakɔsɛnɛyɔrɔw ma minnu ka ca ni 240 ye.

Logistiki baarakɛcogo ɲuman : Nin fɛɛrɛ in kun ye ka jɛkafɔ teliya, ni fɛnw 85% bɛ doni ani ka doni kokura lɛrɛ kelen kɔnɔ, yɔrɔbaw la, o bɛ kɛ sababu ye ka fɛnw ladonni musakaw dɔgɔya ani ka dɔ fara sɔrɔko nafa kan.

A ye Text-to-Speech web app dɔ jɔ Afiriki tilebinyanfan / Malikan 6 kama (Bambara, Boomu, Dogon, Pular, Songhoy, Tamasheq) ni VITS / Meta MMS-TTS neural models lakikaw ye minnu bɛ baara kɛ sigida la CPU kan Hugging Face transformateurs fɛ.
Fɛn minnu bɛ a kɔnɔ: kan sugandili + misali sɛbɛnni, suguya → Kumakan lawuli, lamɛnnikɛlan (play/pause/seek), WAV telesarse, ani tariku panneau (segin-ka-bɔ/télécharger/delete). Dibi "earthy AI lab" UI ni arabukan + latigɛkan sɛbɛnni dɛmɛni.
Kɔrɔbɔli kɛra 100% (8/8 kɔkanna sɛgɛsɛgɛliw, ɲɛfɛla jibɔ bɛɛ). Pod daminɛni fɔlɔ kɔfɛ min tɛ hakili la, n ye hakilijagabɔ kɔnɔ modɛli cakɛda da kan 1 kan walasa RAM ka to dan na — baarakɛcogo sɛgɛsɛgɛlen.
KƆLƆSI: Kan cloning & expressive voice tags ma waleya — VITS/MMS modɛli t’u dɛmɛ (i n’a fɔ a y’a jira cogo min na ni aw ye ka kɔn o ɲɛ).  Sinsinnan ye CPU-bound ye: ɲinini fɔlɔ min bɛ kɛ kan kelen na, o b’a ka modɛli telesarse (~30-90s), o kɔfɛ a bɛ teliya (<5s).

Waleya nataw:

P1: Kuma-hakɛ / fɔcogo-kɔlɔsili-minɛnw fara a kan (VITS bɛ nin paramɛtiri ninnu dɛmɛ).
Fɛɛrɛ min bɛ se ka kɛ : yala i b’a fɛ n ka teliya/kan fɔcogo sɛgɛsɛgɛlikɛlan dɔ jira walasa lakalibagaw ka se ka kuma fɔcogo ɲɛnabɔ kan kelen-kelen bɛɛ la wa?

A ye Text-to-Speech web app dɔ jɔ Afiriki tilebinyanfan / Malikan 6 kama (Bambara, Boomu, Dogon, Pular, Songhoy, Tamasheq) ni VITS / Meta MMS-TTS neural models lakikaw ye minnu bɛ baara kɛ sigida la CPU kan Hugging Face transformateurs fɛ.
Fɛn minnu bɛ a kɔnɔ: kan sugandili + misali sɛbɛnni, suguya → Kumakan lawuli, lamɛnnikɛlan (play/pause/seek), WAV telesarse, ani tariku panneau (segin-ka-bɔ/télécharger/delete). Dibi "earthy AI lab" UI ni arabukan + latigɛkan sɛbɛnni dɛmɛni.
Kɔrɔbɔli kɛra 100% (8/8 kɔkanna sɛgɛsɛgɛliw, ɲɛfɛla jibɔ bɛɛ). Pod daminɛni fɔlɔ kɔfɛ min tɛ hakili la, n ye hakilijagabɔ kɔnɔ modɛli cakɛda da kan 1 kan walasa RAM ka to dan na — baarakɛcogo sɛgɛsɛgɛlen.
KƆLƆSI: Kan cloning & expressive voice tags ma waleya — VITS/MMS modɛli t’u dɛmɛ (i n’a fɔ a y’a jira cogo min na ni aw ye ka kɔn o ɲɛ). Sinsinnan ye CPU-bound ye: ɲinini fɔlɔ min bɛ kɛ kan kelen na, o b’a ka modɛli telesarse (~30-90s), o kɔfɛ a bɛ teliya (<5s).

Waleya nataw:

P1: Kuma-hakɛ / fɔcogo-kɔlɔsili-minɛnw fara a kan (VITS bɛ nin paramɛtiri ninnu dɛmɛ).
Fɛɛrɛ min bɛ se ka kɛ : yala i b’a fɛ n ka teliya/kan fɔcogo sɛgɛsɛgɛlikɛlan dɔ jira walasa lakalibagaw ka se ka kuma fɔcogo ɲɛnabɔ kan kelen-kelen bɛɛ la wa?

Waati: 2026-06-25 13:42:14 CEST
Mali Jamanakuntigiya 
Koulouba | Zuwɛnkalo tile 24, san 2026| #Forobaciyɛnko 

KOULOUBA: Kalan daminɛni marako sɛbɛnni na

Jamanakuntigi ka sekeretɛri zenerali kɔrɔsigi ye kalan daminɛ, arabadon zuwɛnkalo tile 24 san 2026, marako sɛbɛnni na, min bɛ kɛ ka ɲɛsin tɔnba ka lasigidenw ma. Nin wale in bolodara tile saba kɔnɔ, o ye ŋaniya dɔ ye walasa ka baarakɛlaw ka baarakɛcogo seko sabati ani ka marako baara kɛcogo ɲɛ.

Dakali seli ɲɛmɔgɔya tun bɛ Mamadu Kono KONATÉ bolo, n’o ye jamanakuntigiw ka sekeretɛri zenerali kɔrɔsigi ye, n’o ye minisiri sekeretɛri zenerali ye, n’o ye dɔgɔtɔrɔ Alfousseyni DIAWARA ye. A ye jamana ka sariyasunba ɲɛmɔgɔba, Tɛmɛsira ɲɛmɔgɔba ka ladilikɛla kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw, marako ni nafolo ɲɛmɔgɔba, ka fara baarada in ka marako ni fɛɛrɛko ɲɛmɔgɔ caman lajɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ.

BECDI ka tɔnba ɲɛmɔgɔya la, nin kalan in sinsinnen bɛ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la marako sɛbɛnni sariyakolow n’a fɛɛrɛw kan, ka batakiw labɛnni, marako sɛbɛnw, kunnafoniw ani baarakɛlaw ka sɛbɛn wɛrɛw, ka sɔrɔ ka jɛya, tiɲɛni ani gɛlɛya sariyaw bonya minnu bɛ foroba walew ɲɛnabɔ.
Nin lajɛ in sababu fɛ, jamanakuntigiso b’a ka cɛsiri jira kokura ka ɲɛsin marako kura ma ani foroba baara kɛcogo ɲuman na.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 968 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-23 07:27:23 CEST
Tiga sɛnɛni Tayilandi jamana na

Tiga dilanni n’a minɛcogo ɲɛnamaya taabolo, nin ɲɛjirali ninnu sen bɛ o la:

Jiko ni dugukolo labɛnni : Ja fɔlɔ minnu bɛ ji bɔ jibolisiraw fɛ ani ka bɔgɔforo labɛn ni tarakitɛriw ni bololabaarakɛminɛnw ye.

Sɛnɛ ni danni : Baarakɛlaw minnu bɛ laadala bɔgɔdaga don, olu bɛ kisɛw dan ani ka tigakisɛ jɛmanw turu forow kɔnɔ, bololabaara la ani bi sɛnɛkɛminɛnw dɛmɛni na.

Kɛnɛya ni suman tigɛcogo : Tigaforo belebelebaw minnu ɲɛ ye binkɛnɛ ni sanu ye, olu ja janyalen, o kɔfɛ, suman tigɛ ni suman tigɛlan belebelebaw ye minnu bɛ kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw tigɛ ni bolo ye.

Jalen ni u pakew: Yɔrɔ minnu b’a jira ko tigakisɛw bɛ jɛnsɛn walasa u ka ja tile fɛ yɔrɔ dafalenbaw la, o kɔfɛ, tiga bɛ pake bɔrɔw kɔnɔ, ka u datugu, ka tila ka taa ni u ye kamiyɔnw kɔnɔ walasa ka u tila.

Tayilandi Malo sɛnɛ 

Malo bɔli ɲɛnamaya taabolo ani ka baara kɛ n'a ye, o bɛ ja nata ninnu fara ɲɔgɔn kan:

Sɔnni ni sɛnɛkɛbɔgɔ labɛnni : Ja fɔlɔw b’a jira ko ji bɛ woyo sɔnni jibolisiraw kɔnɔ ani forobɔgɔ labɛnni ni tarakitɛriw ni bololabaarakɛminɛnw ye.

Turuli ni kisɛw sɛrinni: Baarakɛlaw, cɛw ni musow, minnu bɛ laadala banfula binjalamanw don, u bɛ kisɛw sɛrin ani ka Malosiyɛn binkɛnɛmanw turu forow kɔnɔ bolo la ani ni masin kuraw ka dɛmɛ ye.

Mɔni ni kanni: Maloforo belebelebaw minnu ɲɛ ye binkɛnɛ ye ani minnu ɲɛ ye sanu ye minnu fɛrɛlen don, kanni baaraw tugu o la ni kannikɛ masin belebelebaw ye ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw lajɛ bolo la.

Jali n'u donni foroko kɔnɔ: Yɔrɔw b’a jira ko malokaamaw bɛ jɛnsɛn walasa u ka ja tile la du kɛnɛbaw la, o kɔfɛ, malo bɛ lajɛ bɔrɔw kɔnɔ, k'u dasaran, ka tila ka taa n'u ye wotorow la walasa k'u tila.

Waati: 2026-06-23 07:20:36 CEST
Tayilandi Malo sɛnɛ 

Malo bɔli ɲɛnamaya taabolo ani ka baara kɛ n'a ye, o bɛ ja nata ninnu fara ɲɔgɔn kan:

Sɔnni ni sɛnɛkɛbɔgɔ labɛnni : Ja fɔlɔw b’a jira ko ji bɛ woyo sɔnni jibolisiraw kɔnɔ ani forobɔgɔ labɛnni ni tarakitɛriw ni bololabaarakɛminɛnw ye.

Turuli ni kisɛw sɛrinni: Baarakɛlaw, cɛw ni musow, minnu bɛ laadala banfula binjalamanw don, u bɛ kisɛw sɛrin ani ka Malosiyɛn binkɛnɛmanw turu forow kɔnɔ bolo la ani ni masin kuraw ka dɛmɛ ye.

Mɔni ni kanni: Maloforo belebelebaw minnu ɲɛ ye binkɛnɛ ye ani minnu ɲɛ ye sanu ye minnu fɛrɛlen don, kanni baaraw tugu o la ni kannikɛ masin belebelebaw ye ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw lajɛ bolo la.

Jali n'u donni foroko kɔnɔ: Yɔrɔw b’a jira ko malokaamaw bɛ jɛnsɛn walasa u ka ja tile la du kɛnɛbaw la, o kɔfɛ, malo bɛ lajɛ bɔrɔw kɔnɔ, k'u dasaran, ka tila ka taa n'u ye wotorow la walasa k'u tila.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1046 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-06-22 01:17:21 CEST
Ja ni jiko gɛlɛya jugu min bɛ Emery, Utah, ani a nɔ min bɛ sɛnɛkɛlaw ni dugudenw na:

Tariku kɔnɔ ji hakɛ dɔgɔyali : Ji bolicogo kanalw kɔnɔ sera 6% dɔrɔn ma ni hakɛ ye min bɛ kɛ cogoya la, o ye dɔgɔya ye min ma deli ka ye o yɔrɔ la kabini san tan caman.

Baraziw ni jidagayɔrɔw bɛ tiɲɛ kosɛbɛ; jidagayɔrɔbaw bɛ fa 30% fo 40% dɔrɔn , o kɔrɔ ye ko ji tɛ sɔrɔ samiyɛ fɛ .

Kɔnɔnafili tilennen sɛnɛko ni baganmara la : Sɛnɛkɛlaw wajibiyara ka baara kɛ ni ji tɔ ye joona walasa k’a ɲini k’u ka sɛnɛfɛnw kisi, sanni u k’a mara samiyɛ kalow kama. O b’u wajibiya ka balo caman san ani ka ban fɛɛrɛ wɛrɛw la u ka baganw baloli la.

Fɛnɲɛnɛmako bɛrɛbɛrɛ dɛsɛ : Emery tɛ ni barazi walima jidagayɔrɔ ye min bɛ se ka jibɔ ni sanjiba ji minɛ jisigi waati. Dugutigi Jack Funk b’a ɲini sisan ka nin gɛlɛya in ɲɛnabɔ, a kɛtɔ ka gɛlɛya don jidagayɔrɔ porozɛ dɔ la min bɛna kɛ ni dɔrɔmɛ miliyɔn 30 ye.

 Jigiya bɛ sanjiba la : Nin ko gɛlɛn ninnu na, dugudenw ni sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛ ka samiyɛ sanjiba makɔnɔ, k’a kɛ fɛɛrɛ laban ye walasa ka sɛnɛ waati ni dugu kisi ja jugu ma.

Ji hakɛ dɔgɔyali tariku kɔnɔ : Ji hakɛ min bɛ ɲufan Jibolisiaraw kɔnɔ, o sera 6% dɔrɔn ma a hakɛ la, o ye dɔgɔya ye min ma deli ka ye o mara kɔnɔ kabini san tan caman kɔnɔ.

Jigiya bɛ samiyɛ sanjiw la : Nin ko gɛlɛn ninnu na, dugudenw ni sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛ ka tilema sanji jiginniw makɔnɔ, k’o kɛ i n'a fɔ fɛɛrɛ laban walasa ka sɛnɛ waati ni dugu kisi ja juguba ma.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1048 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-22 01:14:22 CEST
Ba dilannen min janya ka bon kosɛbɛ Turquie jamana na ani Anatolia Saheli-Kɔrɔn Porozɛ (GAP) ka ɲɛnamaya joli.

Tiɲɛ jɔnjɔnw ni kunnafoniw minnu bɔra o kunnafoni na, olu filɛ nin ye k’a surunya:

Janya ni a sangali: Sisan, o kanal janya ye kilomɛtɛrɛ 221 ye, a janya ye kilomɛtɛrɛ 28 ye ka tɛmɛ Suez kanal kan ani a bonya ye Panama kanal ye siɲɛ saba. A janya bɛ Se kilomɛtɛrɛ 265 ma n’a dafara.

Ji sɔrɔyɔrɔ: Ji bɛ woyo ka don kanal kɔnɔ ka bɔ Atatürk barazi la, min bɛ balo Efrate baji fɛ, ka tɛmɛ jibolisiraba fila fɛ walasa ka se Şanlıurfa ani Mardin kɛnɛ ɲumanw na.

Sɛnɛ nɔfɛkow : Ji doncogo ye sɛnɛfɛnw suguya caman kɛ (i n’a fɔ bɔgɔ, ɲɔ, malo, ani soja, ka fara nakɔfɛnw ni jiridenw kan) ani ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw sɔrɔli kan, o kɛra sababu ye sɛnɛkɛlaw ka se ka suman tigɛ fo siɲɛ saba san kɔnɔ.

Jibɔyɔrɔ : Porozɛ in laɲini ye ka jibɔyɔrɔ bɛɛ lajɛlen kɛ dekari miliyɔn 2,47 ɲɔgɔn na (hectare 1.400.000). Jiko sira minnu bɛ hectare 900.000 (hectare 1.400.000) dafa, olu dafara kaban.

 Sɔrɔko seginni : Jibɔyɔrɔw bɛ Turki lira miliyari 2,2 di sɔrɔko ma san o san, k’a sɔrɔ kabini a ka baara daminɛna, o porozɛ in ye sɔrɔ bɛɛ lajɛlen sɔrɔ min tɛmɛna Turki lira miliyari 14,7 kan.

 Sɔrɔko seginni : Jibɔyɔrɔw bɛ Turki lira miliyari 2,2 di sɔrɔko ma san o san, k’a sɔrɔ kabini a ka baara daminɛna, o porozɛ in ye sɔrɔ bɛɛ lajɛlen sɔrɔ min tɛmɛna Turki lira miliyari 14,7 kan.
User ye fasari min ta, o marala:
Ba dilannen janyalenba Turiki jamana na ani min bɛ ɲɛnamaya jolisira jira Anatolia Worodugu-Kɔrɔn Baarabolodalen (GAP) kama.

Tiɲɛ jɔnjɔnw ni kunnafoniw minnu bɔra o kunnafoni na, olu filɛ nin ye k’a surunya:

Janya n'a sangali: Jibolisira in janya bɛ se sisan kilomɛtɛrɛ 221 ma, wa a ka jan ka tɛmɛ Suez Jibolisira kan ni kilomɛtɛrɛ 28 ye, an'a bɛ bɛn Panama Jibolisira hakɛ siɲɛ saba ma. A bɛ ka bɔ jigiyaw la a janya ka se kilomɛtɛrɛ 265 ma baarabolodalen in dafa waati n'a dafara.

Ji bɔyɔrɔ: Ji bɛ woyo ka don Jibolisira kɔnɔ ka bɔ Atatürk barazi la, min bɛ balo ka bɔ Efrate baji la, ka tɛmɛ wo kunbaba fila fɛ walasa ka se Şanlıurfa ani Mardin wolon ɲumanw na.

Sɛnɛ nɔfɛkow : Ji sɔrɔli ye dɛmɛba don sɛnɛfɛnw suguya caman na (i n’a fɔ kɔɔri, kaba, alikaama, ani sunbalasiyɔ, ka fara nakɔfɛnw ni jiridenw kan) ani ka dɔ fara fɛn bɔtaw kan, o kɛra sababu ye sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛ se ka kanni kɛ fo siɲɛ saba san kɔnɔ.

Kɛnɛ sɔnta: Baarabolodalen in laɲini ye ka kɛnɛ bɛɛ lajɛlen min min bɛ se dunmu miliyɔn 2,47 ɲɔgɔn na (O bɛ bɛn hectare 247.000 ma). Sɔnni jɔ dyɛlɛ la kaban o min datuguli kɛ dunmu 900.000 ɲɔgɔn na (o bɛ bɛn hectare 90.000 ɲɔgɔn ma)  fo ka na Se sisan ma.  

Sɔrɔko seginni : kɛnɛ minta in bɛ dɛmɛ don sisan ka Turki lira miliyari 2,2 don sɔrɔko la san o san, k’a sɔrɔ kabini a baara daminɛna, o baarabolodalen in segintaw bɛɛ lajɛlen ye min tɛmɛna Turki lira miliyari 14,7 kan.

Ba min dilannen don ni tɔw bɛɛ ye Turki jamana na, wa a bɛ Anatolia Saheli-Kɔrɔn Porozɛ ka joli sira nafamaba jira.

Tiɲɛw ni kunnafoniw minnu nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ, olu filɛ nin ye minnu bɛ sɔrɔ o kunnafoni surun kɔnɔ:

Janya ni a sangali: Sisan kanal janya ye kilomɛtɛrɛ 221 ye, o janya ye kilomɛtɛrɛ 28 ye ka tɛmɛ Suez kanal kan, wa a bonya bɛ Panama kanal ta siɲɛ 3. A janya bɛ se kilomɛtɛrɛ 265 ma ni porozɛ in dafara ka ban.

Ji sɔrɔyɔrɔ: Ji bɛ woyo ka don kanal kɔnɔ ka bɔ Ataturk barazi la min bɛ balo Efrate baji fɛ ka tɛmɛ jirisunba fila fɛ walasa ka se Sanliurfa ni Mardin kɛnɛ ɲumanw na.

Sɛnɛ nɔfɛkow : Ji sɔrɔli ye sɛnɛfɛnw suguya caman kɛ (i n’a fɔ bɔgɔ, ɲɔ, malo, ani soja, ka fara nakɔfɛnw ni jiridenw kan) ani ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw sɔrɔli kan, o kɛra sababu ye sɛnɛkɛlaw ka se ka suman tigɛ fo siɲɛ 3 san kɔnɔ.

Jibɔyɔrɔ : Porozɛ in bɛɛ lajɛlen laɲini ye ka jibɔyɔrɔ bɛɛ lajɛlen kɛ dunum miliyɔn 2,47 ɲɔgɔn ye. Jiko sira minnu bɛ dunum ba 900 dafa, olu dabɔra kaban fo ka na se bi ma.

Sɔrɔko seginni : Jibɔyɔrɔw bɛ Turki lira miliyari 2,2 di sɔrɔko ma san o san, k’a sɔrɔ kabini a daminɛ, porozɛ in ye sɔrɔ bɛɛ lajɛlen sɔrɔ min tɛmɛna Turki lira miliyari 14,7 kan.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1091 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-21 15:21:19 CEST
Ja gɛlɛya ni jiko gɛlɛya jugu min kɛra Emery dugu kɔnɔ, Utah, Ameriki jamana na, ani a nɔfɛkow sɛnɛkɛlaw ni dugudenw kan:

Ji hakɛ dɔgɔyali tariku kɔnɔ : Ji hakɛ min bɛ kanalw kɔnɔ, o sera 6% dɔrɔn ma a cogo kɔrɔ la, o ye hakɛ ye min ma deli ka ye o mara kɔnɔ kabini san tan caman.

Baraziw ni jidagayɔrɔw dɛsɛ : Jidagayɔrɔw bɛ tɔɔrɔ kosɛbɛ. U la belebeleba bɛ 30% fo 40% dɔrɔn de fa, o kɔrɔ ye ko stock tɛ yen samiyɛ kama.

Sɛnɛ ni baganmara nɔ tilennen don : Sɛnɛkɛlaw wajibiyara ka ji tɔ bɛɛ kɛ joona walasa k’a ɲini k’u ka sɛnɛfɛnw kisi, sanni u k’a mara samiyɛ kalow kama, o min y’u wajibiya ka balo caman san ani ka bɔnɛ fɛɛrɛ wɛrɛw la minnu bɛ se ka kɛ baganw baloli nɔ na.

Fɛnɲɛnɛmako ɲuman dɛsɛ : Emery dugu kɔnɔ, barazi walima jidagayɔrɔ tɛ yen min bɛ se ka ji bolicogo ni jibolisiraw minɛ jisigi waatiw la, gɛlɛya min bɛ dugutigi Jack Funk b’a ɲini ka min ɲɛnabɔ sisan, a kɛtɔ ka laɲini dɔ gɛlɛya walasa ka jidagayɔrɔ porozɛ dɔ sigi senkan, musaka min bɛ se miliyɔn 30 ɲɔgɔn ma.

Jigiya bɛ sanjiba la : Nin ko gɛlɛn ninnu na, dugudenw ni sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛ ka samiyɛ sanji makɔnɔ, k’a kɛ fɛɛrɛ laban ye walasa ka sɛnɛ waati ni dugu kisi ja jugu ma.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1121 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-21 00:43:51 CEST
Mali Jamanakuntigiya

Minisiriw ka tɔnba y’a ka lajɛ basigilen kɛ jumadon zuwɛnkalo tile 19 san 2026, Koulouba masaso hakilijagabɔso kɔnɔ, n’o ɲɛmɔgɔya tun bɛ jenerali Assimi Goïta bolo, n’o ye jamanakuntigi ye, n’o ye tɛmɛnkan gɔfɛrɛnaman ɲɛmɔgɔ ye.

Kumasen in kuncɛlen filɛ nin ye yɔrɔw la:

Hɛrɛ ni bɛnkan : "Jamana ka hɛrɛ sabatili baarada" dabɔli ka kɛ Worodugu yiriwali baarada nɔnabila ye.

Kiiritigɛlaw: Sariya kura dɔ ta min bɛ kiritigɛlaw ka baarakɛlaw tɔgɔ Changer ka kɛ "Kiritigɛlaw ka komisɛriw" ye ani k'u ka baara labɛn.

Sigiliw: Mali lasigiden kura sigili Tamanrasset (Alzeri), ani sigili minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ ka biro la, sɛnɛko minisiriso la, ani baganmara minisiriso la.

Duniya jɛ-ka-baara : Mali ka sendon diɲɛ tɔnba dɔw la (Oslo, Geneve, Istanbul) walasa k’a jɔyɔrɔw lafasa, ani ka sɛnɛkɛɲɔgɔnya dɔ yiriwa ni Turquie ye.

Ko minnu kɛra Bamakɔ: Senegali bajida jɛkulu ka minisiriw ka lajɛ dɔ kɛli ani ka farafinna kunnafonidilaw ka tɔnba fɔlɔ daminɛ.

Kɛnɛya : Dengue banakisɛ sɔrɔli cayara, wa, waati tɛmɛnen gɔfɛrɛnaman ɲɛmɔgɔ y’a jira ko mɔgɔw ka tugu banakunbɛn fɛɛrɛw kɔ.

Minisiriw ka tɔnba y’a ka lajɛ basigilen kɛ jumadon zuwɛnkalo tile 19 san 2026, Kuluba masaso hakilijagabɔso kɔnɔ, n’o ɲɛmɔgɔya tun bɛ kɛlɛbolo ɲɛmaaba Assimi Goïta bolo, n’o ye jamanakuntigi ye, n’o ye tɛmɛnkan mara ɲɛmɔgɔ ye.

Kumasen in kuncɛlen filɛ nin ye teliya la:

Hɛrɛ ni bɛnkan : "Jamana ka hɛrɛ sabatili baarada" dabɔli ka kɛ Kɔgɔdugu yiriwali baarada nɔnabila ye.

Kiiritigɛlaw: Sariya kura dɔ ta min bɛ kiritigɛlaw ka baarakɛlaw tɔgɔ yɛlɛma ka kɛ "Kiritigɛlaw ka Sɛgɛsɛgɛlikɛlaw" ye ani k'u ka baara labɛn.

Sigili: Mali lasigiden kura sigili Tamanrasset (Alzeri), ani sigili minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ ka ɲɛmaaso la, sɛnɛko minisiriso la, ani baganmara minisiriso la.

Duniya jɛ-ka-baara : Mali ka sendon diɲɛ tɔnba dɔw ka lajɛ la (Oslo, Geneve, Istanbul) walasa k’a jɔyɔrɔw lafasa, ani ka sɛnɛkɛɲɔgɔnya dɔ yiriwa ni Turiki ye.

Ko minnu kɛra Bamakɔ: Senegali bajida jɛkulu ka minisiriw ka lajɛ dɔ kɛli ani ka farafinna kunnafonidilaw ka tɔnba fɔlɔ ka lajɛ daminɛ.

Kɛnɛya : Dengue banakisɛ sɔrɔli cayara, wa, waati tɛmɛ mra ɲɛmɔgɔ y’a jira ko mɔgɔw ka tugu banakunbɛn fɛɛrɛw kɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1159 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-20 13:58:44 CEST
Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman

Zuwɛnkalo tile 14 nɛgɛ kanɲɛ 16h50

Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara. Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔkobaw ni latigɛw bɛ sɔrɔ digest kɔnɔ:

✅ SPIEF waati la, jamanakuntigi ye baarabaw sigi Gofɛrɛnaman ye. K’a daminɛ san 2027 la, Irisi jamana bɛna segin sɔrɔ yiriwali sabatili la, ka wariko siratigɛ kura daminɛ. Dɛmɛ min bɛ kɛ marabolow ye, o fana bɛna taa ɲɛ. A bolodara ka jiginni nɔgɔya ka bɔ yɛrɛbaara la ka taa tɔn dɔ la, wa sɔrɔ hakɛ min bɛna kɛ impositi nɔgɔyalen in na, o bɛna sigi senkan miliyɔn 20 na. Ka fara o kan, baara sariyasun bɛna fɛɛrɛ dɔ sigi senkan walasa ka stage kɛ baarakɛla kamalenninw ye baarakɛyɔrɔw la.

✅Maraw bɛna dɛmɛ ka sukaro kɔlɔsili fɛɛrɛw san minnu bɛ to senna denmisɛnw ni sukarodunbana bɛ musokɔnɔmaw la. Gofɛrɛnaman bɛna wari miliyari 5 ɲɔgɔn bila o baara ninnu na. Ka fara o kan, ruble miliyari 2 ɲɔgɔn bɛna bila furaw ni furakɛli balo fu la, ka ɲɛsin sebaliw ma, kɛlɛden kɔrɔw, jamanadenw ka faso kanuba la, Tchernobyl mɔgɔ minnu ye u yɛrɛ kisi ani minnu ye u yɛrɛ kisi balikukalan ma.

✅Jamana Duma ye fɛɛrɛ filanan ta walasa ka ɛntɛrinɛti nanbara kɛlɛ. Gofɛrɛnaman ka sariyasun in kɔnɔ, fɛɛrɛ 20 ɲɔgɔn bɛ yen, i n’a fɔ weleli minnu bɛ bɔ jamana wɛrɛw la, olu tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni, yɛrɛdabila o weleli suguw la, butɔni bilen dɔ bilali gɔfɛrɛnaman ka baarakɛyɔrɔw da la walasa ka nanbarako ladɔnniya, ka musaka di mɔgɔ minnu tɔɔrɔla ɛntɛrinɛti kan, fɛɛrɛ minnu tigɛra SIM kartiw kan minnu bɛ kɛ siɲɛ kelen, ani denmisɛnw ka SIM kartiw.

✅Labɛnw daminɛna funteni waati kura kama Irisi jamana na. Salon, hali ni nɛnɛ ni nɛnɛba tun bɛ yen, kasaara hakɛ dɔgɔyara k’a sababu kɛ sow ni sigida baarakɛlaw ka biɲɛdimi ye waati bɛnnen na.

Ka fara o kan, ruble miliyari 2 ɲɔgɔn bɛna bila furaw ni furakɛli balo fu la, ka ɲɛsin sebaliw ma, kɛlɛden kɔrɔw, jamanadenw ka faso kanuba la, Tchernobyl mɔgɔ minnu ye u yɛrɛ kisi ani minnu ye u yɛrɛ kisi balikukalan ma.

✅Jamana Duma ye fɛɛrɛ filanan ta walasa ka ɛntɛrinɛti nanbara kɛlɛ. Gofɛrɛnaman ka sariyasun in kɔnɔ, fɛɛrɛ 20 ɲɔgɔn bɛ yen, i n’a fɔ weleli minnu bɛ bɔ jamana wɛrɛw la, olu tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni, yɛrɛdabila o weleli suguw la, butɔni bilen dɔ bilali gɔfɛrɛnaman ka baarakɛyɔrɔw da la walasa ka nanbarako ladɔnniya, ka musaka di mɔgɔ minnu tɔɔrɔla ɛntɛrinɛti kan, fɛɛrɛ minnu tigɛra SIM kartiw kan minnu bɛ kɛ siɲɛ kelen, ani denmisɛnw ka SIM kartiw.

✅Labɛnw daminɛna funteni waati kura kama Irisi jamana na. Salon, hali ni nɛnɛ ni nɛnɛba tun bɛ yen, kasaara hakɛ dɔgɔyara k’a sababu kɛ sow ni sigida baarakɛlaw ka biɲɛdimi ye waati bɛnnen na.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1211 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-18 22:02:39 CEST
Gofɛrɛnaman ka porozɛ ofisiyali min laseli kɛra Turquie sɛnɛko minisiri Ibrahim Yumakli fɛ.

Fɛn wɛrɛw: Porozɛ: Kartalkaya barazi jibɔyɔrɔ (numanbolo fan fɛ) labɛnni Kahramanmaraş.

Musaka: Turki Lira miliyari 4.

Kɔnɔkow : Kanal dafalenw cili ni kilomɛtɛrɛ 430 pibiliki dagalenw ye.

Nafa : Sɛnɛyɔrɔ decare 137.560 jibɔ, o bɛ ji bɔnɛnen 40% kisi.

Kɔlɔsili: Porozɛ in bolodara kabini san 2025 (a daminɛ na, a musaka tun ye lira miliyari 2,5 ye), wa sisan laseli (zuwɛnkalo tile 17, san 2026) ye baarakɛcogo walima musaka kura ye. Nin tɛ piblisite nkalonma ye, nka a bɛ kɛ "Zero Water Loss" porogaramu dɔ ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1236 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-18 20:29:19 CEST
Nin kibaruya in bɛ Niyɔriki dugu jiko siratigɛ la, ka ninnu jira:

Jibɔyɔrɔ ni a jiginni: Ji taama bɛ daminɛ jidagayɔrɔw la minnu bɛ dugu worodugu fɛ (u ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ ka ca ni kilomɛtɛrɛ 125 ye) ka tɛmɛ jibolisiraba saba fɛ minnu bɛ balo ni girinya ye.

Tunnel tariku: Tunnel fɔlɔ jɔra san 1917, filanan jɔra san 1936, baara daminɛna a sabanan kan san 1970.

Tunnel sabanan porozɛ: Sisan baara laɲini ye ka Brooklyn ni Queens ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ ni rezow ye. Nin porozɛba in min daminɛna a san tan caman ye nin ye, a jirala ko a bɛna ban pewu san 2032, o bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka dugu ka ji sɔrɔ ka taa a fɛ ka tɛmɛ galɔn miliyari kelen kan tile kɔnɔ, ka jibolisira minnu bɛ yen, olu ladonni nɔgɔya.

Jibɔyɔrɔ n'a tali: Ji ka taama bɛ daminɛ jidagayɔrɔw la minnu bɛ dugu kɔgɔdugu fɛ (u ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ ka ca ni kilomɛtɛrɛ 125 ye) wa bɛ ɲufan ka tɛmɛ jibolisira woba saba fɛ minnu bɛ banban dugukolo ka samani kan.

Wow tariku: wo fɔlɔ jɔra san 1917, filanan jɔra san 1936, k'a baara daminɛna a sabanan na san 1970.

Wa o ye baarabolodalenba ye min daminɛna a san tan ni caman ye nin ye, an'a jirala ko a bɛna ban pewu san 2032, o bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka dugu ka ji sɔrɔ ka taa a fɛ ka tɛmɛ galɔn miliyari kelen kan tile kɔnɔ, ani ka wo kɔrɔw ladonni nɔgɔya.

Jibɔyɔrɔ ni a jiginni: Ji taama bɛ daminɛ jidagayɔrɔw la minnu bɛ dugu worodugu fɛ (u ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ ka ca ni kilomɛtɛrɛ 125 ye) ka tɛmɛ jibolisiraba saba fɛ minnu bɛ balo ni girinya ye.

Tunnel tariku: Tunnel fɔlɔ jɔra san 1917, filanan jɔra san 1936, baara daminɛna a sabanan kan san 1970.

Fɛn kolomaw:
Porozɛ : Kartalkaya barazi “Kɔgɔjida kininfɛ” jiko siratigɛ kurayali Kahramanmaraş.
Musaka: Turki lira miliyari 4.
Nafa : Ka kanal dafalenw tigɛli kɛ pibiliki dagalenw ye (km 430) walasa ka sɛnɛyɔrɔ dunum 137 560 (acre) ji.
Laɲini : ka ji bɔnɛ dɔgɔya ni 40% ye, “Suda Sıfır Kayıp” (Zero Ji bɔnɛ) kanpaɲi kɔnɔ.
Tiɲɛni:
Porozɛ in bolodara kabini san caman (a kofɔra san 2022-2025) wa a ye jamana ka cɛsiriw dɔ ye walasa ka jiko ni jiko kɛ bi ta ye.
Laseli laban min kɛra (zuwɛnkalo tile 17, san 2026) o sinsinnen bɛ baara daminɛni walima a teliya kan, wa a bɛ laseli kɛ kunnafonidilaw fɛ.

O ye porozɛ lakika ye min nafa ka bon sigida sɛnɛko la yɔrɔ la min mago bɛ jiko la, nka a tɛ « kura ye pewu » nka a ye porozɛ tɛmɛnenw kurayali/falen ye.

#CIGMA_INFO | Minisiriw ka lajɛ 4nan min bɛ AES ka izini ni jagokow ɲɛnabɔ : Minisiri Moussa Alassane DIALLO tun bɛ Ouagadougou 

Burkina Faso, Zuwɛnkalo tile 14, san 2026

Minisiri min ɲɛsinnen bɛ izini ni jagokow ma, n’o ye Moussa Alassane DIALLO ye, ale farala a jɛɲɔgɔnw kan ka bɔ Nizɛri ni Burukina Faso, minisiri minnu bɛ izini ni jagokow ɲɛnabɔ ani Sahel jamanaw ka tɔnba (AES) ka sekɔrɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ka lajɛ 4nan baara la, min kɛra Ouagadougou, Burkinabe minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ jɛɲɔgɔn Jean-Emmanuel ka ɲɛmɔgɔya kɔnɔ Ouédraogo ye. 

Cidenjɛkulu barikama dɔ ɲɛmɔgɔya la, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, Mali jagokɛlaw ka tɔnba, Mali jamana baarakɛlaw ka tɔnba, OPAM ka fara API-Mali ɲɛmɔgɔba ka lasigidenw kan, minisiri y’a jira kokura ko Mali cɛsirilen don sɔrɔko jɛ-ka-baara la ani seko ni dɔnko siratigɛ la, min bɛ se ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ tɔnba kɔnɔ.

Minisiri Moussa Alassane DIALLO y’a ka kuma kɔnɔ, a ye AES jamana ɲɛmɔgɔw ka yelifɛn bisimila, min kun ye ka sɔrɔko yɔrɔ jɛlen, yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya ani ɲɛtaa sɔrɔ.

Moritani silamɛ jamana ka jamanakuntigiya

#Sisan | A ka jamanakuntigiba Mohamed Ould Cheikh El Ghazouani ye a ka bonyaba Julius Maada Bio, Siyera Lewɔni jamanakuntigi bisimila Nouakchott jamanadenw ka pankurunbonda la. Jamanakuntigi Bio bɛ tile fila baarakɛta la Moritani jamana kan.

#Sisan| A ka jamanakuntigiba, n’o ye Mohamed Ould Cheikh Al-Ghazouani ye, ale bɛ ka Umm Al-Tunisi jamana ka pankurunbonda bisimila A ka bonyali Julius Maada Bio, n’o ye Siyera Lewɔni jamanakuntigi ye, n’o bɛ tile fila baarakɛta la an ka jamana kɔnɔ.

Nin taama in politiki ni diplomasi siratigɛ tilennen, n’a surunyalen don, o sinsinnen bɛ fɛnba fila kan : Jɛɲɔgɔnya min bɛ farafinna jamanakuntigiw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ : Taama in bɛ na ni dunan (Julius Maada Bio) ye, n’o ye Afiriki tilebinyanfan jamanaw ka sɔrɔko jɛkulu ɲɛmɔgɔ ye (CEDEAO), ani jatigikɛ (Mohamed Ould Sheikh Al-Ghazouani), n’o ye Afiriki tɔnba ɲɛmɔgɔ ye.

Sigida lakanani dosiye : Laɲini jɔnjɔn ye ka baro kɛ Afiriki Sahel mara lakanani kan, ka mara sabatili sabati, ani ka bɛnbaliyakow ɲɛnabɔ Afiriki jɛkulu caman ka jamanaw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ.

Mali Jamanakuntigiya 

Koulouba | Zuwɛnkalo tile 15, san 2026|  #jamana fila ka jɛ-ka-baara 

Diplomasi: Moritani jamana lakanani minisiri bɛ ka cikan ta ka bɔ jamanakuntigi Ghazouani fɛ ka taa jamana ɲɛmaa ma

Tɛmɛsira ɲɛmɔgɔba, n’o ye sɔrɔdasikulu jenerali Assimi GOÏTA ye, n’o ye jamanakuntigi ye, ale ye lamɛnni kɛ bi jumadon zuwɛnkalo tile 15, san 2026, ni minisiri Hanana OULD SIDI ye, n’o ye Lakana ni lakɔlidenw ka koɲɛw minisiri ye ani Moritani silamɛya jamana ka martiriw denkɛ ye. O laban in ye cikan ta ka bɔ Moritani jamanakuntigi fɛ, n’o ye Mohamed Ould Cheikh EL GHAZOUANI ye, ka taa a ka Mali jɛɲɔgɔn ma. Lajɛ in kɛra minisiri ka lasigiden min ɲɛsinnen bɛ lakana ni kɛlɛden kɔrɔw ma, n’o ye jenerali Oumar DIARRA ye.

A bɔlen kɔ jama la, Moritani minisiri ye kunnafonidilaw ka ɲininkaliw jaabi.  A y’a ka waleɲumandɔn jira jamanakuntigi ma, k’a sɔrɔ a y’a sɔrɔ, k’a jira ko a ye “cikan sɛbɛnnen dɔ lase” ka bɔ jamanakuntigi GHAZOUANI fɛ ka taa sɔrɔdasi jenerali Assimi GOÏTA ma. A y’a jira ko : « O waati kelen na, n y’a balimakɛ, Moritani silamɛya jamanakuntigi ka balimaya foli lase a bonya ma, k’a sɔrɔ n hakili bɛ teriya, balimaya ani jɛɲɔgɔnya jɛɲɔgɔnyaw juguya la, minnu bɛ an balima jamana fila ka siniɲɛsigi jɛkulu sigi senkan ».

Hanana OULD SIDI fana y’a jira k’a jɛya ko jama laban na, “A ka jamanakuntigiba Assimi GOÏTA ye ci bila n ma k’a ka balimaya foli n’a ka ɲɛtaa negew lase Moritani silamɛya jamanakuntigi ma. A y’a ka kuma kuncɛ k’a ka « waleɲumandɔnba jira Mali faamaw la, u ka bisimilali ɲuman n’u ka jatigila ni bolomafara la» minnu bilala a bolo.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1383 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-16 00:30:56 CEST

A y’a jira ko : « O waati kelen na, n y’a balimakɛ, Moritani silamɛya jamanakuntigi ka balimaya foli lase a bonya ma, k’a sɔrɔ n hakili bɛ teriya, balimaya ani jɛɲɔgɔnya jɛɲɔgɔnyaw juguya la, minnu bɛ an balima jamana fila ka siniɲɛsigi jɛkulu sigi senkan ».

Hanana OULD SIDI fana y’a jira k’a jɛya ko jama laban na, “A ka jamanakuntigiba Assimi GOÏTA ye ci bila n ma k’a ka balimaya foli n’a ka ɲɛtaa negew lase Moritani silamɛya jamanakuntigi ma. Minnu ka ca ni tɔw bɛɛ ye, olu ye jɛ-ka-baara ye Sinuwa kɔrɔnyanfan ni tlebinyanfan maraw cɛ sɛnɛko ni togodala yiriwali siratigɛ la :

San 30 jɛkafɔ : San tan saba jɛkafɔ min kɛra kɔrɔnfɛla ni tilebin fɛ, o ye nɔ ɲuman sɔrɔ yiriwali dɛmɛni na.

Baarakɛyɔrɔw dicogo : Jɛɲɔgɔnya fɛɛrɛw kɛra sababu ye ka togodala baarakɛla miliyɔn 5 ni kɔ bila baara la tilebin yanfan maraw kɔnɔ, mɔgɔ miliyɔn 3 ni kɔ bɔra faantanya la.

Industriw ka jɛɲɔgɔnya ni wariko : Sɛnɛko jɛ-ka-baarakɛyɔrɔ 800 ɲɔgɔn sigira senkan, o bɛ nafolodonni sama ka tɛmɛ yuan miliyari 750 kan ka bɔ baarakɛda minnu bɛ taa tilebin yanfan maraw la.

Jɛkafɔ misali Shanghai ni Yunnan cɛ : Shanghai dugu ye jɛkafɔ kɛ ni Yunnan mara ye walasa ka feereli daminɛ minnu tun ye sɛnɛfɛn suguya caman dilanni ye, ani ka magan 300 ni kɔ da wuli ani jiralikɛnɛ tilennenw Shanghai walasa ka dɛmɛ don ani ka fɛn danmadɔw feere minnu bɛ bɔ Yunnan.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1503 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-14 05:37:25 CEST
Brooke Rollins, Ameriki sɛnɛko minisiri, bɛ kuma sɛnɛfɛnw lakanani nafa kan jamana kɔnɔ walasa ka Ameriki jamana lakana lakana.

N ye hakilina nafama minnu fɔ, olu kuncɛlen surun filɛ nin ye:

Bagaji sɔngɔ jigira : Bagaji sɔngɔ jigira ni 36% fo 40% ye ni i y’a suma ni Biden ka fanga ye, wa hali ni dɔ farala dɔɔnin Iran kɛlɛ kosɔn, u bɛ dɔgɔya hali bi ka tɛmɛ fɔlɔ kan.

Ka da jamana kɔkankow kan : A y’a jira ko bagaji minnu bɛ kɛ Ameriki sisan, olu tilancɛ bɛ bɔ jamanaw la i n’a fɔ Sinuwa ani Irisi, o min bɛ bagabagali jira “foro lakanani” ma, a b’o jate jamana lakanani yɔrɔba dɔ ye.

Sigida waridon : Dɔrɔmɛ miliyari caman bɛ ka don sisan walasa ka sigida porozɛw sigi senkan, o dɔ ye baara daminɛni ye sɔɔni Luiziana jamana na, amoniyɔmu bagaji feereyɔrɔba kan diɲɛ kɔnɔ, min bɛna daminɛ san nata la.

Porozɛ kura : Bagajiko porozɛ 80 wɛrɛw bɛ ka daminɛ walasa ka fɛn dilanni segin Ameriki kɔnɔ, ka sɔngɔ dɔgɔya sɛnɛkɛlaw bolo, ani ka yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1544 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-13 20:21:03 CEST
Tuma dɔw la, an tun b’u kasikan mɛn u kelen na k’u to buru dɔw mugumugu la.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1545 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-13 20:19:41 CEST
O jiri jɛnsɛnnen jukɔrɔ, an lajɛlen, an y’an ka dumuni to, min ka dɔgɔ i n’a fɔ jiri sɔgɔlen, in

O fini bɔrɔ minnu sirilen don kosɛbɛ, an baw ye minnu dilan, minnu bɛ...

U tun bɛ u yɛrɛ minɛ i n’a fɔ cɛw foro la ani i n’a fɔ musow n’u seginna so, olu

Tuma dɔw la, an tun b’u kasikan mɛn u kelen na k’u to buru dɔw mugumugu la.

Cɛw y’u ka fulakɛw siri, bɛɛ y’u ka don o don laadalakow daminɛ, n’o ye ka sama

U ka marifaw. U y’u ka nɛgɛw siri ka bɔ esparto bin juruw la, ka garadimisɛnninw kɛ u bolow ye

Nɛgɛbere ta, min y’u bolokɔnincininw tanga tigɛw ma siɲɛ jatebaliya.

Machete kelen an kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye, o de don. O de tun ye baarakɛminɛn ye, .

O bɛ sɛgɛn. O y’a to i ma i yɛrɛ jogin, tiɲɛ don, a dabɔra cogo min na, wa i tun bɛ se ka dɔ fara i kan

Banakisɛ sɔrɔli farati tun ka dɔgɔn.

Ne ye u bolow baara ani u ka kabakow dege.

N’u ka kabako banbaliw ye, ani nege ka fɛn bɛɛ kunbɛn.

A ka c’a la, an tun ye mɔgɔ wɔɔrɔ ye minnu bɛ tigɛ ani kelen tun bɛ ɲɔgɔn cɛ, u bɛɛ lajɛlen tun ye wolonwula ye. Kiɲɛfɛla la, jirisun wɔɔrɔ, fɔlɔ bɛ tigɛ baara ta.

Aw bɛ jiribolow tigɛ ka u to kinin fɛ, ka jiribolo fila to. O kɔ fɛ, filanan bɛ Yɛlɛma ka Taa numan fɛ, o kɔ fɛ, mɔgɔ dɔ bɛ Nà ʃi wolonwula Tɛmɛ.

O de b’an tigɛ, ka ɲɔgɔn Jɛ. A bɛ se ka taa a fɛ ka siri sanga fila kɔnɔ, o kɔfɛ, u bɛ jɔyɔrɔw falenfalen, dɔ wɛrɛ bɛ siri, ani o ɲɔgɔnnaw.

Nka a ka c’a la, o tun ye mɔgɔ wɔɔrɔ ka kulu ye.

O wɔɔrɔ la kelen bɛ taa a fɛ ka tigɛ, tɔ kelen bɛ taa a fɛ ka siri.

Sow tun bɛ yen, musow, denmisɛnw, bɛɛ tun bɛ jɛ. So wɛrɛw tun bɛ se ka mɔgɔ caman ɲɛnabɔ, o la sa, u tun bɛ cɛw ta baara la.

Ekipu kelen walima fila, a ka c’a la, wolonwula, bɛ taa o yɔrɔw ɲini.

Ni ɲɛmɔgɔ y’a ye ko waati bɛnnen don, tuma bɛɛ a tun bɛ tɛmɛn an bolo, a tun bɛ wele bila ka ji min, an tun bɛ jɔ dɔɔnin.

O tun tɛ se ka kɛ ne ni n balimakɛ ye abada. Don o don, ko tun bɛ kɛ cogo kelen na.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1546 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-13 20:16:24 CEST
O jiri dɛsɛlen in jukɔrɔ, min dalajɛlen don ɲɔgɔn fɛ, an y’an ka dumuni to, a dɛsɛlen i n’a fɔ a, in

o fini bɔrɔ misɛnnin minnu sirilen don kosɛbɛ, an baw ye minnu dilan, minnu

dafara i n' a fɔ cɛw foro la ani i n' a fɔ musow n' u donna so kɔnɔ , olu

ko tuma dɔw la i tun bɛ kasikan mɛn i kelen na buru dɔɔnin muguli kosɔn.

Cɛw y’u ka cɛsirilanw siri ani bɛɛ ye don o don laada daminɛ ka finiw bɔ

u ka marifaw. U y'u ka nɛgɛw Bɔ o esparto juru la k'u Kɛ u bolo ka kala ye.

tokɛtiw tora, o min y’u bolokɔnincininw kisi siɲɛ ba caman tigɛw ma.

Bolo fɛ ni sɔgɔsɔgɔninjɛ ye, sɔgɔsɔgɔninjɛ kelen kelen-kelen bɛɛ ani o de don. O de ye baarakɛminɛn ye min tun bɛ kɛ, .

o musaka kɛra. O y’i kisi i yɛrɛ tigɛ ma, tiɲɛ don, a dabɔra cogo min na, wa i ye dɔ fara o kan

ani farati tun ka dɔgɔn ka i yɛrɛ tigɛ.

Ne ye baara dege a bolo ani a ka kabakow la.

N’a ka kabako dan tɛ minnu na, k’a fɛ ka fɛn bɛɛ kunbɛn.

A ka c’a la an tun bɛ wɔɔrɔ tigɛ ani kelen sirilen, wolonwula. Mɔgɔ tilennenw kɔnɔ, dingɛ wɔɔrɔ, fɔlɔ min bɛ taa.

tigɛ ka bila kinin fɛ ani kɔkolo fila bɛ yen. Filanan bɛ taa numan fɛ ka sɔrɔ ka wolonwula kɛ,

O kelen b’an tigɛ ka jigin, k’an siri. Wa n’a sɔrɔla u ye siri sanga fila kɔnɔ, o kɔfɛ u ye fɛn caman Changé, dɔ wɛrɛ sirilen don ani o ɲɔgɔnnaw.

Nka a ka c’a la, o tun ye kurun kɔnɔ mɔgɔ wɔɔrɔ ye.

Mɔgɔ wɔɔrɔ la kelen tugura o kɔ, a ye tigɛ kɛ, kelen ye siri.

Sow tùn bɛ yen musow, denmisɛnw, bɛɛ tùn bɛ yen. Dɔ wɛrɛw tun bɛ se ka dɔ fara o kan, u tun bɛ cɛw ɲini, .

 kurunba kɔnɔ baarakɛla kelen walima fila, a ka c’a la, u tun ye wolonwula ye, u tun bɛ tigɛ.

Tuma min na dugutigi y’a ye ko a bɛnnen don, tuma bɛɛ a bɛ kɔfɛ an bolo, a ye wele bila ka minfɛn dɔ min, an ye waati dɔ jɔ.

A ma se abada ne ni n balimakɛ ma. Wa don o don, o ye kelen ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1566 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-13 15:36:29 CEST
Tiɲɛ min bɛ kuma surun na:
O kuma in ye tiɲɛ ye foroba la, wa a ye laseli ye jamanakuntigi Erdogan fɛ zuwɛnkalo tile 10 san 2026.
Toprak Mahsulleri Ofisi (TMO) bɛna sɛnɛfɛnw bɛɛ san (kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la sumanw i n’a fɔ malo ni orje) sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛ minnu lase a ma k’a sɔrɔ u ma tiɲɛ.
Sarali bɛ daminɛ tile 21 fura dilen kɔfɛ (o ye ɲɛtaa ye ka tɛmɛ waati tɛmɛnen kan, o min tun bɛ se tile 45 ma tuma dɔw la).
Laɲini : Ka sɛnɛkɛlaw dɛmɛ suman tigɛ waati kura la, ani ka sɔngɔ dɔgɔyali walima bɔnɛ bali.
Tiɲɛn kunnafoniw:
A tɛ kɛ a yɛrɛma « sɛnɛfɛnw bɛɛ la Turki jamana na », nka sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛ na ni fɛn o fɛn ye TMO yɔrɔw la walima fɛnmarayɔrɔw la minnu ka lase bɛ u bolo.
Sanni sɔngɔw fɔra (i n’a fɔ malo lira 16500/ton + dɛmɛ wɛrɛ), wa sɛnɛkɛla dɔw ka ŋunankow bɛ yen sɔngɔw kan musakabaw (dizili, bagajiw...) musakaw la.
Sosow: Laseli ofisiyali + TMO ka fɔtaw. Nin ye san o san gɔfɛrɛnaman ka dɛmɛ fɛɛrɛ ye min bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ walasa ka sɛnɛ dɛmɛ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1582 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-11 22:44:39 CEST
Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman

Zuwɛnkalo tile 7 nɛgɛ kanɲɛ 19h06

Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara. Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔko jɔnjɔnw ni latigɛw digest kɔnɔ:

✅Fɛnw ni baarakɛminɛnw jɛnsɛnni suguw ni ɛntɛrinɛti baarakɛminɛnw fɛ, o bɛ 5% ni kɔ bɔ jamana ka PIB la kaban. Mikhail Mishustin ye fɛɛrɛbɔ lajɛ min ɲɛmɔgɔya kɛ, o kumana nizɛri sigidaw dabɔli n’u yiriwali ɲɛtaa kan.

✅Ka marabolow dɛmɛ u ka koɲɛw ɲɛnabɔ minnu nafa ka bon sigida la, o ye Gofɛrɛnaman ka ɲɛtaa kunba ye. Dagestan ni Tchechenia bɛna ruble miliyari 3 ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ sanjiba dɛmɛni kama, ka sɔrɔ Kursk ni Belgorod maraw ye ruble miliyari 4,5 ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ walasa ka dugudenw dɛmɛ minnu wajibiyalen don ka boli u ka so. Ruble miliyari 2,5 wɛrɛ bɛna kɛ ka dumuni funtenimaw labɛn fu ani ka karamɔgɔw dɛmɛ yɔrɔjanw na.

✅Bisi ni tramway kura bɛna bɔ Irisi maraw la. Ruble miliyari 11 ɲɔgɔn bɛna bila foroba bolifɛnw yiriwali kama mara naani kɔnɔ.

 ✅Gofɛrɛnaman ka tɔndenw y'u sen don SPIEF-2026 la.

Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman

Zuwɛnkalo tile 7 nɛgɛ kanɲɛ 19h06

Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara. Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔko jɔnjɔnw ni latigɛw kumasurun kɔnɔ:

✅Fɛnw ni baarakɛminɛnw jɛnsɛnni suguw ni bɔlɔlɔ ni Jatedenya baarakɛminɛnw fɛ sisan, o bɛ 5% ni kɔ bɔ sigida ka bɔta bɛɛlajɛlen na jamana ye ka kaban. Mikhail Mishustin ye fɛɛrɛbɔ lajɛ min ɲɛmɔgɔya kɛ, a kumana Jatedenya bɔlɔlɔ sigidaw dayɛlɛli n’u yiriwali ɲɛtaa kan.

✅Ka marabolow dɛmɛ sigidako gɛlɛnw ɲɛnabɔli la, o bɛ jate gɔfɛrɛnaman ka ɲɛtaa kunba ye. Dagestan ni Tchechenia bɛna rubulu miliyari 3 ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ jiwalankataaw tulomangɛnni kama, ka sɔrɔ Kursk ni Belgorod maraw ye rubulu miliyari 4,5 ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ walasa ka dugudenw dɛmɛ minnu jaakuyara ka boli ka bɔ u ka so kɔnɔ. Rubulu miliyari 2,5 wɛrɛ bɛna kɛ ka dumuni kalamaw labɛn fu ani ka karamɔgɔw dɛmɛ yɔrɔjanw na.

✅Kaare ni tramway kuraw bɛna don Irisi maraw la. Rubulu miliyari 11 ɲɔgɔn bɛna bila foroba bolifɛnw yiriwali kama mara naani kɔnɔ.

✅Gofɛrɛnaman ka tɔndenw y’u sen don diɲɛ sɔrɔko forobajɛkulu ka fɛɛrɛbɔ la san 2026.

Jago kɛli fɛnw ni baarakɛminɛnw na ɛntɛrinɛti suguw ni nizɛri baarakɛminɛnw fɛ, o bɛ jamana ka PIB 5% ni kɔ bɔ sisan

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1617 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-11 16:51:15 CEST
Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman

Zuwɛnkalo tile 7 nɛgɛ kanɲɛ 19h06

Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara. Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔkobaw ni latigɛw bɛ sɔrɔ digest kɔnɔ:

✅Fɛnw ni baarakɛminɛnw jiginni suguw ni ɛntɛrinɛti baarakɛminɛnw fɛ, o bɛ jamana ka PIB 5% ni kɔ di kaban. Mikhail Mishustin ɲɛmɔgɔya la, fɛɛrɛbɔ lajɛ dɔ senfɛ, u ye baro kɛ baara bɛ ka taa ɲɛ cogo min na nizɛri sigidaw dabɔli n’u yiriwali kan.

✅Ka marabolow dɛmɛ sigidako nafamaw ɲɛnabɔli la, o ye Gofɛrɛnaman ka fɔlɔfɔlɔko dɔ ye. Dagestan ni Tchechenia bɛna ruble miliyari 3 ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ walasa ka sanjiba in kɔlɔlɔw bɔ yen, wa ruble miliyari 4,5 ɲɔgɔnna bilala Kursk ni Belgorod maraw la walasa ka dugudenw dɛmɛ minnu wajibiyalen don ka bɔ u ka so. Ani fana, ruble miliyari 2,5 bɛna musaka kɛ dumuni funtenimaw labɛnni na fu ani ka karamɔgɔw dɛmɛ yɔrɔjanw na.

✅Bisi ni tramway kura bɛna bɔ Irisi maraw la. Ruble miliyari 11 ɲɔgɔn bɛna bila ka forobaciyɛn kuraya mara naani kɔnɔ.

 ✅Gofɛrɛnaman ka tɔndenw y'u sen don SPIEF-2026 baara la.

✅Fɛnw ni baarakɛminɛnw jiginni suguw ni ɛntɛrinɛti baarakɛminɛnw fɛ, o bɛ jamana ka PIB 5% ni kɔ di kaban. Mikhail Mishustin ɲɛmɔgɔya la, fɛɛrɛbɔ lajɛ dɔ senfɛ, u ye baro kɛ baara bɛ ka taa ɲɛ cogo min na nizɛri sigidaw dabɔli n’u yiriwali kan.

✅Ka marabolow dɛmɛ sigidako nafamaw ɲɛnabɔli la, o ye Gofɛrɛnaman ka fɔlɔfɔlɔko dɔ ye. Dagestan ni Tchechenia bɛna ruble miliyari 3 ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ walasa ka sanjiba in kɔlɔlɔw bɔ yen, wa ruble miliyari 4,5 ɲɔgɔnna bilala Kursk ni Belgorod maraw la walasa ka dugudenw dɛmɛ minnu wajibiyalen don ka bɔ u ka so. Ani fana, ruble miliyari 2,5 bɛna musaka kɛ dumuni funtenimaw labɛnni na fu ani ka karamɔgɔw dɛmɛ yɔrɔjanw na.

✅Bisi ni tramway kura bɛna bɔ Irisi maraw la. Ruble miliyari 11 ɲɔgɔn bɛna bila ka forobaciyɛn kuraya mara naani kɔnɔ.

✅Gofɛrɛnaman ka tɔndenw y'u sen don SPIEF-2026 baara la.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1621 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-11 11:49:07 CEST
Présidence Mali 

Nafolo minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ ka fɔta min kɛra arabadon zuwɛnkalo tile 10 san 2026, n’o ɲɛmɔgɔya tun bɛ tɛmɛsira jamanakuntigi fɛ, n’o ye Lieutenant général Assimi Goita ye:

Nin kumasen in bɛ kumasenba naani kɔnɔ, minnu tilennen don:

Sibɛri lakanani: Ka jamana ka baarakɛda dɔ sigi senkan walasa ka yɔrɔ nafamaw lakana ani ka ɛntɛrinɛti juguya kɛlɛ.

Sɔrɔko ni nafolo : Bonya jiralen don ni 6,5% ye, ani dɔ farala impositi kan ka se 15,1% ma, ni baarakɛnafolo ye min bɛ se miliyari 4382,9 ma.

Kow ni baara kɛtaw : Dɔgɔkun nizɛri labɛnni, laadala seli (balafon), ani denmisɛnw ka don walasa ka sinsin ji lakanani kan.

Foroba kɛnɛya : Dengue banakisɛw cayalenba kɔlɔsili, ani welekan min kɛra jamana ɲɛmɔgɔw fɛ, u k’u yɛrɛ bila banakunbɛn na.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1625 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-11 11:41:21 CEST
Nafolo minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ ka fɔta min kɛra arabadon zuwɛnkalo tile 10 san 2026, n’o ɲɛmɔgɔya tun bɛ tɛmɛsira jamanakuntigi fɛ, n’o ye Lieutenant général Assimi Goita ye:

Nafolo minisiriso ka fɔta kuncɛlen ni kuncɛlen filɛ nin ye, min kɛra arabadon zuwɛnkalo tile 10 san 2026, n’o ɲɛmɔgɔya tun bɛ tɛmɛsira jamanakuntigi fɛ, n’o ye Lieutenant Général Assimi Goita ye:

1. Sariya ni sariyasunw (sibɛri lakanani) .
Jamana ka kunnafonidilanw lakanani baarada sigili : n’a kun ye ka fɛnsɔrɔsiraw ni baarakɛminɛn nafamaw lakana ka bɔ ɛntɛrinɛti binkanniw na ani ka ɛntɛrinɛti juguya kɛlɛ.

O bɛ na ni jamana ka ɛntɛrinɛti lakanani fɛɛrɛ ni wale bolodalen (2026-2030) waleyali ye, min tun dabɔra ka tɛmɛ.

2. Minisiriw ka kumaw ni u ka kunnafoniw
Fɔlɔ : Sɔrɔko ni nafolo (budjet porogaramu 2027-2029) .
Sɔrɔ yiriwali : A jirala ko bonya lakika hakɛ bɛ se ka kɛ 6,5% ye.

Takisi : Dɔ farala dɔɔni dɔɔni impositi doni kan ka se 15,1% ma san 2029 (ni i y’a suma ni 13,9% ye san 2027), ka da lakana ɲɛtaa kan.

Musaka bɛɛ lajɛlen : Gofɛrɛnaman ka fɛɛrɛw waleyali musakaw o waati kɔnɔ, o bɛ bɛn Afiriki tilebinyanfan CFA wari miliyari 4382,9 ma.

Filanan : Sosiyete, laadalakow ani seko ni dɔnko koɲɛw
Farafinna den ka don (zuwɛnkalo tile 16 san 2026): A labɛnna Bamakɔ ni kumasen ye ko « Ka ji, saniya ani saniya sɔrɔ diɲɛ bɛɛ kɔnɔ Mali den kelen-kelen bɛɛ bolo ».

Nizɛri dɔgɔkun (zuwɛnkalo tile 29 - zuluyekalo tile 3, san 2026): Lajɛ naaninan kɛra Bamakɔ walasa ka dɛmɛ don daminɛw ni nizɛri jiginni na, ni diɲɛ seleke naani sendonni ye min kɔnɔ Burukina Faso ni Nizɛri kɛra bonya dunanw ye.

Balafon Triangle Festival (5 - 8 Nowanburukalo san 2026): Ka laadala seli 10nan labɛn Sikaso walasa ka jɛkafɔ ni sigiɲɔgɔnya sabati Mali, Burkina Faso ani Côte d’Ivoire cɛ.

3. Kɛnɛyako cogoya
Dengue banakisɛw bɛ ka caya: Kɛnɛya minisiriso ye dɔ fara mɔgɔ minnu kan, n’i y’a suma ni dɔgɔkun tɛmɛnen ta ye, wa jamanakuntigi ye wele bila jamanadenw ma, u ka tugu banakunbɛn fɛɛrɛw kɔ kosɛbɛ.

Nizɛri dɔgɔkun (zuwɛnkalo tile 29 - zuluyekalo tile 3, san 2026): Lajɛ naaninan kɛra Bamakɔ walasa ka dɛmɛ don daminɛw ni nizɛri jiginni na, ni diɲɛ seleke naani sendonni ye min kɔnɔ Burukina Faso ni Nizɛri kɛra bonya dunanw ye.

Balafon Triangle Festival (5 - 8 Nowanburukalo san 2026): Ka laadala seli 10nan labɛn Sikaso walasa ka jɛkafɔ ni sigiɲɔgɔnya sabati Mali, Burkina Faso ani Côte d’Ivoire cɛ.

3. Kɛnɛyako cogoya
Dengue banakisɛw bɛ ka caya: Kɛnɛya minisiriso ye dɔ fara mɔgɔ minnu kan, n’i y’a suma ni dɔgɔkun tɛmɛnen ta ye, wa jamanakuntigi ye wele bila jamanadenw ma, u ka tugu banakunbɛn fɛɛrɛw kɔ kosɛbɛ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1705 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-06-09 10:23:50 CEST
China Resource Recycling Group sigira sen kan Tianjin san 2024 Utikalo la.

Fɛn kolomaw:

Laɲini : Ka dɛmɛ don yiriwali jɛlen ni sabatili la Sinuwa jamana kɔnɔ, n’o ye ka jamana ka nafolo maracogo ɲɛ ani ka fɛnw lasegincogo ɲuman sabati.

Jagokɛlaw : Jɛkulu in kɔnɔ, Sinuwa cɛmancɛ-tɔnba dɔw bɛ yen i n’a fɔ Sinopec, Baowu, China Minmetals, China Chinalco, ani dɔw wɛrɛw.

Jagokɛyɔrɔw: * Nɛgɛ, plastiki, nɛgɛ minnu tɛ nɛgɛ ye, ani batiri kɔrɔw lasegincogo.

* Elektɔriki kɔrɔw, du kɔnɔ minɛnw ani mobili kɔrɔw ladonni, ka fara fiɲɛbɔ ni tile fanga minɛnw tiɲɛni kan minnu ye lafiɲɛbɔ sɔrɔ.

Nafa ni sini kuntilenna:

Ka jamana lakanani sabati fanga ni minɛnko siratigɛ la.

San 2025 na, Siniwajamana b’a fɛ ka dɔ fara nafolosɔrɔsiraw lasegincogo nafa kan ka se yuan triliyɔn 5 ma.

San 2030 na, san o san, nɔgɔ gɛlɛnw baara bɛna se tɔni miliyari 4,5 ma.

Laɲini : Ka dɛmɛ don yiriwali binkɛnɛman ni mɛɛta la Sinuwa jamana kɔnɔ, jamana ka nafolomafɛnw maracogo ɲuman fɛ, ani ka fɛnw lasegincogo wasalen sinsin.

Jagokɛlaw : Jɛkulu in bɛ Sinuwa jamana ka cɛmancɛ-tɔnba dɔw fara ɲɔgɔn kan i n’a fɔ Sinopec, Baowu, China Minmetals, China Chinalco, ani min t' olu ye.

Baarataw: * Nɛgɛw, manaw, damanmanfɛn minnu tɛ nɛgɛ ye, ani batiri kɔrɔw lasegin u cogo kɔrɔ la.

* Ka baara kɛ ni masinmanfɛnw ye, ani du kɔnɔ minɛnw ni mobili kɔrɔw ka fɛn bɔtaw kan, ni Ka fara fiɲɛ fanga baarakɛminɛnw cicili kan ani Tile fanga min bɔra baara la.

Nafa ani kuntilenna nataw:

Ka jama ka lakana sinsin fanga ni damanko siratigɛ la.

Ni San 2025 seli ye,Sinuwa jamana b'a laɲini Ka dɔ fara nafolomafɛnw seginni baarada ka fɛn bɔtaw nafa kan ka se yuan triliyɔni 5 ma.

Ni San 2030 seli ye, a b'a jigiya ko san o san nafa niyɔrɔ bɛna se ka bɔ ɲaman gɛlɛnw na ka se tɔni miliyari 4,5 ma..

Lajɛ in cogoya : Lajɛba min kɛra Irisi jamanatigi Vladimir Putin ni Siniwa jamanatigi kɔrɔ Han Zheng cɛ, n’o kɛra Sɛnt Pɛriburugu jamana sɔrɔko tɔnba kɛrɛfɛ.

Jamana fila ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ jɛɲɔgɔnya : Fɛn fila bɛɛ ye tariku kɔnɔ jɛɲɔgɔnya caman tanu, min ɲɔgɔn ma deli ka kɛ fɔlɔ jamana fila ninnu cɛ, ani jago yiriwali 10%.

Jɛkafɔ waleyali yɔrɔw : Jɛɲɔgɔnya min bɛ senna fanga, izini, sɛnɛko, mɔbiliko, hakililata, ani atomikɛlan fanga baaracogo hɛrɛ la, o sinsin kokura.

Tariku donw : Diplomasi jɛɲɔgɔnya san 75 hakilijigin ani sigiɲɔgɔnya ɲuman ni jɛkafɔ bɛnkan san 25nan.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1715 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-08 10:17:36 CEST
Kanpaɲi/politiki propagande min bɛ kɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni White House ye. Trump taara foro dɔ la Wisconsin (Chippewa Falls) zuwɛnkalo tile 5 san 2026, ka kuma sɛnɛkɛlaw dɛmɛbagaw fɛ ni pankarti ye min tɔgɔ ye ko "Fighting for American Farmers".

Tiɲɛ min bɛ dugukolo kan : Mara ye miliyari tan ni tan musaka kɛ (i n’a fɔ dɛmɛ miliyari 12 san 2025) k’a kɛ dɛmɛ kɔrɔtɔlen ye sɛnɛkɛlaw ma k’a sababu kɛ bɔnɛ ye.

Nka gɛlɛya lakikaw bɛ senna hali bi : forow ka banki filili minnu bɛ ka caya (a cayara ni 46% ye san 2025), sɛnɛfɛnw ni bagaji sɔngɔ jiginni (k’a sababu kɛ tarifu/kɛlɛw ye), baarakɛlaw dɛsɛ (k’a sababu kɛ bɔnɔgɔla politiki ye), ani bɔnɛ minnu bɛ bɔ jamana kɔkan suguw la.

Sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛ ka gɛlɛya sɔrɔ ni sɛnɛ musakabaw ye, wa u caman bɛ u jigi da gɔfɛrɛnaman ka dɛmɛ kan (o bɛ tali kɛ Trump ka fanga fɔlɔ la).

A kunba : Kumasen in ye koɲuman ye, wa a bɛ basigi dɔ laɲini swing cogoya la, nka kunnafoniw b’a jira ko gɛlɛya lakikaw bɛ seko ni dɔnko siratigɛ la hali ni dɛmɛ bɛ yen. Politikiw (tarifuw, immigration, musakaw) bɛ ka double whammy effect sɔrɔ : dɛmɛ dɔw farala tiɲɛni dɔw kan.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1755 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-02 18:39:05 CEST
A jirala ko a bɛna sɔrɔdasi caman tigɛli teliya walasa ka dron bagabagali kunbɛn joona, n’o ye ka biroko dɔgɔya sannifeere ni yiriwali taabolo la, walasa sɔrɔdasiw ka marifaw ni dron kɛlɛli siraw sɔrɔ joona sanni u ka san caman makɔnɔ. 
Wideyo in bɛ sisan fɛɛrɛw ni kalanw jira: sufɛla yeli, mɔbiliw, misiriw, 30mm fiɲɛ-bɔlanw, ani dronw filicogo sɔngɔ gɛlɛnw. 
Contexte lakika:
Ameriki sɔrɔdasikulu bɛ ka kalan sɔrɔ Ukraine ni Gaza kɛlɛw la, yɔrɔ minnu na dronw y’a jira ko u bɛ se kosɛbɛ. U b’a ɲini sisan ka taa teliya la walasa ka dankan mara, wa o ye sɔrɔdasi sannifeere sinsinni dɔ ye min bɛ senna.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1760 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-02 04:17:50 CEST
Sinuwa jamanatigi Xi Jinping ka dɔgɔkun laban baaraw k'a surunya

Sinuwa jamanatigi Xi Jinping ka baara kunbabaw kuncɛlen filɛ nin ye dɔgɔkun laban tɛmɛnen kɔnɔ:

📸 Kow lajɛ ni ɲɛ ye 🧸 ka sinsin kɛ bɔnsɔn kura kan (Diɲɛ denmisɛnw ka don)

"Sikisɛ bilenmanw" cikan: Jamanakuntigi Xi Jinping ye cikan dɔ Lase min b'a ɲini tɔn jɛkulu denmisɛnw fɛ, u k'u ka "Sikisɛw torabasoli" lakana ani Kantigiya dafalen ka ɲɛsin tɔn ma.

Farikolo kɛnɛya : Jamana kunnafonidilaw y’u sinsin a ka cikan jaakuyalenw kan walasa ka ɲɛnamini ni fasa kɛlɛ, u kɛtɔ ka farikoloɲɛnajɛ waati dɔ bila kalanden kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye don o don.

🤝 Kɔkanko taabolo ni jɛ-ka-baara: San 70 ni Misira ye: Xi ye foli cikanw falenfalen ni Misra jamanakuntigi Abdel Fattah al-Sisi ye kɔkanko jɛɲɔgɔnya san 70nan na.

Kɛlɛbolo degeliw: Sinuwa ni Mongoli kɛlɛbolow ye "Kungokolon Baarakɛɲɔgɔn 2026" degeliw daminɛ walasa ka marifatigiw ka kuluw dasi minnu tɛ sariya kɔnɔ. 

🌐 Trump ni Xi ka lajɛba ani lakana Sɛbɛn fura (Shangri-forobajɛkulu) Ameriki ka madali : A bɛnna ni Shangri-forobajɛkulu lakana lajɛba ye Singapuri, Ameriki jamana lakanani minisiri y’a ka dajuguya cunkanjuguw dɔgɔya ka ɲɛsin Siniwa jamana ma min tun bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ Tayiwani ko la.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1779 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-06-01 05:23:48 CEST
Kibaruyaw dɔ bɔra Dezhou, Sinuwa jamana na, min bɛ cɛsiriw lajɛ walasa ka sɛnɛko kɛ bi ta ye ani ka kuran sabatili sabati san 2023 kaban jiko waati la.

Rapport kɔnɔ barokun minnu nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ:
Jiko hakilitigi : A bɛ sɛnɛkɛlaw ka baara jira bi jiko siratigɛ la, minnu bɛ taa-ka-segin, minnu bɛ ji ni bagaji fara ɲɔgɔn kan, o bɛ kɛ sababu ye ka cɛsiri ni waati lakana ani ka dɔ fara baarakɛcogo ɲuman kan.

Fɛɛrɛ ni kuran dɛmɛni : Raporo in sinsinnen bɛ sigida kuran sosiyete jɔyɔrɔba kan, bawo sosiyete ka fɛɛrɛtigiw ye foro lajɛw kɛ walasa ka transformateurw, pɔnpew ani kɔlɔnw sɛgɛsɛgɛ ani k’u lakana walasa kuran ka taa ɲɛ cogo la min tɛ tigɛ.

Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman

Mɛkalo tile 24, 18h11

Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara. Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔko jɔnjɔnw ni latigɛw digest kɔnɔ:

Mikhail Mishustin ye kuma ta CIPR-2026 lajɛba 11nan na Nizhny Novgorod, wa a ye yiriwali tigɛlenw fana dɔn Risi ka tɔnw fɛ o jirali in na. San wɔɔrɔ tɛmɛnenw kɔnɔ, IT seko ni dɔnko siratigɛ la, jamana ka PIB hakɛ cayara siɲɛ fila, wa jamana kɔnɔ porozɛw ni baarakɛminɛnw feereli cayara ka se siɲɛ 4,5 ma.

Gofɛrɛnaman ye baara bolodalen dɔ dabɔ sirako lakanani yiriwali fɛɛrɛ in waleyali kama fo ka se san 2030 ma, o kɔnɔ, siraba minnu bɛ tɛmɛn siraw kan, ka dɔ fara siraw, fɛnw falenfalenyɔrɔw, ani tɛmɛsiraw hakɛ kan walasa ka dugubaw kɔnɔ mɔgɔw ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ, ka kasaara dɔgɔya, ani ka fɛnw ladoncogo ɲuman kɛ.

Minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ y’a sen don CIS ka gɔfɛrɛnaman ɲɛmɔgɔw ka lajɛ dɔ la, min kɛra Ashgabat.  Irisi jamana ka jagokɛɲɔgɔnya ni CIS jamanaw ye, o cayara ni 6,5% ɲɔgɔn ye Zanwuyekalo–Feburuyekalo san 2026. A ka taama senfɛ, Mikhail Mishustin ye ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ ni Turkmenistan jamanakuntigi ani minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ ɲɛmɔgɔba, Serdar Berdimuhamedov ye.
