. A ka sin dili nɔ min bɛ bɔ fali (fali) la .
Komin a sin dila bagan dɔ fɛ min dagalen don ka dun (o ye sokɔnɔ fali ye), sariyatigiw b’a nɔrɔ bonya sariya la:  
YouTube kan

Sogo saniyali sani a ka faga: Dɔnnibaaw fanba dalen b’a la ko ni bagan dagalen dɔ sinna bagan fɛ min dagalen don, a sogo tɛ dabila fewu, nka a bɛ kɛ fɛn ye min man di a ye walima a bɛ bali waati dɔ kɔnɔ ni nɔnɔ dagalen nɔ dɔw bɔra a kasa la walima a sogo diya la.

O cogoya jɔnjɔn : Walasa a ka saraka ani ka haramulen in bɔ a la pewu, a ka kan ka a yɛrɛ mabɔ mɔgɔw la ani ka a bila kaso la waati dɔ kɔnɔ sani a ka faga (a jate bɛ kɛ tile 4 na ka se tile 7 ma sagaw ni bakɔrɔnw na), o waati la, a bɛ balo saniyalen, balo ɲuman di a ma (i n’a fɔ bin ni sumanw) fo ka se fali nɔnɔ nɔ dɔ ma min bɛ a fari la, o ka tunun ani ka a sogo falen ka bɔ dumuni saniyalen na.  
Tile wolonwulanan

Kuncɛli:
Ni nin den in kɔrɔla ka se saraka san hakɛ sariyalen ma, ka sɔrɔ ka a datugu ani ka balo bagan saniyalen na tile damadɔ kɔnɔ ka kɔn seli don ɲɛ fo a sogo ka nɔgɔya ani sinji kɔrɔ nɔw ka ban, o tuma na, a bɛ se ka kɛ ka a saraka k’a sɔrɔ maloya ma kɛ a la, wa o ye saraka ye min bɛ se ka kɛ, wa a bɛ sɔn, ni Ala sɔnna.  
Islamweb ye

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1808 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-05-30 11:56:57 CEST
Silamɛya sariya kɔnɔ, nin ɲɛjirali in bɛ na ni kiritigɛ jɔnjɔn fila ye minnu ɲɛsinnen bɛ nɔnɔ saniyali ma ani furu senumaya ma (sin dili):

1. Nɔnɔ minni n’a saniyacogo kiritigɛ
Sariya min bɛ faliw nɔnɔ ko la (sokɔnɔ fali musow): Dɔnnibaaw fanba (Maliki, Shafi’i, ani Hanbali, min bɛ sɔn Hanafi kalanso fɛ) taara sokɔnɔ faliw ka nɔnɔ minni balili la, ka tugu u sogo dunni balili kɔ, o min sɛgɛsɛgɛra kira ka sunna lakika kɔnɔ (Kaybar don).

Bagan fitinin ko la: Nin dennin walima sagaden min bɛ sin di fali ma, o tɛ maloya a yɛrɛ la, wa o tɛ nɔ bila a saniya la i n’a fɔ bagan, wa a sogo tɛ nɔgɔ sin dili dɔrɔn fɛ.

2. Kiiritigɛ min bɛ nin sin dili in nɔ bila dankarili la (mahramiya) .
Ɲininkali min bɛ kɛ mɔgɔ dɔw fɛ sariya siratigɛ la: Yala sin dili balili walima “balimaya” sigira sen kan suguya wɛrɛw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ (i n’a fɔ hadamaden min bɛ sin di bagan ma, walima bagan suguya wɛrɛ) wa?

Baganw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ: Baganw sin dili ɲɔgɔn fɛ, o tɛ sariyako latigɛ si kɛ; Sariya ka latigɛw ni wajibiw ye hadamadenw dɔrɔn de ta ye.

Sin dili sariya min bɛ hadamadenw na : Ni den fila bɛ sin di bagan kelen nɔnɔ ma (i n’a fɔ saga walima fali muso), dalilu si tɛ yen min b’a jira ko balimakɛ bɛ u ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ sinji dili fɛ hali dɔɔnin ka kɛɲɛ ni dɔnnikɛla fanba ka fɔta ye. Sabu sogo ni joli sin dili dagalen ye hadamadenw (musow) dɔrɔn ka nɔnɔ ye, ka kɛɲɛ ni kira, Ala ka hɛrɛ ni dugaw ka kɛ a kan, a y’a fɔ min ye ko: “Sin dili tɛ yen fo min bɛ kolo falen ka sogo falen,” wa baganw ka nɔnɔ tɛ bɔnsɔn walima furu sigi hadamadenw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ.

Mɔni kɛli Moritani jamana na, o bɛ se ka lajɛ nin yɔrɔ koloma ninnu na:

Jɛgɛmarayɔrɔ caman : Moritani kɔgɔjida bɛ kilomɛtɛrɛ 760 bɔ, wa a kɔgɔjida bɛ mɔnikɛyɔrɔ nafamabaw cɛma diɲɛ kɔnɔ k’a sababu kɛ jikuruw ye minnu bɛ jɛgɛw ka ɲɛnamaya sigida fa. Jɛgɛ hakɛ bɛ Se tɔni miliyɔn 1,5 ɲɔgɔn ma sàn o sàn.

Don o don baara ni fɛnw bɔli jamana wɛrɛw la: Hali ni minɛnw ni laadala mɔni kurunw ka nɔgɔn, mɔnikɛlaw bɛ segin don o don ni jɛgɛ suguya caman ye (i n’a fɔ kapɛri, sardine, ani fɛn wɛrɛw), minnu fanba bɛ taa u sigiɲɔgɔn jamanaw na ani Erɔpu.

Sɔrɔko ni balo nafa : Nin seko in ye nafolo belebele ye Moritani sɔrɔko la. Jɛgɛ sugu min bɛ Nouakchott, o bɛ don o don taamaw ye ka bɔ dugumɔgɔw ni turisiw bɛɛ fɛ minnu bɛ jɛgɛ kuraw ɲini. A suguya fanba bɛ sɔrɔ sɔngɔ dafalen na walasa ka bɛn bɛɛ ma, n’a ma fɔ suguya dɔw minnu man ca, minnu bɛ taa ni u ye jamana wɛrɛw la k’a sababu kɛ u musaka ka bon.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1905 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-05-20 20:54:40 CEST
Mɔni kɛli Moritani jamana na, o bɛ se ka lajɛ nin yɔrɔ koloma ninnu na:

Jɛgɛmarayɔrɔ caman : Moritani kɔgɔjida bɛ kilomɛtɛrɛ 760 bɔ, wa a kɔgɔjida bɛ mɔnikɛyɔrɔ nafamabaw cɛma diɲɛ kɔnɔ k’a sababu kɛ jikuruw ye minnu bɛ jɛgɛw ka ɲɛnamaya sigida fa. Jɛgɛ hakɛ bɛ Se tɔni miliyɔn 1,5 ɲɔgɔn ma sàn o sàn.

Don o don baara ni fɛnw bɔli jamana wɛrɛw la: Hali ni minɛnw ni laadala mɔni kurunw ka nɔgɔn, mɔnikɛlaw bɛ segin don o don ni jɛgɛ suguya caman ye (i n’a fɔ kapɛri, sardine, ani fɛn wɛrɛw), minnu fanba bɛ taa u sigiɲɔgɔn jamanaw na ani Erɔpu.

Sɔrɔko ni balo nafa : Nin seko in ye nafolo belebele ye Moritani sɔrɔko la. Jɛgɛ sugu min bɛ Nouakchott, o bɛ don o don taamaw ye ka bɔ dugumɔgɔw ni turisiw bɛɛ fɛ minnu bɛ jɛgɛ kuraw ɲini. A suguya fanba bɛ sɔrɔ sɔngɔ dafalen na walasa ka bɛn bɛɛ ma, n’a ma fɔ suguya dɔw minnu man ca, minnu bɛ taa ni u ye jamana wɛrɛw la k’a sababu kɛ u musaka ka bon.

*🇲🇱JAMANAW KA ƝƐNABƆLI ƝƐNABƆLI ƝƐNABƆLI SƐNƐKƐLAW (CAA), 2026 SESSION🌾*

📒Dimansi, Mɛkalo tile 17, san 2026, Askia Mohamed lise la Bamakɔ.

Sɛgɛsɛgɛlikɛyɔrɔ 9 kɔnɔ jamana kɔnɔ, mɔgɔ 1026 bɛ ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ yɔrɔ 220 sɔrɔli la san 2026 jamana ka donko sɛgɛsɛgɛli la, n’o ye sɛnɛko kalansow (CAA) ye.

Laseli fɔlɔ in senfɛ, sɛnɛko minisiri, dɔgɔtɔrɔ Ibrahima SAMAKE, n’a jɛɲɔgɔnw ka bɔ baganmara ni jɛgɛko minisiriso la, n’o ye Youba BA ye; Fasokanw ka kalanko, Amadu SY SAVANÉ; Lamini, Doumbie Mariyam TANGARA; ani Baara ni Foroba Baara, Fassoun COULIBALY.  Anwɛlɛki fɔlɔ min kɔnɔ Sɛbɛnni ɛkizamɛn sɛbɛn bɛ yen, o dabɔra sɛnɛko minisiri dɔgɔtɔrɔ SAMAKE fɛ.
Kandidati bɛna Sɛbɛnni, Jatebla ani Biologi sɛgɛsɛgɛliw kɛ tile kelen kɔnɔ.
Gofɛrɛnaman mɔgɔ duuru ninnu ye laadilikan nafamaw di kɔlɔsilikɛlaw ni kandidaw ma, k’u sinsin nafa kan, Mali fanga kɔrɔbaw bɛ min bila ɲɛɲini sɛgɛsɛgɛliw ni ɲɛɲiniw na, ka jɛlenya dafalen ni lafiya sabatili sabati.

U ye dusu don kandidaw kɔnɔ fana u ka baara kɛ kosɛbɛ, k’u yɛrɛ di u ka kalan ma, o min bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka seko ni dɔnko sɔrɔ ɲɛmɔgɔ nataw bolo togodala yiriwali siratigɛ la, n’u donna jamana baara la.

Hakilijigin na, sɛnɛko kalansow (CAA) bɛ Kayes, Koulikoro, Ségou, ani Koutiala maraw la.

*🇲🇱 JAMANA KA DONKO SƐGƐSƐGƐLI DAMINƐNI FOROBA LA SƐNƐKO KALANSOW (CAA), SAN 2026 WAATI 🌾*

📒 Karidon, Mɛkalo tile 17, san 2026, Askia Mohamed cɛmancɛkalanso la Bamakɔ.

Sɛgɛsɛgɛlikɛyɔrɔ 9 la, jamana fan bɛɛ la, mɔgɔ 1026 bɛ ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ yɔrɔ 220 sɔrɔli la san 2026 jamana ka donko sɛgɛsɛgɛli la, n’o ye sɛnɛko kalansobaw ye (CAA).

Laseli fɔlɔ in senfɛ, sɛnɛko minisiri, dɔgɔtɔrɔ Ibrahima Samakɛ, n’a jɛɲɔgɔnw ka bɔ baganmara ni jɛgɛko minisiriso la, n’o ye Youba Ba ye; Fasodenw ka kalanko, Amadu Sy Savane; Lamini, Doumbia Mariyam Tangara; ani Baara ni foroba baarakɛlaw, Fassoun Coulibaly.

Jamana ka donko sɛgɛsɛgɛli daminɛni laseli forobayali kan sɛnɛko kalansow (CAA), san 2026 kalan. Sɛnɛ minisiri, n’o ye dɔgɔtɔrɔ Samake ye, ale ye bataki foroko fɔlɔ da wuli, kɔrɔbɔli sɛbɛnnen bɛ min kɔnɔ.

ɲininikɛlaw bɛna sɛbɛnni, jatebɔ ani ɲɛnamayako sɛgɛsɛgɛliw kɛ o don kelen na.

Gofɛrɛnaman ɲɛmaa duuru ninnu ye laadilikan nafamaw di kandidaw n’a kɔlɔsibagaw ma, k’u sinsin nafa kan min bɛ Mali fangatigiba dɔw bila ɲɛɲini sɛgɛsɛgɛliw ni ɲɛɲiniw na, ka jɛlenya dafalen ni lafiya sabatili sinsin.

U ye dusu don ɲininikɛlaw kɔnɔ fana u k’u cɛsiri ka ɲɛtaa sɔrɔ ani k’u yɛrɛ ka cɛsiri jira, o min bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka ɲɛmɔgɔ nataw ka seko ni dɔnko sabati togodala yiriwali siratigɛ la n’u donna jamana baarakɛlaw ka baara la.

Hakilijigin na, sɛnɛko kalansow bɛ Kayes, Koulikoro, Ségou, ani Koutiala maraw la.

*🇲🇱JAMAN KA ƝƐNABƆLI ƝƐNABƆLI FƆRƆBƆLI LA CAA SƐNƐKƐLA KALANSENW NA, SƐBƐN 2026🌾*

📒Dimanche mɛkalo tile 17 san 2026, Askia Mohamed lise la Bamakɔ. 

Sɛgɛsɛgɛlikɛyɔrɔ 9 kɔnɔ jamana kɔnɔ, mɔgɔ 1026 de bɛ yen, walasa yɔrɔ 220 ka fa, san 2026 kalan kama, jamana ka donko sɛgɛsɛgɛli la CAA kɔnɔ.
Laseli ofisiyali la, sɛnɛko minisiri, Dɔgɔtɔrɔ Ibrahima SAMAKE n’a jɛɲɔgɔnw ka bɔ baganmara ni jɛgɛko la, Youba BA, ka bɔ jamana kalanko la, Amadu SY SAVANÉ, ka bɔ sigida lamini na, DOUMBIA Mariam TANGARA, ani ka bɔ baara ni jamana baarakɛlaw la, Fassoun COULIBALY. 
 Anwɛlɛki fɔlɔ min kɔnɔ, Essay test bɛ yen, o dabɔra sɛnɛko minisiri Dɔgɔtɔrɔ SAMAKE fɛ.
Kandidati bɛna baara kɛ Sɛbɛnni, Jatebla ani Biologi sɛgɛsɛgɛliw kan tile kelen kɔnɔ.
Gofɛrɛnaman mɔgɔ duuru ninnu ye laadilikan nafamaw di kɔlɔsilikɛlaw ni kandidaw ma walasa k’a jira ko Mali fanga kɔrɔbaw bɛ nafa min don ɲɛɲiniw ni sɛgɛsɛgɛliw la ni jɛlenya ni lafiya dafalen ye.
U ye dusu don kandidaw kɔnɔ fana u ka cɛsiri ni u yɛrɛ ka baara kɛ minnu bɛ seko ni dɔnko sabati ɲɛmɔgɔyaso nataw la togodala yiriwali siratigɛ la, n’u donna foroba baara la.
Hakilijigin kama,🌽 CAA Sɛnɛ kalansow,🌾 bɛ Kayes, Koulikoro, Ségou ani Koutiala maraw la.🇲🇱

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1927 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-05-19 12:42:41 CEST
Mɔni kɛli Moritani jamana na, o bɛ se ka lajɛ nin yɔrɔ koloma ninnu na:

Jɛgɛmarayɔrɔ caman : Moritani kɔgɔjida bɛ kilomɛtɛrɛ 760 bɔ, wa a kɔgɔjida bɛ mɔnikɛyɔrɔ nafamabaw cɛma diɲɛ kɔnɔ k’a sababu kɛ jikuruw ye minnu bɛ jɛgɛw ka ɲɛnamaya sigida fa. Jɛgɛ hakɛ bɛ Se tɔni miliyɔn 1,5 ɲɔgɔn ma sàn o sàn.

Don o don baara ni fɛnw bɔli jamana wɛrɛw la: Hali ni minɛnw ni laadala mɔni kurunw ka nɔgɔn, mɔnikɛlaw bɛ segin don o don ni jɛgɛ suguya caman ye (i n’a fɔ kapɛri, sardine, ani fɛn wɛrɛw), minnu fanba bɛ taa u sigiɲɔgɔn jamanaw na ani Erɔpu.

Sɔrɔko ni balo nafa : Nin seko in ye nafolo belebele ye Moritani sɔrɔko la. Jɛgɛ sugu min bɛ Nouakchott, o bɛ don o don taamaw ye ka bɔ dugumɔgɔw ni turisiw bɛɛ fɛ minnu bɛ jɛgɛ kuraw ɲini. A suguya fanba bɛ sɔrɔ sɔngɔ dafalen na walasa ka bɛn bɛɛ ma, n’a ma fɔ suguya dɔw minnu man ca, minnu bɛ taa ni u ye jamana wɛrɛw la k’a sababu kɛ u musaka ka bon.

I n'a fɔ Jɛgɛ sugu minnu bɛ Nouakchott, Olu bɛ don o don taamaw ye ka bɔ dugumɔgɔw ni yaalakɛlaw bɛɛ fɛ minnu bɛ na ka jɛgɛ kɛnɛw ɲini. Wa a suguya fanba bɛ sɔrɔ ni sɔngɔ dafalenw ye walasa ka bɛn bɛɛ ma, n’a ma fɔ suguya dɔw ye minnu ka dɔgɔ, minnu ni taa bɛ kɛ n'u ye jamana wɛrɛw la k’a sababu kɛ u musaka ka caya ye.

🛑 Mali ~ Minisiriw ka cidenjɛkuluba dɔ bɛ ka taa Irisi jamana na sisan.

O taama in senfɛ, Mali ni Irisila ye bolonɔ bila jɛɲɔgɔnya bɛnkanw na sigida ni sɔrɔko siratigɛ suguya caman na.

Fɛnɲɛnamaw bɛ sɔrɔ kumaɲɔgɔnya la ni minisiri ye min ɲɛsinnen bɛ bolifɛnko ni fɛnsɔrɔko ma.

Fɛnɲɛnamaw bɛ sɔrɔ kumaɲɔgɔnya la ni minisiri ye min ɲɛsinnen bɛ bolifɛnko ni fɛnsɔrɔko ma.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1962 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-05-17 14:12:18 CEST
Mɛkalo tle 17, san 2026, doni-ta-aviyɔn fɔlɔ min bɔra Hɔngiri, o sera Constantine Airport la Alzeri, a tun bɛ ni saga kɛmɛ caman ye (kunkolo 400 ɲɔgɔn bɛ nin ci fɔlɔ in na, ka kɛɲɛ ni kunnafoniw ye).

Kunnafoni : Nin ye gɔfɛrɛnaman ka porogaramuba dɔ ye min yamaruyara jamanakuntigi Tebboune fɛ ka saga miliyɔn kelen don jamana kɔnɔ san 2026 Adha seli makɔnɔni na, n’a kun ye ka dɔ fara u sɔrɔli kan, ka sɔngɔw dɔgɔya, ani ka ɲininiw dafa.

Jagokɛlaw bɛ don jamana kɔnɔ fɔlɔ kurunw fɛ ka bɔ jamanaw la i n’a fɔ Rumani, Ɛsipaɲi, Georgie ani jamana wɛrɛw. Nin ye a siɲɛ fɔlɔ ye fiɲɛbɔlanw ka kɛ ka sagaw ta kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la ka taa Kɔnstantin.

Sagaw bɛ jira kaburu kɔnɔ awiyɔn/jiginyɔrɔ la.

Kɔlɔsili: Hali ni fɛnw donna jamana kɔnɔ ka caya, jamanaden caman bɛ ŋunan hali bi saraka baganw sɔngɔ gɛlɛnw na.

Labɛn in bɛ senna walasa k’u sɔrɔ sɔngɔ bɛnnen na (sɔngɔ dantigɛlen min bɛna kɛ dinari 50.000 ye saga kelen na min bɛ na jamana kɔnɔ).

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1967 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-05-17 10:19:46 CEST
Mɛkalo tile 13, san 2026, Jaljulia dugu kɔnɔ (Ramallah worodugu/kɔrɔn fɛ, Cisjordanie). Israɛl sigibagaw (ni saga ni bakɔrɔn kuluba) bɛ ye ka baganw ladon dugu siraw fɛ, a bɛ iko Israɛl sɔrɔdasikulu (sɔrɔdasi bolifɛnw ni sɔrɔdasiw) ka lakanani kɔnɔ. Palestina ka maana ye ko sigibagaw ye bagan kɛmɛ caman sonya (sɛnɛkɛlaw ka sɔrɔ fɔlɔ) binkanni senfɛ o yɔrɔ la, ani Palestina kamalennin dɔ fagara kɛlɛw la minnu bɛ tali kɛ o la.

Sagakuluw ladonni sɔrɔdasiw ka lakanani kɔnɔ, o ye ko dɔw ye minnu bɛ kɛ siɲɛ caman Cisjordanie jamana na, n’o ye baganw ni dugukolo sonya ye. Nin ko sugu in sɛbɛnnen don Palestina mɔgɔw fɛ ani hadamadenw ka josariyaw tɔnw fɛ, wa a ka c’a la, Israɛl fan fɛ, a bɛ ban walima ka jo di a ma ko “baganmara sɔsɔli” walima binkanniw jaabiw.

(sɛnɛkɛlaw ka sɔrɔ bɔyɔrɔ fɔlɔ) binkanni senfɛ o yɔrɔ kan, ani Palestina kamalennin dɔ fagara kɛlɛw la minnu ni o ɲɔgɔnna bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1978 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-05-16 13:04:09 CEST
Nin kibaruya in bɛ Ameriki jamanakuntigi kɔrɔ Donald Trump ni Sinuwa jamanakuntigi Xi Jinping ka ɲɔgɔnye min kɛra, o kɔlɔlɔw lajɛ, Trump ka taama kɔfɛ Sinuwa jamana na, ka hakilina jɔnjɔnw jira:

Jagokɛlaw ka bɛnkanw: Sinuwa sɔnna ka Ameriki sɛnɛfɛn caman san, Boeing ka awiyɔn 200 ani Ameriki ka fanga sɔrɔfɛnw.

Taiwan: O ko in kumana, Trump y’a yɛrɛ tanga jaabi tilennen ma, n’o ye ko Ameriki bɛna Taiwan lafasa sɔrɔdasiya siratigɛ la, k’a sɔrɔ Ameriki jamana sariyasunbatigiw bɛ ka dɔrɔmɛ miliyari caman lafasa Taiwan ma.

Iran: Jamanakuntigi fla ninnu ye kuma ta sɔsɔli in kan ni Iran ye (k’a da a kan, Siniwajamana ye a ka jagokɛɲɔgɔnba ye), wa Trump y’a jira ko ale tɛ “nafa si” ɲini Siniwa jamana fɛ nin ko in kan, k’a sɔrɔ Iran y’a ka waleɲumandɔn jira Siniwa jamana ka diplomasi dɛmɛni na, sɔsɔli min bɛ senna uraniyɔmu nafabɔli kan.

Fɛn nataw : Siniwajamana y’a jira ko nin lajɛ in ye “tariku” ye, wa a ka jamana kɔkankow minisiriso y’a jira ko jamanakuntigi Xi Jinping bɛna taa bɔ Ameriki jamana na tilebin fɛ Trump ka welekan fɛ.

Waati: 2026-05-16 13:04:08 CEST
Nin kibaruya in bɛ Ameriki jamanakuntigi kɔrɔ Donald Trump ni Sinuwa jamanakuntigi Xi Jinping ka ɲɔgɔnye min kɛra, o kɔlɔlɔw lajɛ, Trump ka taama kɔfɛ Sinuwa jamana na, ka hakilina jɔnjɔnw jira:

Jagokɛlaw ka bɛnkanw: Sinuwa sɔnna ka Ameriki sɛnɛfɛn caman san, Boeing ka awiyɔn 200 ani Ameriki ka fanga sɔrɔfɛnw.

Taiwan: O ko in kumana, Trump y’a yɛrɛ tanga jaabi tilennen ma, n’o ye ko Ameriki bɛna Taiwan lafasa sɔrɔdasiya siratigɛ la, k’a sɔrɔ Ameriki jamana sariyasunbatigiw bɛ ka dɔrɔmɛ miliyari caman lafasa Taiwan ma.

Iran: Jamanakuntigi fla ninnu ye kuma ta sɔsɔli in kan ni Iran ye (k’a da a kan, Siniwajamana ye a ka jagokɛɲɔgɔnba ye), wa Trump y’a jira ko ale tɛ “nafa si” ɲini Siniwa jamana fɛ nin ko in kan, k’a sɔrɔ Iran y’a ka waleɲumandɔn jira Siniwa jamana ka diplomasi dɛmɛni na, sɔsɔli min bɛ senna uraniyɔmu nafabɔli kan.

Fɛn nataw : Siniwajamana y’a jira ko nin lajɛ in ye “tariku” ye, wa a ka jamana kɔkankow minisiriso y’a jira ko jamanakuntigi Xi Jinping bɛna taa bɔ Ameriki jamana na tilebin fɛ Trump ka welekan fɛ.

Nin kibaruya in bɛ Ameriki jamanakuntigi Donald Trump ni Sinuwa jamanakuntigi Xi Jinping ka lajɛba min kɛra, o jaabiw lajɛ, Trump ka taama kɔfɛ Sinuwa jamana na, wa a b’a ka hakilina jɔnjɔnw jira:

Jago bɛnkanw: Sinuwa sɔnna ka Ameriki sɛnɛfɛn bɔta caman san, ka Boeing ka pankurun 200 san, ani Ameriki ka fanga fɛn bɔtaw.

Tayiwani sɛbɛn fura: O ko in kumana, wa Trump y’a yɛrɛ tanga jaabi tilennen ma ni Ameriki bɛna Tayiwani lafasa kɛlɛboloya siratigɛ la, O waati kelen na, Ameriki jamana sariyasunbatigiw bɛ k'u digi ka dolari miliyari caman ta ka marifa siriw dɔ tɛmɛn Tayiwani jamana ma.

Iran sɛbɛn fura: Jamanakuntigi fila ninnu ye baro kɛ sɔsɔli in kan ni Iran ye (k’a da a kan, Siniwa jamana ye a ka jagokɛɲɔgɔnyaba ye), wa Trump y’a jira ko ale tɛ “nafa si” ɲini Siniwa jamana fɛ nin sɛbɛn fura in na, k’a sɔrɔ Iran y’a gɛlɛya ka waleɲumandɔn jira Siniwa jamana ka kɔkanko dɛmɛni na, fɔkoɲɔgɔnya min bɛ senna o cɛma uraniyɔmu nafabɔliko la.

Fɛn nataw : Siniwajamana y’a jira ko nin ɲɔgɔnye in ye “tariku” ye, wa a ka jamana kɔkankow minisiriso y’a jira ko jamanakuntigi Xi Jinping bɛna taa bɔ Ameriki jamana na kawula nata in na laminɛni kama Trump ka welekan na.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 1984 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-05-16 06:31:15 CEST
Kastamonu mara la, jamana kalanko ɲɛmɔgɔso (Turquie).

Baarakɛlaw ka kalan bolodalenw lakɔlisow kɔnɔ, minnu bɛ kalandenw ka baara kɛcogo ɲumanw jira i n’a fɔ :

Dɛmɛ fɔlɔ kalan

Kuranko minɛnw dilancogo

Masina ni izini baarakɛyɔrɔw

Kɔrɔtɔko degeliw

Cidenyabaara : "An bɛ dɔnniya sɛmɛntiya ka kɛ fɛn dilanni ye ani ka baara kɛ baara ye jamana kɔnɔ, ka funankɛnin barikamaw jɔ jɛkafɔ ni nafaw fɛ."

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2012 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-05-15 10:52:12 CEST
Jamana ka ntolatanba min bɛ kɛ Irisi jamana na, n’o ye baarakɛlaw ka seko ni dɔnko ɲɛɲini ye, n’o ye fiyentɔw ni kɛnɛyako seko danmadɔw ye, olu ka se sɔrɔli daminɛna. Fɛn kolomaw : ɲɔgɔndankɛla 2200 bɛ ka bɔ Irisi jamana mara bɛɛ la.

O ɲɔgɔndan in kun ye k’u ka baarakɛcogo jira ani k’u ni baarakɛyɔrɔw cɛsiri.

Baara hakɛ min bɛ kɛ jɛkulu in senfɛ, o tɛmɛna 93% kan.

O ɲɔgɔndanw bɛna kɛ mara 15 kɔnɔ, minnu bɛna kɛ baara kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen 47 danfaralenw kan.

Minnu ye 'tàli Kɛ 'sèn na, olu bɛna Taa 'ɲɛnajɛ labanw na.

O ntolatan in ye jamana ka porozɛ dɔ ye walasa ka dɛmɛ don kalanko ni baara la fiyentɔw ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2042 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-05-15 00:06:58 CEST
Mali Jamanakuntigiya

Minisiriw ka tɔnba ye ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ lajɛ gansan na arabadon mɛkalo tile 13 san 2026, a ka hakilijagabɔso kɔnɔ Koulouba masaso kɔnɔ, jenerali Assimi Goïta ka ɲɛmɔgɔya kɔnɔ, n’o ye wuliliko ɲɛmɔgɔ ye, jamanakuntigi.

Minisiriw ka tɔnba ka fɔta (san 2026 mɛkalo tile 13) kɔnɔko jɔnjɔnw kuncɛlen filɛ nin ye :

1. Baarakɛda fanw (Taxation): .

Impositi ɲɛmɔgɔso yiriwali a ka sariyaw labɛnni kura fɛ ani a ka baarakɛlaw barika bonya fɛ san duuru nataw kɔnɔ walasa ka impositi lajɛcogo ɲuman yiriwa.

2. Sɔrɔdasi sigili:

Kolonɛli Dɔgɔtɔrɔ Souleymane Coulibaly sigili ka kɛ sɔrɔdasi kalanso ɲɛmɔgɔba ye.

 3. Marabolow ka jɛkafɔ (AES Sahel): .

Jɛkafɔ ni Burukina Faso ni Nizɛri ye walasa ka siwili awiyɔn sariyaw bɛn ɲɔgɔn ma walasa ka taama ni sɔrɔko jɛɲɔgɔnya nɔgɔya jɛkulu jamanaw cɛ.

4. Sanji waati labɛnniw:

Daminɛ, mɛkalo tile 14, ba saniya baaraba dɔ Bamakɔ (a ka ca ni mɛtɛrɛ 348.000 ye) walasa ka sanjiba bali.

5. Sosiyete ka fɛɛrɛw (Eid al-Adha): .

Jɛkulu, k’a ta mɛkalo tile 20 na ka se tile 27 ma Bamakɔ ni marabolow la, saraka bagan feereli dɔ sɔngɔ dɔgɔyali la walasa ka wariko doni nɔgɔya denbayaw kan. 6. Kɛnɛya ni sigida:

Dengue banabagatɔw dɔgɔyali sɛbɛnna.

Porozɛ "Citizen Dialogues" daminɛna walasa ka hɛrɛ ni jɛkafɔ nafaw yiriwa funankɛninw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ.

 Duniya denbayaw ka donba (mɛkalo tile 15) kɛra ni sinsin kɛra dɔrɔguta kɛlɛli kan ani waati jiginni nɔfɛkow.

Siniwa jamanatigi Xi Jinping ni Mali jamanakuntigi Assimi Goeta (sɛtanburukalo tle 2024) ka ɲɔgɔnye min Kɛra FOCAC ka lajɛba senfɛ, o Kɛra jamana fla ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ lajɛ ye min bɛ Kɛ tuma bɛɛ Sinuwa ni Afiriki diplomasi kɔnɔ, min ye jamana fla ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ jɛɲɔgɔnyaw kɔrɔta ka Kɛ jɛ-ka-baara ye. 



Lajɛ in tiɲɛba : Fɛn fila ninnu y’a jira ko jɛɲɔgɔnyaw wulila ka kɛ jɛɲɔgɔnya siratigɛ la.
Sinuwa ye layidu ta ko a bɛna dɛmɛ don wariko la sɔrɔ yiriwali la, ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲɛ, ani ka ɲɔgɔn dɛmɛ diɲɛ koɲɛw la (i n'a fɔ "Sina kelen" sariya).
Goeta ye Mali ka waleɲumandɔn jira Siniwa jamana jɔyɔrɔ la diɲɛ hɛrɛ ni yiriwali la. 



Nin lajɛ in ye lajɛba dɔ ye min kɔnɔ farafinna jamana tan ni caman tun bɛ yen, wa laseli si ma kɛ ka ɲɛsin porozɛba kuraw ma Mali dɔrɔn de kama. Sinuwa ka fanga lakika Mali kɔnɔ : Sinuwa ni Mali cɛsira kɔrɔlen don (kabini san 1960) wa a juguman don, nka a fanba tɛ sɔrɔdasi ta ye n’i y’a suma ni jamana tɔw ye i n’a fɔ Irisi (Afiriki Kɔrɔsili). Sɔrɔko ni yiriwali fanw (min ka bon kosɛbɛ): Jago : A sera dɔrɔmɛ miliyɔn 880 ɲɔgɔn ma san 2023 (32,7% bonya). Sinuwa bɛ masinw ni mɔbiliw bila ka taa jamana wɛrɛw la, A bɛ minɛnw (nɛgɛ, manganɛsi, sesame) don jamana kɔnɔ. 



Nafolodonni : fɛnsɔrɔko porozɛw (bonda, siraw, dɔgɔtɔrɔsow), ani minɛnko porozɛw (i n’a fɔ litiyamu min bɛ Goulamina porozɛ kɔnɔ ni Ganfeng ye). Mali b’a ɲini ka sɔrɔko cakɛdaw kɔlɔsi (misali la 51% bɔgɔbɔgɔli porozɛw la). 



Jɔrɔ ni dɛmɛ : Sinuwa ye wariko ɲɛnabɔbaga ŋana ye, nka a tɛ “juru jaan” laɲinilen ye; Aw ye aw sinsin porozew kan ka sɔrɔ ka nafolo sɔrɔ tuma dɔw la.
FOCAC 2024 kɔnɔ : Sinuwaw ka layidu bɛɛ lajɛlen ye dɔrɔmɛ miliyari 50,7 ye Afiriki (juru + waridon + dɛmɛ), ni jiriforo, kɛnɛya, ani sɛnɛko porozɛw ye Mali sen bɛ o la (i n’a fɔ Sanankoroba tilebɔlan). 



Sɔrɔdasi ni lakana fan fɛ : Jɛɲɔgɔnya danma (2013 logistiki bɛnkan), kalan dɛmɛni FOCAC kɔnɔ (Afiriki sɔrɔdasiw dege).
Mali bɛ ka baara kɛ ni Irisila ye walasa ka terrorisme (jatigɛwale) kɛlɛ Faransi ni ONU ka kɛlɛbolow gɛnnen kɔ. Sinuwa bɛ sabatili fɛ a ka sɔrɔko nafaw kama, nka a tɛ sɔrɔdasi sigiyɔrɔba dɔw jɔ yen. 



Tiɲɛniba (min tɛ propagande ye): Sinuwaw ka sɔrɔko fanga barikama : Sinuwa ye jɛɲɔgɔn dannamɔgɔ ye Mali bolo (min bɛ lakana ni sɔrɔko gɛlɛyaw ɲɛ), a sinsinnen bɛ « se sɔrɔli » kan nafolo ni suguw musaka la.
A tɛ fangatigi ye fewu: Mali bɛ ni jɛɲɔgɔn wɛrɛw ye (Irisi, Turquie, Gulf jamanaw), ani Sinuwa bɛ k’a janto sɔrɔdasiw ka donko tilennen na.
Lajɛba in bɛ Siniwajamana ka fɛɛrɛba jira walasa ka fanga sabati Afiriki kɔnɔ Tlebi jamanaw ɲɛkɔrɔ, n’a bɛ ka sinsin kosɛbɛ iziniw, fanga jɛlenw, ani jago kan sanni ka kɛ fɛnsɔrɔko belebelebaw dɔrɔn ye.

Lajɛ in ye diplomasi protocole ye min bɛ jɛɲɔgɔnya min bɛ sen na, o barika bonya, wa a tɛ « gundolajɛ » ye min bɛ balansi caman Changé. Sinuwa bɛ ka fanga kuntaalajan jɔ sɔrɔko siratigɛ la ka tɛmɛ sɔrɔdasiw kan. 

Kuma surun : Xi Jinping ni Mali jamanakuntigi Assimi Goeta (sɛtanburukalo san 2024) ka ɲɔgɔnye min kɛra FOCAC ka lajɛba la, o kɛra diplomasi lajɛ ye min bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ, ka jɛɲɔgɔnyaw lawuli ka kɛ jɛɲɔgɔnya siratigɛ la. Tiɲɛ: Sɔrɔko jɛ-ka-baara barikama : jago, wari bilali minɛnko la (litiyɔmu, sanu), fɛnsɔrɔko, ani fanga porozɛw.
China ye sɔrɔko jɛɲɔgɔnba ye Mali bolo, nka sɔrɔdasi fanga tɛ a la kosɛbɛ (Mali bɛ baara kɛ ni Irisi ye lakana koɲɛw la).
Sinuwa ka fɛɛrɛba dɔ ye Afiriki kɔnɔ: nafolo min bɛ kɛ ka wari bila ani politiki dɛmɛni.

Kuncɛli : Protocole lajɛ min bɛ Siniwa jamana ka sɔrɔko fanga sabati Mali kɔnɔ, wa a tɛ gundola bɛnkan ye walima fɛn caman tigɛli ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2049 — Kuma fasaralen

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2074 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-05-14 14:34:29 CEST
Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman

Mɛkalo tile 10 nɛgɛ kanɲɛ 17 waati

Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara. Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔko jɔnjɔnw ni latigɛw digest kɔnɔ:

✅Dɔnniya duguw Dubna ani Korolev bɛna nafolo sɔrɔ yiriwali bɛɛjɛfanga kama. O dɛmɛn ninnu bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka ɲininikɛyɔrɔw bonya, ka fɛn dilanni yɔrɔw kɛ bi ta ye, ani ka sigida baarakɛlaw yiriwa.

✅Ɲinan, denmisɛn miliyɔn 5,75 bɛna sababu sɔrɔ ka lafiɲɛbɔ kɛnɛyasow la. Gofɛrɛnaman ye dɔ fara dɔgɔtɔrɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw kan denmisɛnw ka kanpaɲiw furakɛli yɔrɔw la. Rospotrebnadzor (Rospotrebnadzor) bɛ kanpaɲiw saniya cogoya kɔlɔsi. Telefɔni telefɔni dɔ dabɔra walasa bangebagaw ka se ka lajɛ kɛ kanpaɲi sugandili kan: 8 (800) 250-28-90.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2077 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-05-14 14:13:59 CEST
Siniwa jamanatigi Xi Jinping ni Mali jamanakuntigi Assimi Goeta (sɛtanburukalo tle 2024) ka ɲɔgɔnye min Kɛra FOCAC ka lajɛba senfɛ, o Kɛra jamana fla ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ lajɛ ye min bɛ Kɛ tuma bɛɛ Sinuwa ni Afiriki diplomasi kɔnɔ, min ye jamana fla ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ jɛɲɔgɔnyaw kɔrɔta ka Kɛ jɛ-ka-baara ye. 



Lajɛ in tiɲɛba : Fɛn fila ninnu y’a jira ko jɛɲɔgɔnyaw wulila ka kɛ jɛɲɔgɔnya siratigɛ la.
Sinuwa ye layidu ta ko a bɛna dɛmɛ don wariko la sɔrɔ yiriwali la, ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲɛ, ani ka ɲɔgɔn dɛmɛ diɲɛ koɲɛw la (i n'a fɔ "Sina kelen" sariya).
Goeta ye Mali ka waleɲumandɔn jira Siniwa jamana jɔyɔrɔ la diɲɛ hɛrɛ ni yiriwali la. 



Nin lajɛ in ye lajɛba dɔ ye min kɔnɔ farafinna jamana tan ni caman tun bɛ yen, wa laseli si ma kɛ ka ɲɛsin porozɛba kuraw ma Mali dɔrɔn de kama. Sinuwa ka fanga lakika Mali kɔnɔ : Sinuwa ni Mali cɛsira kɔrɔlen don (kabini san 1960) wa a juguman don, nka a fanba tɛ sɔrɔdasi ta ye n’i y’a suma ni jamana tɔw ye i n’a fɔ Irisi (Afiriki Kɔrɔsili). Sɔrɔko ni yiriwali fanw (min ka bon kosɛbɛ): Jago : A sera dɔrɔmɛ miliyɔn 880 ɲɔgɔn ma san 2023 (32,7% bonya). Sinuwa bɛ masinw ni mɔbiliw bila ka taa jamana wɛrɛw la, A bɛ minɛnw (nɛgɛ, manganɛsi, sesame) don jamana kɔnɔ. 



Nafolodonni : fɛnsɔrɔko porozɛw (bonda, siraw, dɔgɔtɔrɔsow), ani minɛnko porozɛw (i n’a fɔ litiyamu min bɛ Goulamina porozɛ kɔnɔ ni Ganfeng ye). Mali b’a ɲini ka sɔrɔko cakɛdaw kɔlɔsi (misali la 51% bɔgɔbɔgɔli porozɛw la). 



Jɔrɔ ni dɛmɛ : Sinuwa ye wariko ɲɛnabɔbaga ŋana ye, nka a tɛ “juru jaan” laɲinilen ye; Aw ye aw sinsin porozew kan ka sɔrɔ ka nafolo sɔrɔ tuma dɔw la.
FOCAC 2024 kɔnɔ : Sinuwaw ka layidu bɛɛ lajɛlen ye dɔrɔmɛ miliyari 50,7 ye Afiriki (juru + waridon + dɛmɛ), ni jiriforo, kɛnɛya, ani sɛnɛko porozɛw ye Mali sen bɛ o la (i n’a fɔ Sanankoroba tilebɔlan). 



Sɔrɔdasi ni lakana fan fɛ : Jɛɲɔgɔnya danma (2013 logistiki bɛnkan), kalan dɛmɛni FOCAC kɔnɔ (Afiriki sɔrɔdasiw dege).
Mali bɛ ka baara kɛ ni Irisila ye walasa ka terrorisme (jatigɛwale) kɛlɛ Faransi ni ONU ka kɛlɛbolow gɛnnen kɔ. Sinuwa bɛ sabatili fɛ a ka sɔrɔko nafaw kama, nka a tɛ sɔrɔdasi sigiyɔrɔba dɔw jɔ yen. 



Tiɲɛniba (min tɛ propagande ye): Sinuwaw ka sɔrɔko fanga barikama : Sinuwa ye jɛɲɔgɔn dannamɔgɔ ye Mali bolo (min bɛ lakana ni sɔrɔko gɛlɛyaw ɲɛ), a sinsinnen bɛ « se sɔrɔli » kan nafolo ni suguw musaka la.
A tɛ fangatigi ye fewu: Mali bɛ ni jɛɲɔgɔn wɛrɛw ye (Irisi, Turquie, Gulf jamanaw), ani Sinuwa bɛ k’a janto sɔrɔdasiw ka donko tilennen na.
Lajɛba in bɛ Siniwajamana ka fɛɛrɛba jira walasa ka fanga sabati Afiriki kɔnɔ Tlebi jamanaw ɲɛkɔrɔ, n’a bɛ ka sinsin kosɛbɛ iziniw, fanga jɛlenw, ani jago kan sanni ka kɛ fɛnsɔrɔko belebelebaw dɔrɔn ye.

Lajɛ in ye diplomasi protocole ye min bɛ jɛɲɔgɔnya min bɛ sen na, o barika bonya, wa a tɛ « gundolajɛ » ye min bɛ balansi caman Changé. Sinuwa bɛ ka fanga kuntaalajan jɔ sɔrɔko siratigɛ la ka tɛmɛ sɔrɔdasiw kan. 

Kuma surun : Xi Jinping ni Mali jamanakuntigi Assimi Goeta (sɛtanburukalo san 2024) ka ɲɔgɔnye min kɛra FOCAC ka lajɛba la, o kɛra diplomasi lajɛ ye min bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ, ka jɛɲɔgɔnyaw lawuli ka kɛ jɛɲɔgɔnya siratigɛ la. Tiɲɛ: Sɔrɔko jɛ-ka-baara barikama : jago, wari bilali minɛnko la (litiyɔmu, sanu), fɛnsɔrɔko, ani fanga porozɛw.
China ye sɔrɔko jɛɲɔgɔnba ye Mali bolo, nka sɔrɔdasi fanga tɛ a la kosɛbɛ (Mali bɛ baara kɛ ni Irisi ye lakana koɲɛw la).
Sinuwa ka fɛɛrɛba dɔ ye Afiriki kɔnɔ: nafolo min bɛ kɛ ka wari bila ani politiki dɛmɛni.

Kuncɛli : Protocole lajɛ min bɛ Siniwa jamana ka sɔrɔko fanga sabati Mali kɔnɔ, wa a tɛ gundola bɛnkan ye walima fɛn caman tigɛli ye.

Sinuwa ka fanga lakika Mali kɔnɔ : Sinuwa ni Mali cɛsira kɔrɔlen don (kabini san 1960) wa a juguman don, nka a fanba tɛ sɔrɔdasi ta ye n’i y’a suma ni jamana tɔw ye i n’a fɔ Irisi (Wagner/Africa Corps). Sɔrɔko ni yiriwali fanw (min ka bon kosɛbɛ): Jago : A sera dɔrɔmɛ miliyɔn 880 ɲɔgɔn ma san 2023 (32,7% bonya). Sinuwa bɛ masinw bila ka taa jamana wɛrɛw la. Ani bolifɛnw, ani ka minɛnw don jamana kɔnɔ (nɛgɛ, manganɛsi, sesamɛ). 



Nafolodonni : fɛnsɔrɔko porozɛw (bonda, siraw, dɔgɔtɔrɔsow), ani minɛnko porozɛw (i n’a fɔ litiyamu min bɛ Goulamina porozɛ kɔnɔ ni Ganfeng ye). Mali b’a ɲini ka sɔrɔko cakɛdaw kɔlɔsi (misali la 51% bɔgɔbɔgɔli porozɛw la). 



Jɔrɔ ni dɛmɛ : Sinuwa ye wariko ɲɛnabɔbaga ŋana ye, nka a tɛ “juru jaan” laɲinilen ye; Aw ye aw sinsin porozew kan ka sɔrɔ ka nafolo sɔrɔ tuma dɔw la.
FOCAC 2024 kɔnɔ : Sinuwaw ka layidu bɛɛ lajɛlen ye dɔrɔmɛ miliyari 50,7 ye Afiriki (juru + waridon + dɛmɛ), ni jiriforo, kɛnɛya, ani sɛnɛko porozɛw ye Mali sen bɛ o la (i n’a fɔ Sanankoroba tilebɔlan). 



Sɔrɔdasi ni lakana fan fɛ : Jɛɲɔgɔnya danma (2013 logistiki bɛnkan), kalan dɛmɛni FOCAC kɔnɔ (Afiriki sɔrɔdasiw dege).
Mali bɛ ka baara kɛ ni Irisila ye walasa ka terrorisme (jatigɛwale) kɛlɛ Faransi ni ONU ka kɛlɛbolow gɛnnen kɔ. Sinuwa bɛ sabatili fɛ a ka sɔrɔko nafaw kama, nka a tɛ sɔrɔdasi sigiyɔrɔba dɔw jɔ yen. 



Tiɲɛniba (min tɛ propagande ye): Sinuwaw ka sɔrɔko fanga barikama : Sinuwa ye jɛɲɔgɔn dannamɔgɔ ye Mali bolo (min bɛ lakana ni sɔrɔko gɛlɛyaw ɲɛ), a sinsinnen bɛ « se sɔrɔli » kan nafolo ni suguw musaka la.
A tɛ fangatigi ye fewu: Mali bɛ ni jɛɲɔgɔn wɛrɛw ye (Irisi, Turquie, Gulf jamanaw), ani Sinuwa bɛ k’a janto sɔrɔdasiw ka donko tilennen na.
Lajɛba in bɛ Siniwajamana ka fɛɛrɛba jira walasa ka fanga sabati Afiriki kɔnɔ Tlebi jamanaw ɲɛkɔrɔ, n’a bɛ ka sinsin kosɛbɛ iziniw, fanga jɛlenw, ani jago kan sanni ka kɛ fɛnsɔrɔko belebelebaw dɔrɔn ye.

Lajɛ in ye diplomasi protocole ye min bɛ jɛɲɔgɔnya min bɛ sen na, o barika bonya, wa a tɛ « gundolajɛ » ye min bɛ balansi caman Changé. Sinuwa bɛ ka fanga kuntaalajan jɔ sɔrɔko siratigɛ la ka tɛmɛ sɔrɔdasiw kan. 

Kuma surun : Xi Jinping ni Mali jamanakuntigi Assimi Goeta (sɛtanburukalo san 2024) ka ɲɔgɔnye min kɛra FOCAC ka lajɛba la, o kɛra diplomasi lajɛ ye min bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ, ka jɛɲɔgɔnyaw lawuli ka kɛ jɛɲɔgɔnya siratigɛ la. Tiɲɛ: Sɔrɔko jɛ-ka-baara barikama : jago, wari bilali minɛnko la (litiyɔmu, sanu), fɛnsɔrɔko, ani fanga porozɛw.
China ye sɔrɔko jɛɲɔgɔnba ye Mali bolo, nka sɔrɔdasi fanga tɛ a la kosɛbɛ (Mali bɛ baara kɛ ni Irisi ye lakana koɲɛw la).
Sinuwa ka fɛɛrɛba dɔ ye Afiriki kɔnɔ: nafolo min bɛ kɛ ka wari bila ani politiki dɛmɛni.

Kuncɛli: Protocole lajɛ min bɛ Siniwa jamana ka sɔrɔko fanga sabati Mali kɔnɔ, wa a tɛ gundola bɛnkan ye walima fɛn caman tigɛli.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2082 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-05-14 14:05:23 CEST

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2088 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-05-14 10:41:00 CEST
Mali Jamanakuntigiya

Minisiriw ka tɔnba ye ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ lajɛ gansan na arabadon mɛkalo tile 13 san 2026, a ka hakilijagabɔso kɔnɔ Koulouba masaso kɔnɔ, jenerali Assimi Goïta ka ɲɛmɔgɔya kɔnɔ, n’o ye wuliliko ɲɛmɔgɔ ye, jamanakuntigi.

Minisiriw ka tɔnba ka fɔta (san 2026 mɛkalo tile 13) kɔnɔko jɔnjɔnw kuncɛlen filɛ nin ye :

1. Baarakɛda fanw (Taxation): .

Impositi ɲɛmɔgɔso yiriwali a ka sariyaw labɛnni kura fɛ ani a ka baarakɛlaw barika bonya fɛ san duuru nataw kɔnɔ walasa ka impositi lajɛcogo ɲuman yiriwa.

2. Sɔrɔdasi sigili:

Kolonɛli Dɔgɔtɔrɔ Souleymane Coulibaly sigili ka kɛ sɔrɔdasi kalanso ɲɛmɔgɔba ye.

 3. Marabolow ka jɛkafɔ (AES Sahel): .

Jɛkafɔ ni Burukina Faso ni Nizɛri ye walasa ka siwili awiyɔn sariyaw bɛn ɲɔgɔn ma walasa ka taama ni sɔrɔko jɛɲɔgɔnya nɔgɔya jɛkulu jamanaw cɛ.

4. Sanji waati labɛnniw:

Daminɛ, mɛkalo tile 14, ba saniya baaraba dɔ Bamakɔ (a ka ca ni mɛtɛrɛ 348.000 ye) walasa ka sanjiba bali.

5. Sosiyete ka fɛɛrɛw (Eid al-Adha): .

Jɛkulu, k’a ta mɛkalo tile 20 na ka se tile 27 ma Bamakɔ ni marabolow la, saraka bagan feereli dɔ sɔngɔ dɔgɔyali la walasa ka wariko doni nɔgɔya denbayaw kan. 6. Kɛnɛya ni sigida:

Dengue banabagatɔw dɔgɔyali sɛbɛnna.

Porozɛ "Citizen Dialogues" daminɛna walasa ka hɛrɛ ni jɛkafɔ nafaw yiriwa funankɛninw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ.

 Duniya denbayaw ka donba (mɛkalo tile 15) kɛra ni sinsin kɛra dɔrɔguta kɛlɛli kan ani waati jiginni nɔfɛkow.

Mali Jamanakuntigiya

Minisiriw ka tɔnba ye ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ lajɛ gansan na arabadon mɛkalo tile 13 san 2026, a ka hakilijagabɔso kɔnɔ Kuluba masaso kɔnɔ, ɲɛmaaba Assimi Goïta ka ɲɛmɔgɔya kɔnɔ, n’o ye wuliliko ɲɛmɔgɔ ye, jamanakuntigi.

Minisiriw ka tɔnba ka fɔta (san 2026 mɛkalo tile 13) kɔnɔko jɔnjɔnw kuncɛlen filɛ nin ye :

1. Baarakɛda fanw (Saalenw): .

Saalen ɲɛnabɔliba yiriwali n’a sariyaw kurayali ye ani ka dɔ fara a ka hadamadenya seko kan san duuru nataw kɔnɔ walasa ka wariko lajɛcogo ɲuman sabati.

2. Kɛlɛcɛw sigili:

Kolonɛli Dɔgɔtɔrɔ Souleymane Coulibaly sigili ka kɛ kɛlɛcɛw kalanso ɲɛmɔgɔba ye.

3. Marabolo jɛ-ka-baara (AES Sahel): .

Jɛkafɔ ni Burukina Faso ni Nizɛri ye walasa ka jamanadenw ka pankurun sariyaw bɛn ɲɔgɔn ma walasa ka taama ni sɔrɔko jɛɲɔgɔnya nɔgɔya jɛkulu jamanaw cɛ.

 4.Labɛn samiya kama:

Jibolisiraw saniya baaraba dɔ daminɛ Bamakɔ faaba kɔnɔ (a ka ca ni mɛtɛrɛ 348.000 ye) walasa ka sanjiba bali, k’a daminɛ mɛkalo tile 14 na.

5. Sigidamɔgɔw ka fɛɛrɛw (Seliba): .

Ka "saraka baganw feereli labɛn sɔngɔ dɔgɔyalen na" k'a ta mɛkalo tile 20 na ka se tile 27 ma Bamakɔ ni jamanaw kɔnɔ, walasa ka wariko doni nɔgɔya denbayaw kan.

 6. Kɛnɛya ni sigida:

Dengue bana cogoya dɔgɔyali sɛbɛnna.

"Jamanadenw ka kumaɲɔgɔnya" baarabolodalen daminɛni walasa ka bɛn ni sendonni nafaw yiriwa funankɛninw cɛ.

Duniya denbayaw ka donba (mɛkalo tile 15) ni sinsin ye dɔrɔguta kɛlɛli kan ani waati yɛlɛma nɔfɛkow.

Curfew ka kunnafoni

Distrikw ka sub-prefets (marabolow) la.

Dugutigiw.

Marabolo lakanani baarakɛlaw ɲɛmɔgɔw.

Nin ye lakana fɛɛrɛ ye min laɲini ye ka dan sigi sufɛ taamaw la waati latigɛlen kɔnɔ faaba kɔnɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2140 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-05-12 08:09:52 CEST
Maroc suguba dɔ... Munna saga sɔngɔ wulila Fkih Ben Salah sugu tɔgɔba la?

Mɛkalo tile 11, san 2026

A kunba : Saga sɔngɔ wulila Fkih Ben Salah sugu la (Maroko suguba dɔ) ka da sɛnɛ musakaw caya kan, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la balo sɔngɔ, o sɔngɔ wulila kosɛbɛ (saga kun kelen baloli musaka bɛ se dirham 300 ɲɔgɔn ma kalo kɔnɔ).

Fɛn teliyalenw : Sisan sɔngɔw : Saga misɛnninw bɛ daminɛ dirham 2000 ɲɔgɔn na, saga cɛmancɛw bɛ daminɛ dirham 3000-5000 ɲɔgɔn na, saga premium bɛ se dirham 8000-10000+ ma.

O kunba ye : Balo sɔngɔ jiginni, ka fara fɛn wɛrɛw kan i n’a fɔ ja tɛmɛnen, wa a tɛ kɛ “baganmaralaw ka sugandili” ye.

O nɔfɛko : Jamanadenw ka ɲininiw dɔgɔyali (a kɔlɔsira ko u ma sɔn) ni Adha seli surunyana, ani dɔ farala dirham 300-500 kan ni i y’a suma ni dɔgɔkun tɛmɛnenw ta ye. Dɔw bɛ "cɛmancɛlaw" jalaki.

Marɔku suguba dɔ... Munna saga sɔngɔ wulila Fkih Ben Salah sugu tɔgɔba la?

Mɛkalo tile 11, san 2026

A tiɲɛ surunyalen: Saga sɔngɔ wulila Fkih Ben Salah sugu la (suguba dɔ ka bɔ Marɔku) ka da fɛnw bɔli musakaw caya kan, Kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la  Baganbalo sɔngɔw, O wulila kosɛbɛ (saga kun kelen baloli musaka bɛ se dirham 300 ɲɔgɔn ma kalo kɔnɔ).

Ɲɛfɔli teliyalenw : Sisan sɔngɔw : Saga misɛnninw bɛ daminɛ dirham 2000 ɲɔgɔn na, saga cɛmancɛw bɛ daminɛ dirham 3000-5000 ɲɔgɔn na, Wa Saga Ɲuman bɛ se dirham 8000-10000+ ma.

O kunba ye : Dɔ farali Baganbalow sɔngɔ kan, ka fara fɛn wɛrɛw kan i n’a fɔ ja tɛmɛnen, wa o tɛ “sagatigiw ka sugandili” ye.

O nɔfɛko : Jamanadenw ka ɲininiw dɔgɔyali (a kɔlɔsira ko u ma sɔn) ni lahiya seli surunyani ye, ani dɔ farala dirham 300-500 kan ni i y’a suma ni dɔgɔkun tɛmɛnenw ta ye. Dɔw bɛ "cɛmancɛlaw" jalaki.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2230 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-05-08 17:17:13 CEST
Mali sɛnɛko: Yiriwali fɛɛrɛ bɛɛjɛfanga dɔ kɛra Nizɛri biro bolo Mali kɔnɔ san 2021-2030 waatiw la, o jirala sɔrɔko, sigida, ani ladamu tɔnba ka lajɛ dɔ senfɛ.

Nin ye ɲɛfɔli surun ye o yɔrɔ kolomaw kan:

1. Fɛɛrɛbɔ Laɲiniw
Dumuni sabatili sɔrɔli : Laɲini in kun ye ka Mali kɛ "buruburu" ye Afiriki tilebinyanfan fɛ, a kɛtɔ ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw kan, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la tiga.

Fɛnsɔrɔsiraw yiriwali : Labɛn in kɔnɔ, jibolisiraw ni baraziw ɲɛnabɔli bɛ kɛ walasa ka ji sɔrɔli sabati sɛnɛkɛlaw bolo.

2. Pilari jɔnjɔnw
Sɛnɛko biɲɛdimi : Ka bi fɛɛrɛ kuraw don sen kan walasa ka dɔ fara sɔrɔ kan ani ka dɔ bɔ tiɲɛni na.

Sɛnɛkɛlaw dɛmɛni : Ka bagajiw, kisɛw, ani sɛnɛkɛminɛnw (i n’a fɔ suman tigɛlanw) di walasa ka baarakɛlaw ka ɲɛnamaya ɲɛ ka taa a fɛ seko ni dɔnko siratigɛ la.

Yiriwali sabatili : Ji ni sigida nafolo lakanani ka sɔrɔ ka sɛnɛfɛnw bonya.

3. Jɛɲɔgɔnya ni jɛ-ka-baara
Nizɛri biro ɲɛmɔgɔ (Samba Boukary Tounkara) y’a sinsin a kan ko jɛkafɔ nafa ka bon ni sɔrɔko tɔnba ye walasa ka fura sɔrɔ gɛlɛyaw la minnu bɛ sɛnɛkɛlaw kan ani ka togodala seko ni dɔnko yiriwa caman na.

 Kuma surun na : A bɛ san tan bolodalenba dɔ sɛbɛn min kun ye ka sɛnɛ yiriwa Mali kɔnɔ "Nizɛri biro" yiriwali fɛ walasa ka yɛrɛdɔn ni sɔrɔ yiriwali sabati.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2238 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-05-07 12:58:11 CEST
Mali Jamanakuntigiya

Minisiriw ka lajɛba min kɛra san 2026 mɛkalo tile 6, n’o ɲɛmɔgɔya tun bɛ jenerali Assimi Goïta bolo, o kunnafoni kuncɛlen jɛlen ni labɛncogo filɛ nin ye.

⚖️ Sariya ni sariyasunba fɛɛrɛw
Gofɛrɛnaman ye sɛbɛn bolodalen caman ta minnu kun ye ka marako kɛ bi ta ye ani ka jamana ka yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sabati:

Foroba sannifeere : Foroba sannifeere sariya ladilanni walasa ka dɛsɛw latilen ani ka musaka minnu bɛ bɔ ka kɔn wari sarali biro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw na, olu don a kɔnɔ, minnu bɛ bɔ kɛnɛ kan.

Decentralisation : Fanga dili ladilanni ka bɔ Jamana la ka taa sigida maraw ma (Municipalités, Regiones, District de Bamaco) ka tugu "Circles" ni Bamakɔ Distrik minisirisow bɔli la marako siratigɛ la. O ɲɛsinnen bɛ Industriw ni Jagokɛlaw ma.

Fasokanw ka danbe : Sariyasen dɔ tali foroba siraw ni sigidaw tɔgɔladonni kama. O laɲini ye ka Mali tariku ni laadala mɔgɔ tɔgɔba dɔw labɛn kokura walasa ka jamana ka ciyɛn barika bonya.

 👤 Mɔgɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka fɛɛrɛw (Lajɛw) .
Conseil ye fɛn caman Changé, minnu kɔlɔsira kosɛbɛ olu ye :

Lafasali
Jenerali Major Elisée Jean DAO : A kɔrɔtara ka se nin jɔyɔrɔ in ma cogo kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen na, ka kɛ sɔrɔdasikulu ka sɔrɔdasikulu ɲɛmɔgɔ ye.

Territorial Administration (marabolow ɲɛnabɔli).
Sub-Prefects (Prefets) sigili wuliba dɔ kɛra sariya ye jamana fan bɛɛ la (Bamako, Lontou, Faléa, Tinzawatène, a ɲɔgɔnnaw), min kɛra siwili ɲɛmɔgɔw kan ka fara sɔrɔdasi ni polisiw kan (Warrant Officers).

Minisiriw ka birow
Kiiritigɛlaw: Bakary Soliba COULIBALY (Baarakɛlaw ɲɛmɔgɔ).

Fanga ni ji: Mohamɛdi SOGODOGO (Baarakɛlaw kuntigi).

Sɛnɛko: Modibo SOGOBA (Baarakɛlaw kuntigi).

Funankɛninw ni farikoloɲɛnajɛw: Moussa BAMBARA (Baarakɛlaw ɲɛmɔgɔba).

 📢 Kumaɲɔgɔnya ni kunnafonidi
Lamini : San 2026 mɛkalo tile 7, lakɔlisow ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ saniyako ɲɛɲini dɔ daminɛna Bamakɔ, Kalabankɔro, ani Kati, walasa ka saniya sabati lakɔlisow kɔnɔ.

Kɛnɛya: Kɔlɔsili ka ɲɛsin dengue banakisɛ sɔrɔli caya ma. Tɛmɛsira ɲɛmɔgɔba y’a ɲini jamanadenw fɛ, u ka banakunbɛn fɛɛrɛw labato kosɛbɛ.

Kiiritigɛlaw: Bakary Soliba COULIBALY (Baarakɛlaw ɲɛmɔgɔba).

Fanga ni ji: Mohamɛdi SOGODOGO (Baarakɛlaw kuntigi).

Sɛnɛko: Modibo SOGOBA (Baarakɛlaw kuntigi).

Funankɛninw ni farikoloɲɛnajɛw: Moussa BAMBARA (Baarakɛlaw ɲɛmɔgɔba). 

📢 Kumaɲɔgɔnya ni kunnafonidi

Foroba sannifeere : Foroba sannifeere sariya ladilanni walasa ka dɛsɛw latilen ani ka musaka minnu bɛ bɔ ka kɔn wari sarali biro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw na, olu don a kɔnɔ, minnu bɛ bɔ kɛnɛ kan.

Decentralisation : Fanga dili ladilanni ka bɔ Jamana la ka taa sigida maraw ma (Municipalités, Regiones, District de Bamaco) ka tugu "Circles" ni Bamakɔ Distrik minisirisow bɔli la marako siratigɛ la. O ɲɛsinnen bɛ Industriw ni Jagokɛlaw ma.

Fasokanw ka danbe : Sariyasen dɔ tali foroba siraw ni sigidaw tɔgɔladonni kama. O laɲini ye ka Mali tariku ni laadala mɔgɔ tɔgɔba dɔw labɛn kokura walasa ka jamana ka ciyɛn barika bonya.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2266 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-05-04 04:09:41 CEST
Sinuwa jamana ka kalanko minisiriso ni baarakɛda naani wɛrɛw jɛra ka "Hakilila + kalanko wale bolodalen" bɔ, n’o laɲini ye ka seko ni dɔnko sɛnɛni, baarakɛminɛnw kurabɔli, fɛnsɔrɔsiraw, ani ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo jɔli labɛn ani k’a bila sen kan hakililata la.

Laɲini jɔnjɔnw kalanko siratigɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ la:
* Kalan jɔnjɔn : Aw ye aw sinsin AI kalanw dicogo n’u laseli kan walasa ka kalandenw ka miiri kura sɛnɛ.
* Kalan sanfɛla : Ka seko kura caman sɛnɛ ni AI donli ye kalan bɛɛ lajɛlen kalanw na ani ka baarakɛlaw ka labɛncogo ɲuman kɛ.
* Baarakɛkalan : Ka sinsin laadala iziniw yiriwali hakili la, ka baarakɛlaw sɛnɛ minnu bɛ se kosɛbɛ walasa u ka se ka ladamu iziniw jiginni na.
* Kalan min bɛ kɛ ɲɛnamaya bɛɛ kɔnɔ : Ka kalankɛminɛn ɲumanw labɛn walasa ka AI kalanni siraw sɔrɔ cogo kelen na bɛɛ ye.

Karamɔgɔya yiriwali ani ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo:
* Ka "Karamɔgɔ ka nizɛri kalan yiriwali porozɛ" waleya, ka kalan ni jateminɛ bɛɛ lajɛlen kɛ karamɔgɔw bɛɛ ye.
* Ka kalanso hakilitigiw ni fɛnsɔrɔsiraw jɔ walasa ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo kura dilan AI + kalanko kama.

Nin laɲini in kun ye ka jamana ka kalanko yiriwa ani ka kalanko kura sabati, n’o ye ka AI fɛɛrɛbɔ bɛɛ lajɛlen don ɲɔgɔn na.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2274 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-05-01 22:42:33 CEST
Faransi kibaruya dɔ y’a jira ko gɛlɛya dɔ bɛ yen min bɛ nakɔfɛn nafama dɔw feereli la i n’a fɔ pɔmutɛri ni pɔmitɛri Faransi. Nin ye hakilina kunbabaw kuncɛlen ye:

1. Leek ka gɛlɛya

Fɛn ɲinini dɔgɔyali : Jagokɛlaw bɛ ka ŋunan feereli dɔgɔyaliba la (a sera a hakɛ cayalenba siɲɛ wolonwula ma). O sababuba ye waati nɔgɔlen ye; "nakɔfɛnw suman" dunni, n'o ye pɔmutɛri ye a fɛnba ye, o bɛ dɔgɔya nɛnɛ duman waati.

Sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli kojugu : O kɔfɛ, ɲinan suman sɔrɔta cayara kosɛbɛ, o kɛra sababu ye ka sɛnɛkɛlaw bila gɛlɛya la.

Fɛn min ka kan ka kɛ : Sɛnɛkɛlaw y’u sen don pɔmutɛri feereli la sɔngɔ "slashed" na (promotional offers) min ka dɔgɔn ni €10 ye kilo 5 la (a bɛ se ka kɛ sɔngɔ sabatilen tilancɛ ye) walasa k’u ka stock saniya sanni a ka falen, ka kɛ feerebali ye.

2. Pomitoro gɛlɛya

Sɛnɛfɛnw dalajɛlen : Salon suman tigɛlen hakɛ camanba (tɔn 5 ɲɔgɔn foro kelen kɔnɔ) bɛ to marayɔrɔ la fo awirilikalo, o tɛ ko ye min tɛ deli ka kɛ.  Sɔngɔ dɔgɔyali: Sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli kojugu kɛra sababu ye ka sɔngɔ dɔgɔya, o kɛra sababu ye ka feereli kɛ nafa tɛ sɛnɛkɛlaw bolo.

Dumuni tiɲɛni: Sɛnɛkɛla dɔw wajibiyara k’u ka sɛnɛfɛnw tilancɛ fili, k’a sɔrɔ u hakɛ tɔw y’a daminɛ ka falen, o kɛra sababu ye k’u ma se ka feere jago la.

Fɛɛrɛ minnu tigɛra: Sɛnɛkɛla dɔw bɛ ka pɔmitɛri bɔrɔw di u ka kiliyan kantigiw ma fu walasa u kana tiɲɛ pewu ani ka yɔrɔ di suman tigɛ kura ma.

Kuncɛli : Nin kunnafoni in bɛ gɛlɛyaw jira minnu bɛ Faransi sɛnɛkɛlaw kan, k’a sababu kɛ waati jiginni ye (nɛnɛba), o min bɛ ka nɔ bila fɛnw tacogo la, wa u bɛ na ni wariko bɔnɛ ye ani sɛnɛfɛnw tiɲɛni.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2304 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-05-01 03:06:01 CEST
Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman

Awirilikalo tile 26 nɛgɛ kanɲɛ 17 waati

Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara. Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔkobaw ni latigɛw bɛ sɔrɔ digest kɔnɔ:

Denbayabaw fɛ, nafa kelen sarali bɛna to ni mɔgɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka sɔrɔ hakɛ cayalenba denbaya kɔnɔ, o ma tɛmɛ 10% kan ka tɛmɛ marabolow ka balo hakɛ kan. Ni denbayaw ma sɔn ka nafa sɔrɔ ka tɛmɛ, Fondation Sociale bɛna a yɛrɛma ka sɛbɛnw bɛɛ lajɛ.

Fɛɛrɛ minnu tigɛra walasa ka denbayabaw dɛmɛ kɛnɛyako siratigɛ la, olu cayara : u bɛna se ka fura sɔrɔ fu denmisɛnw ye minnu si tɛ san 6 bɔ, marabolo dɔrɔn tɛ, nka a bɛ kɛ fana fédéral dɔgɔtɔrɔsow la ni den bɛ furakɛli la yen.

Kalan san nata kama, ɲininikɛlaw bɛna kɛ baarakɛnafolo yɔrɔ laɲinitaw ba 83 ni kɔ ye kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la minnu ka di kosɛbɛ : furakɛli, ɛntɛrinɛti, kalanko ani sɛnɛko. Kalandenw bɛna se ka kɔn ka kalan kɛ yɔrɔ min na ani ka baara kɛ yɔrɔ min na, u ka kalan bannen kɔfɛ, ani baarakɛda minnu mago bɛ mɔgɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw na, olu bɛna olu sɔrɔ

Fɛɛrɛ minnu tigɛra walasa ka denbayabaw dɛmɛ kɛnɛyako siratigɛ la, olu cayara : u bɛna se ka fura sɔrɔ fu denmisɛnw ye minnu si tɛ san 6 bɔ, marabolo dɔrɔn tɛ, nka a bɛ kɛ fana fédéral dɔgɔtɔrɔsow la ni den bɛ furakɛli la yen.

Kalan san nata kama, ɲininikɛlaw bɛna kɛ baarakɛnafolo yɔrɔ laɲinitaw ba 83 ni kɔ ye kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la minnu ka di kosɛbɛ : furakɛli, ɛntɛrinɛti, kalanko ani sɛnɛko. Kalandenw bɛna se ka kɔn ka kalan kɛ yɔrɔ min na ani ka baara kɛ yɔrɔ min na, u ka kalan bannen kɔfɛ, ani baarakɛda minnu mago bɛ mɔgɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw na, olu bɛna olu sɔrɔ

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2321 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-30 14:33:09 CEST
Sheki Mustafa Al-Ghalayini ye ɲɛnajɛko ɲɛfɔ iko “bana furakɛbali” ani sigida bana min bɛ ka jamanaw tiɲɛ, a ye sapitiri kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen dɔ bila o la a ka gafe tɔgɔba kɔnɔ, n’o ye Sermon for Young People ye. 
Al-Ghalayini ka yelifɛn ɲɛnajɛko la, o bɛ se ka lajɛ nin yɔrɔ ninnu na:
Jamana halakibaga : A y’a jate ko o de ye siwiliw binni sababuba ye, bawo a dalen b’a la ko ni jamana y’a yɛrɛ bila ɲɛnajɛko la, a fanga tɛ ban ani a tɛ se ka gɛlɛyaw muɲu. 

Academia.edu ka baarakɛyɔrɔ
Cɛya ni cɛsiri fagabaga : Al-Ghalayini dalen b’a la ko ɲɛnajɛ bɛ cɛsiri fanga dɔgɔya ani ka jagɛlɛya ni jagɛlɛya hakili faga kamalenninw niw la, k’u tigɛli kɛ mɔgɔ ye min bɛ u bolo, minnu b’u janto ɲɛda ni yecogo la. 
Jogoɲumanya tiɲɛni: A ɲɛfɔlen don ko a ye kojugu bɛɛ ju ye, bawo a bɛ na ni kuncɛbaya, nafantan ani dantɛmɛko ye, wa a bɛ mɔgɔ bila ka bɔ fɛn nafamaw la ka taa fɛn dɔgɔmanw na.
Siwili tiɲɛnen : A ye danfara don siwili lakika cɛ, min bɛ hadamaden jɔyɔrɔ kɔrɔta, ani “siwilisiyɔn tiɲɛbali” cɛ, k’a jateminɛ ko ɲɛnajɛ ye siwili dibi fan ye min bɛ na ni sigida tiɲɛni ye. 
Al-Ghalayini dalen b’a la ko ɲɛnajɛ tɛ nafolo dantɛmɛnen dɔrɔn ye, nka a bɛ kɛ “fɛntigiw ka kɛwale tiɲɛnenw” ye min bɛ mɔgɔ kelen kɛ a negew n’a dususalo jɔn ye, o min laban bɛ na ni mɔgɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka tɔɔrɔ ye ani jamana tiɲɛni.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2330 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-30 14:19:34 CEST
Mali Jamanakuntigiya

Nin ye hakilina jɔnjɔnw ye minnu bɔra minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ ka lajɛ la min kɛra awirilikalo tile 29 san 2026 :

1. Jamana ka dusukasi ni bonya
Conseil ye bonya da Lakana minisiri Sadio Camara kan, min sara awirilikalo tile 25 binkanniw kɔfɛ, a salen kɔfɛ, a kɔrɔtara ka kɛ jenerali ye sɔrɔdasikulu la.

2. Kuran (Kuran) .
Mali ye juru sɔrɔ min bɛ se CFA miliyari 39,5 ɲɔgɔn ma ka bɔ Afiriki yiriwali banki la. O warijɛ in bɛna kɛ ka woroduguyanfan bololanɛgɛ 225 kV kuran sɛnɛyɔrɔ dɔ jɔ, n’a kun ye ka kuran sɛnɛcogo sabati ani k’a barika bonya Bamakɔ.

3. Togodala Sekɔrɔ (Baganmara ni mɔni) .
Jamana ka lajɛw : Lajɛba caman daminɛni k’a ta mɛkalo tile 4 na ka se zuluyekalo tile 29 ma san 2026, walasa ka baganmara ni jɛgɛko siratigɛw kɛ bi ta ye.

Duniya jɛkamiirikalandenw: Mali ka sendonni lajɛba dɔ kɛra sɛnɛko jirali la Maroc jamana kɔnɔ walasa ka Mali baganw ka jamu suguyaw yiriwa.

4. Sosiyete ni Kɛnɛya

Kunnafonidila: Baarakɛjɛkuluw bɛna kɛ (mɛkalo tile 14-15) jamana kanw baaracogo kan kibaruyaw la.

Kɛnɛya: Dengue banakisɛw dɔgɔyali kɔlɔsira, nka hali bi, a ka ɲi ka aw janto a la.

Mali ye juru sɔrɔ min bɛ se Faransi ka Farafinna CFA miliyari 39,5 ɲɔgɔn ma ka bɔ Farafinna yiriwali waribon na. Nin hakɛ bɛna kɛ ka kɔgɔduguyanfan kuran tali taasira sɛnɛyɔrɔ dɔ jɔ min bɛ se kilovolti 225 ma, n’a kun ye ka kuran sɛnɛcogo sabati an’a mɛɛli sinsin Bamakɔ.

3. Togodala baarada (Baganmara ni mɔni) .
Faso ka lajɛw : Lajɛba caman daminɛni k’a ta mɛkalo tile 4 na ka se zuluyekalo tile 29 ma san 2026, walasa ka baganmara ni mɔn baaradaw kuraya.

Duniya jɛkamiirikalandenw ka jɛkafɔ: Mali ka sendonko lajɛba ye sɛnɛko jirali la Marɔku jamana kɔnɔ walasa ka Mali baganw ka ciyɛn suguyaw yiriwa.

4. Sigida ni Kɛnɛya

Kunnafonidi : Baarakɛyɔrɔw labɛnni (mɛkalo tile 14-15) Fasokanw baaracogo kan Kibaruyaw ɲɛfɔli la.

Kɛnɛya: Dengue banakisɛw dɔgɔyali kɔlɔsira, ani ka weele kɛ ko mɔgɔw k'u janto u yɛrɛ la.

Mali Présidence

Jɛɲɔgɔnya fɛɛrɛbɔlen Irisi ni Mali cɛ

Sisan gɛlɛya in kɛnɛ kan, Irisi jamana b’a ka cɛsiri jira kokura Mali la. Igor Gromyko, n’o ye Irisi jamana ka lasigiden ye Mali la, a y’a sinsin a kan ko a ka kan ka jɛkafɔ sabati jamana fila ninnu cɛ, a ka ɲɔgɔnye senfɛ ni Tɛmɛsira fanga ɲɛmɔgɔba, Assimi Goïta ye.

Baro kɛra yɔrɔ kolomaw kan:

Sɔrɔdasi jɛ-ka-baara: Irisi n’a ka kɛlɛcɛw bɛ ka baara kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ ni Mali kɛlɛcɛw ye walasa ka terrorisme (jatigɛwale) binkanniw kɛlɛ minnu bɛ ka juguya Mali kɔnɔ.

Baro kɛra sisan kow kan : Lajɛ in ye sababu di ka baro kɛ lakanako kan ani ka jɛɲɔgɔnya jɛɲɔgɔnyaw sabati.

Diplomasi Dɛmɛ: Ambasadɛrɛ y’a ka foli lase Mali ni Risi kɛlɛcɛw ma, k’a sinsin a kan ko Irisi bɛna to Mali jɛɲɔgɔn sabatilen ye.

Nin lajɛ in b’a jira ko jamana fila bɛɛ ka ŋaniya jɛlen don k’u ka jɛɲɔgɔnya sabati walasa ka gɛlɛya kelenw ɲɛnabɔ, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la sigida lakanani ni basigi siratigɛ la.

Jɛɲɔgɔnya siratigɛ la Irisi ni Mali cɛ
Sisan gɛlɛya in ɲɛkɔrɔ, Irisi jamana b’a ka cɛsiri barikama jira Mali kɛrɛfɛ. Igor Gromyko, n’o ye Risi jamana lasigiden ye Mali la, ale y’a jira ko jɛkafɔ min bɛ ka bonya jamana fila ninnu cɛ, o nafa ka bon jamanadenw ka ɲɔgɔnye dɔ senfɛ, min dira wuliliko ɲɛmɔgɔba, Assimi Goïta fɛ.

Yɔrɔ kolomaw minnu ɲɛfɔlen don:
Sɔrɔdasi jɛ-ka-baara: Irisi n’a ka kɛlɛcɛw bɛ ka baara kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ ni Mali sɔrɔdasikulu (FAMa) ye walasa ka terrorisme (jatigɛwale) binkanniw kɛlɛ, minnu bɛ ka caya Mali mara kɔnɔ bi.

Nin lajɛ in b’a jira ko jamana fila ninnu ka ŋaniya jɛlen don k’u ka jɛɲɔgɔnya sabati walasa ka gɛlɛya kelenw kunbɛn, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la lakana ni mara sabatili siratigɛ la.

Jɛɲɔgɔnya siratigɛ la Irisi ni Mali cɛ
Sisan gɛlɛya in ɲɛkɔrɔ, Irisi jamana b’a ka cɛsiri barikama jira Mali kɛrɛfɛ. Igor Gromyko, n’o ye Risi jamana lasigiden ye Mali la, ale y’a jira ko jɛkafɔ min bɛ ka bonya jamana fila ninnu cɛ, o nafa ka bon jamanadenw ka ɲɔgɔnye dɔ senfɛ, min dira wuliliko ɲɛmɔgɔba, Assimi Goïta fɛ.

Yɔrɔ kolomaw minnu ɲɛfɔlen don:
Sɔrɔdasi jɛ-ka-baara: Irisi n’a ka kɛlɛcɛw bɛ ka baara kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ ni Mali sɔrɔdasikulu (FAMa) ye walasa ka terrorisme (jatigɛwale) binkanniw kɛlɛ, minnu bɛ ka caya Mali mara kɔnɔ bi.

Baro min bɛ kɛ sisan kow kan: Lamɛnnikɛlaw ye sababu di u ma u ka baro kɛ lakanako kan ani ka jɛɲɔgɔnya jɛɲɔgɔnyaw sabati.

Diplomasi dɛmɛni: Ambasadɛrɛ y’a ka ɲɛtaa nege jira Mali ni Risi sɔrɔdasiw la, k’a jira ko Irisi bɛna to Mali jɛɲɔgɔn ye tuma bɛɛ.

Nin lajɛ in b’a jira ko jamana fila ninnu ka ŋaniya jɛlen don k’u ka jɛɲɔgɔnya sabati walasa ka gɛlɛya kelenw kunbɛn, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la lakana ni mara sabatili siratigɛ la.

MALI-RUSSIA: Tɛmɛsira ɲɛmaa ye Risi jamana lasigiden bisimila
 
Tɛmɛsira ɲɛmaa, n’o ye sɔrɔdasikulu jenerali Assimi GOÏTA ye, n’o ye jamanakuntigi ye, ale ye bi tarata, awirilikalo tile 28, san 2026, Risi jamana ka lasigiden min bɛ Mali la, n’o ye Igor GROMYKO ye.
 
Lajɛ in senfɛ, jɛkulu fila ninnu ye baro kɛ sisan kow kan ani jɛkafɔ ɲuman kan Bamakɔ ni Moskow cɛ. Irisi jamana lasigiden ye a ka jamana ka cɛsiri jira Mali kɛrɛfɛ diɲɛ terrorisme kɛlɛli la, k’a jira ko Mali ni Risi kɛlɛcɛw ka jɛkafɔ walew kɛra. Irisi jamana ka diplomasikɛla ye ɲɛtaa ɲini FAMa ni Risi sɔrɔdasikulu fɛ, k’a hakili sigi ko Irisi bɛna kɛ Mali teri ye tuma bɛɛ.

Kibaru minnu bɛ tweet in kɔnɔ, olu ma dafa fɔlɔ (awirilikalo tile 28, san 2026), wa a jatera kumakan ye walima kunnafoni “danfara tɛ ofisi la” min bɛ ka jɛnsɛn kosɛbɛ sosiyete ka kunnafonidilanw kan. 
@Alpasino6 ye
Kibaru bɛ min fɔ:
A b’a jira ko bɛnkan dɔ kɛra walasa ka tɛmɛsira fanga kura sigi Mali kɔnɔ.
Bɛnkansɛbɛn in kɔnɔ, jenerali Asimi Goeta (min ye waatilatigɛ jamanakuntigi ye sisan) ka ɲɛmɔgɔya laban fɔ.
Jenerali Malick Diaw (Jamana ka tεmεkεlεkεla/tεmεn Parlement) bε bεnkansεbεn kura ɲɛmɔgɔya ta.
O kun : marabolow ni diɲɛ jamanaw ka degunw walasa ka jamana binni, ɲagami, terrorisme, ani lakana ni hadamadenya faratiw jɛnsɛnni.
Nafolo telewisɔn bɛ ka a labɛn ka kuma nafama dɔ bɔ.
Sosow y’a fɔ ko : « diplomasi sɔrɔyɔrɔw » ani « sɔrɔyɔrɔba dɔ », nka k’a sɔrɔ wariko ɲɛmɔgɔw ma walima kunnafonidilanba dannamɔgɔbaw ma fo ka na se bi ma.
Sisan tiɲɛ (ka kɛɲɛ ni kunnafoni labanw ye minnu bɛ sɔrɔ):
Asimi Goita tora jamanakuntigi kɔrɔsigi la. Zuluyekalo san 2025, tɛmɛsira pariti (min ɲɛmɔgɔya tun bɛ Malick Diaw yɛrɛ bolo) ye san 5 jamanakuntigi ka fanga di Goeta ma, min bɛ se ka kuraya k’a sɔrɔ kalataw ma kɛ, o min y’a to a ka to fanga la fo san 2030 a dɔgɔyalenba. 
bbc.com kan
Malick Diao ye Gueta jɛɲɔgɔn ye kabini waati jan ani junta fɔlɔ mɔgɔ dɔ ye ka bɔ san 2020 fanga tiɲɛni na. A ye jamana ka 'kùnnafoni-falen-falen-jɛkulu (CNT) ɲɛmɔgɔ ye kabini sàn caman.
Nin don laban ninnu na (Awirilikalo tile 25-27, san 2026), Mali ye binkanniba kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ sɔrɔdasi yɔrɔw kan Bamakɔ, Kati ani woroduguyanfan duguw la, min kɛra sababu ye ka Lakana minisiri Sadio Camara (jamana fangatigi dɔ) faga. O ye lakana ni politiki gɛlɛyaba dɔ lawuli, ni kumakanw ye ko fanga tiɲɛni walima terrorisme/murutilenw ka binkanni dɔ bɛna kɛ. 
aljazeera.com kan
Mun na o kibaruya jɛnsɛnna joona ten?
Kɔsa in na binkanniw kɔfɛ ani Guaita ka bɔli forobaciyɛnko fɔlenw kɔfɛ, kumakan barikamaw daminɛna "tɛmɛsira labɛnw" kan ani jɔyɔrɔba min bɛna bila Malick Diaw bolo. X ni Facebook kan, kunnafoni dɔw bɛ kuma sufɛ kumaɲɔgɔnya kan ani « bɛnkan » kan, nka hali bi u bɛ u jigi da mɔgɔw kan minnu tɔgɔ ma fɔ walima minnu ye « diplomasi » ye.
Kuncɛli:
O kibaruya ma Sɛmɛntiya foroba la. A bɛ se ka kɛ sisan gɛlɛya dɔ ye binkanniw kɔfɛ, politiki degun ɲinini, walima kunnafoni fɔlɔ minnu bɛ se ka yiriwa. Fɔlɔ, kuma fɔlen si ma bɔ Mali gofɛrɛnaman fɛ walima jamana telewisɔn fɛ min b’a jira ko Goeta ka bɔ fanga la walima ka tɛmɛn fanga kura sigili kan Diaw ɲɛmɔgɔya la.
Ni jamana ka kunnafoni dɔ walima ko kura dɔw bɔra lɛrɛ nataw la, o ko bɛna jɛya. Mali kow bɛ ka gɛlɛya kosɛbɛ sisan ka da lakana bagabagali ni kɔnɔna politiki gɛlɛyaw kan. Aw b’a fɛ ka kunnafoni wɛrɛw sɔrɔ binkanniw kan kɔsa in na walima kɔkankow kan mɔgɔ minnu bɛ o kɔnɔ wa?

Binkanni minnu kɛra kɔsa in na Mali kɔnɔ, olu kunnafoni

Jenerali Malick Diaw (Jamana ka tεmεkεlεkεla/tεmεn Parlement) bε bεnkansεbεn kura ɲɛmɔgɔya ta.
O kun : marabolow ni diɲɛ jamanaw ka degunw walasa ka jamana binni, ɲagami, terrorisme, ani lakana ni hadamadenya faratiw jɛnsɛnni.
Nafolo telewisɔn bɛ ka a labɛn ka kuma nafama dɔ bɔ.
Sosow y’a fɔ ko : « diplomasi sɔrɔyɔrɔw » ani « sɔrɔyɔrɔba dɔ », nka k’a sɔrɔ wariko ɲɛmɔgɔw ma walima kunnafonidilanba dannamɔgɔbaw ma fo ka na se bi ma.
Sisan tiɲɛ (ka kɛɲɛ ni kunnafoni labanw ye minnu bɛ sɔrɔ):
Asimi Goita tora jamanakuntigi kɔrɔsigi la. Zuluyekalo san 2025, tɛmɛsira pariti (min ɲɛmɔgɔya tun bɛ Malick Diaw yɛrɛ bolo) ye san 5 jamanakuntigi ka fanga di Goeta ma, min bɛ se ka kuraya k’a sɔrɔ kalataw ma kɛ, o min y’a to a ka to fanga la fo san 2030 a dɔgɔyalenba. 
bbc.com kan
Malick Diao ye Gueta jɛɲɔgɔn ye kabini waati jan ani junta fɔlɔ mɔgɔ dɔ ye ka bɔ san 2020 fanga tiɲɛni na. A ye jamana ka 'kùnnafoni-falen-falen-jɛkulu (CNT) ɲɛmɔgɔ ye kabini sàn caman.
Nin don laban ninnu na (Awirilikalo tile 25-27, san 2026), Mali ye binkanniba kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ sɔrɔdasi yɔrɔw kan Bamakɔ, Kati ani woroduguyanfan duguw la, min kɛra sababu ye ka Lakana minisiri Sadio Camara (jamana fangatigi dɔ) faga. O ye lakana ni politiki gɛlɛyaba dɔ lawuli, ni kumakanw ye ko fanga tiɲɛni walima terrorisme/murutilenw ka binkanni dɔ bɛna kɛ. 
aljazeera.com kan
Mun na o kibaruya jɛnsɛnna joona ten?
Kɔsa in na binkanniw kɔfɛ ani Guaita ka bɔli forobaciyɛnko fɔlenw kɔfɛ, kumakan barikamaw daminɛna "tɛmɛsira labɛnw" kan ani jɔyɔrɔba min bɛna bila Malick Diaw bolo. X ni Facebook kan, kunnafoni dɔw bɛ kuma sufɛ kumaɲɔgɔnya kan ani « bɛnkan » kan, nka hali bi u bɛ u jigi da mɔgɔw kan minnu tɔgɔ ma fɔ walima minnu ye « diplomasi » ye.
Kuncɛli:
O kibaruya ma Sɛmɛntiya foroba la. A bɛ se ka kɛ sisan gɛlɛya dɔ ye binkanniw kɔfɛ, politiki degun ɲinini, walima kunnafoni fɔlɔ minnu bɛ se ka yiriwa. Fɔlɔ, kuma fɔlen si ma bɔ Mali gofɛrɛnaman fɛ walima jamana telewisɔn fɛ min b’a jira ko Goeta ka bɔ fanga la walima ka tɛmɛn fanga kura sigili kan Diaw ɲɛmɔgɔya la.
Ni jamana ka kunnafoni dɔ walima ko kura dɔw bɔra lɛrɛ nataw la, o ko bɛna jɛya. Mali kow bɛ ka gɛlɛya kosɛbɛ sisan ka da lakana bagabagali ni kɔnɔna politiki gɛlɛyaw kan. Aw b’a fɛ ka kunnafoni wɛrɛw sɔrɔ binkanniw kan kɔsa in na walima kɔkankow kan mɔgɔ minnu bɛ o kɔnɔ wa?

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2572 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-25 11:03:44 CEST
Ameriki Kalifɔrni sɛnɛkɛlaw falen bɛ Koloradugu baji ji la ...
Sɛnɛfɛnw sɛnɛbagaw bɛ u labɛn ka Koloradugu baji ji bila - CalMatters
Sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛ jiko ɲɛnabɔli daminɛ tuma min na Koloradugu baji bɛ ka dɔgɔya
Jiko gɛlɛya ɲɛnabɔli bɛna kɛ dɔgɔya ye Kalifɔrni forow bolo ...
Koloradugu baji ji hɔrɔnyali ka bɔ Kalifɔrni forow la, o bɛ se ka ...
Kalifɔrni Imperial Valley, min ka joba bɛ Koloradugu baji gɛlɛn na, o bɛ degun na walasa ka jiko nafa bonya, jibɔ dɔgɔyali cɛma 20% kabini san 2000. Ja min bɛ senna, o mara in bɛ degunba la min bɛ ka Changé, k’a sɔrɔ a ji tilancɛ ɲɔgɔn bɛ alfalfa ni misiw balo dɛmɛ. Hali ni sɛnɛkɛlaw ka jogo kɔrɔw bɛ u bolo, u bɛ degun ka taa a fɛ walasa ka bi taw kɛ ani ka u lakana,... 

Jiko gɛlɛya ni degunko yɔrɔ kolomaw
Sɛnɛfɛnw sɔrɔli dɔgɔyali: Koloradugu baji min nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ Tlebi sɛnɛko la, o jibɔ dɔgɔyara ni 20% ye kabini san 2000 k’a sababu kɛ ja ye min bɛ sɔrɔ waati cogoya fɛ. 

Imperial Valley jɔyɔrɔ: Imperial Irrigation District (IID) bɛ Kalifɔrni Koloradugu baji hakɛ 70% mara, walima a bɛ se miliyɔn 3 ma, o min b’a to a ka baarakɛcogo nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ. 

Ji baaracogo : O ji in yɔrɔba dɔ bɛ kɛ ka shɔ ni balo wɛrɛw sɛnɛ misisogo/nɔnɔma misiw fɛ, o bɛ na ni welekan ye ka fɛn caman Changer sɛnɛ kɛcogo la ani dumuni ɲinini na. 

Sariya/tariku josariyaw : Sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛ baara kɛ ni "prior appropriation" kalansira ye — fɔlɔ waati la, fɔlɔ jogo la — o min bɛ fɔlɔ di u ma, nka o bɛ kɔrɔbɔ dɛsɛba fɛ. 

Nafolo lakanani : Walasa ka dɛsɛw kɛlɛ, IID ye bɛnkanw kɛ walasa ka ji jiginni kɛ, dugubaw bɛ dɔrɔmɛ kɛmɛ caman sara jiko la, akere kelen-kelen bɛɛ la, ni sɔrɔko nafolo ye ka fɛnsɔrɔsiraw sɛmɛntiya. 

Degun min bɛ ka bonya : Ɲininkaliw bɛ ka caya, n’o ye ko sisan sigida in bɛ sabati, walima ni fɛn caman bɛna kɛ jiko hakɛw n’a baaracogo la ani waati min na, o bɛna kɛ wajibi ye walasa ka mara in sabati.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2588 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-25 01:32:34 CEST
Irisi jamana bɛna lakana kɔlɔsili barika bonya minɛnw bɔli waati. Gofɛrɛnaman ye sariyaw sɛmɛntiya minnu bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka dugukoloko cogoyaw kɔlɔsi cogo labɛnnen na dugukolo jukɔrɔla yiriwali waati. O bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka dɔnnikɛlaw dɛmɛ u ka kunnafoniw sɔrɔ waati yɛrɛ la dugujukɔrɔji walima mɛtan gazi kan dugukoloko yɔrɔw la, ka jaabi di joona faratiw ma minnu bɛ ka bɔ kɛnɛ kan.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2614 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-25 01:12:22 CEST
Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman
19 Awirilikalo tile 17:00
Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara. Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔkobaw ni latigɛw bɛ sɔrɔ digest kɔnɔ:

✅Komisiɔn jɛlen ka lajɛ 6nan min kɛra Irisi ni Uzbekistan jamana gɔfɛrɛnaman ɲɛmɔgɔw ta fan fɛ, o kɛra Moskow. Lajɛ in senfɛ, jamana fila ninnu ɲɛmɔgɔw ye baara minnu sigi sen kan, olu ye ɲɛtaa minnu sɔrɔ, olu ye kuma ta. Kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, jateminɛ kɛra fɛɛrɛw kan minnu laɲini ye ka Irisi ni Uzbekistan ka jɛɲɔgɔnya juguya ka taa a fɛ.

✅Mikhail Mishustin ye fɛɛrɛbɔ lajɛ dɔ kɛ baarakɛlaw magow fɔli kan sɔrɔko siratigɛ la. Salon, san 7 jateminɛ dɔ labɛnna ni kunnafoni ye ka kɛɲɛ ni mara, izini, baara ani seko ni dɔnko ye. A basigilen, baarakɛlaw kalanni sigicogo bɛ jɔ mara kelen-kelen bɛɛ kɔnɔ ani fédéral ta fan fɛ.

✅San 2026 laban na, kuran sira minnu bɛ kɛ sigida laminiw ni sigiyɔrɔw la, olu bɛna labɛn kokura Irisi jamana mara kura kɔnɔ. Gofɛrɛnaman bɛna ruble miliyari 3,5 ɲɔgɔn bila o baara ninnu na Donetsk ni Lugansk jamanadenw ka jamanaw, Zaporozhye ani Kherson maraw la.

✅Irisi jamana na, lakana kɔlɔsili bɛna barika sɔrɔ minɛnko waati la. Gofɛrɛnaman ye jateminɛ kɛ fɛn caman Changements dans les legislations, min bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka dugukoloko cogoya kɔlɔsi cogo labɛnnen na dugukolo jukɔrɔla yiriwali waati. O sababu la, dɔgɔtɔrɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bɛna se ka kunnafoniw sɔrɔ waati bɛnnen na dugujukɔrɔji walima mɛtanɛni kan jirisunw na, ka jaabi di joona faratiw ma minnu bɛ ka bɔ kɛnɛ kan.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2621 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-24 23:21:56 CEST
Wideyo in bɛ Sinuwaw ka dugukolo kan MUMT manɛwɛrɛw jira dugubaw kɔnɔ kɛlɛw la, ka ZRY222 UGV min bɛ ni misiri ye, n’o ye UGV ye min bɛ taa ni wotoro 8 ye, robo wulu minnu bɛ marifa/bɔn, ani FPV ISR ani binkanni dronw fara ɲɔgɔn kan.

CCTV wideyow b’a jira ko PLA ka degeliw bɛ kɛ ni sɔrɔdasiw ni sennamɔgɔw ye dugu sigidaw la minnu bɛ kɛ i n’a fɔ u bɛ kɛ cogo min na, yɔrɔ minnu na, sigida minnu tɛ mɔgɔ ta, olu bɛ siraw jɛya, ka tasuma dɛmɛ, ani ka dɔ bɔ hadamadenw ka se sɔrɔli la kɛlɛ la ni sisi ni sow ye.
A b’a jira ko Siniwajamana y’a sinsin sɔrɔdasi robow kan sigida gɛlɛnw kama i n’a fɔ dugubaw kɔnɔ kɛlɛ, ka fɔlɔfɔlɔ kɛ sigida minnu bɛ se ka tiɲɛ ani minnu musaka ka dɔgɔ, minnu bɛ hadamaden fanga dafa k’a daminɛ san 2025 laban na.

 Ja minnu bɔra jamanakuntigiw ka lajɛba la, olu b’a jira ko jamanakuntigiw ni faamaw bɛ CICB (Centre for International Cooperation and Cooperation) la ni AES darapow ni sɔgɔlilanw ye, ka jamana ka jɛɲɔgɔnya jira ani ka sinsin jamanadenw kan kan, jamanakuntigiw ka lajɛ kura sababu fɛ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2631 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-24 22:50:53 CEST
Mali ka CNT ye kelenya (127) ye sariyasen naani wɛrɛw sigi senkan walasa ka Confédération des Etats du Sahel (AES) baara, minnu ɲɛsinnen bɛ jamanadenw ka lafasali ni lakana, diplomasi wale jɛlenw, sɔrɔ yiriwali ani jɛkulu ka pariti lajɛw ma.
Awirilikalo tile 23 san 2026 lajɛ min kɛra Bamakɔ, o bɛ AES ka sariyasun sabati, n’o ye Mali, Burkina Faso ani Nizɛri ye, jamana ɲɛmɔgɔw ka latigɛw kɔfɛ san 2025 desanburukalo la, ani CEDEA ka bɔli tɛmɛnen kɔ.
Ja minnu bɔra jamanakuntigiw ka lajɛba la, olu b’a jira ko jamanakuntigiw ni faamaw bɛ CICB la ni AES darapow ni sɔgɔlilanw ye, ka jamana ka jɛɲɔgɔnya jira ani ka sinsin jamanadenw kan kan, jamanakuntigiw ka lajɛ kura sababu fɛ.

Sɔrɔko ni minɛnko : Jamana bɛ sigida tiga tɔni 26.000 san kokura walasa ka sɛnɛfɛnw dilannikɛlaw dɛmɛ ani ka sɔngɔ dɔgɔya jamanadenw ma. Minɛko fan fɛ, Farid Mandela Guindo bɛ Minɛko Cɛsiriso ɲɛmɔgɔ ta.
Fɛnɲɛnɛmako: San o san Fasokanw ka AI Forum dɔ dabɔra zuwɛnkalo la walasa ka kokuradonni ni robow yiriwa Mali kɔnɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2683 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-24 15:18:59 CEST
San 2025 laban na, Siniwa jamana ka sɛnɛyɔrɔ jibɔlen sera mu miliyari 1,09 ma (hectare miliyɔn 72 ɲɔgɔn), o ye dɔ fara mu miliyɔn 53 ni kɔ kan (hectare miliyɔn 3,5 ɲɔgɔn) ni i y’a suma ni san duuru labɛn waati 13nan laban ye. Suman minnu bɛ bɔ sɛnɛyɔrɔw la minnu bɛ ji bɔ, olu kɛra 80,76% ye jamana ka sɔrɔ bɛɛ lajɛlen na.

Jiko yɔrɔbaw ni cɛmancɛw de ye "fanga kunba" ye suman sɛnɛni na, u bɛ kɛ 38,89% ye jamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw sɛnɛyɔrɔ la ani 50,9% sɔrɔta la, ni sɛnɛfɛnw sɔrɔta hakɛ cayalenba ye jinɛ 1164 ye (kati 688 ɲɔgɔn) mu kelen kɔnɔ (hectare 0,067 ɲɔgɔn), o ye jamana hakɛ cayalenba siɲɛ 1,5 ye.

Jiko ni jɔli bɛ ka taa ɲɛ waati kelen na:

Sɛnɛyɔrɔw jiko ji baaracogo ɲuman hakɛ sera 0,583 ma, wa sɛnɛ ji baaracogo ɲuman bɛ ka taa ɲɛ ; porozɛ kura 7 daminɛna san 2025 kɔnɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2795 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-24 11:01:18 CEST
Sinuwa jamana ka sɛnɛko jiko kunnafoni labanw b’a jira ko san 2025 laban na,

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2796 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-24 10:58:25 CEST
Sinuwa jamana ka sɛnɛko jiko kunnafoni labanw b’a jira ko san 2025 laban na, sɛnɛyɔrɔ jibɔyɔrɔ min bɛ jamana kɔnɔ, o tɛmɛna ɛkitɛri miliyari 1,09 kan, o ye dɔ farali ye min ka ca ni ɛkitɛri miliyɔn 53 ye n’i y’a suma ni “san duuru bolodalen 13nan” laban ye. Suman sɔrɔta sɛnɛyɔrɔ jibɔlenw kan, o bɛ kɛ 80,76% ye jamana ka sɔrɔ bɛɛ lajɛlen na.

Olu cɛma, suman sɛnɛyɔrɔ min bɛ jibɔyɔrɔbaw ni yɔrɔ cɛmancɛw la, o bɛ kɛ 38,89% ye jamana bɛɛ lajɛlen na, wa a sɔrɔta bɛ kɛ 50,9% ye . Mu kelen ka sɔrɔ hakɛ cayalenba ye kilo 1164 ye, o ye jamana sɛnɛta hakɛ cayalenba siɲɛ 1,5 ye, ani sɛnɛfɛnw sɛnɛta hakɛ min bɛ balo sanji fɛ, o hakɛ cayalenba siɲɛ 2,7, o b’a jira k’a jɔyɔrɔ ye « fanga kunba » ye suman sɛnɛni na.

Jiko ni baarakɛcogo ɲuman yiriwali siratigɛ la :

Sɛnɛyɔrɔw jiko ji baaracogo ɲuman hakɛ cayara ka se 0,583 ma , o ye 3,2% ye ni i y’a suma ni « san duuru bolodalen 13nan » laban ye
Sɛnɛji sɔngɔko bɛɛjɛfanga waleyali yɔrɔ bɛɛ lajɛlen sera ɛkitɛri miliyari 1,086 ma, wa fɛn caman b’a la ka Changé.
Jiko yɔrɔbaw ni jikoyɔrɔbaw kunkolo minnu ka ca ni mɛtɛrɛ 50.000 ye, olu ye "ɛntɛrinɛti jateminɛ" sɔrɔ walasa ka jiko tigitigi sabati.
Jiko yɔrɔ jɔli:

San 2025, jikoyɔrɔba kura 7 bɛna daminɛ, jiko yɔrɔ min dilannen don, o bɛ tɛmɛ miliyɔn 5,6 kan ;
An tora ka jiko yɔrɔba 15 jɔli yiriwa minnu bɛ ka jɔ, ka jiko yɔrɔbaw ni cɛmancɛ 157 biɲɛdimi waleya, ka jiko yɔrɔ kura faralen ɲɔgɔn kan, n’o ye ɛkitɛri miliyɔn 20 ni kɔ ye, k’o labɛn kokura ani k’a ɲɛ.
Porozɛ minnu ye taamasiyɛn ye i n’a fɔ Qingtongxia jiko marabolo min bɛ Ningxia, olu ye jiko nafa bonya ni 40% ye, fɛɛrɛko caman tigɛli fɛ i n’a fɔ kanalw dilanni ani filaninw nizɛri, ka jiko magow sabati kosɛbɛ sɛnɛyɔrɔ miliyɔn 1,15 na.
Togodala jiko lakanani yiriwara o waati kelen na. Pompi ji doncogo hakɛ togodaw la jamana kɔnɔ, o bɛna se 96% ma san 2025 kɔnɔ, ani jamanaden hakɛ min bɛ porozɛbaw kɔnɔ, o bɛna se 71% ma.

Togodala jiko lakanani yiriwara o waati kelen na. Pompi ji doncogo hakɛ togodaw la jamana kɔnɔ, o bɛna se 96% ma san 2025 kɔnɔ, ani jamanaden hakɛ min bɛ porozɛbaw kɔnɔ, o bɛna se 71% ma.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2798 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-24 10:44:30 CEST
Ameriki Kalifɔrni sɛnɛkɛlaw falen bɛ Koloradugu baji ji la ...
Sɛnɛfɛnw sɛnɛbagaw bɛ u labɛn ka Koloradugu baji ji bila - CalMatters
Sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛ jiko ɲɛnabɔli daminɛ tuma min na Koloradugu baji bɛ ka dɔgɔya
Jiko gɛlɛya ɲɛnabɔli bɛna kɛ dɔgɔya ye Kalifɔrni forow bolo ...
Koloradugu baji ji hɔrɔnyali ka bɔ Kalifɔrni forow la, o bɛ se ka ...
Kalifɔrni Imperial Valley, min ka joba bɛ Koloradugu baji gɛlɛn na, o bɛ degun na walasa ka jiko nafa bonya, jibɔ dɔgɔyali cɛma 20% kabini san 2000. Ja min bɛ senna, o mara in bɛ degunba la min bɛ ka Changé, k’a sɔrɔ a ji tilancɛ ɲɔgɔn bɛ alfalfa ni misiw balo dɛmɛ. Hali ni sɛnɛkɛlaw ka jogo kɔrɔw bɛ u bolo, u bɛ degun ka taa a fɛ walasa ka bi taw kɛ ani ka u lakana,... 

Jiko gɛlɛya ni degunko yɔrɔ kolomaw
Sɛnɛfɛnw sɔrɔli dɔgɔyali: Koloradugu baji min nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ Tlebi sɛnɛko la, o jibɔ dɔgɔyara ni 20% ye kabini san 2000 k’a sababu kɛ ja ye min bɛ sɔrɔ waati cogoya fɛ. 

Imperial Valley jɔyɔrɔ: Imperial Irrigation District (IID) bɛ Kalifɔrni Koloradugu baji hakɛ 70% mara, walima a bɛ se miliyɔn 3 ma, o min b’a to a ka baarakɛcogo nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ. 

Ji baaracogo : O ji in yɔrɔba dɔ bɛ kɛ ka shɔ ni balo wɛrɛw sɛnɛ misisogo/nɔnɔma misiw fɛ, o bɛ na ni welekan ye ka fɛn caman Changer sɛnɛ kɛcogo la ani dumuni ɲinini na. 

Sariya/tariku josariyaw : Sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛ baara kɛ ni "prior appropriation" kalansira ye — fɔlɔ waati la, fɔlɔ jogo la — o min bɛ fɔlɔ di u ma, nka o bɛ kɔrɔbɔ dɛsɛba fɛ. 

Nafolo lakanani : Walasa ka dɛsɛw kɛlɛ, IID ye bɛnkanw kɛ walasa ka ji jiginni kɛ, dugubaw bɛ dɔrɔmɛ kɛmɛ caman sara jiko la, akere kelen-kelen bɛɛ la, ni sɔrɔko nafolo ye ka fɛnsɔrɔsiraw sɛmɛntiya. 

Degun min bɛ ka bonya : Ɲininkaliw bɛ ka caya, n’o ye ko sisan sigida in bɛ sabati, walima ni fɛn caman bɛna kɛ jiko hakɛw n’a baaracogo la ani waati min na, o bɛna kɛ wajibi ye walasa ka mara in sabati.

 Masaya wolon bɛ k'a ɲɛsin Kalifɔrni, o min ka joba bɛ Koloradugu baji gɛlɛn na, o bɛ degun na walasa ka jiko kɛcogo ɲɛ, jibɔ dɔgɔyali cɛma 20% kabini san 2000.  Jiko gɛlɛya ni degunko yɔrɔ kolomaw
 Sɛnɛfɛnw sɔrɔli dɔgɔyali: Koloradugu baji, min nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ Tilebi sɛnɛko la, o jibɔ dɔgɔyara ni 20% o bɛ yen kabini san 2000, k’a sababu kɛ ja ye min bɛ sɔrɔ waati cogoya fɛ. 

 Masaya wolon jɔyɔrɔ: Masaya mara bɛ marali kɛ sɔnni kama (IID) Kalifɔrni jamana ka niyɔrɔ 70% la ka bɔ Koloradugu baji ji la, o kɔrɔ ye min ka surun akere sen miliyɔn 3 la, o min b’a to a ka baarakɛcogo ɲuman nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ. 
 
 Ji baaracogo : O ji in yɔrɔba dɔ bɛ kɛ ka clover ni baganbalo wɛrɛw sɛnɛ Nɔnɔ ni sogo misiw kama, O kɛra sababu ye ka ɲininiw kɛ walasa ka fɛn caman yɛlɛma sɛnɛ kɛcogo la ani balo ɲinini. 

 Sariya/tariku josariyaw : Sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛ baara kɛ ni "ka kɔn ka bolomafaraw di" - o kɔrɔ ye ka kɛ fɔlɔ ye waati kɔnɔ — min bɛ fɔlɔya di u ma, fo n'a kɛra nin sariyakolo in bɛ ka kɔrɔbɔ k’a sababu kɛ gɛlɛyaba ye jiko la. 

 Ji lakanani cɛsiriw musakaw : Walasa ka dɛsɛ in ɲɛnabɔ, Masaya marabolo banna sɔnni bɛnkanw na Ji tali kama, yɔrɔla dugubaw bɛ dolari kɛmɛ caman di akere-sen kelen na jiko la, Nafolo min bɛ bɔ nin bɛnkan ninnu na, o bɛ kɛ ka fɛnsɔrɔ yiriwali musakaw kɛ.

 Dɔ farali degun kan : Ɲininkaliw bɛ ka caya sisan sigida in sabatili janya kan, Ani ni fɛn caman b’a la ka Yɛlɛmaba kɛ jiko hakɛw n’a baaracogo la walasa ka mara in lakana ani ka se waati jumɛn ma.

Sariya/tariku josariyaw : Sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛ baara kɛ ni "prior appropriation" kalansira ye — fɔlɔ waati la, fɔlɔ jogo la — o min bɛ fɔlɔ di u ma, nka o bɛ kɔrɔbɔ dɛsɛba fɛ. 

Nafolo lakanani : Walasa ka dɛsɛw kɛlɛ, IID ye bɛnkanw kɛ walasa ka ji jiginni kɛ, dugubaw bɛ dɔrɔmɛ kɛmɛ caman sara jiko la, akere kelen-kelen bɛɛ la, ni sɔrɔko nafolo ye ka fɛnsɔrɔsiraw sɛmɛntiya. 

Degun min bɛ ka bonya : Ɲininkaliw bɛ ka caya, n’o ye ko sisan sigida in bɛ sabati, walima ni fɛn caman bɛna kɛ jiko hakɛw n’a baaracogo la ani waati min na, o bɛna kɛ wajibi ye walasa ka mara in sabati.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2818 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-04-24 07:15:50 CEST
Ameriki: San caman ja min kɛra Texas Saheliyanfan na, o ye sɛnɛko gɛlɛya bila ka bin, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, ji hakɛ dɔgɔyali min ma deli ka sɔrɔ fɔlɔ Rio Grande ani a jidagayɔrɔw la.

Degunba saba minnu bɛ yen:

Sekɔrɔ binkanni : Teksas kɔɔriko banna foroba la san 2024. Jamana ka kɔɔriforo kelenpe datugulen don k’a sababu kɛ ji bɛrɛ tɛ yen walasa ka sɛnɛfɛnw sɛnɛ, o kɛra sababu ye ka sɔrɔko bɔnɛ miliyɔn 100 sɔrɔ san o san.

Jiko gɛlɛya ni bɛnkanw : Ji hakɛ min bɛ jidagayɔrɔw la i n’a fɔ Falcon ani Amistad, o sera tariku dɔgɔyali ma (dɔw bɛ 10% duguma). Jɛɲɔgɔnya bɛ ka bonya san 1944 bɛnkan in kan, Texas jamana ɲɛmɔgɔw y’a fɔ ko Mɛkisiki bɛ ka ji miliyɔn kelen ni kɔ minɛ, juru min tun bɛ Ameriki kan.

Dɔgɔyali dɔɔni dɔɔni: Sekɔrɔ wɛrɛw fana, i n’a fɔ situlu ni cotton, olu fana bɛ ka dɔgɔya joona. Ni Fasa 5nan pɔnpe dantigɛliw kɛra yɔrɔw la i n’a fɔ Edwards Aquifer, sɛnɛkɛla denbaya caman minnu ye sɛnɛ kɛ kabini mɔgɔw ka tile, olu bɛ wajibiya k’u ka dugukolo walima u ka ji hakɛw feere walasa ka balo.

 Kuma surun na, funteni jugumanba, sanji dɔgɔyali, ani diplomasi sɔsɔliw faralen ɲɔgɔn kan jiko la, o kɛra sababu ye ka laadala sɛnɛ kɛ o mara kɔnɔ sɔrɔko siratigɛ la, mɔgɔ caman bolo.

Sɔngɔko gɛlɛya Mali kɔnɔ: Faaba Bamakɔ bɛ ka sogo sɔngɔ wuli kosɛbɛ (Awirilikalo san 2026), o de y’a to gɔfɛrɛnaman ye lajɛ kɔrɔtɔlenw kɛ ni fɛn dilannikɛlaw ye walasa ka sugu kɔlɔsi ani ka fɛnw sɔrɔ.

Tɔnɔ minnu bɛ bɔ baganw ka wuluwulu la: Jamana minnu bɛ mara kɔnɔ (Senegali ni Mali ɲɛmɔgɔya la) ye porogaramu dɔ daminɛ walasa ka baganw nɔfɛtaama kɛ nizɛrikan na walasa ka dɔ bɔ sonyali la, o min bɛ kɛ sababu ye ka Afiriki tilebinyanfan wari miliyari 260 bɔ o mara in na san o san, n’a kun ye ka dɔ bɔ o ko in na ni 70% ye.

Kɛnɛya ni sɔrɔko gɛlɛyaw:

Côte d’Ivoire: Kɔnɔw ka mura banakisɛw bɔra kɛnɛ kan kokura san caman sabatili kɔfɛ.

Benin: Sogofagayɔrɔ kura dɔ dabɔra Kandy walasa ka jagokɛlaw ka jago yiriwa, o bɛnna ni dɔ farala kosɛbɛ Risi kɔnɔsogow ladonni kan.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2918 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-20 19:55:03 CEST
import torch (kalan) min bɛ don jamana kɔnɔ
import soundfile i n’a fɔ sf
ka bɔ transformateurw la ka VitsModel, AutoTokenizer lase

# Kan minnu bɛ sɔrɔ: bamanankan, boomu, dogon, pular, songhoy, tamasheq
kan = "bambara".
modɛli_id = "MALIBA-AI/mali-tts".

# Load model ani tokenizer
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_id, subfolder=f"modɛliw/{kan}")
model = VitsModel.from_pretrained(model_id, subfolder=f"modɛliw/{kan}")

# Set minɛn
minɛn = "cuda" ni torch.cuda.is_available() n'o tɛ "cpu".
modɛli = modɛli.ka(minɛn) .

# Kumasenw sinsin
text = "An ka baara ni ye yɔrɔ minna ni an ye an a layɛ yala bɛ baara min kɛ ɛsike a don ka sigi ka sigi wa?"
donnakow = tokenizer(sɛbɛnni, kɔsegin_tensors="pt").ka(minɛn)

ni torch.no_grad() ye:
    bɔli = model(**donnakow).waveform

waveform = bɔli.squeeze ().cpu ().numpy () .
misali_hakɛ = modɛli.config.sample_hakɛ

# Save to file
sf.write("bɔyɔrɔ.wav", waveform, sample_rate)

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2939 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-20 05:33:01 CEST
Wideyo in bɛ Siniwajamana ka hɔrɔnya kɛlɛbolo ka dugu kɛlɛbolo caman jira, minnu bɛ dugukolo kan bolifɛn min bɛ ni misiri ye ZRY222, mɔgɔ tɛ min na, ni wotoro 8 bɛ a la, robo wulu minnu bɛ marifa ta/ minnu bɛ se ka bɔn, ani sɛgɛsɛgɛli ni binkanni dronw.

Wideyo in, n’o bɔra CCTV fɛ, o b’a jira ko jamanadenw ka hɔrɔnya kɛlɛbolo sɔrɔdasiw ni sennamɔgɔw bɛ ka kalan kɛ dugubaw kɔnɔ minnu bɛ kɛ i n’a fɔ a bɛ kɛ cogo min na, yɔrɔ minnu na, mɔgɔ tɛ minnu na, olu bɛ siraw jɛya, ka tasuma dɛmɛ, ani ka baarakɛlaw bila ka dɔgɔya sisi ni sow la kɛlɛ waati.

O b’a jira ko Siniwajamana y’a sinsin sɔrɔdasi robow kan sigida gɛlɛnw kama i n’a fɔ dugubaw kɔnɔ kɛlɛ, k’a bila jɔyɔrɔ fɔlɔ la sigida minnu bɛ se ka bila senkan nɔgɔya la ani minnu musaka ka dɔgɔ, n’olu bɛ hadamadenw ka fanga dafa k’a daminɛ san 2025 laban na.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2943 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-04-20 05:20:58 CEST
Faransi bɛ ka fanga di a ka minɛnko baara ma walasa k’a ka nɛgɛ nafamaw (litiyamu, nɛgɛ, tungsten) sɔrɔli lakana ani ka fanga jiginni dɛmɛ. Porozɛ minnu bɛ i n’a fɔ Imerys ta Allier mara la, olu de bɛ nin fɛɛrɛ in ɲɛminɛ, a laɲini ye ka dɔ bɔ jamana wɛrɛw ka danfara la, ni sariyasunba kura ye (san 2025 sɛnɛko sariyasun sinsinni) min sinsinnen bɛ sabatili kan.
Google ye fasari min jira:
Faransi bɛ ka fanga di a ka minɛnko baara ma walasa k’a ka nɛgɛ nafamaw (litiyamu, nɛgɛ, tungsten) sɔrɔli lakana ani ka fanga jiginni dɛmɛ. Porozɛw bɛ i n’a fɔ Imerys ta Allier mara la, nin fɛɛrɛ in laɲini ye ka dɔ bɔ jamana wɛrɛw ka dannaya la, ni sariyasunba kura ye (san 2025 sɛnɛko sariyasun sinsinni) min sinsinnen bɛ sabatili kan.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2944 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-20 05:20:03 CEST
Maroc, Awirilikalo tile 18, san 2026

Tomati sɔngɔ wulila ka se dirham 12 ma... Foroba dimi ni baarakɛlaw ka lajɛ

Tomati sɔngɔw cayara kosɛbɛ jamana suguw la nin don laban ninnu na, o kɛra sababu ye ka jamanadenw bila ka lasɔmini kɛ, ka ɲɛsin fɛn jɔnjɔn caman sɔngɔ jiginni ma min bɛ senna. U bɛ ka dɛmɛ ɲini fangatigiw fɛ, olu minnu ye fɛnw bilali jɔ Afiriki suguw la waati dɔɔnin kɔnɔ, o kɛra sababu ye ka mɔgɔw ka jaabi caman lase baarakɛlaw ma.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 2947 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-20 05:17:41 CEST
Kibaru dɔ min bɛ Mali ni Maroc jamana fila ka jɛkafɔ kan sɛnɛko ni baganmara siratigɛ la. Raporo in sinsinnen bɛ dɛmɛn porogaramu dɔ kan min bɛ kɛ ka nɔnɔko yiriwa Mali kɔnɔ, o sababu fɛ : • Ka bagan suguyaw yiriwa ni kɔnɔmaya kɛcogo dilannenw ye. • Fɛɛrɛko dɔnniya falenfalen jamana fila ninnu cɛ. • Ka Saheli ni Saheli jɛkafɔ sabati walasa ka yiriwali sabatilen sɔrɔ o seko in na.

Kibaru dɔ min bɛ Mali ni Marɔku jamana fila ka jɛkafɔ kan sɛnɛ ni baganmara siratigɛ la. Jateminɛ in sinsinnen bɛ dɛmɛn waleya dɔ kan min bɛ kɛ ka nɔnɔ bɔli yiriwa Mali kɔnɔ, an'o sababu fɛ : • Ka bagan suguyaw ɲɛ ni kɔnɔmaya kɛcogo dilannenw ye. • Fɛɛrɛko dɔnniya falenfalen jamana fila ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ. • Ka worodugu ni Worodugu jɛɲɔgɔnya sinsin walasa ka yiriwali Mɛɛlen sɔrɔ nin taabolo in na.

Alzeri bɛ ka fɛn caman sɛmɛntiya a ka damanko siratigɛ la, min jirala san 2025 damanko sariya kura fɛ min bɛ sira di jamana wɛrɛw ka bolomafara ma fo ka se 80% ma.  Baarabolodalenbaw bɛ ka taa ɲɛ, i n’a fɔ... 

  Zɛnki ni plɔmu daman min bɛ Bejaia ani Gara Djebilet baarabolodalenba nɛgɛmugu kama, n’a baara bɛna daminɛ mɛkalo san 2026. Ani Gofɛrɛnaman bɛ ka dɔ fara wari bilali kan walasa ka sɔrɔko caman kɛ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 3012 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-18 15:12:26 CEST
Turquie jamana ka jamanakuntigiso ye a bila ka segin a kan
Recep Tayyip Erdogan ye a ka baara kɛ

N jigi b’a kan ko Antalya Diplomasi Forum, an bɛ min labɛn a siɲɛ 5nan na ɲinan, o bɛna kɛ nafa ye an ka mara ni diɲɛ bɛɛ ma.

N b’a fɛ barow, jateminɛw, ani hakilina falenfalen minnu bɛna kɛ porogaramu kɔnɔ, ka fara kɛrɛfɛko ni ɲɔgɔnye fila kan minnu bɛna kɛ forobajɛkulu in kɔnɔ, olu ka nafa sɔrɔ.

A san duuru ye nin ye, an y’a daminɛ ni laɲini ye ka diɲɛ seleke naani sigida dɔ da min bɛna diplomasi ka wulikan ta, wa bi an b’a ye ko Antalya diplomasi forobajɛkulu kɛra kɛnɛ ye min bɛ kɛ diɲɛ hakilila, diɲɛ dusukun, ani siniɲɛsigi jigiya la.

Ne dalen b'a la ko baro minnu bɛna Kɛ tile saba kɔnɔ n'o tɔgɔ ye ko "Shaping tomorrow, Managing Uncertainties" olu bɛna nin foroba-jɛkulu in fan kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen n'a kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen in Jira ka T'a fɛ.

Ne dalen b’a la ko forobajɛkulu in bɛna dɛmɛ don Turquie ka cidenyabaara la, n’o ye ka kɛ « hɛrɛ kunba » ye, wa n bɛ foli lase lajɛden kelen-kelen bɛɛ ma. #ADF2026 ye

A san duuru ye nin ye, an y’a daminɛ ni laɲini ye ka diɲɛ kɛnɛba dɔ da min bɛna kɔkanko ka wulikan ta, wa bi an b’a ye ko Antalya kɔkanko forobajɛkulu kɛra diɲɛ hakililata, diɲɛ dusukun, ani siniɲɛsigi jigiya ye. Ne dalen b'a la ko baro minnu bɛna Kɛ tile saba kɔnɔ n'o tɔgɔ ye ko "sini cogoya, Lagɛlɛyabaliyakow ɲɛnabɔli" olu bɛna nin foroba-jɛkulu in fan kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen n'a kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen in Jira ka T'a fɛ. Ne dalen b’a la ko forobajɛkulu in bɛna dɛmɛ don Turquie ka cidenyabaara la, n’o ye ka kɛ « bɛn kunba » ye, wa n bɛ foli lase a senfɛla kelen-kelen bɛɛ ma. #ADF2026

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 3027 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-18 12:35:52 CEST
Nin kunnafoni in bɛ minisiri Youba Ba ka taama fɛɛrɛbɔ dɔ jira Koulikoro mara kɔnɔ, ka Mali ka wuli ka taa bi jɛgɛmara la walasa k’a ka balo yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sabati.
Nin taama in kɔnɔko jɔnjɔnw filɛ nin ye:
Fɛnɲɛnɛmako jɔnjɔnw : CAPEJ (ambition de 200.000 de lèvres) ani bi Safo jɛgɛ sugu bɛ o seko in wulicogo jira.
Waati cogoya wɛrɛ : Jiko gɛlɛyaw ɲɛkɔrɔ, jɛgɛmara bɛ jira iko fura min bɛ nafa sɔrɔ kosɛbɛ ani min bɛ se ka muɲu kosɛbɛ walasa ka baarakɛyɔrɔw dabɔ.
Baarakɛɲɔgɔnya siratigɛ la : Dɛmɛ min bɛ bɔ PRTD (Porozɛ min bɛ dugukolo tiɲɛ, n’o wari bɛ bɔ diɲɛ banki fɛ, o jatera ko a nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ walasa ka sigida labɛnni ni sɔrɔko siraw siri ɲɔgɔn na.
Laɲini laban : Ka dumuniko yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔ ka sɔrɔ ka lakanabaliya kɛlɛ min ni waati jiginni bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 3066 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-17 02:42:21 CEST
Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman
Awirilikalo tile 12 nɛgɛ kanɲɛ 17h31
Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara. Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔkobaw ni latigɛw bɛ sɔrɔ digest kɔnɔ:

✅Jamanadenw bɛna se ka kansɛri furakɛli fɛɛrɛ kura sɔrɔ fu. Dɔgɔtɔrɔso asiransi wajibiyalen porogaramu kɔnɔ, furakɛli bɛ kɛ ni kansɛri bolociw ye ani CAR-T selilɛri furakɛli. Fura ninnu bɛ kɛ kelen-kelen ka kɛɲɛ ni banabagatɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye.

✅Kɛnɛya fɔlɔw ka biɲɛdimi bɛna t’a fɛ maraw kɔnɔ. Mara damadɔ bɛna bolomafara wɛrɛ sɔrɔ min bɛ tɛmɛ ruble miliyari 2 kan o baara ninnu kama. Ruble miliyari 10 wɛrɛ bɛna bila furakɛli nizɛri yiriwali kama mara 84 kɔnɔ.

✅Mikhail Mishustin ye fɛɛrɛbɔ lajɛ dɔ kɛ sɛnɛfɛnw ni fanga yiriwali kan, k’a jateminɛ Moyen-Orient jamanaw ka ko la.

✅Jamanakuntigi ka yamaruya kɔnɔ, gɔfɛrɛnaman ka komisiyɔn dɔ sigira sen kan sanjiba dɛmɛni kama. Fɛdɛrali minisiriw taara yɔrɔw la minnu falen don ji la, ka kɛnɛyako yɔrɔw n’u sigiyɔrɔw sɛgɛsɛgɛ Dagestan ni Tchechenia jamanaw na, mɔgɔ minnu tɔɔrɔla.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 3072 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-04-17 02:40:00 CEST
Mali Jamanakuntigiya

Minisiriw ka lajɛ min kɛra arabadon awirilikalo tile 15 san 2026, o bɛ ɲɛfɔli kɛ latigɛba caman kan minnu kɛra jenerali Assimi Goïta ka jamanakuntigiya kɔnɔ. Nin ye hakilina jɔnjɔnw ye:

1. Sariya ni sariyasunba fɛɛrɛw
Ji: Jamana ka jiko politiki sɔnni (2026-2035). A laɲini ye yiriwali sabatili ye waati jiginni ɲɛkɔrɔ, ni "Mali Kurasirara" yeli ye.

Decentralisation (Youth & Sports): Dekerew tali ka fanga di jamana ma foroba la ka taa Kominiw, Marabolow, ani Bamakɔ mara la. O bεnkan in bε tugu "Sɛrɛkili" nivo bɔli la marako siratigɛ la.
Baganmara : Baganmara sabatili ni lakanani fɛɛrɛbɔ siratigɛ la sigida hukumu dabɔli (2025-2029). Jamana ni marabolow ɲɛnabɔli sira dɔ bɛ ka sigi senkan walasa ka baganw lakana san 2034 kɔnɔ.

2. Lajɛba jɔnjɔnw (Mɔgɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka fɛɛrɛw) .
Minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ ka biro : Balobo Cissé kɛra ɲɛmɔgɔba ye diɲɛ seleke naani nafolo marali baarada la.

Presidency of Mali

The Council of Ministers meeting of Wednesday, April 15, 2026, details of several major decisions taken under the presidency of General Assimi Goïta. Here are the key points:

1. Legislative and Regulatory Measures
Water: Approval of the National Water Policy (2026-2035). It aims for sustainable development in the face of climate change, in line with the "Mali Kura ɲɛtaasira" vision.

Decentralization (Youth & Sports): Adoption of decrees officially transferring powers from the State to the Communes, Regions, and the District of Bamako. This reform follows the administrative elimination of the "Circle" level.
Livestock: Creation of the institutional framework for the Livestock Stabilization and Security Strategy (2025-2029). A national and regional management system is being established to protect livestock by 2034.

2. Key Appointments (Individual Measures)
Prime Minister's Office: Mr. Balobo Cissé is appointed Director General of the Universal Access Fund Management Agency.
Transport and Infrastructure: Mr. Youssouf Dembélé becomes Chief Inspector, and Ms. Mariam Touré Diallo is appointed Chief of Staff.
Justice: Appointment of two special advisors (Mr. Guindo and Ms. Sanogo).
