Mali Jamanakuntigiya
Tɛmɛsira ɲɛmɔgɔba, a ka bon ɲɛmaaba Assimi Goïta, ye kunbɛnni kɛ ntɛnɛdon marisikalo tile 2 san 2026, sariyatigiw ka kulu la, minnu bɛ Mali jamana nɔna bila kiritigɛlaw ɲɛkɔrɔ,  Farafinna tilebinyanfan jamanaw ka sɔrɔko jɛkulu (CEDEAO) ani Farafinna tilebinyanfan sɔrɔko ni wariko tɔnba (UEMOA).

Nin lajɛ in bɛ tugu kiritigɛ la min bɔra san 2026 zanwuyekalo tile 28, Farafinna tilebinyanfan sɔrɔko ni wariko tɔnba ka kiritigɛso fɛ, ka Mali dɛmɛ, k’a jira ko jalaki minnu kɛra an ka jamana kan san 2022 daminɛ na, olu ye sariya sɔsɔli ye, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, marabolo fitininw kɔnɔ.

Minisiri min ɲɛsinnen bɛ kiritigɛlaw ni hadamadenw ka josariyaw ma, taamasiyɛnw marabaga, Mahamadou KASSOGUÉ, ani sariya jɛkulu mɔgɔ saba—Cɛ. Ousmane Mama TRAORÉ, Fatoumata SIDIBÉ DIARRA, ani Amadou Tiéoulé DIARRA—u y'u sen donna ɲɔgɔnye in na. Ka fara nin sariyatigi saba ninnu kan, o jɛkulu kɔnɔ, Moustaphe CISSÉ, Abdrahamane Ben Mamata TOURÉ, ani Cheick Oumar KONARÉ fana tun bɛ yen.

A ka kuma kɔnɔ, kiritigɛlaw ka minisiri ye lafasalitɔn tanu u ka cɛsiri, u ka gɛlɛya, ani u ka baarakɛcogo ɲuman na. A y’a jira ko ko minnu kɛra sigida kiritigɛso ɲɛkɔrɔ, u daminɛ na, o kɛra sababu ye ka jalaki in waleyali jɔ, sanni kiritigɛ laban ka bɔ o ko in na, o min y’a jira k’a jɛya ko taabolo minnu sɔsɔra, olu tɛ sariya kɔnɔ.

"Tɛmɛsira ɲɛmɔgɔba y'a laɲini ka foli lase sariyatigiw ka jɛkulu ma, minnu ye Mali nafaw lafasa ni bonya ni danbe ye." Kiiritigɛ minisiri y’a jira ko: “Nin dugukoloko fɛɛrɛ  makaritɔko in kɔnɔ, O ŋaniya sugu sɔrɔli tun tɛ ko ye k'i bɛ se k'i yɛrɛ bɔ..”

A y’a sinsin a kan fana ko jalaki minnu jaakuyara Mali kan, jamana ɲɛmɔgɔw y’a jate ko kiiri tɛ, wa sariya tɛ, wa hadamadenya tɛ. O cogo la, zanwuyekalo tile 28 kiritigɛ in bɛ kɛ kiritigɛlaw ka dɛmɛ ye, ka fanga di Mali jamana ka jɔyɔrɔ lafasali ma marabolo ni diɲɛ seleke naani na.

Faamaw ye wasa sariyalen min jira, o kɔfɛ, Minisiri ye sigida kiritigɛso kiritigɛlaw ka jagɛlɛya n’u ka yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya tanu. A y’a jira kokura ko sariya in waleyali gɛlɛn, fɛɛrɛ sigida la, gɛlɛyabaw bɛ min kɔnɔ, o bɛ kɛwale barikama jira min bɛ sariyasunba dɛmɛ ani ka marabolow ka jɛɲɔgɔnya jɛkuluw sigicogo sariyakolow bonya.

Ousmane Mama Traoré ka kuma la, ɲɔgɔnye kɔfɛ, a y’a jira ko jɛkulu in ka waso don, k’a sababu kɛ jamana ɲɛmɔgɔba ye u bisimila. A y’a jira ko: “An y’an ka baara kɛ dɔrɔn i n’a fɔ lafasabaa, k’an jigi da sigida sariyasun min bɛ yen dɔrɔn.”

A y’a sinsin a kan ko Mali lafasali bɛ da sɔsɔli barikamaw kan, minnu sinsinnen don kosɛbɛ sɛbɛnw kan minnu bɛ Farafinna tilebinyanfan sɔrɔko ni wariko tɔnba ɲɛminɛ ani jɛkulu ka sariyasunw daminɛw. A y'a Jira ko "Mali tun tɛ ni fɛɛrɛ wɛrɛ ye n'a ma Kɛ k'a jigi Da Erɔpu kelenya tɔba jamanaw ka sariya kan walasa k'a ka fɔtaw Dɛmɛ. O sariyako in kɔnɔ, a jɛlen don ko Jalaki minnu kɛra, olu tun ye fili ye."

Hakililajigin na, fɛɛrɛ minnu sɔsɔra, olu tun kɛra sababu ye ka Mali ka lasigidenw bila ka bɔ sigida jɛkulu caman na.Tɛmɛsira fangatigiw ye sɔsɔli kɛ taabolo ninnu tiɲɛni n’o latigɛw sariya siratigɛ la kiritigɛso min bɛ ka baara kɛ, k’a fɔ k’u ma tugu sɛbɛnw sigicogo sariyaw kɔ.

Kiiritigɛso y’a ka kiritigɛ-sɛbɛn kɔnɔ, sariya tiɲɛni jɔnjɔnw kɔlɔsi jalaki taabolo la, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, fanga minnu dira latigɛjɛkuluw ma Erɔpu kelenya tɔba ka bɛnkanw kɔnɔ. A y’a jira kokura ko hali fɛɛrɛ gɛlɛya waatiw la, jamanadenw ni marabolow ka tɔnw bɛ to u cɛsirilen don kosɛbɛ sariyasun jɛlen na min bɛ u ka walew ɲɛnabɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 4742 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-03-03 13:08:45 CEST
Mali Jamanakuntigiya 
Tɛmɛsira ɲɛmɔgɔba, a ka kɛlɛbolo jenerali Assimi GOÏTA, ye sɔn, bi jumadon marisikalo tile 2 san 2026, avoka kulu ma, minnu ye Mali jamana lafasa sigida kiritigɛsow ɲɛkɔrɔ, sɔsɔli hukumu kɔnɔ min tun b’a kɛlɛ Afiriki tilebinyanfan jamanaw ka sɔrɔko jɛkulu (ECOWAS) ani Afiriki tilebinyanfan sɔrɔko ni wariko tɔnba (UEMOA).

Nin lajɛ in bɛ tugu kiritigɛ in kɔ, min kɛra san 2026 zanwuyekalo tile 28, Afiriki tilebinyanfan sɔrɔko ni wariko tɔnba ka kiritigɛso fɛ, ka Mali dɛmɛ, k’a jira ko sankɔrɔta minnu kɛra an ka jamana kan san 2022 daminɛ na, olu ye sariya sɔsɔli ye, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, marabolo fitininw kɔnɔ.

Minisiri min ɲɛsinnen bɛ kiritigɛlaw ni hadamadenw ka josariyaw ma, kiritigɛlaw ka minisiri, Mahamadou KASSOGUÉ, ye a sen don nin lajɛ in na, ka fara sariyatigiw ka jɛkulu mɔgɔ saba kan, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la Maître Ousmane Mama TRAORÉ, Maître Fatoumata SIDIBÉ DIARRA ani Maître Amadou Tiéoulé DIARRA. Ka fara nin sariyatigi saba ninnu kan minnu tun bɛ ɲɔgɔnye in na, o kulu in kɔnɔ, jamanakuntigi Moustaphe CISSÉ, Maître Abdrahamane Ben Mamata TOURÉ ani Maître Cheick Oumar KONARÉ fana tun bɛ yen.

A ka dɛmɛ kɔnɔ, kiritigɛlaw ka minisiri ye lafasalitɔn ka cɛsiri, a ka gɛlɛya ani a ka baarakɛcogo tanu. A hakili jigira ko taabolo min daminɛna jɛkulu kiritigɛso ɲɛkɔrɔ, a daminɛ na, o kɛra sababu ye ka desizɔn ta ka fagali jɔ, sanni kiritigɛ min kɛra ka da a kan, o k’a jira k’a jɛya ko fɛɛrɛ minnu sɔsɔra, olu tɛ sariya kɔnɔ.

« Tɛmɛsira jamanakuntigi tun b’a fɛ ka foli lase sariyatigiw ka kulu ma, minnu ye Mali nafaw lafasa ni bonya ni danbe ye. Kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, dugukoloko politiki siratigɛ la, o desizɔn sugu sɔrɔli tun tɛ ko ye min kɛra ka kɔn o ɲɛ », kiritigɛlaw minisiri y’o fɔ.

A y’a jira fana ko sankɔrɔta minnu kɛra Mali kan, jamana ɲɛmɔgɔw y’a jate sariya sɔsɔli ye, sariya sɔsɔli ani hadamadenyabaliya. Zanwuyekalo tile 28 kiritigɛ in bɛ kɛ o cogo la kiritigɛlaw ka danbe ye min bɛ Mali jamana ka jɔyɔrɔ lafasa mara ni diɲɛ kɔnɔ.

Faamaw ye wasa sariyalen min jira, o kɔfɛ, Minisiri tun b’a fɛ ka foli lase sigida kiritigɛso kiritigɛlaw ka jagɛlɛya n’u ka yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya ma. A hakili jigira ko sariya labatoli gɛlɛn, politiki sigida la, gɛlɛya barikamaw bɛ min kɔnɔ, o bɛ wale barikama jira min bɛ sariyasunba dɛmɛ ani ka marabolow ka jɛɲɔgɔnya jɛkuluw sigicogo sariyakolow bonya.

Maître Ousmane Mama TRAORÉ ka kuma la jama laban na, a y’a jira ko jɛkulu in ka waso b’a la k’a sababu kɛ jamana ɲɛmɔgɔ ye u bisimila. “An y’an ka baara kɛ dɔrɔn i n’a fɔ avoka, an y’an jigi da marifakisɛw dɔrɔn de kan Sigida sariyasunba min bɛ yen », a ko ten.

A y’a sinsin a kan ko Mali ka lafasalitɔn sigilen don sɔsɔli gɛlɛnw de kan, minnu sinsinnen don kosɛbɛ sɛbɛnw kan minnu bɛ UEMOA ɲɛminɛ ani sigida sariya sariyakolow. « Mali tun bɛ se k’a ka fɔtaw sinsin dɔrɔn ka da sigida sariya kan. Nin sariyasun in yeelen na, a y’a jira k’a jɛya ko sankɔrɔta minnu kɛra, olu nɔgɔlen don ni sariya tiɲɛniw ye », a ko ten.

Hakilijigin na, fɛɛrɛ sɔsɔlen minnu kɛra, olu kɛra sababu ye ka Mali bila sigida jɛkulu caman bolo. Tɛmɛsira ɲɛmɔgɔw tun ye kiritigɛso min bɛ se ka baara kɛ, o minɛ walasa ka sɔsɔli kɛ taabolo basigilenw kan ani sariya siratigɛ la, o latigɛw, k’a jateminɛ k’u ma sariyaw bonya minnu bɛ sigikafɔ sɛbɛnw kɔnɔ.

Kiiritigɛso y’a ka kiritigɛ kɔnɔ, a y’a jira ko sariya tiɲɛniba kɛra sankɔrɔta taabolo la, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, fanga minnu bɛ di latigɛjɛkuluw ma, jɛkulu ka bɛnkanw fɛ. A hakili jigira ko hali politiki gɛlɛya waatiw la, jamanadenw ni marabolow ka tɔnw bɛ to ka siri kosɛbɛ sariyasun jɛlen na min b’u ka walew sinsin.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 4820 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-03-03 10:34:06 CEST
Mali Jamanakuntigiya 
Tɛmɛsira ɲɛmɔgɔba, a ka kɛlɛbolo jenerali Assimi GOÏTA, ye sɔn, bi jumadon marisikalo tile 2 san 2026, avoka kulu ma, minnu ye Mali jamana lafasa sigida kiritigɛsow ɲɛkɔrɔ, sɔsɔli hukumu kɔnɔ min tun b’a kɛlɛ Afiriki tilebinyanfan jamanaw ka sɔrɔko jɛkulu (ECOWAS) ani Afiriki tilebinyanfan sɔrɔko ni wariko tɔnba (UEMOA).

Nin lajɛ in bɛ tugu kiritigɛ in kɔ, min kɛra san 2026 zanwuyekalo tile 28, Afiriki tilebinyanfan sɔrɔko ni wariko tɔnba ka kiritigɛso fɛ, ka Mali dɛmɛ, k’a jira ko sankɔrɔta minnu kɛra an ka jamana kan san 2022 daminɛ na, olu ye sariya sɔsɔli ye, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, marabolo fitininw kɔnɔ.

Minisiri min ɲɛsinnen bɛ kiritigɛlaw ni hadamadenw ka josariyaw ma, kiritigɛlaw ka minisiri, Mahamadou KASSOGUÉ, ye a sen don nin lajɛ in na, ka fara sariyatigiw ka jɛkulu mɔgɔ saba kan, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la Maître Ousmane Mama TRAORÉ, Maître Fatoumata SIDIBÉ DIARRA ani Maître Amadou Tiéoulé DIARRA. Ka fara nin sariyatigi saba ninnu kan minnu tun bɛ ɲɔgɔnye in na, o kulu in kɔnɔ, jamanakuntigi Moustaphe CISSÉ, Maître Abdrahamane Ben Mamata TOURÉ ani Maître Cheick Oumar KONARÉ fana tun bɛ yen.

A ka dɛmɛ kɔnɔ, kiritigɛlaw ka minisiri ye lafasalitɔn ka cɛsiri, a ka gɛlɛya ani a ka baarakɛcogo tanu. A hakili jigira ko taabolo min daminɛna jɛkulu kiritigɛso ɲɛkɔrɔ, a daminɛ na, o kɛra sababu ye ka desizɔn ta ka fagali jɔ, sanni kiritigɛ min kɛra ka da a kan, o k’a jira k’a jɛya ko fɛɛrɛ minnu sɔsɔra, olu tɛ sariya kɔnɔ.

« Tɛmɛsira jamanakuntigi tun b’a fɛ ka foli lase sariyatigiw ka kulu ma, minnu ye Mali nafaw lafasa ni bonya ni danbe ye. Kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, dugukoloko politiki siratigɛ la, o desizɔn sugu sɔrɔli tun tɛ ko ye min kɛra ka kɔn o ɲɛ », kiritigɛlaw minisiri y’o fɔ.

A y’a jira fana ko sankɔrɔta minnu kɛra Mali kan, jamana ɲɛmɔgɔw y’a jate sariya sɔsɔli ye, sariya sɔsɔli ani hadamadenyabaliya. Zanwuyekalo tile 28 kiritigɛ in bɛ kɛ o cogo la kiritigɛlaw ka danbe ye min bɛ Mali jamana ka jɔyɔrɔ lafasa mara ni diɲɛ kɔnɔ.

Faamaw ye wasa sariyalen min jira, o kɔfɛ, Minisiri tun b’a fɛ ka foli lase sigida kiritigɛso kiritigɛlaw ka jagɛlɛya n’u ka yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya ma. A hakili jigira ko sariya labatoli gɛlɛn, politiki sigida la, gɛlɛya barikamaw bɛ min kɔnɔ, o bɛ wale barikama jira min bɛ sariyasunba dɛmɛ ani ka marabolow ka jɛɲɔgɔnya jɛkuluw sigicogo sariyakolow bonya.

Maître Ousmane Mama TRAORÉ ka kuma la jama laban na, a y’a jira ko jɛkulu in ka waso b’a la k’a sababu kɛ jamana ɲɛmɔgɔ ye u bisimila. “An y’an ka baara kɛ dɔrɔn i n’a fɔ avoka, an y’an jigi da marifakisɛw dɔrɔn de kan Sigida sariyasunba min bɛ yen », a ko ten.

A y’a sinsin a kan ko Mali ka lafasalitɔn sigilen don sɔsɔli gɛlɛnw de kan, minnu sinsinnen don kosɛbɛ sɛbɛnw kan minnu bɛ UEMOA ɲɛminɛ ani sigida sariya sariyakolow. « Mali tun bɛ se k’a ka fɔtaw sinsin dɔrɔn ka da sigida sariya kan. Nin sariyasun in yeelen na, a y’a jira k’a jɛya ko sankɔrɔta minnu kɛra, olu nɔgɔlen don ni sariya tiɲɛniw ye », a ko ten.

Hakilijigin na, fɛɛrɛ sɔsɔlen minnu kɛra, olu kɛra sababu ye ka Mali bila sigida jɛkulu caman bolo. Tɛmɛsira ɲɛmɔgɔw tun ye kiritigɛso min bɛ se ka baara kɛ, o minɛ walasa ka sɔsɔli kɛ taabolo basigilenw kan ani sariya siratigɛ la, o latigɛw, k’a jateminɛ k’u ma sariyaw bonya minnu bɛ sigikafɔ sɛbɛnw kɔnɔ.

Kiiritigɛso y’a ka kiritigɛ kɔnɔ, a y’a jira ko sariya tiɲɛniba kɛra sankɔrɔta taabolo la, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, fanga minnu bɛ di latigɛjɛkuluw ma, jɛkulu ka bɛnkanw fɛ. A hakili jigira ko hali politiki gɛlɛya waatiw la, jamanadenw ni marabolow ka tɔnw bɛ to ka siri kosɛbɛ sariyasun jɛlen na min b’u ka walew sinsin.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 4824 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-03-03 04:26:51 CEST
Sinuwa jamana ka cotton finiko baara ye ladilanni juguw kɛ, fɛn caman tigɛli ani fɛn caman sɛmɛntiya ka bɔ san 2025 la ka se san 2026 ma, wa yiriwali bɛɛ lajɛlen taabolo ye "ka duguma jɔ degun kɔrɔ, ka sigicogo ɲuman kɛ, ani ka jogoɲumanya yiriwa Hali n’a y’a sɔrɔ gɛlɛyaw bɛ a kan i n’a fɔ kɛnɛyako ɲinini barika dɔgɔyali ani suguw ka ɲɔgɔndan fanga bonya, o baara in bɛ ka taa dɔɔnin dɔɔnin yiriwali siratigɛ kura la, politiki ɲɛminɛni fɛ, fɛɛrɛ kuraw ni fɛnkurabɔli fɛ.

1. Sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli bɛ ka bonya ka taa a fɛ, wa hali bi Sinjiang ye fɛn dilanni yɔrɔ koloma ye
San 2025, jamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw bɛɛ lajɛlen bɛna se tɔni miliyɔn 6,641 ma, o ye san o san caya ye ni 7,7% ye. Olu cɛma, Sinjiang ka sɔrɔ tɛmɛna tɔni miliyɔn 6,16 kan, o kɛra 92,8% ye jamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw bɛɛ lajɛlen na, ka t’a fɛ k’a jɔyɔrɔ sabati i n’a fɔ jamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw sɛnɛyɔrɔ ɲumanba.
San 2026, Sinjiang bɛna izini sariyasunba kura daminɛ. A bolodara ka dɔ bɔ cotton sɛnɛyɔrɔ la ni 10% ni kɔ ye, wa laɲini bɛna sabati ka se miliyɔn 36 ɲɔgɔn ma walasa ka degunw nɔgɔya minnu bɛ sɔrɔ kojuguba la ani ka sigida sabatili sabati.
Sɛgɛsɛgɛli fɔlɔ min kɛra Siniwajamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw tɔnba fɛ, o y’a jira ko sɛnɛyɔrɔ min laɲinina jamana kɔnɔ san 2026, o ye ɛkitɛri miliyɔn 44,583 ye, o ye san o san dɔgɔyali ye ni 0,5% ye. Dɔgɔyali in dɔgɔyara kosɛbɛ, o b’a jira ko suguw ka dannaya bɛ ka segin dɔɔnin dɔɔnin.

2. Politikibaw bɛ don sen kan walasa ka izini cakɛda yiriwali sabati
"Sinjiang ka finiko ni finiko yiriwali bolodalen cɛmancɛ ni kuntaalajan (2026-2035)" lajɛra ka sɔn a ma san 2026 daminɛ na. A jɛlen don ko a sinsinnen bɛ hakilijagabɔ, jirisunw falenni, ani jɛkafɔ kan walasa ka kulu kura dɔ da finiko baarakɛyɔrɔ ye min bɛ da tilebin fɛ.
Xinjiang ye "Politiki ni fɛɛrɛ kɔnɔntɔn" bɔ walasa ka dɔ fara wariko dɛmɛ kan ka ɲɛsin fɛn labanw dilanni baarakɛda ma, fɛɛrɛko caman tigɛli porozɛw ani jirisunw feereli sanfɛtaw, ani ka dusu don baarakɛdabaw kɔnɔ u ka wuli ka bɔ cotton sɔgɔli la ka taa jiri ɲagaminenw na, minnu bɛ sɔgɔsɔgɔ, minnu jate ka bon ani fɛn wɛrɛw minnu nafa ka bon.
K’a daminɛ san 2026 zuluyekalo la, jamana ɲɛmɔgɔso min ɲɛsinnen bɛ suguya labɛnni ma, o bɛna "Fibre Products Quality Supervision and Management Measures" ni GB 18383-2025 wajibiyalen sariya kura in waleya, k’a sinsin fɛnw kɔlɔsili kan i n’a fɔ denmisɛnninw ka finiw, lakɔli finiw, duguma jakitew, a ɲɔgɔnnaw, ka fiyɛriw baaracogo bali kosɛbɛ, ani ka iziniw labɛncogo kura ani hakilijagabɔ.
3. Sugu baara : Kɔnɔna barika ka bon ani kɛnɛma barika ka dɔgɔ, sɔngɔ danfara bɛ bonya
Kabini san 2025, jamana kɔnɔ cotton sɔngɔw ye “yɛrɛyɛrɛba ni kɔnɔna ni kɛnɛma danfara” cogoyaw jira. Politiki dɛmɛni n’a ka finiko tɔnw ka fɛnw bilali kɔfɛ, jamana kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw sɔngɔ bɛ ka wuli ka taa a fɛ, k’a sɔrɔ diɲɛ kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw sɔngɔ bɛ to ka dɔgɔya k’a sababu kɛ diɲɛ kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw sɔrɔli dɔgɔyali ye, o b’a to sɔngɔ danfara min bɛ jamana kɔnɔ ni jamana kɔkan sɛnɛfɛnw cɛ, o tɛmɛna yuan 3000 kan siɲɛ kelen.
Sinuwa cotton tɔn ka fɔ la, jamana ka cotton sɛnɛta bɛna kɛ tɔni miliyɔn 8,1 ye san 2025/26, o ye san o san caya ye ni 3,8% ye. Finiko yamaruyaw seginni kɛra sababu ye ka daminɛ hakɛ segin, wa jiri ni fini jɛmanw jatebɔw jigira ka se hakɛ bɛnnen ma.

4. Baarakɛda caman tigɛli : Hakilila nizɛri ni fɛn dilanni jɛlen bɛ kɛ fɛnba ye
K’u ɲɛsin ɲɔgɔndan kelen ma ani musaka degun ma, tɔnba ɲɛmɔgɔw bɛ ka teliya ka tɛmɛn "sɔngɔba, baarakɛcogo, sigida lakanani" siraw tilalenw fɛ :

Jiangsu Dasheng Group ye izini hakilitigi dɔ jɔ min tɛ gazi bɔ. Baarakɛlaw hakɛ dɔgɔyara jirisun 10000 kɔnɔ, ka se 10 ma, fanga min bɛ kɛ jirisun tɔni kelen na, o jigira ni 12% ye, wa jirisun in jogo sera diɲɛ kɔnɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 4825 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-03-03 04:26:46 CEST
Sinuwa jamana ka cotton finiko baara ye ladilanni juguw kɛ, fɛn caman tigɛli ani fɛn caman sɛmɛntiya ka bɔ san 2025 la ka se san 2026 ma, wa yiriwali bɛɛ lajɛlen taabolo ye "ka duguma jɔ degun kɔrɔ, ka sigicogo ɲuman kɛ, ani ka jogoɲumanya yiriwa Hali n’a y’a sɔrɔ gɛlɛyaw bɛ a kan i n’a fɔ kɛnɛyako ɲinini barika dɔgɔyali ani suguw ka ɲɔgɔndan fanga bonya, o baara in bɛ ka taa dɔɔnin dɔɔnin yiriwali siratigɛ kura la, politiki ɲɛminɛni fɛ, fɛɛrɛ kuraw ni fɛnkurabɔli fɛ.

1. Sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli bɛ ka bonya ka taa a fɛ, wa hali bi Sinjiang ye fɛn dilanni yɔrɔ koloma ye
San 2025, jamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw bɛɛ lajɛlen bɛna se tɔni miliyɔn 6,641 ma, o ye san o san caya ye ni 7,7% ye. Olu cɛma, Sinjiang ka sɔrɔ tɛmɛna tɔni miliyɔn 6,16 kan, o kɛra 92,8% ye jamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw bɛɛ lajɛlen na, ka t’a fɛ k’a jɔyɔrɔ sabati i n’a fɔ jamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw sɛnɛyɔrɔ ɲumanba.
San 2026, Sinjiang bɛna izini sariyasunba kura daminɛ. A bolodara ka dɔ bɔ cotton sɛnɛyɔrɔ la ni 10% ni kɔ ye, wa laɲini bɛna sabati ka se miliyɔn 36 ɲɔgɔn ma walasa ka degunw nɔgɔya minnu bɛ sɔrɔ kojuguba la ani ka sigida sabatili sabati.
Sɛgɛsɛgɛli fɔlɔ min kɛra Siniwajamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw tɔnba fɛ, o y’a jira ko sɛnɛyɔrɔ min laɲinina jamana kɔnɔ san 2026, o ye ɛkitɛri miliyɔn 44,583 ye, o ye san o san dɔgɔyali ye ni 0,5% ye. Dɔgɔyali in dɔgɔyara kosɛbɛ, o b’a jira ko suguw ka dannaya bɛ ka segin dɔɔnin dɔɔnin.

Google ye fasari min jira:
Sinuwa jamana ka cotton finiko baara ye ladilanni ni fɛn caman tigɛli caman kɛ k’a ta san 2025 la ka se san 2026 ma, ka yiriwali taabolo bɛɛ jira, n’o ye “degun ni sabatili faamuyali, sigicogo ɲuman, ani jogoɲumanya yiriwali.”. Hali n’a y’a sɔrɔ gɛlɛyaw bɛ a kan i n’a fɔ kɛnɛyako ɲinini barika dɔgɔyali ani suguw ka ɲɔgɔndan fanga bonya, o baara in bɛ ka taa dɔɔnin dɔɔnin yiriwali siratigɛ kura la, politiki ɲɛminɛni fɛ, fɛɛrɛ kuraw fɛ, ani fɛnkurabɔli fɛ.

I. Bɔli sabatilen ni dɔ farali dɔɔnin; Xinjiang Tora fɛn dilanni yɔrɔ koloma ye
San 2025, Siniwa jamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli bɛɛ lajɛlen sera tɔni miliyɔn 6,641 ma, o ye san o san caya ye ni 7,7% ye, ni Sinjiang ka sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli tɛmɛna tɔni miliyɔn 6,16 kan, o kɛra 92,8% ye jamana bɛɛ lajɛlen na, o ye a jɔyɔrɔ sabati ka t’a fɛ i n’a fɔ jamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw ni sɛnɛfɛnw sɛnɛyɔrɔ ɲumanba.

San 2026, Sinjiang ye izini sariyasunba kura daminɛ, a b’a fɛ ka dɔ bɔ cotton sɛnɛyɔrɔ la ni 10% ni kɔ ye, k’a laɲini k’a sabati ka se mu miliyɔn 36 ɲɔgɔn ma, walasa ka degun tɛmɛnenw dɔgɔya ani ka sigida sabatili sabati.

Sɛgɛsɛgɛli fɔlɔ minnu kɛra Sinuwa jamana kɔnɔ, olu y’a jira ko sɛnɛyɔrɔ min laɲininen don jamana kɔnɔ san 2026, o ye mu miliyɔn 44,583 ye, o ye san o san dɔgɔyali ye ni 0,5% ye, ni dɔgɔyali in bɛ dɔgɔya kosɛbɛ, o b’a jira ko suguw ka dannaya bɛ ka segin dɔɔnin dɔɔnin.

II. Politiki caman bɛ ka labɛn walasa ka izini cakɛda yiriwali sabati.

"Xinjiang finiko ni finiko izini yiriwali kuntaalajan ni waati jan kɔnɔ (2026-2035)" lajɛra ka sɔn a ma san 2026 daminɛ na, a ye sira ɲɛfɔ ka jɛya i n’a fɔ hakilijagabɔ, jirisunw falenni, ani jɛkafɔ, n’a laɲini ye ka kulu kura dɔ da finiko baarakɛlaw ye minnu bɛ da tilebin fɛ.

Xinjiang ye "Politiki fɛɛrɛ kɔnɔntɔn" bɔ kɛnɛ kan, ka dɔ fara wariko dɛmɛ kan ka ɲɛsin fɛn labanw dilannikɛlaw ma, fɛɛrɛko caman tigɛli porozɛw, ani jirisunw feereli, ka dusu don baarakɛlaw kɔnɔ u ka wuli ka bɔ cotton sɔgɔli la ka taa fɛnw na minnu nafa ka bon i n’a fɔ jiri ɲagaminenw ani jiriw hakɛ caman sɔgɔlenw.

K’a daminɛ san 2026 zuluyekalo la, jamana ɲɛmɔgɔso min ɲɛsinnen bɛ suguya labɛnni ma, o bɛna "Fɛɛrɛ minnu bɛ kɛ walasa ka fiɲɛw labɛncogo ɲuman kɔlɔsi" ani sariya wajibiyalen GB 18383-2025, n’o bɛna sinsin fɛnw kɔlɔsili kan i n’a fɔ denmisɛnninw ka finiw, lakɔli finiw, ani duguma jakitew, ka fiɲɛw labɛnni bali kosɛbɛ, ani ka iziniw sɛnɛcogo kura ni dɔ farala a hakili la.

III. Sugu baara : Dugu kɔnɔ sugu barikama, Dugukolo kan sugu barikama, Sɔngɔko danfara bonya

Kabini san 2025, jamana kɔnɔ cotton sɔngɔw ye jogo jira min ye "yɛrɛyɛrɛba ni danfara ye jamana kɔnɔ ani diɲɛ suguw cɛ." Politiki dɛmɛni ni finiko tɔnw ka fɛnw falenfalenni sababu fɛ, jamana kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw sɔngɔ tora ka wuli, k’a sɔrɔ diɲɛ kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw sɔngɔ tora ka dɔgɔya k’a sababu kɛ diɲɛ kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw sɔrɔli caya ye, o kɛra sababu ye ka sɔngɔ danfara don jamana kɔnɔ ni diɲɛ kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw cɛ, n’o tun tɛmɛna yuan 3000 kan fɔlɔ.

Sinuwa cotton Association ka fɔ la, jamana ka cotton sɛnɛta san 2025/26 kɔnɔ, a jirala ko a bɛna se tɔni miliyɔn 8,1 ma, o ye san o san caya ye ni 3,8% ye. Finiko yamaruyaw seginni kɛra sababu ye ka baarakɛcogo hakɛ segin a cogo kɔrɔ la, wa jiriw ni fini jɛmanw jatebɔw jigira ka se hakɛ bɛnnen ma.

IV. Baarakɛda caman tigɛli : Nizɛrikan na ani fɛn dilanni jɛlenw kɛra fɛnba ye

K’u ɲɛsin ɲɔgɔndan kelen ma ani musaka degunw ma, baarakɛda ɲɛmɔgɔw bɛ ka u ka ɲɛtaa teliya "jate ka ca, baarakɛcogo, ani sigida lakanani" suguya kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw na :

Jiangsu Dasheng kulu ye izini hakilitigi dɔ jɔ min tɛ gazi bɔ, ka baarakɛlaw hakɛ dɔgɔya jirisun 10000 kelen na ka se mɔgɔ 10 ma, ka fanga tacogo dɔgɔya jiri tɔni kelen na ni 12% ye, ani ka jiri suguya caman sɔrɔ diɲɛ kɔnɔ.

Hali n’a y’a sɔrɔ gɛlɛyaw bɛ a kan i n’a fɔ kɔkanna ɲinini dɔgɔyali ani suguw ka ɲɔgɔndan gɛlɛyaw, i k'a dɔn dilanni a bɛ k'a ɲɛsin kolonkolonli la dɔɔnin dɔɔnin ka taa cogoya kura fan fɛ ka bɔ ɲɛ yiriwali kɔrɔtali la, ka bɔ ɲɛsinfanw fɛɛrɛw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ, ani kokurabɔw minu ye fɛɛrɛbɔw ye ani ka binkɛnɛ yɛlɛma.

Fɔlɔ. Bɔli sabatilen ani dɔɔnin farali; Xinjiang Tora bɔli yɔrɔ koloma ye
San 2025, Siniwa jamana ka kɔɔri bɔli bɛɛ lajɛlen sera tɔni miliyɔn 6,641 ma, o ye san o san caya ye ni 7,7% ye, yɔrɔla Sinjiang ka kɔɔri bɔli tɛmɛna tɔni miliyɔn 6,16 kan, o kɛra 92,8% ye jamana ta bɛɛ lajɛlen na, o ye a jɔyɔrɔ sinsin ka t’a fɛ i n’a fɔ jamana ka ɲɛmaa kɔɔri kama minu ɲɛ kɔrɔtalen don ani kɔɔri falen.

San 2026, Sinjiang ye taama kura daminɛ, ka bɔ kɔɔri dilanyɔrɔw labɛnni na, ni laɲini ye ka kɔɔri sɛnɛyɔrɔ dɔgɔya ni 10% ni kɔ ye, k’a laɲini k’a sabati ka se mu miliyɔn 36 ɲɔgɔn ma, walasa ka degun tɛmɛnenw dɔgɔya ani ka sigida mɛli kafo.

Sɛgɛsɛgɛli fɔlɔ minnu kɛra Sinuwa jamana ka kɔɔri tɔnw fɛ, olu y’a jira ko kɛnɛ min laɲininen don ka sɛnɛ jamana fan bɛɛ la san 2026, o ye mu miliyɔn 44,583 ye, o ye san o san dɔgɔyali ye ni 0,5% ye, nin dɔgɔyali in bɛ dɔgɔya kosɛbɛ, o b’a jira ko suguw ka dannaya bɛ ka segin dɔɔnin dɔɔnin.

Filanan. tugu tuguli bɛ ka waleya ka bɔ Fɛɛrɛw la walasa ka dilannikɛyɔrɔw ka bɔli tugu tuguli yiriwa.

Wa a lajɛra kokura"Xinjiang ka yiriwali bolodalen cɛmancɛ ni waati jan kɔnɔ Gese ni finiw dilanni kama (2026-2035)" ani k'a banban san 2026 daminɛ 
na,o min ye a ɲɛfɔ k'a jɛya  ɲisinna ka taa hakilidiya fan fɛ, ani mɛli, ni dafali, n’a laɲini ye ka ɲɛkun kura dɔ jɔ Gese dilanni kama min dayɛlɛlen don tilebin jamanaw kan.

Xinjiang ye'' dabali fɛɛrɛ kɔnɔntɔn" bɔ kɛnɛ kan, O bɛ laɲini kɛ ka dɔ fara wariko dɛmɛ kan ka ɲɛsin bɔtaw labanw dilannikɛlaw ma, ani ka fɛɛrɛko baarabolodalenw yɛlɛma, ani ka Gese minu ɲɛ kɔrɔtalen don k'o feere, ka dusu don cakɛda, kɔnɔ u ka wuli ka bɔ kɔɔri falen na ka taa bɔtaw la minnu ni dɔ faralen don u sanga kan an'a kɔrɔtalen don.

daminɛni na ka bɔ san 2026 zuluyekalo la, jamana ka suguw ɲɛnabɔli jɛkulu bɛna a daminɛ ni bɔko kura jaakuyali ka bɔ " Kɔlɔsili Fɛɛrɛw fuw bɔta ɲɛ kan ani k'a ɲɛnabɔ" ani sariya wajibiyalen GB 18383-2025, ani ka sinsin kɔlɔsili kan bɔtaw la i n’a fɔ denmisɛnninw ka finiw, kalanso masiriw, ani fonɛnɛ na suturaw, ani fuw labaarali bali minnu bɛ segin ka kɛ fɛn wɛrɛw ye ni cogoya gɛlɛn ye , ani ka sinsin dilanni kɛcogo kura kan ani dɔ faralali ye a banbanni kan.

Sabanan. Sugu baara masinw: sigida sugu kɔgɔlen don, jamana ka sugu fanga ka dɔgɔ, Sɔngɔw furancɛ fɛrɛlen 

Kabini san 2025, sigida ka kɔɔri sɔngɔw taamasiyɛnnen don ni "yɛlɛmaliw ye Minnu fɛrɛlen don ani danfaraw sugu fila ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ sigida ta ani diɲɛ ta." Ni Gofɛrɛnɛman ka dɛmɛ sababu ye ani Gese tɔnw ka fɛnw falenfalenni sababu ye, jamana kɔnɔ kɔɔri sɔngɔw tora ka wuli, k’a sɔrɔ diɲɛ kɔnɔ kɔɔri sɔngɔw tora ka dɔgɔya k’a sababu kɛ diɲɛ kɔnɔ kɔɔri sɔrɔli caya ye, O kɛra sababu ye ka sɔngɔ danfara don Sigida ni diɲɛ kɔɔri cɛ O tɛmɛna waati dɔ la ka bɔ waatiw la yuan 3000 kan tɔni kelen na.

Ka kɛɲɛ ni Sinuwa kɔɔritɔn ka fɔta ye, a bɛ ka bɔ jigiyaw la k'a fɔ ko jamana ka kɔɔri baarata 2025/26 waati kɔnɔ,  ko a bɛna se tɔni miliyɔn 8,1 ma, o ye san o san caya ye ni 3,8% ye. Gese ɲinini ɲɛnamayali kɛra sababu ye ka baarakɛcogo hakɛ ɲɛnamaya a cogo kɔrɔ la, wa falen marataw dɔgɔyara ani Gese ni finimugu gɛrɛgɛrɛ ka taa se hakɛw la min bɛnnen don.

Naaninan. Baarakɛda caman yɛlɛmara: jatedenya  ani binkɛnɛ dilanni O fila y'u dugujɛ ka ka bɔ sinsinna jɔnjɔnw na.

 Ɲɔgɔndan gɛlɛn suma na ani musaka degunw na, baarakɛdabaw bɛ ka u ka ɲɛtaa teliya ka bɔ a ka fɛn kuraw teliya la suguw la"juruw minnu ɲɛ kɔrɔtalen don, an' a baarakɛcogo, ani teri don sigida ye":

Jiangsu Dasheng kulu ye jɔli kɛ dilannikɛyɔrɔ dɔ la min hakili ka di Falen dali la min bɛ karɔbɔni bɛrɛ bɛn, O kɛra sababu ye ka baarakɛlaw jateda dɔgɔya falen dalan 10000 O  10000   la ka se min ka mɔgɔ ni 10 ye, ka fanga tacogo dɔgɔya tɔni kelen na ka bɔ juruw la ni 12% hakɛ ye, ani ka lakikayali kɛ juruw ɲɛ na min ye ɲɛtaa sɔrɔ diɲɛ kɔnɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 4827 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-03-03 04:24:27 CEST
Jiangsu Dasheng Group ye izini hakilitigi dɔ jɔ min tɛ gazi bɔ. Baarakɛlaw hakɛ dɔgɔyara jirisun 10000 kɔnɔ, ka se 10 ma, fanga min bɛ kɛ jirisun tɔni kelen na, o jigira ni 12% ye, wa jirisun in jogo sera diɲɛ kɔnɔ.

Naaninan. Baarakɛda caman yɛlɛmara: jatedenya  ani binkɛnɛ dilanni O fila y'u dugujɛ ka ka bɔ sinsinna jɔnjɔnw na.

 Ɲɔgɔndan gɛlɛn suma na ani musaka degunw na, baarakɛdabaw bɛ ka u ka ɲɛtaa teliya ka bɔ a ka fɛn kuraw teliya la suguw la"juruw minnu ɲɛ kɔrɔtalen don, an' a baarakɛcogo, ani teri don sigida ye":

Jiangsu Dasheng kulu ye jɔli kɛ dilannikɛyɔrɔ dɔ la min hakili ka di Falen dali la min bɛ karɔbɔni bɛrɛ bɛn, O kɛra sababu ye ka baarakɛlaw jateda dɔgɔya falen dalan 10000 O  10000   la ka se min ka mɔgɔ ni 10 ye, ka fanga tacogo dɔgɔya tɔni kelen na ka bɔ juruw la ni 12% hakɛ ye, ani ka lakikayali kɛ juruw ɲɛ na min ye ɲɛtaa sɔrɔ diɲɛ kɔnɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 4834 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-03-03 04:04:38 CEST
Kɔɔri Geseko dilanyɔrɔw ye yeli kɛ Sinuwa jamana na  tugu tuguli la ka bɔ bɛrɛbɛnw na ani yɛlɛmaliw min ka dun kosɛbɛ san 2025 ani 2026, yiriwali taabolo Bɛɛjɛfanga jirali la, ka ɲɛsin “Degunw faamuyali, cɛsiriw faralen ɲɔgɔn kan, ani sigicogo ɲɛnabɔli, an' a ɲɛ hakɛ kɔrɔtali.”. Hali n’a y’a sɔrɔ gɛlɛyaw bɛ a kan i n’a fɔ kɔkanna ɲinini dɔgɔyali ani suguw ka ɲɔgɔndan gɛlɛyaw, i k'a dɔn dilanni a bɛ k'a ɲɛsin kolonkolonli la dɔɔnin dɔɔnin ka taa cogoya kura fan fɛ ka bɔ ɲɛ yiriwali kɔrɔtali la, ka bɔ ɲɛsinfanw fɛɛrɛw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ, ani kokurabɔw minu ye fɛɛrɛbɔw ye ani ka binkɛnɛ yɛlɛma.

Fɔlɔ. Bɔli sabatilen ani dɔɔnin farali; Xinjiang Tora bɔli yɔrɔ koloma ye
San 2025, Siniwa jamana ka kɔɔri bɔli bɛɛ lajɛlen sera tɔni miliyɔn 6,641 ma, o ye san o san caya ye ni 7,7% ye, yɔrɔla Sinjiang ka kɔɔri bɔli tɛmɛna tɔni miliyɔn 6,16 kan, o kɛra 92,8% ye jamana ta bɛɛ lajɛlen na, o ye a jɔyɔrɔ sinsin ka t’a fɛ i n’a fɔ jamana ka ɲɛmaa kɔɔri kama minu ɲɛ kɔrɔtalen don ani kɔɔri falen.

San 2026, Sinjiang ye taama kura daminɛ, ka bɔ kɔɔri dilanyɔrɔw labɛnni na, ni laɲini ye ka kɔɔri sɛnɛyɔrɔ dɔgɔya ni 10% ni kɔ ye, k’a laɲini k’a sabati ka se mu miliyɔn 36 ɲɔgɔn ma, walasa ka degun tɛmɛnenw dɔgɔya ani ka sigida mɛli kafo.

Sɛgɛsɛgɛli fɔlɔ minnu kɛra Sinuwa jamana ka kɔɔri tɔnw fɛ, olu y’a jira ko kɛnɛ min laɲininen don ka sɛnɛ jamana fan bɛɛ la san 2026, o ye mu miliyɔn 44,583 ye, o ye san o san dɔgɔyali ye ni 0,5% ye, nin dɔgɔyali in bɛ dɔgɔya kosɛbɛ, o b’a jira ko suguw ka dannaya bɛ ka segin dɔɔnin dɔɔnin.

Filanan. tugu tuguli bɛ ka waleya ka bɔ Fɛɛrɛw la walasa ka dilannikɛyɔrɔw ka bɔli tugu tuguli yiriwa.

Wa a lajɛra kokura"Xinjiang ka yiriwali bolodalen cɛmancɛ ni waati jan kɔnɔ Gese ni finiw dilanni kama (2026-2035)" ani k'a banban san 2026 daminɛ 
na,o min ye a ɲɛfɔ k'a jɛya  ɲisinna ka taa hakilidiya fan fɛ, ani mɛli, ni dafali, n’a laɲini ye ka ɲɛkun kura dɔ jɔ Gese dilanni kama min dayɛlɛlen don tilebin jamanaw kan.

Xinjiang ye'' dabali fɛɛrɛ kɔnɔntɔn" bɔ kɛnɛ kan, O bɛ laɲini kɛ ka dɔ fara wariko dɛmɛ kan ka ɲɛsin bɔtaw labanw dilannikɛlaw ma, ani ka fɛɛrɛko baarabolodalenw yɛlɛma, ani ka Gese minu ɲɛ kɔrɔtalen don k'o feere, ka dusu don cakɛda, kɔnɔ u ka wuli ka bɔ kɔɔri falen na ka taa bɔtaw la minnu ni dɔ faralen don u sanga kan an'a kɔrɔtalen don.

daminɛni na ka bɔ san 2026 zuluyekalo la, jamana ka suguw ɲɛnabɔli jɛkulu bɛna a daminɛ ni bɔko kura jaakuyali ka bɔ " Kɔlɔsili Fɛɛrɛw fuw bɔta ɲɛ kan ani k'a ɲɛnabɔ" ani sariya wajibiyalen GB 18383-2025, ani ka sinsin kɔlɔsili kan bɔtaw la i n’a fɔ denmisɛnninw ka finiw, kalanso masiriw, ani fonɛnɛ na suturaw, ani fuw labaarali bali minnu bɛ segin ka kɛ fɛn wɛrɛw ye ni cogoya gɛlɛn ye , ani ka sinsin dilanni kɛcogo kura kan ani dɔ faralali ye a banbanni kan.

Sabanan. Sugu baara masinw: sigida sugu kɔgɔlen don, jamana ka sugu fanga ka dɔgɔ, Sɔngɔw furancɛ fɛrɛlen

Mali Jamanakuntigiya

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 4936 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-03-02 12:06:30 CEST
Sinuwa jamana ka cotton finiko baara ye ladilanni juguw kɛ, fɛn caman tigɛli ani fɛn caman sɛmɛntiya ka bɔ san 2025 la ka se san 2026 ma, wa yiriwali bɛɛ lajɛlen taabolo ye "ka duguma jɔ degun kɔrɔ, ka sigicogo ɲuman kɛ, ani ka jogoɲumanya yiriwa Hali n’a y’a sɔrɔ gɛlɛyaw bɛ a kan i n’a fɔ kɛnɛyako ɲinini barika dɔgɔyali ani suguw ka ɲɔgɔndan fanga bonya, o baara in bɛ ka taa dɔɔnin dɔɔnin yiriwali siratigɛ kura la, politiki ɲɛminɛni fɛ, fɛɛrɛ kuraw ni fɛnkurabɔli fɛ.

1. Sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli bɛ ka bonya ka taa a fɛ, wa hali bi Sinjiang ye fɛn dilanni yɔrɔ koloma ye
San 2025, jamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw bɛɛ lajɛlen bɛna se tɔni miliyɔn 6,641 ma, o ye san o san caya ye ni 7,7% ye. Olu cɛma, Sinjiang ka sɔrɔ tɛmɛna tɔni miliyɔn 6,16 kan, o kɛra 92,8% ye jamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw bɛɛ lajɛlen na, ka t’a fɛ k’a jɔyɔrɔ sabati i n’a fɔ jamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw sɛnɛyɔrɔ ɲumanba.
San 2026, Sinjiang bɛna izini sariyasunba kura daminɛ. A bolodara ka dɔ bɔ cotton sɛnɛyɔrɔ la ni 10% ni kɔ ye, wa laɲini bɛna sabati ka se miliyɔn 36 ɲɔgɔn ma walasa ka degunw nɔgɔya minnu bɛ sɔrɔ kojuguba la ani ka sigida sabatili sabati.
Sɛgɛsɛgɛli fɔlɔ min kɛra Siniwajamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw tɔnba fɛ, o y’a jira ko sɛnɛyɔrɔ min laɲinina jamana kɔnɔ san 2026, o ye ɛkitɛri miliyɔn 44,583 ye, o ye san o san dɔgɔyali ye ni 0,5% ye. Dɔgɔyali in dɔgɔyara kosɛbɛ, o b’a jira ko suguw ka dannaya bɛ ka segin dɔɔnin dɔɔnin.

2. Politikibaw bɛ don sen kan walasa ka izini cakɛda yiriwali sabati
"Sinjiang ka finiko ni finiko yiriwali bolodalen cɛmancɛ ni kuntaalajan (2026-2035)" lajɛra ka sɔn a ma san 2026 daminɛ na. A jɛlen don ko a sinsinnen bɛ hakilijagabɔ, jirisunw falenni, ani jɛkafɔ kan walasa ka kulu kura dɔ da finiko baarakɛyɔrɔ ye min bɛ da tilebin fɛ.
Xinjiang ye "Politiki ni fɛɛrɛ kɔnɔntɔn" bɔ walasa ka dɔ fara wariko dɛmɛ kan ka ɲɛsin fɛn labanw dilanni baarakɛda ma, fɛɛrɛko caman tigɛli porozɛw ani jirisunw feereli sanfɛtaw, ani ka dusu don baarakɛdabaw kɔnɔ u ka wuli ka bɔ cotton sɔgɔli la ka taa jiri ɲagaminenw na, minnu bɛ sɔgɔsɔgɔ, minnu jate ka bon ani fɛn wɛrɛw minnu nafa ka bon.
K’a daminɛ san 2026 zuluyekalo la, jamana ɲɛmɔgɔso min ɲɛsinnen bɛ suguya labɛnni ma, o bɛna "Fibre Products Quality Supervision and Management Measures" ni GB 18383-2025 wajibiyalen sariya kura in waleya, k’a sinsin fɛnw kɔlɔsili kan i n’a fɔ denmisɛnninw ka finiw, lakɔli finiw, duguma jakitew, a ɲɔgɔnnaw, ka fiyɛriw baaracogo bali kosɛbɛ, ani ka iziniw labɛncogo kura ani hakilijagabɔ.
3. Sugu baara : Kɔnɔna barika ka bon ani kɛnɛma barika ka dɔgɔ, sɔngɔ danfara bɛ bonya
Kabini san 2025, jamana kɔnɔ cotton sɔngɔw ye “yɛrɛyɛrɛba ni kɔnɔna ni kɛnɛma danfara” cogoyaw jira. Politiki dɛmɛni n’a ka finiko tɔnw ka fɛnw bilali kɔfɛ, jamana kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw sɔngɔ bɛ ka wuli ka taa a fɛ, k’a sɔrɔ diɲɛ kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw sɔngɔ bɛ to ka dɔgɔya k’a sababu kɛ diɲɛ kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw sɔrɔli dɔgɔyali ye, o b’a to sɔngɔ danfara min bɛ jamana kɔnɔ ni jamana kɔkan sɛnɛfɛnw cɛ, o tɛmɛna yuan 3000 kan siɲɛ kelen.
Sinuwa cotton tɔn ka fɔ la, jamana ka cotton sɛnɛta bɛna kɛ tɔni miliyɔn 8,1 ye san 2025/26, o ye san o san caya ye ni 3,8% ye. Finiko yamaruyaw seginni kɛra sababu ye ka daminɛ hakɛ segin, wa jiri ni fini jɛmanw jatebɔw jigira ka se hakɛ bɛnnen ma.

4. Baarakɛda caman tigɛli : Hakilila nizɛri ni fɛn dilanni jɛlen bɛ kɛ fɛnba ye
K’u ɲɛsin ɲɔgɔndan kelen ma ani musaka degun ma, tɔnba ɲɛmɔgɔw bɛ ka teliya ka tɛmɛn "sɔngɔba, baarakɛcogo, sigida lakanani" siraw tilalenw fɛ :

Jiangsu Dasheng Group ye izini hakilitigi dɔ jɔ min tɛ gazi bɔ. Baarakɛlaw hakɛ dɔgɔyara jirisun 10000 kɔnɔ, ka se 10 ma, fanga min bɛ kɛ jirisun tɔni kelen na, o jigira ni 12% ye, wa jirisun in jogo sera diɲɛ kɔnɔ.
Baarakɛda minnu bɛ i n’a fɔ Weiqiao Textile ani Xinhuayuan Group, olu ye dɔ fara u ka wari bilali kan ɲinini ni yiriwali la walasa ka fɛn kuraw labɛn i n’a fɔ baarakɛtaw ɲagaminenw ani fiyɛri jɛmanw minnu bɛ segin ka kɛ fɛn wɛrɛw ye walasa ka dɔ fara u ka fɛn dilannenw nafa faralen kan.
Nafolo basigilenw bilali baara in na, o bɛ ka bonya ka taa a fɛ. San 2025, wari bilali kemikɛli fiyɛri baarakɛyɔrɔ la, o bɛna bonya ni san o san hakɛ ye 12,3%, ni tɔnw tilancɛ ni kɔ bɛna u sinsin fɛn dilanni seko yiriwali n’a yiriwali kan.
5. Gɛlɛyaw ni jigiyaw
Hali ni o baara in bɛ muɲuli jira, a bɛ degun caman sɔrɔ hali bi:

Fɛnɲɛnɛmako tɔnw ka baarakɛnafolo tɔnɔ hakɛ min bɛ tɛmɛ hakɛ dantigɛlen kan, o ye 3,5% dɔrɔn ye, o jigira ni kɛmɛsarada la 0,3 ye ka tɛmɛ san tɛmɛnnen ta kan, wa baarakɛcogo ɲuman bɛ degun kɔnɔ
Baarakɛda misɛnninw ni baarakɛda cɛmancɛw bɛ tɛmɛ 60% kan. Sariyasen kura in waleyali kɔfɛ, a jirala ko 10%-15% bɛna bɔ yen k’a sababu kɛ sariya labatoli musakabaw ye, wa iziniw ka caya bɛna caya ka taa a fɛ ;
Coton jan kɔrɔlenw bɛ tali kɛ jamana wɛrɛw la kosɛbɛ, wa nafa faralen dɔgɔyali gɛlɛya min bɛ izini cakɛda la, o ka kan ka ɲɛnabɔ hali bi.
Ka san 2026 makɔnɔ, n’o ye « san duuru bolodalen 15nan » san fɔlɔ ye, bɔgɔdaga dilanni bɛna t’a fɛ ka « jogoɲumanya bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli nɔ bila sɛgɛsɛgɛli nɔ na » fɛn caman tigɛli fɛɛrɛbɔ siratigɛ la, politiki siratigɛ la, k’a sinsin fɛɛrɛ kuraw kan, ka taamasiyɛnw jɔ ani ka gazi jɛlen ni kabon dɔgɔya, ani ka bi izini siratigɛ jɔ min bɛ se ka muɲu kosɛbɛ ani min bɛ se ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ.

Yala aw b’a fɛ n ka Cotton Textile Industry Policy and Market Trend Summary Document dɔ labɛn aw ye san 2026 kɔnɔ, walasa aw ka se ka kunnafoni jɔnjɔnw minɛ joona wa?

Sinuwa jamana ka cotton finiko baara ye ladilanni juguw kɛ, fɛn caman tigɛli ani fɛn caman sɛmɛntiya ka bɔ san 2025 la ka se san 2026 ma, wa yiriwali bɛɛ lajɛlen taabolo ye "ka duguma jɔ degun kɔrɔ, ka sigicogo ɲuman kɛ, ani ka jogoɲumanya yiriwa Hali n’a y’a sɔrɔ gɛlɛyaw bɛ a kan i n’a fɔ kɛnɛyako ɲinini barika dɔgɔyali ani suguw ka ɲɔgɔndan fanga bonya, o baara in bɛ ka taa dɔɔnin dɔɔnin yiriwali siratigɛ kura la, politiki ɲɛminɛni fɛ, fɛɛrɛ kuraw ni fɛnkurabɔli fɛ.

1. Sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli bɛ ka bonya ka taa a fɛ, wa hali bi Sinjiang ye fɛn dilanni yɔrɔ koloma ye
San 2025, jamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw bɛɛ lajɛlen bɛna se tɔni miliyɔn 6,641 ma, o ye san o san caya ye ni 7,7% ye. Olu cɛma, Sinjiang ka sɔrɔ tɛmɛna tɔni miliyɔn 6,16 kan, o kɛra 92,8% ye jamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw bɛɛ lajɛlen na, ka t’a fɛ k’a jɔyɔrɔ sabati i n’a fɔ jamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw sɛnɛyɔrɔ ɲumanba.
San 2026, Sinjiang bɛna izini sariyasunba kura daminɛ. A bolodara ka dɔ bɔ cotton sɛnɛyɔrɔ la ni 10% ni kɔ ye, wa laɲini bɛna sabati ka se miliyɔn 36 ɲɔgɔn ma walasa ka degunw nɔgɔya minnu bɛ sɔrɔ kojuguba la ani ka sigida sabatili sabati.
Sɛgɛsɛgɛli fɔlɔ min kɛra Siniwajamana ka sɛnɛfɛnw tɔnba fɛ, o y’a jira ko sɛnɛyɔrɔ min laɲinina jamana kɔnɔ san 2026, o ye ɛkitɛri miliyɔn 44,583 ye, o ye san o san dɔgɔyali ye ni 0,5% ye. Dɔgɔyali in dɔgɔyara kosɛbɛ, o b’a jira ko suguw ka dannaya bɛ ka segin dɔɔnin dɔɔnin.

2. Politikibaw bɛ don sen kan walasa ka izini cakɛda yiriwali sabati
"Sinjiang ka finiko ni finiko yiriwali bolodalen cɛmancɛ ni kuntaalajan (2026-2035)" lajɛra ka sɔn a ma san 2026 daminɛ na. A jɛlen don ko a sinsinnen bɛ hakilijagabɔ, jirisunw falenni, ani jɛkafɔ kan walasa ka kulu kura dɔ da finiko baarakɛyɔrɔ ye min bɛ da tilebin fɛ.
Xinjiang ye "Politiki ni fɛɛrɛ kɔnɔntɔn" bɔ walasa ka dɔ fara wariko dɛmɛ kan ka ɲɛsin fɛn labanw dilanni baarakɛda ma, fɛɛrɛko caman tigɛli porozɛw ani jirisunw feereli sanfɛtaw, ani ka dusu don baarakɛdabaw kɔnɔ u ka wuli ka bɔ cotton sɔgɔli la ka taa jiri ɲagaminenw na, minnu bɛ sɔgɔsɔgɔ, minnu jate ka bon ani fɛn wɛrɛw minnu nafa ka bon.
K’a daminɛ san 2026 zuluyekalo la, jamana ɲɛmɔgɔso min ɲɛsinnen bɛ suguya labɛnni ma, o bɛna "Fibre Products Quality Supervision and Management Measures" ni GB 18383-2025 wajibiyalen sariya kura in waleya, k’a sinsin fɛnw kɔlɔsili kan i n’a fɔ denmisɛnninw ka finiw, lakɔli finiw, duguma jakitew, a ɲɔgɔnnaw, ka fiyɛriw baaracogo bali kosɛbɛ, ani ka iziniw labɛncogo kura ani hakilijagabɔ.
3. Sugu baara : Kɔnɔna barika ka bon ani kɛnɛma barika ka dɔgɔ, sɔngɔ danfara bɛ bonya
Kabini san 2025, jamana kɔnɔ cotton sɔngɔw ye “yɛrɛyɛrɛba ni kɔnɔna ni kɛnɛma danfara” cogoyaw jira. Politiki dɛmɛni n’a ka finiko tɔnw ka fɛnw bilali kɔfɛ, jamana kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw sɔngɔ bɛ ka wuli ka taa a fɛ, k’a sɔrɔ diɲɛ kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw sɔngɔ bɛ to ka dɔgɔya k’a sababu kɛ diɲɛ kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw sɔrɔli dɔgɔyali ye, o b’a to sɔngɔ danfara min bɛ jamana kɔnɔ ni jamana kɔkan sɛnɛfɛnw cɛ, o tɛmɛna yuan 3000 kan siɲɛ kelen.
Sinuwa cotton tɔn ka fɔ la, jamana ka cotton sɛnɛta bɛna kɛ tɔni miliyɔn 8,1 ye san 2025/26, o ye san o san caya ye ni 3,8% ye. Finiko yamaruyaw seginni kɛra sababu ye ka daminɛ hakɛ segin, wa jiri ni fini jɛmanw jatebɔw jigira ka se hakɛ bɛnnen ma.

4. Baarakɛda caman tigɛli : Hakilila nizɛri ni fɛn dilanni jɛlen bɛ kɛ fɛnba ye
K’u ɲɛsin ɲɔgɔndan kelen ma ani musaka degun ma, tɔnba ɲɛmɔgɔw bɛ ka teliya ka tɛmɛn "sɔngɔba, baarakɛcogo, sigida lakanani" siraw tilalenw fɛ :

Jiangsu Dasheng Group ye izini hakilitigi dɔ jɔ min tɛ gazi bɔ. Baarakɛlaw hakɛ dɔgɔyara jirisun 10000 kɔnɔ, ka se 10 ma, fanga min bɛ kɛ jirisun tɔni kelen na, o jigira ni 12% ye, wa jirisun in jogo sera diɲɛ kɔnɔ.
Baarakɛda minnu bɛ i n’a fɔ Weiqiao Textile ani Xinhuayuan Group, olu ye dɔ fara u ka wari bilali kan ɲinini ni yiriwali la walasa ka fɛn kuraw labɛn i n’a fɔ baarakɛtaw ɲagaminenw ani fiyɛri jɛmanw minnu bɛ segin ka kɛ fɛn wɛrɛw ye walasa ka dɔ fara u ka fɛn dilannenw nafa faralen kan.
Nafolo basigilenw bilali baara in na, o bɛ ka bonya ka taa a fɛ. San 2025, wari bilali kemikɛli fiyɛri baarakɛyɔrɔ la, o bɛna bonya ni san o san hakɛ ye 12,3%, ni tɔnw tilancɛ ni kɔ bɛna u sinsin fɛn dilanni seko yiriwali n’a yiriwali kan.
5. Gɛlɛyaw ni jigiyaw
Hali ni o baara in bɛ muɲuli jira, a bɛ degun caman sɔrɔ hali bi:

Fɛnɲɛnɛmako tɔnw ka baarakɛnafolo tɔnɔ hakɛ min bɛ tɛmɛ hakɛ dantigɛlen kan, o ye 3,5% dɔrɔn ye, o jigira ni kɛmɛsarada la 0,3 ye ka tɛmɛ san tɛmɛnnen ta kan, wa baarakɛcogo ɲuman bɛ degun kɔnɔ
Baarakɛda misɛnninw ni baarakɛda cɛmancɛw bɛ tɛmɛ 60% kan. Sariyasen kura in waleyali kɔfɛ, a jirala ko 10%-15% bɛna bɔ yen k’a sababu kɛ sariya labatoli musakabaw ye, wa iziniw ka caya bɛna caya ka taa a fɛ ;
Coton jan kɔrɔlenw bɛ tali kɛ jamana wɛrɛw la kosɛbɛ, wa nafa faralen dɔgɔyali gɛlɛya min bɛ izini cakɛda la, o ka kan ka ɲɛnabɔ hali bi.
Ka san 2026 makɔnɔ, n’o ye « san duuru bolodalen 15nan » san fɔlɔ ye, bɔgɔdaga dilanni bɛna t’a fɛ ka « jogoɲumanya bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli nɔ bila sɛgɛsɛgɛli nɔ na » fɛn caman tigɛli fɛɛrɛbɔ siratigɛ la, politiki siratigɛ la, k’a sinsin fɛɛrɛ kuraw kan, ka taamasiyɛnw jɔ ani ka gazi jɛlen ni kabon dɔgɔya, ani ka bi izini siratigɛ jɔ min bɛ se ka muɲu kosɛbɛ ani min bɛ se ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ.

Yala aw b’a fɛ n ka Cotton Textile Industry Policy and Market Trend Summary Document dɔ labɛn aw ye san 2026 kɔnɔ, walasa aw ka se ka kunnafoni jɔnjɔnw minɛ joona wa?

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 4950 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-03-01 20:01:57 CEST
Awirilikalo tile 3 san 2025, cotton sɛnɛkɛla dɔ ka bɔ Moulton, Alabama, y’a haminankow fɔ Trump ka fanga ka tarifu kura sigili kan, tile kelen a kɛlen kɔ ka min wele ko “Hɔrɔnya don”. 

Nin wale in yɔrɔ kolomaw:
Lagɛlɛya jatebɔw kan : Sɛnɛkɛla ye sigasiga jira tarifu bɛna jate cogo min na fɛnw na minnu bɛ taa jamana wɛrɛw la, Ameriki cotton bɛ minnu na, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la bɛnkanw kɔnɔ i n’a fɔ CAFTA walima CUSMA (MCA).
Supply chain impact : Hali n’a yɛrɛ ka fɛn dilannenw bɛ dilan 100% Ameriki, a bɛ hami ko tarifuw bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka jago gɛlɛya ka taa a fɛ. Nka, a jigi b’a kan ko a bɛna dusu don jamana kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw na ani ka U.S. mansin caman sɔrɔ walasa ka sigida cotton baara.
Sɔrɔko gɛlɛya : Nin ɲininkali in kɛra waati min na sɛnɛko tun bɛ kaban ka sɛnɛ musaka caman sɔrɔ ani nafa zeru sɛnɛfɛnbaw la kabini san 2022. 

Yɛlɛma wɛrɛw (2025-2026):
Dɛmɛ kɔrɔtɔlen : Jagokɛlaw ka waleɲumandɔn ɲɛkɔrɔ, gɔfɛrɛnaman ye dɔrɔmɛ miliyari 12 ɲɔgɔn bɔ fɛnw jiginni sara la (FBA ani Bridge porogaramuw) walasa ka sɛnɛkɛlaw dɛmɛ minnu tɔɔrɔla.
Bɛnkanw ni tiɲɛniw : San 2025 nowanburukalo la, bɛnkan min kɛra ni Sinuwa ye, o kɛra sababu ye ka tarifu caman jɔ minnu bɛ kɛ ka mɔgɔw sara, Pekin y’a yɛrɛ bila ka soja hakɛ caman san.
Kiiritigɛlaw ka latigɛ : San 2026 feburuyekalo la, Kiiritigɛsoba ye o sariyaba dɔw bɔ yen, ka dɛmɛ don sɛnɛkɛminɛnw musakaw la minnu bɛ na jamana wɛrɛw la. 

Yala aw b’a fɛ ka kunnafoni wɛrɛw sɔrɔ dɛmɛ hakɛ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw kan ka ɲɛsin cotton dilannikɛlaw ma san 2025 kɔnɔ walima diɲɛ finiko suguw bɛna jaabi cogo min na wa?

User ye fasari min ta, o marala:
Awirilikalo tile 3 san 2025, kɔɔri sɛnɛkɛla dɔ ka bɔ Moulton, Alabama, A y’a haminankow fɔ ka bɔ a ka jɔrɔnnako la Trump ka fanga ka donniko saalenw jaakuyali kan min ye kura ye, tile kelen laseli kɔfɛ a ye min weele ko “Hɔrɔnyali don”.

A ka donko in tomi kolomaw:
Daŋaniyabaliya jatebɔw la : Sɛnɛkɛla ye sigasiga jira Saalenw bɛna jate cogo min na bɔtaw minnu bɛ taa kɔ kan, o bɛ fara Ameriki kɔɔri kan, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la bɛnkanw kɔnɔ i n’a fɔ Cɛma-Ameriki Hɔrɔnya Jago bɛnkan (CAFTA) walima Ameriki, Mɛkisiki ani kanada bɛnkan (USMCA).

Sɔrɔko siratigɛw min ka gɛlɛn : Nin ɲininkali in kɛra waati min na sɛnɛko siratigɛ tun bɛ k'a ɲɛsin tiɲɛ na kɔrɔtaba la bɔli musakabaw ni tɔnɔ ntanya sɔrɔta kunba la kabini san 2022.

Kɔrɔtɔko dɛmɛw:

Bɛnkanw ni filitaw : San 2025 nowanburukalo la, bɛnkan min kɛra ni Sinuwa ye, o kɛra sababu ye ka tajurusara donko Saalenw caman jɔ, ka fara Pekin ka jija kan ni hakɛba sanni ye sunbala siyɔ la.
Kiiritigɛlaw ka latigɛ : San 2026 feburuyekalo la, Kiiritigɛsoba ye o Saalen dɔw fili, nin donko Saalen jaakuyalen in na ni Saalen jaakuyali ye, O bɛ se ka kɛ sababu ye ka dɔ bɔ sɛnɛkɛminɛnw musakaw la minnu bɛ don.

A ka donko in tomi kolomaw:

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 4999 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-03-01 15:07:34 CEST
Zuluyekalo san 2025, Faransi finiko sugu bɛ fɛnba dɔ daminɛ min ye fɛɛrɛ tigɛlen ye walasa ka ultra fast-fashion (Shein, Temu) ka fanga kɛlɛ. O fɛn caman tigɛli in sinsinnen bɛ sariyasunba dɔ kan min ɲɔgɔn ma deli ka kɛ fɔlɔ, ani sigida baarakɛlaw labɛnni kokura.
1. Sariyasunba ka jaabi min ye tutigɛbaga ye
Faransi ye tariku senna-taama kɛ ni « anti-fast fashion » sariya ta ye Senat fɛ zuwɛnkalo tile 10 san 2025. Nin sɛbɛn in ɲɛsinnen bɛ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la « ultra express fashion » ma ni levier saba ye : 

Nafolo jalaki : Sigidako bolomafara min bɛ taa ɲɛ, o bɛ daminɛ €5 na fɛn kelen na, ka se €10 ma san 2030 kɔnɔ.
Piblisite balili: Sekɔtiri ka mɔgɔba tɛ se ka piblisite kɛ tugun walima ka dɛmɛ don.
Lamini jirali : Wajibiya ka feerekɛlaw ladɔnniya fɛn dilannenw nɔfɛkow la sigida lamini na, ka kɛɲɛ ni jalaki ye. 

2. Suguda cogoya ani taabolo kura
O fɛɛrɛw bɛɛ n’a ta, plateformew ka fanga bɛ to ka barika sɔrɔ. San 2025, Faransi mɔgɔ saba o saba, kelen ni kɔ ye sanni kɛ o yɔrɔw la. Nka, fɛn dɔw b’a jira ko fɛn dɔw bɛ se ka Changer: 

Suguda dɔw dɔgɔyali : San 2025 laban na, Shein y’a ye k’a ka suguya jiginna ka bɔ 14,9% na ka se 10,7% ma, kɔrɔfɔli jikuruw kɔfɛ ("buzz jugu").
Fɛn fɔlɔw yiriwali : Nin yɔrɔ in bɛ kɛ sisan 18% ye ɛntɛrinɛti sanniw na, o bɛ sugu labɛn cogo sabatilen na.
Yɛlɛma ni kokuradonni : Lemahieu i n’a fɔ fɛn dilannikɛlaw bɛ ka u yɛrɛ labɛn kokura, u kɛtɔ k’u sinsin Faransikan 100% ni sabatili kan walasa ka kiliyanw sama minnu bɛ laadala cɛmancɛlafɛnw bila. 

3. Ka ɲɛsin Erɔpu sariyasunba ma
Faransi bɛ kɛ Erɔpu tɔnba ka laboratuwari ye, min ye bɔgɔko sariya seginni sinsin san 2025 sɛtanburukalo la, ka fɛn dilannikɛlaw ka kunkanbaaraba bonya Erɔpu jamana bɛɛ kɔnɔ. 

Yala aw b’a fɛ ka kunnafoni caman sɔrɔ malus impositi kunnafoni kunbabaw kan walima ka Faransi ka fɛn dilannenw sɔrɔ minnu bɛ nafa sɔrɔ nin sariya kura in na wa?

User ye fasari min ta, o marala:
San 2025 zuluyekalo la, Faransi Gese suguw bɛna fɛnba dɔ yɛlɛmali ye fɛɛrɛko siratigɛ la walasa ka finidoncogo teliya fanga kɛlɛ (Sheen, Timo). O fɛn caman yɛlɛmali in sinsinnen bɛ sariyaw kan minnu ɲɔgɔn ma deli ka kɛ fɔlɔ ani sigida ɲɔgɔndan labɛnni kokura kɛ.

1. Sariyasunba ka jaabi min bɛ sanfɛ 
Faransi ye tariku  senna-taama ta ni wasabulon maakɔrɔw ka sariya ye  ka "Suguya teliman kɛlɛ"" zuwɛnkalo tile 10 san 2025. Nin sariya in laɲini bɛ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la Suguya teliya ka bɔ nata saba fɛ:

Nafolo jalakiw : Sigidako bolomafara min bɛ taa ɲɛ, o bɛ daminɛ ni ɛrowari 5 ye fɛn kelen na, wa a bɛ se ɛrowari 10 ma san 2030. Jirali balili : Baarakɛda belebele ma se ka jirali tigɛ walima ka kɔlɔsili kɛ.

Lamini taamasiɲɛw kɛli  : A bɛna ɲini tɔnw fɛ u ka magojɔbagaw ladɔnniya u ka fɛn dilannenw nɔfɛkow la sigida nɔfɛtɔkow la u ka bɔtaw la, jalaki banbanli kɔrɔ.

2. bɛɛ Ka filɛli Sugu la ani ɲɛsinfan lamaga
O fɛɛrɛw bɛɛ n’a ta, bɔlɔlɔ yɔrɔw nɔ bɛ to ka kɔgɔ. San 2025, Faransi sannikɛlaw tilancɛ ni kɔ ye sanni kɛ o yɔrɔw fɛ. Nka, fɛn dɔw b’a jira ko fɛn dɔw bɛ se ka yɛlɛma:

Sugu dɔw ka sɔrɔta dɔgɔyali : San 2025 laban na, SHEIN ka sugu sɔrɔta jigira ka bɔ 14,9% na ka se 10,7% ma, kɔrɔfɔba dɔ kɔfɛ.

Bɔta Labaaralenw Sugu yɛlɛli : nin seko in b'a poron 18% kan fɛn minu bɛ san ka bɔ bɔlɔlɔ sira fɛ, ka bɔ fɛnna o bɛ sugu kɛcogo labɛn kokura kudayi.

Tɛmɛni ni kokurabɔ : dilanni cakɛdaw bɛ jate i n’a fɔ Limaheu min b'a yɛrɛ ka fɛnkuraw bɔ a yɛrɛ ye, ni sinsin ye Faransi ka fɛn bɔtaw la ni 100% ninyɔrɔ ye walasa ka sannikɛlaw sama minnu b'u ɲɛ sin yɔrɔjanw fɛ ka bɔ  laadalabɔtaw ma, minnu ɲɛ bɛ cɛmancɛ la.

3. Erɔpu sariyasunba siratigɛ la : Faransi bɛ ka kɛ Erɔpu tɔnba ka kɔrɔbɔli Foro ye, min sɔnna ka nɔgɔw ɲɛsinfan sariya lajɛ kokura san 2025 sɛtanburukalo la, ka kunkanbaaraba jaakuya min fɛrɛlen don bɔlikɛlaw kan Erɔpu fan bɛɛ la.

Yala aw b’a fɛ ka kunnafoni caman sɔrɔ saalenw jalaki kan walima ka Faransi ka jago taamasiyɛnw dɔn o min bɛ nafa sɔrɔ nin sariya kura in na wa?

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5032 — Fasari kunnafoni/jateminɛ
Waati: 2026-03-01 00:53:04 CEST
The Mouritanian Channel, bulletin file: Clothing Manufacturing Establishment, cɛsiri minnu bɛ senna walasa ka yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔ  
23 nowanburukalo tile 2025
“Bulletin file: Fini dilanni sigida: Cɛsiri minnu bɛ senna walasa ka yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔ.” Raporo in sinsinnen bɛ finiko tɔnba kan (min ni Moritani jamana sɔrɔdasikulu cɛsirilen don), wa a bɛ cɛsiriw jira minnu bɛ senna walasa ka nin baarada in yiriwa ni laɲini ye ka yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔ fini dilanni na, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la sɔrɔdasikulu ni sɔrɔdasi ni siwili baara minnu bɛ tali kɛ o la. Sigida in kɔkankow : A daminɛna ni « Finiko tɔn » ye san 1993, o kɔfɛ, a yiriwara ka kɛ bi baarada ye ani bi waati in na, finiko tɔn tɔgɔ la.
A ni Moritani jamana sɔrɔdasikulu cɛsirilen don, a laɲini ye ka sɔrɔdasi finiw, finiw ani minɛn wɛrɛw dilan sigida la walasa ka dɔ bɔ fɛnw na minnu bɛ na ni u ye jamana wɛrɛw la.
A ye yiriwaliba ye nin san laban ninnu na, ni minɛnw ni taabolo kura ye walasa u ka se ka baara kɛ ka ɲɛ ani ka nafa sɔrɔ.

San 2025 nowanburukalo la, kunnafoni in kɔnɔko : A bɛ na kanpaɲiba dɔ kɔnɔ Moritani jamana na walasa ka sigida ka fɛn dilanni ni yɛrɛdɔn yiriwa seko ni dɔnko caman na (i n’a fɔ sɛnɛ, tiga, ani izini wɛrɛw).
Google ye fasari min jira:
Moritani telewisɔn kibaruyaw: Fini dilanni sigida, cɛsiri minnu bɛ senna walasa ka yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔ
Nowanburukalo tile 23, san 2025
"Kibaruya: Fini dilanni sigili, cɛsiri minnu bɛ senna walasa ka yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔ." Nin kunnafoni in sinsinnen bɛ finiko tɔnba kan (min ni Moritani jamana sɔrɔdasikulu cɛsirilen don) wa a b’a ka cɛsiriw jira minnu bɛ senna walasa ka sigida in yiriwa n’a kun ye ka yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔ finiko la, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la sɔrɔdasikulu ni sɔrɔdasi ni siwili baara minnu bɛ tali kɛ o la. Sigida in kɔkankow : A daminɛna ni "Finiko tɔn" ye san 1993, kabini o waati, a jiginna ka kɛ bi baarada ye min ka bon kosɛbɛ, n’a bɛ fɔ a ma ko finiko tɔnba.

A ni Moritani jamana sɔrɔdasikulu cɛsirilen don, a laɲini ye ka sɔrɔdasi finiw, finiw ani minɛn wɛrɛw dilan sigida la walasa ka dɔ bɔ u jigi da fɛnw kan minnu bɛ na jamana kɔnɔ.

A ye yiriwaliba ye nin san laban ninnu na, ni minɛnw ni taabolo kura ye walasa ka kɛ baarakɛcogo ɲuman ye ani ka nafa sɔrɔ.

San 2025 nowanburukalo la, kunnafoni in kɔnɔko : Nin kunnafoni in ye kanpaɲiba dɔ ye min kɛra Moritani jamana na, walasa ka sigida ka fɛn dilanni n’a yɛrɛdɔn yiriwa seko ni dɔnko siratigɛ la (i n’a fɔ sɛnɛ, tiga sɛnɛ, ani izini wɛrɛw).

Nin kunnafoni in sinsinnen bɛ finiko tɔnba kan (o min ni Moritani faso kɛlɛcɛw cɛsirilen don) wa yeelen bɛ jɔ cɛsiriw kan min bɛ ka taa fɛ walasa ka sigida in yiriwa n’a kun ye ka yɛrɛwasa kɛ lakika ye finiw bɔli la, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la fanga maramanfɛntigiw ni kɛlɛ magow kama ani dugubakɔnɔmaaya cɛrinnen don ɲɔgɔnna. Sigida in kɔkankow : A daminɛna ni "Finiko tɔn" ye san 1993,o kɔfɛ a yiriwara ka taa sigida kura la ani ka kɛ bi tile ta ye fini dilanni tɔgɔ sigida jukɔrɔ.

A tugulen don Moritani faso kɛlɛbolokulu la, wa a laɲini ye ka taa kɛlɛ masiriw bɔ, finiw ani minɛn wɛrɛw min ye sigida ta ye.walasa ka jigida dɔgɔya fɛn dontaw kan.

A ye yiriwaliba ye nin san laban ninnu na, ni minɛnw kurayali ni baaraw ye mun kɔsɔn a k'a dugujɛ a ka wasa ka caya an'a ka bɔta.

San 2025 nowanburukalo la, kunnafoni in kɔnɔko : Nin kunnafoni in ye wuli ka jɔba dɔ ye min kɛra Moritani jamana na, walasa ka sigida ka fɛn dilanni n’a yɛrɛwasa yiriwa siratigɛ caman na  (i n’a fɔ sɛnɛ, Malo, ani fɛn wɛrɛw dilanni).

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5036 — User ka fasari yɛlɛma
Waati: 2026-02-28 14:48:44 CEST
Kunnafoni minnu bɔra kɔsa in na Mali finiko yiriwali tɔnba (CMDT) kan san 2026 feburuyekalo la, olu b’a jira ko san nata baarakɛnafolo ŋaniyatalen dɔ tiɲɛni n’a laɲiniw ye ka cotonsɛnɛ lakunu.
1. Nafolo ni baarakɛnafolo kibaruyaw (san 2026 feburuyekalo) .
CMDT ɲɛmɔgɔyaso ye sɔn, san 2026 feburuyekalo tile 26, baarakɛnafolo belebeleba dɔ ma, min bɛna kɛ nafolosɔrɔ san in na : 

Baarakɛnafolo bɛɛ lajɛlen : FCFA ka ca ni miliyari 418 ye minnu lajɛra walasa ka cotton seko dɛmɛ.
Jateminɛ kuntilenna : Sosiyete in b’a fɛ ka tɔnɔ sɔrɔ min bɛna kɛ FCFA miliyari 10 ɲɔgɔn ye.
Nafolodonni : Nin laɲini in kun ye ka izini baarakɛminɛnw kɛ bi ta ye ani ka fɛnw sɔrɔli lakana cotton sɛnɛkɛlaw ma. 

2. Sɛnɛko kanpaɲi san 2025-2026
CMDT ye yiriwali laɲiniw sigi senkan walasa k’a jɔyɔrɔ sɔrɔ kokura mara ɲɛmɔgɔ ye, gɛlɛya minnu tun bɛ parazitiw (jassids) la san tɛmɛnnenw na : 

Sɛnɛfɛnw dilannikɛlaw sanni sɔngɔ : Kisɛ cotton sɔngɔ bɛ to 300 FCFA kilo kelen na walasa ka dusu don sɛnɛfɛnw na.
Sɛnɛyɔrɔ : Mali b’a fɛ ka hectare 672.000 ɲɔgɔn dan nin kanpaɲi in kama.
Sɛnɛko makɔnɔnen : Jamana ka laɲini ye ka kisɛkisɛ tɔni 650.000 sabati ani ka tɛmɛ a kan, Mali ye fanga sɔrɔ CFA mara la ni tɔni 656.751 ye kunnafoni tɛmɛnen kɔnɔ. 

Ɲɛmɔgɔya : Sosiyete in ɲɛmɔgɔya bɛ dɔgɔtɔrɔ Kouloumégué Dembélé bolo bi, ale min kɛra ɲɛmɔgɔba ye san 2025 zuwɛnkalo la.
Industriyali : Fɛɛrɛko cidenyabaara dɔ (kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la ni Alemaɲi jɛɲɔgɔnw ye) bɛ baara kɛ finiko iziniba dɔ dabɔli kan walasa ka cotton fibre caman sɛmɛntiya sigida la.
Gɛlɛyaw : Banakisɛw ka binkanniw (jassids) ɲɛnabɔli ani lakanani sɛnɛyɔrɔw la, o bɛ to ka kɛ kɔlɔsiliba ye ɲɛmɔgɔyaso bolo.
User ye fasari min ta, o marala:
Kunnafoni minnu bɔra kɔsa in na, minnu ɲɛsinnen bɛ Mali Gesemanfɛnw yiriwali tɔnba (CMDT) ma san 2026 feburuyekalo la, olu b’a jira ko baarakɛnafolo ŋaniyaba dɔ daminɛna ka nafolosɔrɔ san nata kama, ani laɲiniw kan, minnu bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka kɔɔri sɛnɛni lakunu.

1. Wariko kibaruyaw ni baarakɛnafolo (san 2026 feburuyekalo) .
San 2026 feburuyekalo tile 26, CMDT ka ɲɛmɔgɔyaso ye baarakɛnafolo belebeleba dɔ ta san 2026 nafolosɔrɔta kama :

Baarakɛnafolo bɛɛ lajɛlen : A ka ca ka tɛmɛ Faransi ka Farafinna CFA miliyari 418 ni kɔ kan min kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen na walasa ka kɔɔri seko dɛmɛ.

Tɔnɔ laɲini : cakɛda in b’a ɲini ka tɔnɔ sɔrɔ min ka surun Faransi ka Farafinna CFA miliyari 10 ɲɔgɔn na.

Nafolodonni : Nin laɲini in kun ye ka dilannikɛyɔrɔw kɛ kuraya ani ka sɔrɔ dontaw banbanni lakana kɔɔri sɛnɛkɛlaw ye.
2. Sɛnɛko wuli ka jɔ san 2025-2026
CMDT cakɛda ye yiriwali laɲiniw sigi senkan walasa k’a jɔyɔrɔ sɔrɔ kokura ka kɛ mara ɲɛmɔgɔ ye, gɛlɛyaw kɔfɛ a ye minnu kunbɛn san tɛmɛnnenw na, k’a sababu kɛ kɔɔri fɛnɲɛnamaw ye (fɛnɲɛnamaw) ye :

Sanni sɔngɔ min bɛ kɛ fɛn bɔlikɛlaw ye : kɔɔri gɛrɛgɛrɛ sɔngɔ latigɛra ka kɛ Faransi ka Farafinna CFA 300 ye kilo kelen na walasa ka bɔli dusu don.

Kɛnɛ min labɛnna sɛnɛ kama: Mali bɛ ka labɛn kɛ min ka surun hectare 672.000 ɲɔgɔn na k'o sɛnɛ nin wuli ka jɔ in na.

bɔta makɔnɔnen : Jamana ka waleyaw laɲinitaw ye ka taa basigi lakika sɔrɔ kɔɔri gɛrɛgɛrɛ bɔli la ani k'a tɛmɛ, n’o ye tɔni 650.000 ye. A dɔn k'a fɔ tiɲɛna ko Mali a ye bɔli kɛ Faransi ka Farafinna CFA mara kɔnɔ bɔlila min sera  tɔni 656.751 ma salon.

Ɲɛmɔgɔya : cakɛda in ɲɛmɔgɔya bɛ sisan dɔgɔtɔrɔ Kolomégui Dembélé bolo, ale min kɛra ɲɛmɔgɔba ye san 2025 zuwɛnkalo la.

Baarakɛcogo : Fɛɛrɛko cidenyabaara dɔ bɛ baara kɛ (o bɛ Alemaɲi jɛɲɔgɔnw fara ɲɔgɔn kan) walasa ka gese dilanyɔrɔ bɛɛ sigi senkan sigida la kɔɔri fu baara kama.

Gɛlɛyaw : ɲɛmɔgɔya in ma wali a bɛ fɛnɲɛnamaw kɛlɛli (fɛnɲɛnama minnu bɛ pan) ani lakana bɔliyɔrɔw la, o tora haminankoba ye o min bɛ jɔrɔnanko wuli ɲɛmɔgɔyaso sigiyɔrɔ la.

Jɛkafɔ: Ciden kura fila ka bɔli

Tɛmɛsira ɲɛmaa, a ka bon ɲɛmaaba Assimi Goïta, ye kunbɛnni kɛ alamisadon feburuyekalo tile 25 san 2026, Mali kɔkanciden kura fila la kɔkan. U Nàna a ka cikanw Sɔrɔ ka Sɔrɔ k'u ka baara daminɛ u ka baarakɛyɔrɔw la.

Olu ye Mali lasigiden dantigɛlen ye Arabu Saudite masaya la ani min bugunnatigɛra ka kɛ Mali lasigiden ye Libi.

Kunba Ibrahima Dahirou Dembélé, n’o ye Mali lasigiden ye Arabie Saoudite jamana na, nowanburukalo tile 5 san 2025, o de kɛra fɔlɔ ye min sɔrɔla Tɛmɛsira jamanakuntigi fɛ.

Ɲɛmaaba y’a daminɛ k’a sinsin a kan ko a bɛ ka nin cidenyabaara kura in daminɛ ni hakilina ɲuman ye. O kɔfɛ, a y’a ka cidenyabaara jira sira saba fɛ : ka sɔrɔko jɛ-ka-baara sabati Mali ni Arabu Sawudi jamana cɛ, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, fɛnsɔrɔko baarabolodalen yiriwali fɛ ; lakana jɛ-ka-baara sabatili, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, kalanko, fɛɛrɛdɛmɛ, ani kunnafonifalen siratigɛ la; ani ka sigida, laadalakow ani diinɛ jɛ-ka-baara sabati ni Arabu Saudite masaya ye.

Kɛlɛtigikunba Maouloud Ould Mohamed ye kɔkanciden filanan ye min sɔrɔla jamanakuntigi fɛ. A ka baara ye Mali ni Libi ka jɛkafɔ sabatili ye.

A ka kumaw la lajɛ kɔfɛ, ciden Maouloud Ould Mohamed y’a sinsin mara lakanani kan, sɔrɔko jɛɲɔgɔnyaw sabatili, ani fɛɛrɛ minnu kun ye ka Malidenw ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲɛ, minnu sigilen bɛ Libi jamana na.

Lasigiden fila ninnu, n’olu ye kunba Ibrahima Dahirou DEMBÉLÉ ani Kɛlɛtigi-Maouloud Ould MOHAMED ye, olu y’u ka waleɲumandɔn jira dannaya min dara u kan, k’u ka cɛsiri jira kokura walasa ka cidenyabaara min kalifara u la, k’o kɛ ni kantigiya ni baarakɛcogo ɲuman ye.

Jɛkafɔ: Ciden kura fila ka bɔli

Tɛmɛsira ɲɛmaa, a ka bon ɲɛmaaba Assimi Goïta, ye kunbɛnni kɛ alamisadon feburuyekalo tile 25 san 2026, Mali kɔkanciden kura fila la kɔkan. U Nàna a ka cikanw Sɔrɔ ka Sɔrɔ k'u ka baara daminɛ u ka baarakɛyɔrɔw la.

Olu ye Mali lasigiden dantigɛlen ye Arabu Saudite masaya la ani min bugunnatigɛra ka kɛ Mali lasigiden ye Libi.

Kunba Ibrahima Dahirou Dembélé, n’o ye Mali lasigiden ye Arabie Saoudite jamana na, nowanburukalo tile 5 san 2025, o de kɛra fɔlɔ ye min sɔrɔla Tɛmɛsira jamanakuntigi fɛ.

Ɲɛmaaba y’a daminɛ k’a sinsin a kan ko a bɛ ka nin cidenyabaara kura in daminɛ ni hakilina ɲuman ye. O kɔfɛ, a y’a ka cidenyabaara jira sira saba fɛ : ka sɔrɔko jɛ-ka-baara sabati Mali ni Arabu Sawudi jamana cɛ, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, fɛnsɔrɔko baarabolodalen yiriwali fɛ ; lakana jɛ-ka-baara sabatili, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, kalanko, fɛɛrɛdɛmɛ, ani kunnafonifalen siratigɛ la; ani ka sigida, laadalakow ani diinɛ jɛ-ka-baara sabati ni Arabu Saudite masaya ye.

Kɛlɛtigikunba Maouloud Ould Mohamed ye kɔkanciden filanan ye min sɔrɔla jamanakuntigi fɛ. A ka baara ye Mali ni Libi ka jɛkafɔ sabatili ye.

A ka kumaw la lajɛ kɔfɛ, ciden Maouloud Ould Mohamed y’a sinsin mara lakanani kan, sɔrɔko jɛɲɔgɔnyaw sabatili, ani fɛɛrɛ minnu kun ye ka Malidenw ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲɛ, minnu sigilen bɛ Libi jamana na.

Lasigiden fila ninnu, n’olu ye kunba Ibrahima Dahirou DEMBÉLÉ ani Kɛlɛtigi-Maouloud Ould MOHAMED ye, olu y’u ka waleɲumandɔn jira dannaya min dara u kan, k’u ka cɛsiri jira kokura walasa ka cidenyabaara min kalifara u la, k’o kɛ ni kantigiya ni baarakɛcogo ɲuman ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5055 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-27 10:56:53 CEST
Dunanw ka kibaruya labanw: Moritani, Alzeri, Maroc, Arabie Saoudite, Faransi, Ameriki, Turquie, Ukraine, Irisila, Sinuwa. 

Jamana kofɔlenw ka jamana kɔkankow ɲɛnabɔli minnu kɛra bi, feburuyekalo tile 27, san 2026, olu kuncɛlen filɛ nin ye:
Moritani, Maroc ani Alzeri
Maroc: Maroc jamana kɔkankow minisiri Nasser Bourita ye yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya laɲini laban jira sɛbɛn dɔ kɔnɔ min ɲɛ 40 bɛ sɔrɔ, lajɛ dɔ senfɛ Madrid, Ameriki, Alzeri ani Moritani jamana ka lasigidenw ɲɛkɔrɔ. Masakɛ Mohamɛdi VI fana ye jamana wɛrɛw ka lasigiden kura damadɔ Sɔrɔ Rabat.
Alzeri: Alzeri ye a sen don marabolow ka kumaɲɔgɔnyaw la Sahara ko la, ka sɔrɔ jamana kɔkankow sekeretɛri zenerali Lounes Mokarmane ye Qatar jamana lasigiden bisimila walasa ka jamana fila ka jɛkafɔ yiriwa. Jamanakuntigi min bɛ sigida koɲɛw ɲɛnabɔ, n’o ye Sufyan Shayeb ye, ale fana y’a ka lajɛw fanga bonya ni Misira jamana lasigiden ye walasa ka konsulasi jɛɲɔgɔnya sabati.
Moritani: Nouakchott y’a ka tugu kura don “neutreté positif” jɔyɔrɔ la Sahara ko la, k’a sababu kɛ kunnafoniw ye minnu b’a jira ko sɔrɔko jɛ-ka-baara bɛna bonya ni Iran ye, wariko ni fɛɛrɛbɔ siratigɛ la. 

Arabie Saoudite ani Moyen-Orient jamanaw
Saudi Arabia jamana kɔkankow minisiri ye ɲɔgɔnye caman Kɛ diɲɛ jamanaw kan, a ɲɔgɔnna minnu bɛ Misira, Oman, Turquie ani Pakistan, walasa ka baro Kɛ marabolo yiriwaliw kan.
Saudi Arabia jamana kɔkankow minisiri kɔrɔ ye Israɛl ka sigikafɔ walew jalaki, k’a sinsin Masaya ka dɛmɛ kan Palestina jamana minɛlenw ka sariya siratigɛ la. 

Irisi ni Ukraine (dugukolo kan foro) .
Duniya jamanaw ka degun walasa ka kɛlɛ in ban, o bɛ senna; Duniya Kelenyatɔnba ka lajɛba ye wele bila Irisi jamana ma, a ka fanga baara dabila joona.
Diplomasi wale dɔw bɛ yen minnu ɲɛmɔgɔya bɛ Washinton (Trump ka fanga) bolo walasa ka hadamadenya-kɛlɛw sigi senkan ani ka jalaki bin mɔgɔ minnu kan, n’olu ye dankarili kɛ kɛlɛyɔrɔw la, n’olu ni diɲɛ jɛɲɔgɔnyaw bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na. 

Fangabaw (Amerika, Faransi, Sinuwa, Turki)
Etazuni: Trump ka fanga be ka “diplomasi kɛlɛ” dɔ ɲɛminɛ walasa ka MINURSO ka cidenyabaara ban kungo kɔnɔ ani ka hɛrɛ taabolo kura ɲɛsin Moyen-Orient jamanaw ma.
Turquie : A bɛ t’a fɛ a jɔyɔrɔ la i n’a fɔ marabolo cɛsiribaa, jɛkafɔ sabatili fɛ ni Riyad ni Kayira ye mara in ka gɛlɛyaw ko la.
Sinuwa ni Irisi: Laseliw bɛ ka bɔ kɛnɛ kan, k’a jira k’u ka fanga bɛ ka bonya Afiriki woroduguyanfan dosiyew kɔnɔ, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, jamana dɔw bɛ ka taa a fɛ ka lafasali jɛɲɔgɔnya sabati ni Pekin ni Moskow ye.
Faransi: A ni Magreb jamanaw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ jɛɲɔgɔnyaw bɛ ka seginnkanni kɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni diɲɛ fɛn kura caman yeli ye, ni Moritani ye a sen don laadalakow la Pari walasa ka danfara yiriwa.

Dunanw ka kibaruyaw labanw bɔra Moritani, Alzeri, Maroc, Arabie Saoudite, Faransi, Ameriki, Turquie, Ukraine, Irisi ani Sinuwa.

Jamana kofɔlenw ka ɲɛtaa nafamaba minnu kɛra jamana kɔkankow la bi, san 2026 feburuyekalo tile 27, olu kuncɛlen filɛ nin ye:

Moritani, Maroc ani Alzeri jamanaw

Maroc: Maroc jamana kɔkankow minisiri Nasser Bourita ye yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya laɲini laban jira sɛbɛn dɔ kɔnɔ min ɲɛ 40 bɛ sɔrɔ, lajɛ dɔ senfɛ Madrid, Ameriki, Alzeri ani Moritani jamana ka lasigidenw tun bɛ kɛnɛ kan. Masakɛ Mohamɛdi VI fana ye jamana wɛrɛw ka lasigiden kura dɔw Sɔrɔ Rabat.

Alzeri: Alzeri ye a sen don marabolow ka jɛkafɔw la Sahara tlebinyanfan ko la, ka sɔrɔ jamana kɔkankow minisiriso sekeretɛri zenerali, Lounes Mokramane ye Qatar jamana lasigiden bisimila walasa ka jamana fila ka jɛkafɔ sabati. Alzeri jamana kɔkan jamana minisiri, Sofiane Chaib, y’a ka lajɛw fanga bonya ni Misira jamana lasigiden ye walasa ka lasigidenw ka jɛkafɔ sabati.

Moritani: Nouakchott y’a jira ko a ye a ka cɛsiri jira ka ɲɛsin “neutreté positif” jɔyɔrɔ ma Sahara Tlebi ko la, k’a sababu kɛ kunnafoniw ye minnu b’a jira ko sɔrɔko jɛkafɔ bɛ ka bonya ni Iran ye wariko ni fɛɛrɛbɔ siratigɛ la.

Arabie Saoudite ani Moyen-Orient jamanaw

Saudi Arabia jamana kɔkankow minisiri ye jamana-ɲɛmaa-jɛkuluw ka welekan caman Kɛ n’a ɲɔgɔnnaw ye Misira, Oman, Turquie ani Pakistan jamanaw na walasa ka baro Kɛ marabolo yiriwaliw kan. Saudi Arabia jamana kɔkankow minisiri kɔrɔ ye Israɛl ka sigikafɔ walew jalaki, k’a jira ko Masaya bɛ dɛmɛ don Palestina jamana minɛlenw ka sariya siratigɛ la.

Irisi jamana ni Ukɛrɛni (Dɔnniya kɛnɛba) .
Duniya jamanaw ka degun bɛ ka taa a fɛ walasa ka kɛlɛ in ban, ONU ka lajɛba ye wele bila Irisi ma a ka fanga baara dabila joona.

Diplomasi wale minnu ɲɛmɔgɔya bɛ Washinton (Trump ka fanga) bolo, olu laɲini ye ka hadamadenya kɛlɛ dabila ani ka jaabi di mɔgɔ minnu ma, olu minnu ye dankarili kɛ kɛlɛyɔrɔw la minnu ni diɲɛ jɛɲɔgɔnyaw bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na.

Fanga belebelebaw (Amerika, Faransi, Sinuwa, Turki)
Etazuni: Trump ka fanga be "diplomasi kɛlɛ" dɔ ɲɛminɛ walasa ka MINURSO ka cidenyabaara ban Sahara Tilebinyanfan fɛ ani ka hɛrɛ taabolo kura ɲɛsin Moyen-Orient jamanaw ma.
Turquie: A bɛ t’a fɛ a jɔyɔrɔ la i n’a fɔ marabolo cɛsiribaa, jɛkafɔ min bɛ senna ni Riyad ni Kayira ye, ka ɲɛsin mara in ka gɛlɛyaw ma.
Sinuwa ni Irisi: Laseliw y’a jira k’u ka fanga bɛ ka bonya Afiriki woroduguyanfan koɲɛw la, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, jamana dɔw bɛ ka taa a fɛ ka lafasali jɛɲɔgɔnya sabati ni Pekin ni Moskow ye.
Faransi: A ni Magreb jamanaw ka jɛɲɔgɔnyaw bɛ ka lajɛ ka taa a fɛ, diɲɛ kɔnɔ yiriwali kuraw yeelen na, Moritani jamana bɛ ka a sen don laadalakow la Pari walasa ka danfara yiriwa.

Jamana kofɔlenw ka ɲɛtaa nafamaba minnu kɛra jamana kɔkanko kow la bi, san 2026 feburuyekalo tile 27, olu kuncɛlen filɛ nin ye:

Moritani, Marɔku ani Alzeri 

Marɔku: Marɔku kɔkankow minisiri Nasser Bourita ye yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya laɲini laban jira sɛbɛn dɔ kɔnɔ ka bɔ ɲɛ 40 kɔnɔ, lajɛ dɔ senfɛ Madrid, Ameriki, Alzeri ani Moritani ka lasigidenw nali ye kɛnɛ kan. Masakɛ Mohamɛdi VI fana ye jamana wɛrɛw ka lasigiden kura dɔw Sɔrɔ Rabat.

Alzeri: Alzeri y'a sen don marabolow ka jɛkafɔw la Sahara Sbɛnko la, ka sɔrɔ jamana kɔkankow minisiriso kalatigiba, Lounes Mokramane ye Qatar lasigiden bisimila walasa ka k'u fila ka jɛkafɔ sinsin. Alzeri jamana kɔkanko jamana minisiri, Sofiane Chaib, y’a ka lajɛw fanga Sinsin ni Misira lasigiden ye walasa ka lasigidenw ka jɛkafɔ sinsin.

Moritani: Nouakchott ye kurayali kɛ a ka minɛli la ni “ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲuman” jɔyɔrɔ ye ka ɲɛsin Sahara Sɛbɛn ma, k’a sababu kɛ kunnafoniw ye ka bɔ sɔrɔko ɲɔgɔndɛmɛ fɛrɛli la ni Iran ye nafolodonniko la ani  fɛɛrɛbɔ la.

Arabie Saoudite ani kɔrɔnfɛla Cɛmancɛ jamanaw

Saudi Arabia jamana kɔkankow minisiri ye jamana-ɲɛmaa-jɛkuluw ka welekan caman Kɛ n’a ɲɔgɔnnaw ye Misira, Oman, Turquie ani Pakistan jamanaw na walasa ka baro Kɛ marabolo yiriwaliw kan. Saudi Arabia jamana kɔkankow minisiri kɔrɔsigi ye Israɛl ka sigili farifoniw jalaki, k'a gɛlɛya ko Masaya ka dɛmɛ bɛ sariya sigili la Palestini dugukolo minɛlenw ko la.

Irisi ni Ukɛrɛni (Dɔnniya kɛlɛ kɛnɛba) .
Duniya jamanaw ka degunw bɛ ka taa a fɛ walasa ka kɛlɛ in ban, Duniya Kelenyatɔnba ka lajɛba ye wele bila Irisi ma jɔli kama teliyala ka bɔ fanga baarali la.

O yɔrɔ la kɔkanko lamagaw bɛ yen Washinton bɛ k'o ɲɛ minɛ (Trump ka ɲɛmaaso) ka hadamadenya basigi jaakuya ani ka ɲɛmaaw jalaki ka bɔ dankarili la kɛlɛyɔrɔw la minnu sirilen don diɲɛ jɛɲɔgɔnyaw la.

Fangabaw (Ameri, Faransi, Sinuwa, Turki)
Fasow ka Kelenya: Trump ka ɲɛmaaso bɛ ka ɲɛmɛnɛli kɛ"kɔlanko cunnkan" dɔ la walasa ka MINURSO ka cidenyabaara ban Saharako la ani ka ɲɔnini kɛ ni bɛn siri kura ye kɔrɔnfɛla cɛmancɛ la.
Turquie: A bɛ t’a fɛ a jɔyɔrɔ la i n’a fɔ marabolo cɛsiribaa, jɛkafɔ min bɛ senna ni Riyad ni Kayira ye, ka ɲɛsin mara in ka gɛlɛyaw ma.
Sinuwa ni Irisi: Laseliw y’a jira ka bɔ u fila ka nɔw cayali la Farafinna kɔgɔduguyanfan Sɛbɛnw kɔnɔ, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, jamana dɔw bɛ ka taa a fɛ k'u ka lafasali jɛɲɔgɔnya Sinsin ni Pekin ni Moskow ye.
Faransi: A ka jɛɲɔgɔnya bɛ ka yeli kɛ ni Arabumara tilebiyanfan ye seginnkanw la minnu bɛ ka taa a fɛ, diɲɛ  kura yɛlɛmaw Suma la, ni Moritani ka jɛɲɔgɔnya ye a ka laadalakow la ni Pari ye walasa ka Suguya sinsin.

Dunanw ka kibaruya labanw: Moritani, Alzeri, Maroc, Arabie Saoudite, Faransi, Ameriki, Turquie, Ukraine, Irisila, Sinuwa. 

Jamana kofɔlenw ka jamana kɔkankow ɲɛnabɔli minnu kɛra bi, feburuyekalo tile 27, san 2026, olu kuncɛlen filɛ nin ye:
Moritani, Maroc ani Alzeri
Maroc: Maroc jamana kɔkankow minisiri Nasser Bourita ye yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya laɲini laban jira sɛbɛn dɔ kɔnɔ min ɲɛ 40 bɛ sɔrɔ, lajɛ dɔ senfɛ Madrid, Ameriki, Alzeri ani Moritani jamana ka lasigidenw ɲɛkɔrɔ. Masakɛ Mohamɛdi VI fana ye jamana wɛrɛw ka lasigiden kura damadɔ Sɔrɔ Rabat.
Alzeri: Alzeri ye a sen don marabolow ka kumaɲɔgɔnyaw la Sahara ko la, ka sɔrɔ jamana kɔkankow sekeretɛri zenerali Lounes Mokarmane ye Qatar jamana lasigiden bisimila walasa ka jamana fila ka jɛkafɔ yiriwa. Jamanakuntigi min bɛ sigida koɲɛw ɲɛnabɔ, n’o ye Sufyan Shayeb ye, ale fana y’a ka lajɛw fanga bonya ni Misira jamana lasigiden ye walasa ka konsulasi jɛɲɔgɔnya sabati.
Moritani: Nouakchott y’a ka tugu kura don “neutreté positif” jɔyɔrɔ la Sahara ko la, k’a sababu kɛ kunnafoniw ye minnu b’a jira ko sɔrɔko jɛ-ka-baara bɛna bonya ni Iran ye, wariko ni fɛɛrɛbɔ siratigɛ la. 

Arabie Saoudite ani Moyen-Orient jamanaw
Saudi Arabia jamana kɔkankow minisiri ye ɲɔgɔnye caman Kɛ diɲɛ jamanaw kan, a ɲɔgɔnna minnu bɛ Misira, Oman, Turquie ani Pakistan, walasa ka baro Kɛ marabolo yiriwaliw kan.
Saudi Arabia jamana kɔkankow minisiri kɔrɔ ye Israɛl ka sigikafɔ walew jalaki, k’a sinsin Masaya ka dɛmɛ kan Palestina jamana minɛlenw ka sariya siratigɛ la. 

Irisi ni Ukraine (dugukolo kan foro) .
Duniya jamanaw ka degun walasa ka kɛlɛ in ban, o bɛ senna; Duniya Kelenyatɔnba ka lajɛba ye wele bila Irisi jamana ma, a ka fanga baara dabila joona.
Diplomasi wale dɔw bɛ yen minnu ɲɛmɔgɔya bɛ Washinton (Trump ka fanga) bolo walasa ka hadamadenya-kɛlɛw sigi senkan ani ka jalaki bin mɔgɔ minnu kan, n’olu ye dankarili kɛ kɛlɛyɔrɔw la, n’olu ni diɲɛ jɛɲɔgɔnyaw bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na. 

Fangabaw (Amerika, Faransi, Sinuwa, Turki)
Etazuni: Trump ka fanga be ka “diplomasi kɛlɛ” dɔ ɲɛminɛ walasa ka MINURSO ka cidenyabaara ban kungo kɔnɔ ani ka hɛrɛ taabolo kura ɲɛsin Moyen-Orient jamanaw ma.
Turquie : A bɛ t’a fɛ a jɔyɔrɔ la i n’a fɔ marabolo cɛsiribaa, jɛkafɔ sabatili fɛ ni Riyad ni Kayira ye mara in ka gɛlɛyaw ko la.
Sinuwa ni Irisi: Laseliw bɛ ka bɔ kɛnɛ kan, k’a jira k’u ka fanga bɛ ka bonya Afiriki woroduguyanfan dosiyew kɔnɔ, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, jamana dɔw bɛ ka taa a fɛ ka lafasali jɛɲɔgɔnya sabati ni Pekin ni Moskow ye.
Faransi: A ni Magreb jamanaw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ jɛɲɔgɔnyaw bɛ ka seginnkanni kɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni diɲɛ fɛn kura caman yeli ye, ni Moritani ye a sen don laadalakow la Pari walasa ka danfara yiriwa.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5138 — User ka fasari yɛlɛma

Mali: kalan fɔlɔ min bɛ poroze lamini na walasa ka Timbuktu tigasɛnɛ kɛnɛw yiriwa

Timbuktu tigaforo yiriwali porozɛ (PMPRT) ɲɛmɔgɔjɛkulu ka lajɛ gansan fɔlɔ, san 2025 nafolosɔrɔta kama, o kɛra san 2026 feburuyekalo tile 17, sɛnɛko minisiriso ka nafolo ni minɛnko ɲɛmɔgɔso (DFM) ka lajɛso kɔnɔ, Bamakɔ.

Dakabanɔgɔ in ɲɛmɔgɔya tun bɛ sɛnɛko minisiri, dɔgɔtɔrɔ Ibrahima Samaké bolo. Nin lajɛ in bɛ kɛ kalo damadɔw porozɛ in daminɛni kɔfɛ foroba la, ɔkutɔburukalo tile 16 san 2025 Timbuktu, minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ, gɔfɛrɛnaman kuntigi, jenerali mɛri Abdoulaye Maïga fɛ.

A bɛ san duuru kɛ, PMPRT in musaka bɛ bɔ Afiriki tilebinyanfan yiriwali banki fɛ (BOAD) min bɛ se miliyari 8 ni miliyɔn 762 ma. A laɲini ye ka dɛmɛ don faantanya dɔgɔyali la Timbuktu mara la, tigaforo kɛnɛw yiriwali fɛ ani togodalamɔgɔw ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲɛnabɔli sabatili fɛ.

Porozɛ in ɲɛsinnen bɛ du 2500 ma, n’o ye nafa sɔrɔbaga 15000 ɲɔgɔn ye, k’a ɲɛsin musow ni funankɛninw ma kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la. Tigaforo kɛnɛw yiriwali n’u nafabɔli sababu fɛ, faamaw b’a fɛ ka sɛnɛko sabati, ka sɛnɛkɛlaw ka sɔrɔ yiriwa ani ka dumuniko sabati o yɔrɔ la.

Nin ɲɛmɔgɔyaso ka lajɛ fɔlɔ in ye fɛɛrɛba ye walasa ka porozɛ in taabolo jateminɛ ani ka fɛɛrɛw ɲɛfɔ walasa ka baara bolodalenw waleya ka ɲɛ.

Mali: Lajɛ fɔlɔ min kɛra Timbuktu maloforo yiriwali baarabolodalen kan

Timbuktu maloforo yiriwali baarabolodalen (PMPRT) ɲɛmɔgɔjɛkulu ka lajɛ gansan fɔlɔ, san 2025 nafolosɔrɔta kama, o kɛra san 2026 feburuyekalo tile 17, sɛnɛko minisiriso ka nafolo ni minɛnko ɲɛmɔgɔso (DFM) ka lajɛso kɔnɔ Bamakɔ.

Dakabanɔgɔ in ɲɛmɔgɔya tun bɛ sɛnɛko minisiri, dɔgɔtɔrɔ Ibrahima Samaké bolo. Nin lajɛ in kɛra kalo damadɔw baarabolodalen in daminɛ fɔlɔ kɔfɛ, ɔkutɔburukalo tile 16, san 2025, Timbuktu, minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ, gɔfɛrɛnaman kuntigi, ɲɛmaaba Abdoulaye Maïga fɛ.

San duuru PMPRT in musaka bɛ bɔ Farafinna tilebinyanfan yiriwali waribon fɛ (BOAD) ka se Faransi CFA miliyari 8,762 ma. A laɲini ye ka dɛmɛ don faantanya dɔgɔyali la Timbuktu mara la, a kɛtɔ ka maloforo kɛnɛw yiriwa ani ka togodalamɔgɔw ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲɛ cogo sabatilen na.

Baarabolodalen in ɲɛsinnen bɛ du 2500 ma, wala min surun nafa sɔrɔbaga 15.000 ɲɔgɔn na, k’a ɲɛsin kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la musow ni funankɛninw ma. Maloforo kɛnɛw yiriwali n’u sɛnɛni sababu fɛ, faamaw b’a fɛ ka sɛnɛko sabati, ka sɛnɛkɛlaw ka sɔrɔ yiriwa, ka baloko sabati o yɔrɔ la.

Nin ɲɛmɔgɔjɛkulu ka lajɛ fɔlɔ in ye fɛɛrɛba ye walasa ka baarabolodalen in ɲɛtaa lajɛ ani ka fɛɛrɛw ɲɛfɔ walasa ka baara bolodalenw waleya ka ɲɛ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5139 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-23 23:54:15 CEST
Sinuwa ka dugukoloko laɲini walasa ka yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔ sɛnɛyɔrɔw la san 2026 kɔnɔ

San 2026, Sinuwa ma 'sèn Bɔ 'sènbɔli-labɛn dɔ la walasa ka "yɛrɛlabɛn" Sɔrɔ sɛnɛyɔrɔw la. O nɔ na, ​​a y’a sinsin sɛnɛfɛnw tigɛcogo bilenman kɔlɔsili kan kosɛbɛ ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw jogo n’u baaracogo ɲuman yiriwa walasa ka jamana ka balo sɔrɔ. Sisan politiki kunba ye "yɔrɔ sabatili ye, ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw sɔrɔta kan, ani ka labɛncogo ɲuman kɛ" sanni ka sɛnɛyɔrɔbaw fara a kan.

1. Politiki kunbabaw ɲɛminɛcogo : Sɛnɛyɔrɔ minnu bɛ yen, olu marali ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli seko bonya
aw bɛ sɛnɛfɛnw tigɛcogo bilenman kɔlɔsi kosɛbɛ
Politiki in b’a ɲini ka jɛya ko "ka sɛnɛfɛnw sira bilenman kɔlɔsi kosɛbɛ" ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw minɛcogo ni u musakaw balansi ɲɛnabɔ kosɛbɛ walasa sɛnɛyɔrɔ min ye ɛkitɛri miliyari 1,8 ye, o sira bilenman kana tiɲɛ. O kɔrɔ ye ko sinsin bɛna kɛ don nataw la ka “dugukolo kura sɔrɔ kokura” nka ka sɛnɛyɔrɔ kɔrɔw bali ka minɛ walima ka tiɲɛ.

sɛnɛyɔrɔw jɔcogo ɲuman sabatili ni zoni ni danfara ye
"Togodala saba" baara sinsinnan dɔ ye san 2026 kɔnɔ, o ye ka "sɛnɛyɔrɔw jɔcogo ɲuman sabati ni jogo ɲumanba ye ni zoni ni danfara ye", ani ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli kan yɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ la, dugukolo jɛli fɛ, ji lakanani fɛɛrɛw fɛ, dugukolo yiriwali fɛ ani fɛɛrɛ wɛrɛw fɛ. Laɲini ye ka sɛnɛko biɲɛdimi kɛ kosɛbɛ san 2035 kɔnɔ, k’a lajɛ ko togodaw ka kɛ bi ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ye.

"Suman tɛ min na" labɛnni ani dugukolo bilalenw sɛnɛni kokura
Politiki in bɛ sinsin sɛnɛfɛnw "sɛnɛ tɛ" dugukolow labɛnni kan cogo basigilen na ani cogo labɛnnen na ani dugukolo bilalenw sɛnɛni kokura, ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw labɛncogo ɲuman kɛ, ani ka sɛnɛyɔrɔ dɔw baarakɛcogo segin, minnu bɔra ka da wariko sɛnɛfɛnw kan walima ka kɛ baarakɛbaliw ye.

2. Mun na i tɛ “yɛrɛlabɛnni” kofɔ?
Lamini ni nafolo gɛlɛyaw : Sinuwa jamana ka dugukolo sɛnɛta nafolo maralenw dan ye, wa u fanba bɛ yɔrɔw la minnu bɛ sigida laminiko gɛlɛya. Labɛnnibaw bɛ se ka kɛ sababu ye ka sigida gɛlɛyaw lase mɔgɔw ma.
Dugukolo kan suman suguya bɛ tali kɛ tiɲɛ na : Sɛnɛfɛn dɔw i n’a fɔ soja ni ɲɔ, olu mago bɛ ka don jamana kɔnɔ hali bi, wa sɛnɛko politiki bɛ sinsin sigida lakanani kan « jamana kɔnɔ yɛrɛdɔn jɔnjɔnw ni fɛnw doncogo faralenw » kan.
Waati jugumanba nɔfɛkow : Sanjiba ni ja bɛ kɛ tuma caman, o b’a to a ka gɛlɛn ka sɛnɛfɛnw ni sɔrɔ sabatili sabati. Politikiw sinsinnan jiginna faratiw kɛlɛli sekow ni fɛɛrɛ kuraw la walasa ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli kan.
Yala aw b’a fɛ n ka yɔrɔ kolomaw lisɛli labɛn sɛnɛyɔrɔw jɔli siratigɛ la san 2026 kɔnɔ walasa k’aw dɛmɛ ka faamuyali jɛlen sɔrɔ jamana ye nafolo belebele bila yɔrɔ minnu na wa?

User ye fasari min ta, o marala:
Sinuwa jamana ka san 2026 bolodalen sɛnɛ dugukolo yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sɔrɔli kama

Sinuwa ka san 2026 laɲini na, dugukoloko laɲini kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen tɛ yen walasa ka sɛnɛko dugukolo yɛrɛta sɔrɔ. O nɔ na, a b’a sinsin sɛnɛyɔrɔ ci bilenmanw kan dugukolo kama minu ka ɲi Sɛnɛ kama, ani k'a cɛɲi ɲɛ ni ka wasa sɔrɔ a baarali la, faso ka balo lakana kafoli la. Sisan fɛɛrɛ in kunba ye "ka sɛnɛyɔrɔ sabati, ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw bɔta kan yɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ la, ani ka labɛncogo ɲuman kɛ", ka bɔ o nɔ na fɛrɛba la dugukolo minu ka ɲi Sɛnɛ kama.

Fɔlɔ. Ka jɔlanw ɲɛsin fɛɛrɛw kan: ka baloko lakana minu ka ɲi Sɛnɛ kama,ani ka bɔta hakɛ sinsin.

**Ka tugu layini bilenman na kosɛbɛ dugukolo kama minu ka ɲi sɛnɛ na :** fɛɛrɛ in b’a ɲini k’a jɛya ko "ka tugu layini bilen na kosɛbɛ sɛnɛfɛnw na", ka Sumannikɛlan ɲɛnabɔ kosɛbɛ sɛnɛfɛnw minɛni ni musakaw cɛ, ani k'a lajɛ ko layini bilenman min ye mu miliyari 1,8 ye (hectare miliyɔn 120) sɛnɛta dugukolo kan, o kana tiɲɛ. O kɔrɔ ye ko siniɲɛsigi sinsin tɛ "dugukolo kura sɔrɔli" kan, nka sɛnɛyɔrɔ kɔrɔw minɛni walima u tiɲɛni balili kan.

**Ka jajɔ kɛ ka Sɛnɛ dugukolow dilan min cɛɲi kɔrɔtalen don ka kɛɲɛ ni mara ni kuluw ye :** ka bɔ Baara jɔnjɔn dɔ la min bɛna kɛ "sɛnɛ tigɛyɔrɔ kama, togodaw, ani sɛnɛkɛlaw" fɛ san 2026 kɔnɔ,Ka jajɔ kɛ ka Sɛnɛ dugukolow dilan min cɛɲi kɔrɔtalen don ka kɛɲɛ ni mara ni kuluw ye , o ye ka dɔ fara bɔta furancɛ kelen kelen bɛɛ kan"ka bɔ dugukolow Kelenyali sababu fɛ, ani ka fɛnsɔrɔsiraw yiriwa Sɔnni kama, ani ka sɛnɛ bɔgɔ ɲɛ,o Laɲini o de ye ka sɛnɛ kuraya san 2035 kɔnɔ, yɔrɔ la togodaw maraw b'u daamu ni ɲɛnamaya jɔlan kura ye.

**Dugukolow labaarali kɛlɛli magow kama min tɛ sɛnɛko ye ani dugukolo bilalenw seginni :** fɛɛrɛ in bɛ sinsin jɛya kan dɔɔnin dɔɔnin ani jɛkulu sɛnɛ dugukolow labaarali kan magow kama min tɛ sɛnɛko ye, ani dugukolo bilalenw labɛnni, ni ka sɛnɛ dugukolow labɛncogo ɲuman kɛ ani ka sɛnɛyɔrɔ dɔw baara lasegin minnu bilalen don wari sɔrɔko kɔsɔn walima k'a baarakɛbaliya .

**II. Mun na ɲɛni tɛ fɔ "ka i yɛrɛ ɲɛ"?**

**Lamini feregew ani nafolomafɛnw:** Sinuwa jamana ka dugukolo nafolo sɛnɛtaw danmadɔ bɛ yen, minnu caman bɛ sɔrɔ yɔrɔw la minnu bɛ se ka sɛnɛ. Labɛnnibaw bɛ se ka kɛ sababu ye ka sigida gɛlɛyaw lawuli.

**Ka jigi da diɲɛ balo sugu kan:** Sɛnɛfɛn dɔw la, i n’a fɔ Sunbalasiyɔ ni kaba, olu mago bɛ donni na. Sɛnɛko fɛɛrɛ bɛ sinsin bakolo lakana kan o min jɔlen don yɛrɛwasa kan sigidalaka min dɛmɛnen don ni dontaw ye''. 

**San ni dugu cɛ ka bangeta nɔbila jugumanbaw:** jiwooyow ni jaw min bɛ segin ka bɔ basigi gɛlɛya la bɔli kama ani mɛli,sinsinni fɛɛrɛw bɛ yɛlɛma ka taa faratikow kɛlɛli la ani ka dɔ fara dili kan fɛɛrɛbɔko la. 

**San ni dugu cɛ ka bangeta nɔbila jugumanbaw** Yala aw b’a fɛ ne ka yɔrɔ kolomaw jɔcogo labɛn sɛnɛyɔrɔ jɔli siratigɛ la san 2026 kɔnɔ walasa k’aw dɛmɛ ka faamuyali ɲuman sɔrɔ jamana ye nafolo caman don yɔrɔ min na wa? A ka nafolomafɛnw fanba la.
