TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5143 — User ka fasari yɛlɛma
Waati: 2026-02-23 21:48:11 CEST
Sinuwa ka dugukoloko laɲini walasa ka yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔ sɛnɛyɔrɔw la san 2026 kɔnɔ

San 2026, Sinuwa ma 'sèn Bɔ 'sènbɔli-labɛn dɔ la walasa ka "yɛrɛlabɛn" Sɔrɔ sɛnɛyɔrɔw la. O nɔ na, ​​a y’a sinsin sɛnɛfɛnw tigɛcogo bilenman kɔlɔsili kan kosɛbɛ ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw jogo n’u baaracogo ɲuman yiriwa walasa ka jamana ka balo sɔrɔ. Sisan politiki kunba ye "yɔrɔ sabatili ye, ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw sɔrɔta kan, ani ka labɛncogo ɲuman kɛ" sanni ka sɛnɛyɔrɔbaw fara a kan.

1. Politiki kunbabaw ɲɛminɛcogo : Sɛnɛyɔrɔ minnu bɛ yen, olu marali ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli seko bonya
aw bɛ sɛnɛfɛnw tigɛcogo bilenman kɔlɔsi kosɛbɛ
Politiki in b’a ɲini ka jɛya ko "ka sɛnɛfɛnw sira bilenman kɔlɔsi kosɛbɛ" ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw minɛcogo ni u musakaw balansi ɲɛnabɔ kosɛbɛ walasa sɛnɛyɔrɔ min ye ɛkitɛri miliyari 1,8 ye, o sira bilenman kana tiɲɛ. O kɔrɔ ye ko sinsin bɛna kɛ don nataw la ka “dugukolo kura sɔrɔ kokura” nka ka sɛnɛyɔrɔ kɔrɔw bali ka minɛ walima ka tiɲɛ.

sɛnɛyɔrɔw jɔcogo ɲuman sabatili ni zoni ni danfara ye
"Togodala saba" baara sinsinnan dɔ ye san 2026 kɔnɔ, o ye ka "sɛnɛyɔrɔw jɔcogo ɲuman sabati ni jogo ɲumanba ye ni zoni ni danfara ye", ani ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli kan yɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ la, dugukolo jɛli fɛ, ji lakanani fɛɛrɛw fɛ, dugukolo yiriwali fɛ ani fɛɛrɛ wɛrɛw fɛ. Laɲini ye ka sɛnɛko biɲɛdimi kɛ kosɛbɛ san 2035 kɔnɔ, k’a lajɛ ko togodaw ka kɛ bi ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ye.

"Suman tɛ min na" labɛnni ani dugukolo bilalenw sɛnɛni kokura
Politiki in bɛ sinsin sɛnɛfɛnw "sɛnɛ tɛ" dugukolow labɛnni kan cogo basigilen na ani cogo labɛnnen na ani dugukolo bilalenw sɛnɛni kokura, ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw labɛncogo ɲuman kɛ, ani ka sɛnɛyɔrɔ dɔw baarakɛcogo segin, minnu bɔra ka da wariko sɛnɛfɛnw kan walima ka kɛ baarakɛbaliw ye.

2. Mun na i tɛ “yɛrɛlabɛnni” kofɔ?
Lamini ni nafolo gɛlɛyaw : Sinuwa jamana ka dugukolo sɛnɛta nafolo maralenw dan ye, wa u fanba bɛ yɔrɔw la minnu bɛ sigida laminiko gɛlɛya. Labɛnnibaw bɛ se ka kɛ sababu ye ka sigida gɛlɛyaw lase mɔgɔw ma.
Dugukolo kan suman suguya bɛ tali kɛ tiɲɛ na : Sɛnɛfɛn dɔw i n’a fɔ soja ni ɲɔ, olu mago bɛ ka don jamana kɔnɔ hali bi, wa sɛnɛko politiki bɛ sinsin sigida lakanani kan « jamana kɔnɔ yɛrɛdɔn jɔnjɔnw ni fɛnw doncogo faralenw » kan.
Waati jugumanba nɔfɛkow : Sanjiba ni ja bɛ kɛ tuma caman, o b’a to a ka gɛlɛn ka sɛnɛfɛnw ni sɔrɔ sabatili sabati. Politikiw sinsinnan jiginna faratiw kɛlɛli sekow ni fɛɛrɛ kuraw la walasa ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli kan.
Yala aw b’a fɛ n ka yɔrɔ kolomaw lisɛli labɛn sɛnɛyɔrɔw jɔli siratigɛ la san 2026 kɔnɔ walasa k’aw dɛmɛ ka faamuyali jɛlen sɔrɔ jamana ye nafolo belebele bila yɔrɔ minnu na wa?
User ye fasari min ta, o marala:
Sinuwa jamana ka san 2026 bolodalen sɛnɛ dugukolo yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sɔrɔli kama

Sinuwa ka san 2026 laɲini na, dugukoloko laɲini kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen tɛ yen walasa ka sɛnɛko dugukolo yɛrɛta sɔrɔ. O nɔ na, ​​a b’a sinsin sɛnɛyɔrɔ ci bilenmanw kan dugukolo kama minu ka ɲi Sɛnɛ kama, ani k'a cɛɲi ɲɛ ni ka wasa sɔrɔ a baarali la, faso ka balo lakana kafoli la. Sisan fɛɛrɛ in kunba ye "ka sɛnɛyɔrɔ sabati, ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw bɔta kan yɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ la, ani ka labɛncogo ɲuman kɛ", ka bɔ o nɔ na fɛrɛba la dugukolo minu ka ɲi Sɛnɛ kama.

Fɔlɔ. Ka jɔlanw ɲɛsin fɛɛrɛw kan: ka baloko lakana minu ka ɲi Sɛnɛ kama,ani ka bɔta hakɛ sinsin.

**Ka tugu layini bilenman na kosɛbɛ dugukolo kama minu ka ɲi sɛnɛ na :** fɛɛrɛ in b’a ɲini k’a jɛya ko "ka tugu layini bilen na kosɛbɛ sɛnɛfɛnw na", ka Sumannikɛlan ɲɛnabɔ kosɛbɛ sɛnɛfɛnw minɛni ni musakaw cɛ, ani k'a lajɛ ko layini bilenman min ye mu miliyari 1,8 ye (hectare miliyɔn 120) sɛnɛta dugukolo kan, o kana tiɲɛ. O kɔrɔ ye ko siniɲɛsigi sinsin tɛ "dugukolo kura sɔrɔli" kan, nka sɛnɛyɔrɔ kɔrɔw minɛni walima u tiɲɛni balili kan.

**Ka jajɔ kɛ ka Sɛnɛ dugukolow dilan min cɛɲi kɔrɔtalen don ka kɛɲɛ ni mara ni kuluw ye :** ka bɔ Baara jɔnjɔn dɔ la min bɛna kɛ "sɛnɛ tigɛyɔrɔ kama, togodaw, ani sɛnɛkɛlaw" fɛ san 2026 kɔnɔ,Ka jajɔ kɛ ka Sɛnɛ dugukolow dilan min cɛɲi kɔrɔtalen don ka kɛɲɛ ni mara ni kuluw ye , o ye ka dɔ fara bɔta furancɛ kelen kelen bɛɛ kan"ka bɔ dugukolow Kelenyali sababu fɛ, ani ka fɛnsɔrɔsiraw yiriwa Sɔnni kama, ani ka sɛnɛ bɔgɔ ɲɛ,o Laɲini o de ye ka sɛnɛ kuraya san 2035 kɔnɔ, yɔrɔ la togodaw maraw b'u daamu ni ɲɛnamaya jɔlan kura ye.

**Dugukolow labaarali kɛlɛli magow kama min tɛ sɛnɛko ye ani dugukolo bilalenw seginni :** fɛɛrɛ in bɛ sinsin jɛya kan dɔɔnin dɔɔnin ani jɛkulu sɛnɛ dugukolow labaarali kan magow kama min tɛ sɛnɛko ye, ani dugukolo bilalenw labɛnni, ni ka sɛnɛ dugukolow labɛncogo ɲuman kɛ ani ka sɛnɛyɔrɔ dɔw baara lasegin minnu bilalen don wari sɔrɔko kɔsɔn walima k'a baarakɛbaliya .

**II. Mun na ɲɛni tɛ fɔ "ka i yɛrɛ ɲɛ"?**

**Lamini feregew ani nafolomafɛnw:** Sinuwa jamana ka dugukolo nafolo sɛnɛtaw danmadɔ bɛ yen, minnu caman bɛ sɔrɔ yɔrɔw la minnu bɛ se ka sɛnɛ. Labɛnnibaw bɛ se ka kɛ sababu ye ka sigida gɛlɛyaw lawuli.

**Ka jigi da diɲɛ balo sugu kan:** Sɛnɛfɛn dɔw la, i n’a fɔ Sunbalasiyɔ ni kaba, olu mago bɛ donni na. Sɛnɛko fɛɛrɛ bɛ sinsin bakolo lakana kan o min jɔlen don yɛrɛwasa kan sigidalaka min dɛmɛnen don ni dontaw ye''. 

**San ni dugu cɛ ka bangeta nɔbila jugumanbaw:** jiwooyow ni jaw min bɛ segin ka bɔ basigi gɛlɛya la bɔli kama ani mɛli,sinsinni fɛɛrɛw bɛ yɛlɛma ka taa faratikow kɛlɛli la ani ka dɔ fara dili kan fɛɛrɛbɔko la. 

**San ni dugu cɛ ka bangeta nɔbila jugumanbaw** Yala aw b’a fɛ ne ka yɔrɔ kolomaw jɔcogo labɛn sɛnɛyɔrɔ jɔli siratigɛ la san 2026 kɔnɔ walasa k’aw dɛmɛ ka faamuyali ɲuman sɔrɔ jamana ye nafolo caman don yɔrɔ min na wa? A ka nafolomafɛnw fanba la.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5153 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-23 17:53:20 CEST
Irisi jamana b’a fɛ ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw segin walasa ka yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔ san 2026 kɔnɔ.

Irisi jamana bɛ ka porogaramuba dɔw waleya kosɛbɛ walasa ka sɛnɛfɛnw bila baara la walasa ka balo sɔrɔ ani ka yɛrɛdɔn, k’a sɔrɔ dugukolo seginni labɛnw labɛnna fo san 2030, ni cɛmancɛ taabolow ye san 2026. 

O baara in yɔrɔ kolomaw fo san 2026, olu ye :
Dugukolo sendon : Jamana ka porogaramu hukumu kɔnɔ, min bɛ baara kɛ kabini san 2022, a labɛnna ka sɛnɛyɔrɔ miliyɔn 2 ɲɔgɔn don baara la min ma baara kɛ san 3 kɔnɔ (2024–2026).
Porogaramu in bonya : K’a bɛɛ lajɛlen ta, jamana ka porogaramu waati kɔnɔ (fo ka se san 2030 ma), a bolodara ka hectare miliyɔn 13 lasegin a ka baara la, ni dugukolo baarabaliw bɛɛ lajɛlen jateminɛlen ye hectare miliyɔn 44 ye.
Dankanw labɛnni : K’a daminɛ san 2026 marisikalo tile fɔlɔ la, Irisi jamana ka sɛnɛko minisiriso bɛna fanga sɔrɔ ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw dancɛw sigi sen kan ani k’u Changer (sɛnɛyɔrɔw, baganmarayɔrɔw, dugukolow) walasa u ka baara kɛ ka ɲɛ.
Yɛrɛlabɛn : San 2025-2026, Irisi ye yɛrɛdɔn hakɛba sɔrɔ fɛnba dɔw la, i n’a fɔ pɔmitɛri (97,9% san 2025) ani nakɔfɛnw (a bɛ surunya 90%).
Jamana ka dɛmɛ : San 2026, a bolodara ka ruble miliyari 500 ni kɔ bila sɛnɛko dɛmɛni na, o la, nafolo bɛna kɛ dugukolo labɛnni ni nizɛrikan na.
Nizɛrikan na : San 2026, jamanakuntigi tɔgɔ la, a labɛnna ka sɛnɛko 50% kɛ nizɛrikan na.

O fɛɛrɛw kun ye ka dɔ fara sɔrɔ mumɛ kan, o la, marabolo minnu farala ɲɔgɔn kan kokura, ani ka jamana kɔnɔ sugu sabati.

O fɛɛrɛw kun ye ka dɔ fara sɔrɔ mumɛ kan, o la, marabolo minnu farala ɲɔgɔn kan kokura, ani ka jamana kɔnɔ sugu sabati.
User ye fasari min ta, o marala:
Irisi jamana b’a cɛsiri ka sɛnɛ dugukolow labɛn kokura walasa ka yɛrɛta kɛ tiɲɛ ye san 2026 kɔnɔ.

Irisi jamana bɛ ka farifoni kɛ Waleyaw fɛrɛli la kosɛbɛ walasa ka sɛnɛ dugukolow labɛn kokura. ka balo lakana ani ka yɛrɛwasa sɔrɔ. Wa a bɛ ka bɔ jigiyaw la ka Dugukolo labɛnni fɛɛrɛ kɛ ka se fo san 2030, a ban waati kuntaalajanw ka dafa san 2026.

A kɛrɛ kunba bɛ fara ɲɔgɔn kan nin Teliyako in kama waati kɔnɔ fo ka se san 2026 ma ani min bɛ tugu o la:
Dugukolo labɛnni : a bɛ gofɛrɛnɛman ka waleya jaakuyalen kɔnɔ, baara daminɛ na ni min ye kabini san 2022, ka bɔ labɛnni fɛɛrɛ la, min ka surun hectare miliyɔn 2 ɲɔgɔn na, ka bɔ sɛnɛ dugukolow la min tun tɛ ka baara san saba kuntaala kɔnɔ (2024–2026).
Waleyaw hakɛ : Gofɛrɛnɛman ka waleyaw kɔnɔna na (fo ka se san 2030 ma), ka bɔ labɛnni fɛɛrɛw la, min man dɔgɔ  hectare miliyɔn 13 ma dugukolo bonyaw bɛɛ lajelen faralen ɲɔgɔn kan o hakɛ ye hectare miliyɔn 44 ye. 
Dancɛw labɛnni : K’a daminɛ san 2026 marisikalo tile fɔlɔ la, Irisi jamana ka sɛnɛko minisiriso bɛna yamaruya sɔrɔ dansigili la ani sɛnɛ dugukolow dancɛw yɛlɛmani na (dugukolo minnu ka ɲi Sɛnɛ kama, ani gɛnnikɛ yɔrɔw, ani sɛnɛ dugukolo ɲuman kɔrɔw min tɛ ka baara la) walasa u baara fara ɲɔgɔn kan ni wasaba ye.
Yɛrɛwasa : San 2025-2026, Irisi bɛna hakɛ kɔrɔtalen kɛ tiɲɛ ye ka bɔ yɛrɛta karajago jɔlanw na fɛn min b'o la o ye pɔmitɛri ye (97,9% san 2025) ani nakɔfɛnw (a bɛ surunya 90%).
Gofɛrɛnaman ka dɛmɛ : ka bɔ jigiya kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw na a ka ca rubulu miliyari 500 ye ka sɛnɛ dɛmɛ san 2026 kɔnɔ, ka bɔ o la, nafolo bɛna di dugukolo labɛnni ni jatedenya na.
Jatedenya yɛlɛmali: San 2026, jamanakuntigi ye cikan bɔ ni ɲɛsinfanw yɛlɛmali ye 50% ka bɔ sɛnɛ dilanni na ka taa jatedenya labɛnni na.

O jagɛlɛya in bɛ laɲini kɛ ka taa dɔ farali kan suman sɔrɔta bɛɛ la, fɛn min b' o la o ye ka bɔ dugukolow Kelenyali la, ani ka sigida  suguw magow jaabi.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5166 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-23 14:31:28 CEST
Ukraine ye sɛnɛyɔrɔ segin a yɛrɛ ma san 2026

San 2026, Ukraine ye fanga di sɛnɛyɔrɔw seginni ma minnu tun tɛ baara kɛ ni u ye fɔlɔ walima minnu nɔgɔlen don kɛlɛw kosɔn, walasa ka balo sɔrɔ ani ka sɛnɛko segin a cogo kɔrɔ la. Gofɛrɛnaman ye sariyasunba dɔ ta dugukolow seginni teliya kan, hali ni faratiw bɛ u la, ka nafolo caman bila u minɛnw bɔli kama. 

Dugukolo seginni yɔrɔ kolomaw san 2026 kɔnɔ:
Minɛnw bɔli n’u labɛnni : San 2026 ta la, UAH miliyari 2 ni kɔ bilala sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli la hadamadenya siratigɛ la. Hectare 12.000 ni kɔ de seginna kaban, wa gɔfɛrɛnaman b’a fɛ k’a lajɛ ko dugukolo minnu bɛ yɔrɔ kɔrɔsilenw na, olu fo ka se 90% ma, san laban na.
Jamana ka dɛmɛ : San 2026 baarakɛnafolo bɛ UAH miliyari 13,1 bila sɛnɛko siratigɛ la, o la, bolomafaraw, minɛnw musakaw ani juru donna sɛnɛkɛlaw ma minnu bɛ dugukolo seginni baara.
Sɛnɛko jateminɛw : Ka kɛɲɛ ni jateminɛw ye, san 2026, sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛna sɛnɛ kɛ hectare miliyɔn 22-23 ɲɔgɔn na, o bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka suman tigɛ sabatilen sɔrɔ jamana kɔnɔ magow ni jamana kɔkan.
Sariyasen kura : K’a daminɛ san 2026 zanwuyekalo tile fɔlɔ la, impositi jatebɔsɛbɛn kura donna jamana ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw jatebɔ la.
Seginkanni fɛɛrɛ : O wale in ye Ukɛrɛni ka seginkanni dakun sabanan dɔ ye (2026-2032), min sinsinnen bɛ yiriwali, biɲɛdimi ani waridonna samali kan.

Ukraine ye sɛnɛyɔrɔ segin a yɛrɛ ma san 2026

San 2026, Ukraine ye fanga di sɛnɛyɔrɔw seginni ma minnu tun tɛ baara kɛ ni u ye fɔlɔ walima minnu nɔgɔlen don kɛlɛw kosɔn, walasa ka balo sɔrɔ ani ka sɛnɛko segin a cogo kɔrɔ la. Sɛnɛko bolodacogo n’a jaabi : Ni "ji fanga" misali kura ye, laɲini ye ka sɔrɔko lakanani sabati ani ka dɔ fara sɛnɛko ɲɛnabɔli kan san 2026 kɔnɔ.
Yɛrɛwasa : Turquie de ye yɛrɛwasa hakɛ cayalenba ye fɛn fanba la (misali la, 113% nakɔfɛnw na, 156% jiridenw na). Nka, san 2026 labɛnw kun ye ka gɛrɛ sabatili dafalen na ni sigida sɔrɔ yiriwali ye, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, fɛnw na minnu bɛ na ni u ye jamana wɛrɛw la i n’a fɔ sukaro, jiridenw, ani baganw balo.

Sɛnɛko jatebɔ : Minisiri b’a fɛ ka sɛnɛko jatebɔ bɛɛjɛfanga dɔ kɛ, min bɛ jate sɛnɛko siratigɛ la, k’a ta san 2026 la.
Budjet ni dɛmɛ : Sɛnɛ ni dugu yiriwali minisiriso ka baarakɛnafolo san 2026 kɔnɔ, o ye Turki lira miliyari 542 ye, wa a jigi b’a kan ka Turki lira miliyari 168 bila kɛrɛfɛ sɛnɛko dɛmɛni siratigɛ la.

Waati: 2026-02-23 12:26:10 CEST
Ukraine ye sɛnɛyɔrɔ segin a yɛrɛ ma san 2026

San 2026, Ukraine ye fanga di sɛnɛyɔrɔw seginni ma minnu tun tɛ baara kɛ ni u ye fɔlɔ walima minnu nɔgɔlen don kɛlɛw kosɔn, walasa ka balo sɔrɔ ani ka sɛnɛko segin a cogo kɔrɔ la. Gofɛrɛnaman ye sariyasunba dɔ ta dugukolow seginni teliya kan, hali ni faratiw bɛ u la, ka nafolo caman bila u minɛnw bɔli kama. 

Dugukolo seginni yɔrɔ kolomaw san 2026 kɔnɔ:
Minɛnw bɔli n’u labɛnni : San 2026 ta la, UAH miliyari 2 ni kɔ bilala sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli la hadamadenya siratigɛ la. Hectare 12.000 ni kɔ de seginna kaban, wa gɔfɛrɛnaman b’a fɛ k’a lajɛ ko dugukolo minnu bɛ yɔrɔ kɔrɔsilenw na, olu fo ka se 90% ma, san laban na.
Jamana ka dɛmɛ : San 2026 baarakɛnafolo bɛ UAH miliyari 13,1 bila sɛnɛko siratigɛ la, o la, bolomafaraw, minɛnw musakaw ani juru donna sɛnɛkɛlaw ma minnu bɛ dugukolo seginni baara.
Sɛnɛko jateminɛw : Ka kɛɲɛ ni jateminɛw ye, san 2026, sɛnɛkɛlaw bɛna sɛnɛ kɛ hectare miliyɔn 22-23 ɲɔgɔn na, o bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka suman tigɛ sabatilen sɔrɔ jamana kɔnɔ magow ni jamana kɔkan.
Sariyasen kura : K’a daminɛ san 2026 zanwuyekalo tile fɔlɔ la, impositi jatebɔsɛbɛn kura donna jamana ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw jatebɔ la.
Seginkanni fɛɛrɛ : O wale in ye Ukɛrɛni ka seginkanni dakun sabanan dɔ ye (2026-2032), min sinsinnen bɛ yiriwali, biɲɛdimi ani waridonna samali kan. 
O fɛɛrɛ ninnu kun ye ka dugukolo segin sɔrɔko siratigɛ la joona, ka sɔrɔko sabatili n’a ka balo yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sabati Ukraine jamana na.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5183 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-23 10:57:19 CEST
Türkiye ka sɛnɛko dugukoloko baarabolodalen laɲini ye ka yɛrɛta sɔrɔ sɛnɛko la san 2026 kɔnɔ.

Turquie ye san 2024-2028 fɛɛrɛbɔ bolodalen dɔ waleya ani sɛnɛfɛnw dilanni bolodacogo bɛɛ lajɛlen labɛn walasa ka dɔ fara sɛnɛko sabatili kan ani ka dɔ bɔ dulonni na fɛn minnu bɛ bɔ kɔkan. Fɛn minnu bɛ tugu San 2026 laɲiniw na ani sisan yiriwali nafamaw la Olu ye ninnu ye :

Sɛnɛfɛnw dilanni bolodacogo ni jaabi ɲuman sɔrɔli : Ni "ji-kɛnɛya" misali kura ye, o laɲini ye ka sɔrɔko lakanani lakana ani ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw sɔrɔli kan fɛɛrɛbɔ siratigɛ la san 2026 kɔnɔ.
Yɛrɛwasa : Turki ye yɛrɛwasa hakɛ ka ca kaban fɛn caman na (misali la, 113% nakɔfɛnw na, 156% jiriden mugantaw la). Nka, san 2026 bolodalenw kun ye ka gɛrɛ yɛrɛta dafalen na, n’o ye ka dɔ fara sigida la sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli kan, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, yɔrɔ minnu na u b'u dulon, fɛnw dondonni na, i n’a fɔ siyɔw, jiriden kolow, ani bagan balow.
Yɛrɛta Dugukolo labɛnni ni fɛnsɔrɔsiraw la : ka bɔ fɛɛrɛw la ka fɛnsɔrɔsiraw dafa Sɛnɛyɔrɔ 7 kama o bolodara san 2026. I n'a fɔ a bɛ jigiya cogo min na ko  sɛnɛ dugulolow hakɛ bɛna tɛmɛ hectare miliyɔn 7,3 kan san 2026.
Sɛnɛ jatebɔ : Minisiriso b’a fɛ ka sɛnɛko jatebɔ bɛɛ lajɛlen dafa, o min bɛ jate jɔlan ye tigitigiyali kama ka bɔ sɛnɛko kunnafoniw na san 2026 kɔnɔ.
Baarakɛnafolo ni dɛmɛn : Sɛnɛko ni kungo minisiriso ka baarakɛnafolo san 2026 kɔnɔ,o bɛ turiki liira miliyari 542 bɔ ; wa a bɛ jigiyaw la ka turiki liira miliyari 168 kɛrɛnkɛrɛn ka bɔ a la sɛnɛko dɛmɛw tilenen kama. 

Walasa ka kunnafoni wɛrɛw sɔrɔ, aw bɛ se ka sɛnɛko ni kungo minisiriso ka san 2024-2028 fɛɛrɛbɔ sɛbɛn lajɛ walima ka tugu sisan laɲiniw kɔ san 2026 baarakɛcogo waleyaw sababu fɛ.
Yala aw b’a fɛ ka dɛmɛ hakɛ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw dɔn fɛn dilannen kulu kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen dɔ la (misali la, Alikaama walima tile den) nin labɛn in kɔnɔ wa?

Sɛnɛfɛnw dilanni bolodacogo n’a baarakɛcogo ɲuman : Ni "ji-kɛnɛya" misali kura ye, a laɲini ye ka sɔrɔko lakanani sabati ani ka dɔ fara baarakɛcogo ɲuman kan fɛn dilanni fɛɛrɛw la fo san 2026.
Yɛrɛlabɛn : Türkiye bɛ se ka kɛ kaban fɛn caman na (misali la 113% nakɔfɛnw na, 156% jiridenw na). Nka, san 2026 bolodalenw laɲini ye ka gɛrɛ dafalen na, n’o ye ka dɔ fara jamana kɔnɔ sɛnɛfɛnw kan, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, yɔrɔ minnu na, fɛnw dondonni bɛ bɔ jamana kɔnɔ, i n’a fɔ shɔ, tulumafɛnw ani baganw balo.
Dugukolo labɛnni ni fɛnsɔrɔsiraw : A bolodara ka sɛnɛyɔrɔ labɛnni 7 ka fɛnsɔrɔsiraw dafa san 2026. Ka fara o kan, sɛnɛyɔrɔ minnu bɛ se ka jigin, olu hakɛ bɛna tɛmɛ hectare miliyɔn 7,3 kan san 2026.
Sɛnɛ jatebɔ : Minisiri b’a fɛ ka sɛnɛko jatebɔ bɛɛ lajɛlen dafa, min nafa ka bon sɛnɛko kunnafoniw sɛgɛsɛgɛli la, san 2026 kɔnɔ.
Baarakɛnafolo ni dɛmɛni : Sɛnɛ ni kungo minisiriso ka baarakɛnafolo min bɛna kɛ san 2026 kɔnɔ, o jateminɛna ka kɛ TL miliyari 542 ye ; o baarakɛnafolo TL miliyari 168 bolodara ka bila sɛnɛko dɛmɛni siratigɛ la. 


Walasa ka kunnafoni wɛrɛw sɔrɔ, aw bɛ se ka sɛnɛko ni kungo minisiriso ka san 2024-2028 fɛɛrɛbɔ sɛbɛn lajɛ walima ka tugu sisan laɲiniw kɔ san 2026 baarakɛcogo porogaramu sababu fɛ.
Yala aw b’a fɛ ka dɛmɛ hakɛ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw dɔn sɛnɛfɛnw kulu kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen dɔ la (misali la malo walima tilebɔ) nin labɛn in kɔnɔ wa?

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5191 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-23 08:49:56 CEST
Ameriki ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw labɛnni ka ɲɛsin a dakun filanan ma san 2026

Ka da kunnafoniw kan minnu bɔra san 2026 feburuyekalo la, sɛnɛko dugukolo marali n’a lakanani Ameriki jamana na san 2026 nafolosɔrɔta kama, o sinsinnen don kosɛbɛ ji lakanani kan Tlebi fɛ, ni waati dantigɛlen jɔnjɔnw ye baganmara porogaramuw kama san 2026 marisikalo la. 
Yɛlɛmaba minnu kɛra san 2026 kɔnɔ, olu ye :
Koloradugu baji baarakɛcogo san 2026 kɔfɛ: U.S. Bureau of Reclamation bɛ ka taabolo gɛlɛn dɔ ɲɛminɛ, min bɛ kɛ san caman kɔnɔ, wa a ka c’a la, a bɛ kɛ cogo la min tɛ jɔ, walasa ka baarakɛcogo laadilikanw latigɛ Powell baji ni Mead baji la san 2026 kɔfɛ, ni bɛnkan laban waati dantigɛlen ye Ɔkutɔburukalo tile 1 san 2026. Lamini nɔfɛko fɔlen (EIS) sɛbɛn dɔ bɔra Zanwuyekalo tile 9 san 2026, min bɛ fɛɛrɛ wɛrɛw jira ka ɲɛsin jiko nataw ma ka kɛɲɛ ni ja basigilen ye.
Baganmara porogaramu waati dantigɛlenw : USDA ka sigida nafolo lakanani baarada (NRCS) ye waati dantigɛlen jɔnjɔnw boloda baganmara porogaramuw kama, ni san 2026 marisikalo tile 13 ye, o kɛra sɛnɛko lakanani nɔgɔya porogaramu (ALE) ka ɲɔgɔndan don filanan ni laban ye Niyɔriki. Kɔnɛkɛti jamana na, mɔgɔ filanan min bɛna kɛ baganmara porogaramu jɔnjɔnw na, o bolodara ka kɛ Marisikalo tile 20 san 2026.
Dugukolo ladonni ni a sabatili : San 2026 Dakota woroduguyanfan dugukoloko lajɛba (marisikalo tile 3-4, san 2026) bɛ sinsin sɛnɛ ni dugukolo labɛnni cɛtigɛcogo kan, ka sinsin dugukolo kɛnɛya kan, dɔnniya waleyali, ani fanga sɔrɔli don sɛnɛyɔrɔw la.
Lamini sariyaw : EPA y’a jira ko a sɔnna waati dɔɔnin dicamba ma walasa ka baara kɛ ni a ye ka tɛmɛn bɔgɔ ni soja kan san 2026 ni 2027 sɛnɛ waatiw la, k’a jira ko a ka kan ka binjuguw ɲɛnabɔ minnu bɛ se ka binfagalanw kɛlɛ.
Sɛnɛko politiki : "Sɛnɛko, dumuniko ani jamana lakanani sariya san 2026" (a bɛ fɔ a ma tuma caman na ko san 2026 sɛnɛko sariyasun) bɛ ka labɛn Kongresi kɔnɔ, min kɔnɔ, sariyaw bɛ sɔrɔ sɛnɛko tigitigi kan ani nɔnɔko porogaramu kura, minnu bɛ mɛn sen na. 

Nin wale ninnu bɛ kɛ sababu ye ka sigida sabatili sabati, ka jiko ɲuman kɛ, ani ka ja nɔ minnu bɛ sɛnɛko la, olu ɲɛnabɔ.

User ye fasari min ta, o marala:
Sɛnɛ dugukolow labɛnni Ameriki ka ɲɛsin a dakun filanan ma san 2026

 Ka da kunnafoniw kan minnu bɔra san 2026 feburuyekalo la, sɛnɛko dugukolo marali n’a lakanani Ameriki jamana na san 2026 San nafolosɔrɔta kama, cogoyabala o sinsinnen don ji labaarali Ladilikan kan Tilebi fɛ, ni waati dantigɛlen kuntigiya jɔnjɔnw banni ye Ladilikan waleyaw kama san 2026 marisikalo la. 
O bɛ Ɲɛtaa kunba fara ɲɔgɔn kan San 2026 kɔnɔ, olu ye :
 Ka Koloradugu baji baara san 2026 kɔfɛ : Ameriki dugukolo labɛnni ɲɛmaaso bɛ ka baaraba haminankoba ɲɛminɛ,o bɛ banban san caman kɔnɔ a ka c'a la a tɛna jɔli ye, walasa ka baarakɛcogo bilasiralikanw latigɛ baji fila la Powell baji ni Mead baji la san 2026 kɔfɛ, ani bɛnkan waati latigɛlen don ka kɛ Ɔkutɔburukalo tile 1 san 2026. Lamini nɔfɛko kunnafonisɛbɛn (EIS) sɛbɛn dɔ bɔra Zanwuyekalo tile 9 san 2026, min bɛ fɛɛrɛ wɛrɛw jira ka ɲɛsin jiko nataw ma ka kɛɲɛ ni ja basigilen ye.
 nafolomafɛnw mara waleya waati dantigɛlenw : Ameriki dugukolo labɛnni ɲɛmaaso ka sigida nafolo lakanani baarada (NRCS) n'o tugulen don Ameriki sɛnɛko minisiriso la o ye waati laban dantigɛlen jɔnjɔnw boloda nafolomafɛnw mara waleyaw kama, yɔrɔla Marisikalo tile 13  san 2026 dantigɛra, i  n'a fɔ waati laban tɔgɔsɛbɛn, digiko filanan ye ka bɔ mara waleyaw la sɛnɛkɛ dugukolow la Niyɔriki. Ani Kuunteekiti mara la, ka bɔ latigɛw la ka da yele tɔgɔsɛbɛn kama mara waleyaw la nafolomafɛnw jɔnjɔnw na, o bolodara ka kɛ Marisikalo tile 20 san 2026.
 Dugukolo labɛnni ni a sabatili : o b'a sinsin dugukolo labɛnni kan San 2026 Dakota kɔgɔduguyanfan fɛ (marisikalo tile 3-4, san 2026) jɛɲɔgɔnya kan sɛnɛko ni dugukolo labɛnni ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ, ka fara sinsinni kan sɛnɛkɛ bɔgɔ kɛnɛya kan, ani dugukolo sigida dɔnniya, ani ka fanga bɔli ɲagami sɛnɛ dugukolow la.
 Lamini sariyaw : lamini Lakanani kɔlɔsibagaw y’a jira k'u sɔnna ka Fɛnɲɛnamafagalan dicamba baara walasa ka fonfonni kɛ ni a ye tilenenyara kɔɔri ni Sunbalasiyɔ la san 2026 ni 2027 sɛnɛ waati filaw la, tilenyara binjuguw kɛlɛli tɔɔrɔ kan minnu bɛ se ka binfagalanw kɛlɛ. 
Lamini sariyaw: Sɛnɛko fɛɛrɛw : baara bɛ ka boli sisan wasabulon kɔnɔ"Sɛnɛ sariya ni baloko ani jamanadenw lakanani seginni kan san 2026" (n'a dɔnnen don tugun ko san 2026 sɛnɛko sariyasun) o min bɛ dannaya dɔw fara ɲɔgɔn kan A bɛ tali Kɛ sɛnɛko tigitigi la.Ani waleya kuntaalajan kuraw Waati dantigɛlen Nɔnɔ bɔli kama. 

 Nin Teliyako ninnu bɛ dulon ka taa magow la ka taa Mɛli sinsin na, ani jiko wasa ɲɛnabɔli ɲɛmaaso la, ani ka ja nɔ furakɛ sɛnɛ bɔli fɛnw na.

Waati: 2026-02-23 08:49:36 CEST

Koloradugu baji baarakɛcogo san 2026 kɔfɛ: U.S. Bureau of Reclamation bɛ ka taabolo gɛlɛn dɔ ɲɛminɛ, min bɛ kɛ san caman kɔnɔ, wa a ka c’a la, a bɛ kɛ cogo la min tɛ jɔ, walasa ka baarakɛcogo laadilikanw latigɛ Powell baji ni Mead baji la san 2026 kɔfɛ, ni bɛnkan laban waati dantigɛlen ye Ɔkutɔburukalo tile 1 san 2026. Waati: 2026-02-23 02:14:39 CEST
Sɛnɛ dugukolow labɛnni Ameriki ka ɲɛsin a dakun filanan ma san 2026

 Ka da kunnafoniw kan minnu bɔra san 2026 feburuyekalo la, sɛnɛko dugukolo marali n’a lakanani Ameriki jamana na san 2026 San nafolosɔrɔta kama, cogoyabala o sinsinnen don ji labaarali Ladilikan kan Tilebi fɛ, ni waati dantigɛlen kuntigiya jɔnjɔnw banni ye Ladilikan waleyaw kama san 2026 marisikalo la. 
O bɛ Ɲɛtaa kunba fara ɲɔgɔn kan San 2026 kɔnɔ, olu ye :
 Ka Koloradugu baji baara san 2026 kɔfɛ : Ameriki dugukolo labɛnni ɲɛmaaso bɛ ka baaraba haminankoba ɲɛminɛ,o bɛ banban san caman kɔnɔ a ka c'a la a tɛna jɔli ye, walasa ka baarakɛcogo bilasiralikanw latigɛ baji fila la Powell baji ni Mead baji la san 2026 kɔfɛ, ani bɛnkan waati latigɛlen don ka kɛ Ɔkutɔburukalo tile 1 san 2026.  nafolomafɛnw mara waleya waati dantigɛlenw : Ameriki dugukolo labɛnni ɲɛmaaso ka sigida nafolo lakanani baarada (NRCS) n'o tugulen don Ameriki sɛnɛko minisiriso la o ye waati laban dantigɛlen jɔnjɔnw boloda nafolomafɛnw mara waleyaw kama, yɔrɔla Marisikalo tile 13  san 2026 dantigɛra, i  n'a fɔ waati laban tɔgɔsɛbɛn, digiko filanan ye ka bɔ mara waleyaw la sɛnɛkɛ dugukolow la Niyɔriki. Ani Kuunteekiti mara la, ka bɔ latigɛw la ka da yele tɔgɔsɛbɛn kama mara waleyaw la nafolomafɛnw jɔnjɔnw na, o bolodara ka kɛ Marisikalo tile 20 san 2026.
 Dugukolo labɛnni ni a sabatili : o b'a sinsin dugukolo labɛnni kan San 2026 Dakota kɔgɔduguyanfan fɛ (marisikalo tile 3-4, san 2026) jɛɲɔgɔnya kan sɛnɛko ni dugukolo labɛnni ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ, ka fara sinsinni kan sɛnɛkɛ bɔgɔ kɛnɛya kan, ani dugukolo sigida dɔnniya, ani ka fanga bɔli ɲagami sɛnɛ dugukolow la.
 Lamini sariyaw : lamini Lakanani kɔlɔsibagaw y’a jira k'u sɔnna ka Fɛnɲɛnamafagalan dicamba baara walasa ka fonfonni kɛ ni a ye tilenenyara kɔɔri ni Sunbalasiyɔ la san 2026 ni 2027 sɛnɛ waati filaw la, tilenyara binjuguw kɛlɛli tɔɔrɔ kan minnu bɛ se ka binfagalanw kɛlɛ. 
Lamini sariyaw: Sɛnɛko fɛɛrɛw : baara bɛ ka boli sisan wasabulon kɔnɔ"Sɛnɛ sariya ni baloko ani jamanadenw lakanani seginni kan san 2026" (n'a dɔnnen don tugun ko san 2026 sɛnɛko sariyasun) o min bɛ dannaya dɔw fara ɲɔgɔn kan A bɛ tali Kɛ sɛnɛko tigitigi la.Ani waleya kuntaalajan kuraw Waati dantigɛlen Nɔnɔ bɔli kama.

 Ka da kunnafoniw kan minnu bɔra san 2026 feburuyekalo la, sɛnɛko dugukolo marali n’a lakanani Ameriki jamana na san 2026 nafolosɔrɔta kama, o sinsinnen don kosɛbɛ ji lakanani kan Tlebi fɛ, ni waati dantigɛlen jɔnjɔnw ye baganmara porogaramuw kama san 2026 marisikalo la. 
 Yɛlɛmaba minnu kɛra san 2026 kɔnɔ, olu ye :
 Koloradugu baji baarakɛcogo san 2026 kɔfɛ: U.S. Bureau of Reclamation bɛ ka taabolo gɛlɛn dɔ ɲɛminɛ, min bɛ kɛ san caman kɔnɔ, wa a ka c’a la, a bɛ kɛ cogo la min tɛ jɔ, walasa ka baarakɛcogo laadilikanw latigɛ Powell baji ni Mead baji la san 2026 kɔfɛ, ni bɛnkan laban waati dantigɛlen ye Ɔkutɔburukalo tile 1 san 2026. Lamini nɔfɛko fɔlen (EIS) sɛbɛn dɔ bɔra Zanwuyekalo tile 9 san 2026, min bɛ fɛɛrɛ wɛrɛw jira ka ɲɛsin jiko nataw ma ka kɛɲɛ ni ja basigilen ye.
 Baganmara porogaramu waati dantigɛlenw : USDA ka sigida nafolo lakanani baarada (NRCS) ye waati dantigɛlen jɔnjɔnw boloda baganmara porogaramuw kama, ni san 2026 marisikalo tile 13 ye, o kɛra sɛnɛko lakanani nɔgɔya porogaramu (ALE) ka ɲɔgɔndan don filanan ni laban ye Niyɔriki.  Kɔnɛkɛti jamana na, mɔgɔ filanan min bɛna kɛ baganmara porogaramu jɔnjɔnw na, o bolodara ka kɛ Marisikalo tile 20 san 2026.
 Dugukolo ladonni ni a sabatili : San 2026 Dakota woroduguyanfan dugukoloko lajɛba (marisikalo tile 3-4, san 2026) bɛ sinsin sɛnɛ ni dugukolo labɛnni cɛtigɛcogo kan, ka sinsin dugukolo kɛnɛya kan, dɔnniya waleyali, ani fanga sɔrɔli don sɛnɛyɔrɔw la.
 Lamini sariyaw : EPA y’a jira ko a sɔnna waati dɔɔnin dicamba ma walasa ka baara kɛ ni a ye ka tɛmɛn bɔgɔ ni soja kan san 2026 ni 2027 sɛnɛ waatiw la, k’a jira ko a ka kan ka binjuguw ɲɛnabɔ minnu bɛ se ka binfagalanw kɛlɛ.
 Sɛnɛko politiki : "Sɛnɛko, dumuniko ani jamana lakanani sariya san 2026" (a bɛ fɔ a ma tuma caman na ko san 2026 sɛnɛko sariyasun) bɛ ka labɛn Kongresi kɔnɔ, min kɔnɔ, sariyaw bɛ sɔrɔ sɛnɛko tigitigi kan ani nɔnɔko porogaramu kura, minnu bɛ mɛn sen na. 

 Nin wale ninnu bɛ kɛ sababu ye ka sigida sabatili sabati, ka jiko ɲuman kɛ, ani ka ja nɔ minnu bɛ sɛnɛko la, olu ɲɛnabɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5252 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-22 13:25:33 CEST
ا Sɛnɛ yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya Faransi san 2026 kɔnɔ

Faransi ka sɛnɛko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya san 2026 kɔnɔ, o ye jamana politiki kuntilenna jɔnjɔn ye, min taamasiyɛn kɛra san 2026 nafolo sariyasun (PLF) tali kɔsa in na, min bɛ ɛrɔ miliyɔn 300 ni kɔ bila sɛnɛkɛlaw ka kɔrɔtɔko bolodalen dɔ la. 

Nin ye sisan koɲɛw ni san 2026 kɔnɔna na, a ɲɛfɔcogo jɔnjɔnw ye:
1. Yɛrɛlabɛn cogoya ka kɛɲɛ ni seko ni dɔnko ye
Hali ni tɔnɔ bɛ Faransi yɔrɔ dɔw la, a bɛ to ka da a kan yɔrɔ wɛrɛw la:
Yɛrɛlabaarakɛyɔrɔw : Jamana bɛ tɔnɔba sɔrɔ sɛnɛfɛnw, nɔnɔmafɛnw ani sogo la (a hakɛ bɛɛ lajɛlen na).
Barikantanya yɔrɔw : Faransi tɛ a yɛrɛ balo sɛnɛfɛnw na, wa a bɛ a ka jiridenw ni nakɔfɛnw yɔrɔba dɔ don jamana kɔnɔ. Kɔnɔw ta fan fɛ, jamana ka kan ka kɔnɔsogonin kura 575 lamini san 2026 kɔnɔ walasa k’a yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sabati.
Duniya bɛɛ ka bolomafara : Kɔsa in na, sɛgɛsɛgɛli dɔ y’a jira ko Faransi bɛ 60% dɔrɔn de dafa k’a ɲɛsin jamana kɔnɔ fɛnw ma. 

Gofɛrɛnaman ye fɛɛrɛ caman daminɛ walasa ka “dumuniko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya minɛ kokura” : 
Sɛnɛko ɲɛnabɔli sariya (2025): A bɛ san tan kuntilenna sigi sen kan, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la ka foro hakɛ sabati ka se 400.000 ma san 2035 kɔnɔ.
Fɛnɲɛnɛmaw balocogo bolodacogo : Laɲini ye ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw caya siɲɛ fila ni jiriw ka balofɛnw ye walasa ka dɔ bɔ soja ladonni na.
Jamana ka dumuniko, balodɛsɛ ani waati cogoya fɛɛrɛ (SNANC): A bɔra san 2026 feburuyekalo la, a bɛ dusu don sigida fɛnw dunni caya la, ka sɔrɔ ka dan sigi sogo minnu bɛ bɔ jamana wɛrɛw la.
Biɲɛdimi : Sɛnɛ yiriwali nafolo dɔ bɛna daminɛ san 2026 daminɛ na Crédit Agricole fɛ walasa ka dɛmɛ don funankɛninw sigili la ani forow labɛnni na. 

3. Gɛlɛyaw ni jɔrɔnankow
San 2026 bɛ daminɛ cogo gɛlɛn na:
Baara gɛlɛya : Sisan sɛnɛkɛlaw 50% ɲɔgɔnna bɛna lafiɲɛbɔ san 2030, o b’a to mɔgɔw ka bɔnsɔn kurayali nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ kabini san 2026.
Sosiyete ka sigida : San 2026 sɛnɛko jirali daminɛna gɛlɛyabaw kɔnɔ, min kɛra ni tɔn dɔw ka boykot ye minnu bɛ ɲɔgɔndan tilenbaliya ni sɔrɔ bɛrɛbɛrɛ jalaki. 

 
Yala aw b’a fɛ ka kunnafoni sɔrɔ dɛmɛ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen kan min dira PLF 2026 kɔnɔ sɛnɛko siratigɛ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen dɔ kama wa?

User ye fasari min ta, o marala:
Faransi sɛnɛko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sɔrɔli san 2026 kɔnɔ

Faransi sɛnɛko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sɔrɔli san 2026 kɔnɔ, o ye jamana Fɛɛrɛw kuntilenna jɔnjɔn ye, wa a y'o sinsin  san 2026 nafolosɔrɔko sariyasunba kan kɔsa in na, min bɛ ɛrowari miliyɔn 300 ni kɔ bila sɛnɛkɛlaw ka kɔrɔtɔko dɛmɛ bolodalen dɔ la.

Nin ye sisan koɲɛw ni san 2026 kɔnɔna na, a ɲɛfɔcogo jɔnjɔnw ye:
1. Yɛrɛwasa cogoya ka kɛɲɛ ni kow tigɛcogo ye ka bɔ tɔnɔ sɔrɔli jaakuyali tigɛyɔrɔ dɔw la 
Hali nin bɛɛ la Faransi a ma wuli a bɛ to k'a jigi da fɛnw dondonni kan yɔrɔ dɔw la: 
Tigɛyɔrɔ Wasalen minnu ye yɛrɛta ye: Faransi bɛ bɔli kɛ tɔnɔba la Suman kisɛw la ani Nɔnɔ ni Sogo ka fɛn bɔtaw la (a sego bɛɛ lajɛlen na).
Yɔrɔ minnu ka fɛgɛ : Faransi tɛ yɛrɛta kɛ tiɲɛ ye siyɔw la, wa a bɛ kunkurunba don jiriden mugantaw la ani Nakɔfɛnw na. nka fanw ta la, Faransi mago bɛ ka siyɛ kulukulu kura 575 ɲɔgɔn jɔ san 2026 kɔnɔ Walasa a ka se k’a  ka yɛrɛ wasa mara.

Dulonni bɛɛ: walanda kura dɔ bɛ jirali kɛ ko Faransi tɛ datuguni kɛ fo n'a bɔra 60% dɔrɔn de la ka bɔ a ka Sigida magoɲɛfɛnw mago la cogoya tilenen na.

Gofɛrɛnaman ye tileya damadɔ daminɛ walasa ka "baloko kuntigiya segin":
Sɛnɛko ɲɛnabɔli sariya (2025): Nin sariya in bɛ san tan kuntilenna sigi sen kan, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, a laɲini ye ka foro hakɛ sabati ka se 400.000 ma san 2035 kɔnɔ.
Falen fɛnw balocogo bolodacogo : o Laɲini ye ka Falen fɛnw foro hakɛ kɛ siɲɛ fila ye walasa ka dɔ bɔ jigida la sunbala siyɔ ladonni na.
Nka Jamana ka fɛɛrɛ, balo ni Baloko kama ani waati cogoya (SNANC): o jɛnsɛnna san 2026 feburuyekalo la, nin fɛɛrɛ in bɛ dusu don kɛ ka sigida fɛn bɔtaw dunni caya, ka sɔrɔ ka dan sigi sogow donni na.

Kurayali : Sɛnɛ yiriwali bolofara dɔ bɛna daminɛ san 2026 daminɛ na sɛnɛ jurudon fɛ walasa ka sɛnɛkɛla kamalenninw dɛmɛ ani ka forow kuraya.

3. Gɛlɛyaw ni jɔrɔnankow
San 2026 bɛ daminɛ cogo gɛlɛn na: 
Baarakɛyɔrɔw Gɛlɛya : Sisan sɛnɛkɛla 50% ɲɔgɔnna bɛna lafiɲɛbɔ kɛ san 2030, o b’a to mɔgɔw ka bɔnsɔn kurayali nafa ka bon san 2026 daminɛna.
Kafo ka sigida : San 2026 Pari diɲɛ sɛnɛko jirali daminɛna gɛlɛyabaw cɛma, min kɛra ni negebɔ ye ka bɔ tɔn dɔw fɛ minnu ye ɲɔgɔndan tilenbaliya ni sɔrɔ bɛrɛbɛrɛ jalaki.

Faransi ka sɛnɛko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya san 2026 kɔnɔ, o ye jamana politiki kuntilenna jɔnjɔn ye, min taamasiyɛn kɛra san 2026 nafolo sariyasun (PLF) tali kɔsa in na, min bɛ ɛrɔ miliyɔn 300 ni kɔ bila sɛnɛkɛlaw ka kɔrɔtɔko bolodalen dɔ la. 

Nin ye sisan koɲɛw ni san 2026 kɔnɔna na, a ɲɛfɔcogo jɔnjɔnw ye:
1. Yɛrɛlabɛn cogoya ka kɛɲɛ ni seko ni dɔnko ye
Hali ni tɔnɔ bɛ Faransi yɔrɔ dɔw la, a bɛ to ka da a kan yɔrɔ wɛrɛw la:
Yɛrɛlabaarakɛyɔrɔw : Jamana bɛ tɔnɔba sɔrɔ sɛnɛfɛnw, nɔnɔmafɛnw ani sogo la (a hakɛ bɛɛ lajɛlen na).
Barikantanya yɔrɔw : Faransi tɛ a yɛrɛ balo sɛnɛfɛnw na, wa a bɛ a ka jiridenw ni nakɔfɛnw yɔrɔba dɔ don jamana kɔnɔ. Kɔnɔw ta fan fɛ, jamana ka kan ka kɔnɔsogonin kura 575 lamini san 2026 kɔnɔ walasa k’a yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sabati.
Duniya bɛɛ ka bolomafara : Kɔsa in na, sɛgɛsɛgɛli dɔ y’a jira ko Faransi bɛ 60% dɔrɔn de dafa k’a ɲɛsin jamana kɔnɔ fɛnw ma. 

Gofɛrɛnaman ye fɛɛrɛ caman daminɛ walasa ka “dumuniko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya minɛ kokura” : 
Sɛnɛko ɲɛnabɔli sariya (2025): A bɛ san tan kuntilenna sigi sen kan, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la ka foro hakɛ sabati ka se 400.000 ma san 2035 kɔnɔ.
Fɛnɲɛnɛmaw balocogo bolodacogo : Laɲini ye ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw caya siɲɛ fila ni jiriw ka balofɛnw ye walasa ka dɔ bɔ soja ladonni na.
Jamana ka dumuniko, balodɛsɛ ani waati cogoya fɛɛrɛ (SNANC): A bɔra san 2026 feburuyekalo la, a bɛ dusu don sigida fɛnw dunni caya la, ka sɔrɔ ka dan sigi sogo minnu bɛ bɔ jamana wɛrɛw la.
Biɲɛdimi : Sɛnɛ yiriwali nafolo dɔ bɛna daminɛ san 2026 daminɛ na Crédit Agricole fɛ walasa ka dɛmɛ don funankɛninw sigili la ani forow labɛnni na. 

3. Gɛlɛyaw ni jɔrɔnankow
San 2026 bɛ daminɛ cogo gɛlɛn na:
Baara gɛlɛya : Sisan sɛnɛkɛlaw 50% ɲɔgɔnna bɛna lafiɲɛbɔ san 2030, o b’a to mɔgɔw ka bɔnsɔn kurayali nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ kabini san 2026.
Sosiyete ka sigida : San 2026 sɛnɛko jirali daminɛna gɛlɛyabaw kɔnɔ, min kɛra ni tɔn dɔw ka boykot ye minnu bɛ ɲɔgɔndan tilenbaliya ni sɔrɔ bɛrɛbɛrɛ jalaki. 

 
Yala aw b’a fɛ ka kunnafoni sɔrɔ dɛmɛ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen kan min dira PLF 2026 kɔnɔ sɛnɛko siratigɛ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen dɔ kama wa?

Ukraine suman ye baganw gosi Faransi

 Yɛrɛlabaarakɛyɔrɔw : Jamana bɛ tɔnɔba sɔrɔ sɛnɛfɛnw, nɔnɔmafɛnw ani sogo la (a hakɛ bɛɛ lajɛlen na).
 Barikantanya yɔrɔw : Faransi tɛ a yɛrɛ balo sɛnɛfɛnw na, wa a bɛ a ka jiridenw ni nakɔfɛnw yɔrɔba dɔ don jamana kɔnɔ.  Kɔnɔw ta fan fɛ, jamana ka kan ka kɔnɔsogonin kura 575 lamini san 2026 kɔnɔ walasa k’a yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sabati.
 Duniya bɛɛ ka bolomafara : Kɔsa in na, sɛgɛsɛgɛli dɔ y’a jira ko Faransi bɛ 60% dɔrɔn de dafa k’a ɲɛsin jamana kɔnɔ fɛnw ma. 

 Gofɛrɛnaman ye fɛɛrɛ caman daminɛ walasa ka “dumuniko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya minɛ kokura” : 
 Sɛnɛko ɲɛnabɔli sariya (2025): A bɛ san tan kuntilenna sigi sen kan, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la ka foro hakɛ sabati ka se 400.000 ma san 2035 kɔnɔ.
 Fɛnɲɛnɛmaw balocogo bolodacogo : Laɲini ye ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw caya siɲɛ fila ni jiriw ka balofɛnw ye walasa ka dɔ bɔ soja ladonni na.
 Jamana ka dumuniko, balodɛsɛ ani waati cogoya fɛɛrɛ (SNANC): A bɔra san 2026 feburuyekalo la, a bɛ dusu don sigida fɛnw dunni caya la, ka sɔrɔ ka dan sigi sogo minnu bɛ bɔ jamana wɛrɛw la.
 Biɲɛdimi : Sɛnɛ yiriwali nafolo dɔ bɛna daminɛ san 2026 daminɛ na Crédit Agricole fɛ walasa ka dɛmɛ don funankɛninw sigili la ani forow labɛnni na. 

 3. Gɛlɛyaw ni jɔrɔnankow
 San 2026 bɛ daminɛ cogo gɛlɛn na:
 Baara gɛlɛya : Sisan sɛnɛkɛlaw 50% ɲɔgɔnna bɛna lafiɲɛbɔ san 2030, o b’a to mɔgɔw ka bɔnsɔn kurayali nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ kabini san 2026.
 Sosiyete ka sigida : San 2026 sɛnɛko jirali daminɛna gɛlɛyabaw kɔnɔ, min kɛra ni tɔn dɔw ka boykot ye minnu bɛ ɲɔgɔndan tilenbaliya ni sɔrɔ bɛrɛbɛrɛ jalaki.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5298 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-22 01:40:11 CEST
Arabu Sawudi : a ye kɛmɛsarada la caman sɔrɔ (71% kɔnɔw, 129% nɔnɔ, 100% kɔnɔ) san 2023-2026, wa a bɛ ka taa a fɛ ka wari bila seriw ni sɛnɛko fɛɛrɛw la walasa ka dumuniko sabati.  
Nin jate ninnu b’a jira ko Saudi Arabia ka yeli 2030 ye ɲɛtaa sɔrɔ sɛnɛko siratigɛ la, ka kɛ sɔrɔko bolofara sabatilen ye. Ka fara yɛrɛdɔn dafalen sɔrɔli kan fɛnw na i n’a fɔ nɔnɔ ni kɔnɔw, jirisunw ni fɛɛrɛ hakilitigiw ka bonya bɛ fɛɛrɛ hakilitigi jira walasa ka se sɔrɔ waati gɛlɛyaw kan.
Nin ɲɛtaa in yɔrɔ minnu ka bon kosɛbɛ, olu filɛ nin ye, ka kɛɲɛ ni sigida, jiko ani sɛnɛko minisiriso ka kunnafoniw ye :
Kɔnɔw : Ni pan ka se 71% ma, o bɛna dɔ bɔ kosɛbɛ fɛnw na minnu bɛ na ni u ye jamana wɛrɛw la, ni kɛmɛsarada la caman bɛna laɲini don nataw la.
Nɔnɔko : 129% tɔnɔ ye Masaya kɛ mara kɔnɔ fɛnw ni fɛɛrɛ kuraw feerela ŋana ye min bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na.
Sɛnɛko fɛɛrɛko : Sisan, sinsin bɛ kɛ jɛgɛmara ni jiko siratigɛ la min bɛ ji bɔ walasa o seko ninnu ka sabati.
Yala aw b’a fɛ ka kunnafoni caman sɔrɔ wariko siraw kan minnu bɛ sɔrɔ sɛnɛko jɔlenw fɛɛrɛw la walima wariko fɛɛrɛw la ka bɔ Sɛnɛ yiriwali nafolosɔrɔsiraw la wa?

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5299 — User ka fasari yɛlɛma
Waati: 2026-02-22 01:40:04 CEST

User ye fasari min ta, o marala:
Arabie Saoudite: A ye yɛrɛta hakɛ caman sɔrɔ (71% kɔnɔw, 129% nɔnɔ, 100% fanw) san 2023-2026 kɔnɔ, wa a bɛ ka taa a fɛ ka wari bila manabuguw ni sɛnɛko fɛɛrɛw la walasa ka Baloko sinsin.

Nin jatebɔ ninnu b’a jira ko Saudi Arabia ka Sugo 2030 ye ɲɛtaa sɔrɔ sɛnɛko siratigɛ la ka kɛ sɔrɔko jɔyɔrɔba ye. Ka fara yɛrɛta dafalen sɔrɔli kan fɛn bɔtaw la i n’a fɔ nɔnɔ ni fanw, fɛrɛli bɛ kalinin kɛ Manabuguw la min bɛ fɛɛrɛ hakilitigi jira walasa ka se sɔrɔ waati gɛlɛyaw kan.

Nin ɲɛtaa in kunbabaw filɛ nin ye, ka kɛɲɛ ni sigida, jiko ani sɛnɛko minisiriso ka kunnafoniw ye :

Kɔnɔw : O hakɛ panna ka se 71% ma O bɛ dɔ bɔ ka jigi da fɛnw kan minnu bɛ na jamana kɔnɔ cogoyabala, ka fara laɲini hakɛ kɔrɔtalen kan siniko kama.

Nɔnɔ: O bɔnna ni hakɛ 129% ye Masaya yɛlɛmana ka kɛ mara ka fɛn bɔta kuntigi ye ani fɛɛrɛw Minnu dulonnen bɛ a la.

Sɛnɛko fɛɛrɛbɔ : O b'a Sinsin Sisan, ka danbe ka taa jɛgɛ mara ma ani sɔnni labɛnen labɔli jiko kama mun kɔsɔn ka dalakan ta nin kɛlen in na.

Yala i b’a fɛ ka kunnafoni caman sɔrɔ wariko siraw kan sɛnɛko jɔlenw fɛɛrɛw la walima ka teliya ka wari don ka bɔ Sɛnɛ yiriwali nafolosɔrɔsiraw kɛsu kɔnɔ wa?

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5306 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-21 16:29:59 CEST
Maroko : A b’a sinsin jiko biɲɛdimi kan ani ka sɛnɛ cakɛda fɛɛrɛbɔlenw (legumes, nakɔfɛnw) yiriwa walasa ka waati jiginni kunbɛn.

Maroko bɛ ka “Green Generation” fɛɛrɛ ta san 2020-2030 walasa ka sɛnɛko seko ni dɔnko sabatili sabati waati jiginni na, k’a sinsin jiko siratigɛw labɛnni kan bi ta la (65% datugulen ni jiko fɛɛrɛw ye) ani ka sɛnɛko cakɛda fɛɛrɛw labɛn (nɔnɔw, nakɔfɛnw). Nin politiki in kun ye ka balo sɔrɔ ni kɔgɔji kɔgɔ bɔli ye, ka sɛnɛ tigitigi ta, ani ka kisɛw ɲini minnu bɛ se ka ja kɛlɛ. 

Maroc ka cɛsiri minnu ka bon kosɛbɛ sɛnɛko biɲɛdimi na:
Jiko biɲɛdimi : Jiko fɛɛrɛw jɛnsɛnni (sigida jiko) walasa ka jiko yɔrɔw 65% ɲɔgɔn don a kɔnɔ sisan, n’o laɲini ye ka biɲɛdimi bɛɛ lajɛlen sɔrɔ.
Sɛnɛ cakɛdaw yiriwali : ka cakɛda fɛɛrɛbɔlenw bila jɔyɔrɔ fɔlɔ la (nakɔfɛnw, shɔw) ani k’u sabatili sabati, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, oasi yɔrɔw la ani yɔrɔ minnu ka nafolo man bon.
Sɛnɛ hakilitigi ni waati jaabi : Ka “sɛnɛ hakilitigi” ta ni dronw, dugukolo jateminɛnanw, ani sɛnɛ nizɛri ye walasa ka ji kisi fo ka se 30% ma.
Sɛnɛ ɲinini : Kisɛ suguya kura minnu bɛ se ka ja ni kɔgɔ kɛlɛ, olu labɛnni jamana ka sɛnɛko ɲinini baarada fɛ (INRA) ani iniwɛrisitew.
Fɛɛrɛ bɛɛjɛfanga : Sisan siraw (2025-2026) laɲini ye ka sɛnɛkɛla misɛnninw dɛmɛ ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw dilanni sabatili sabati walasa ka sanjiko dɛsɛ nɔ bila dumuniko la. 

Nin fɛɛrɛ in ye yelifɛnba dɔ ye walasa ka yɔrɔ tilennenya ni jamana ka dumuniko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sɔrɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5307 — User ka fasari yɛlɛma
Waati: 2026-02-21 16:29:56 CEST
Maroko : A b’a sinsin jiko biɲɛdimi kan ani ka sɛnɛ cakɛda fɛɛrɛbɔlenw (legumes, nakɔfɛnw) yiriwa walasa ka waati jiginni kunbɛn.

Nin politiki in kun ye ka balo sɔrɔ ni kɔgɔji kɔgɔ bɔli ye, ka sɛnɛ tigitigi ta, ani ka kisɛw ɲini minnu bɛ se ka ja kɛlɛ.

Sɛnɛ cakɛdaw yiriwali : ka cakɛda fɛɛrɛbɔlenw bila jɔyɔrɔ fɔlɔ la (nakɔfɛnw, shɔw) ani k’u sabatili sabati, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, oasi yɔrɔw la ani yɔrɔ minnu ka nafolo man bon.
Sɛnɛ hakilitigi ni waati jaabi : Ka “sɛnɛ hakilitigi” ta ni dronw, dugukolo jateminɛnanw, ani sɛnɛ nizɛri ye walasa ka ji kisi fo ka se 30% ma.
Sɛnɛ ɲinini : Kisɛ suguya kura minnu bɛ se ka ja ni kɔgɔ kɛlɛ, olu labɛnni jamana ka sɛnɛko ɲinini baarada fɛ (INRA) ani iniwɛrisitew.
Fɛɛrɛ bɛɛjɛfanga : Sisan siraw (2025-2026) laɲini ye ka sɛnɛkɛla misɛnninw dɛmɛ ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw dilanni sabatili sabati walasa ka sanjiko dɛsɛ nɔ bila dumuniko la. 

Nin fɛɛrɛ in ye yelifɛnba dɔ ye walasa ka yɔrɔ tilennenya ni jamana ka dumuniko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sɔrɔ.
User ye fasari min ta, o marala:
Marɔku : O b’a sinsin Sɔnniko Kurayali kan ani ka sɛnɛ nafa cakɛda fɛɛrɛw yiriwa (shɔw, nakɔfɛnw) walasa ka waati yɛlɛma kunbɛn.

Marɔku ye "Bɔnsɔn binkɛnɛ" fɛɛrɛ ta san bafila ni mugan bafila ni bisaba walasa ka sɛnɛko dugukolow sinsin u ka se ka jɔ waati yɛlɛma ɲɛkɔrɔ, k’a sinsin sɔnniko kuraw labɛnni kan (min bɛ kɛmɛsarada biwɔɔrɔ ni duuru  datugu ni jiko fɛɛrɛw ye) ani ka sɛnɛ nafa cakɛda fɛɛrɛw labɛn (shɔw, nakɔfɛnw). Nin fɛɛrɛ in kun ye ka Baloko sɔrɔ kɔgɔji ji kɔgɔbɔli fɛ, sɛnɛ tigitigi tali fɛ, ani ɲininiw kɛli kisɛw kan minnu bɛ se ka ja kɛlɛ.

Marɔku ka cɛsiri jɔnjɔnw sɛnɛko biɲɛdimi na, olu ye :

Sɔnniko kurayali : Ka sɔnniko fɛɛrɛw kɛ ka labɔli kɛ (sɔnniko sigida la) walasa ka yɔrɔw minta kɛmɛsarada biwɔɔrɔ ni duuru ɲɔgɔn dafa sisan, n'o laɲini ye seli ye kuraya labɔli ma.

Sɛnɛ nafabɔsira yiriwali : Ka nafabɔsira fɛɛrɛw bila jɔyɔrɔ fɔlɔ la (nakɔfɛnw, shɔw) ani k’u banbanni dalakanta, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la jigin jigin maraw la ani yɔrɔ minnu ka sɔrɔ ka dɔgɔ.

Sɛnɛ hakilitigi ni waati kuntaalajan : Ka "sɛnɛ hakilitigi" ta ni droniw, dugukolo jateminɛnanw, ani sɛnɛ jatedenya ye walasa ka ji kisi fo ka se kɛmɛsarada bisaba ma.

Sɛnɛko ɲinini : Kisɛ suguya kura minnu bɛ se ka ja ni kɔgɔ kɛlɛ, olu labɛnni jamana ka sɛnɛko ɲinini baarada fɛ (INRA) ani sanfɛkalansow.

Fɛɛrɛ bɛɛjɛfanga : Sisan fɛɛrɛ minnu bɛ senna (bafila ni mugan ani duuru bafila ni mugan ani wɔɔrɔ) olu kun ye ka sɛnɛkɛla misɛnninw dɛmɛ ani ka sɛnɛ sabatili sinsin walasa ka sanjiko dɛsɛ nɔ nɔgɔya Baloko la.

Nin fɛɛrɛ in ye yelifɛnba dɔ ye walasa ka yɔrɔko bɛnkan sɔrɔ ani ka jamana ka Baloko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sɔrɔ.

Nin fɛɛrɛ in ye yelifɛnba dɔ ye walasa ka yɔrɔko bɛnkan sɔrɔ ani ka jamana ka Baloko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sɔrɔ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5322 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-21 10:58:06 CEST
Alzeri : San 2026 sirako bolodalen sinsinnen bɛ suman sɔrɔli caya kan, ka dɔnniya fɛɛrɛw ta, ka sɛnɛko nafolodon sariyaw lajɛ,"ka Dugukolo di a sɛnɛbagaw ma", ani ka sogo sɔrɔli teliya.

A ka san 2026 sirako bolodalen kɔnɔ, Alizeri ye fɛɛrɛba dɔ ta walasa ka Baloko yɛrɛta sɔrɔ. Nin fɛɛrɛ in sinsinnen bɛ suman sɔrɔli caya kan walasa ka ɲininiw dafa (a laɲini ye ka yɛrɛta sɔrɔ Alikaama gɛlɛn na) dɔnniya fɛɛrɛw ni bi fɛɛrɛw tali fɛ. A fana bɛ ka sɛnɛko wariko sariyaw lajɛ kokura walasa ka "Dugukolo di a sɛnɛbagaw ma" sariyakolo baara, ka sɔrɔ ka sogo sɔrɔli teliya o waati kelen na (jɛman ni bilenman bɛɛ) walasa ka dɔ bɔ fɛnw dondonni na jamana kɔnɔ.

San 2026 sɛnɛko siratigɛ la, a ka samasen jɔnjɔnw :

Sumanw sɔrɔli caya : Sirako in kun ye ka sɛnɛfɛnw sɔrɔ hectare kelen kɔnɔ, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la Alikaama gɛlɛn, walasa ka yɛrɛta sɔrɔ, n’a laɲini ye ka sɔrɔ hakɛ cayalenba sɔrɔ, n’o Girinya ye miliyɔn 50 ye san 2025 waati kɔnɔ.

Dɔnniya taabolo : Ka fɛɛrɛw ta minnu sinsinnen bɛ dɔnniya ɲininiw kan, ka kisɛw yiriwa, ani ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw labɛn ka kɛɲɛ ni mara kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka jogo kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye.

Sɛnɛko nafolodonni sariyaw : Sɛnɛko bilasirali sariya seginni walasa ka sariyasunba fɛɛrɛw barika bonya ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli kɔlɔsi, ka sɔrɔ ka t’a fɛ ka sɛnɛko dugukolo tigiyali sabati. ka Dugukolo di a sɛnɛbagaw ma : Ka sɛnɛfɛnw baaracogo yiriwa sɛnɛfɛnw dilannikɛla lakikaw fɛ ani ka dɔ bɔ fɛnw na minnu bɛ na jamana kɔnɔ k’a sɔrɔ u ma dɛsɛ lase sugu ma.

Sogo bɔli : Ka fɛɛrɛ kɔrɔtɔlenw di walasa ka dɔ fara jamana ka sogo bilenman ni sogo jɛman sɔrɔli kan walasa ka jamana kɔnɔ ɲininiw dafa.

Nin sen ninnu bɛ na ni jiko gɛlɛyaw ni sanji dɔgɔyali gɛlɛyaw jaabi ye, wa u laɲini ye ka sɛnɛko kɛ jamana sɔrɔko jɔyɔrɔba ye.

Dɔnniya taabolo : Ka fɛɛrɛw ta minnu sinsinnen bɛ dɔnniya ɲininiw kan, ka kisɛw yiriwa, ani ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw labɛn ka kɛɲɛ ni mara kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka jogo kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye.

Sɛnɛko nafolodonni sariyaw : Sɛnɛko bilasirali sariya seginni walasa ka sariyasunba fɛɛrɛw barika bonya ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli kɔlɔsi, ka sɔrɔ ka t’a fɛ ka sɛnɛko dugukolo tigiyali sabati. ka Dugukolo di a sɛnɛbagaw ma : Ka sɛnɛfɛnw baaracogo yiriwa sɛnɛfɛnw dilannikɛla lakikaw fɛ ani ka dɔ bɔ fɛnw na minnu bɛ na jamana kɔnɔ k’a sɔrɔ u ma dɛsɛ lase sugu ma.

Sogo bɔli : Ka fɛɛrɛ kɔrɔtɔlenw di walasa ka dɔ fara jamana ka sogo bilenman ni sogo jɛman sɔrɔli kan walasa ka jamana kɔnɔ ɲininiw dafa.

Nin sen ninnu bɛ na ni jiko gɛlɛyaw ni sanji dɔgɔyali gɛlɛyaw jaabi ye, wa u laɲini ye ka sɛnɛko kɛ jamana sɔrɔko jɔyɔrɔba ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5330 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-21 10:02:18 CEST
Alizeri : Sira 2026 siratigɛ la, a sinsinnen bɛ suman sɔrɔta caya kan, ka dɔnniya fɛɛrɛw ta, ka sɛnɛko wariko sariyaw lajɛ, ka “dugukolo di a baarabagaw ma”, ani ka sogo sɔrɔli teliya.

San 2026 sirako jatebɔsɛbɛn kɔnɔ, Alizeri ye fɛɛrɛba dɔ ta walasa ka balo sɔrɔ, k’a sinsin suman sɔrɔli caya kan walasa ka ɲininiw dafa (laɲini min ye yɛrɛdɔn ye malo durum na) k’a kɛ dɔnniya fɛɛrɛw ni bi fɛɛrɛ kuraw tali ye, ani ka sɛnɛko wariko sariyaw lajɛ walasa ka “dugukolo di a baarabagaw ma”, ka sɔrɔ ka sogo (nɛrɛma ni bilen) sɔrɔli teliya walasa ka dɔ bɔ fɛnw donna jamana kɔnɔ. 

Sɛnɛko sirako kariti 2026 kɔnɔ, aksidan minnu nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ:
Sumanw sɔrɔli caya : Karta in laɲini ye ka sɛnɛfɛnw sɔrɔta caya hectare kelen kɔnɔ, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la malo durum na, walasa ka yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔ, k’a kɔlɔsi ko sɛnɛfɛnw sɔrɔli hakɛ min bɛna kɛ san 2025 waati la, o bɛna kɛ miliyɔn 50 ye.
Dɔnniya fɛɛrɛw : Ka fɛɛrɛw ta minnu sinsinnen bɛ dɔnniya ɲininiw kan, ka kisɛw yiriwa, ani ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw labɛn ka kɛɲɛ ni mara kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya ye.
Sɛnɛko wariko sariyaw : Sɛnɛko bilasirali sariya lajɛ walasa ka sariyasunba fɛɛrɛw barika bonya ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli kɔlɔsi, ka sɔrɔ ka t’a fɛ ka sɛnɛko tigiyali sigi sen kan.
Dugukolo min bɛ baara kɛ a ye : ka sɛnɛfɛnw nafa bonya sɛnɛfɛnw dilannikɛla lakikaw fɛ ani ka dɔ bɔ fɛnw dondonni na jamana kɔnɔ k’a sɔrɔ a ma kɛ sababu ye ka suguw dɛsɛ.
Sogo sɛnɛni : Ka fɛɛrɛ kɔrɔtɔlenw di walasa ka jamana ka sogo bilenman ni sogo finman sɛnɛta bonya walasa ka sigida ɲininiw dafa. 

Nin sen ninnu bɛ na ni jiko gɛlɛyaw ni sanjiko gɛlɛyaw jaabi ye, wa u laɲini ye ka sɛnɛko kɛ jamana sɔrɔko jɔyɔrɔba ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5331 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-21 09:20:08 CEST
Moritani ka taa Brakna la: Gofɛrɛnaman ka dɛmɛnw sɛnɛko siratigɛ la
14 zuluyekalo san 2025

Moritani gɔfɛrɛnaman ka bolonɔbila minnu kɛra sɛnɛko siratigɛ la Brakna mara la san 2025 cɛmancɛ la, olu sinsinnen tun bɛ jiko siratigɛ la, ani ka sɛnɛkɛlaw dɛmɛ walasa u ka se ka dumuniko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sabati, ni foro taama caman ye walasa ka tugu porozɛw kɔ minnu bɛ senna.
Interventions ni projets minnu ka bon kosɛbɛ Brakna (Zunikalo/Zuluyekalo san 2025)
Sɛgɛsɛgɛli ni tugu-tugu-taama : San 2025 zuluyekalo la, sɛnɛko minisiri (Am Ould Pibat) ye foro taama dɔ kɛ Boke ni Bababi maraw kɔnɔ walasa ka sɛnɛko porozɛw sɛgɛsɛgɛ minnu bɛ senna, n’u kun ye ka jamanadenw ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲɛ ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw yiriwa.
Tlebi Labrakna jiko porozɛ : Baara bɛ senna walasa ka sɛnɛyɔrɔbaw yiriwa, o la, ka hectare 1500 sɔrɔ kokura tiga sɛnɛni kama, ka sɔrɔ ka hectare 110 bila nakɔsɛnɛ na musow ka koperatifuw ye.
Ka dɛmɛ don jirisunw sɛnɛni na : San 2025, jamana ye jɔyɔrɔ sɔrɔ jirisunba sɛnɛyɔrɔ ɲuman na yɔrɔw la minnu tɛ oasi ye, o b’a jira ko gɔfɛrɛnaman ka cɛsiriw ye ɲɛtaa sɔrɔ sɛnɛfɛnw suguya caman sɛnɛni na laadala yɔrɔw kɔkan.
Lakanali sanjiba la : Ka fɛɛrɛko ni mara jɛkuluw baara walasa ka sanjiba nɔfɛkow lajɛ ani ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw lakana Cisjordanie jamanaw kɔnɔ, Brakna fana sen bɛ o la, walasa sɛnɛko kanpaɲiw ka taa ɲɛ. 

Sɛnɛko politiki siratigɛw san 2025 kɔnɔ
Dumuniko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sɔrɔli : Gofɛrɛnaman ye yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔli kɛ laɲini ye, bawo a b’a jira ko a bɛna se 84% ma nakɔfɛnw na san laban na.
Duniya jɛkuluw : Ka barow daminɛ ni diɲɛ jɛɲɔgɔnw ye (i n’a fɔ Sinuwa ani Itali) walasa ka porozɛbaw lakunu i n’a fɔ Ambane sɛnɛko porozɛ Labrakna.
Baara dɛmɛni : Ka bolonɔ bila bɛnkansɛbɛnw na minnu kun ye ka baara ni sɛnɛ dɛmɛ Brakna jamana kɔnɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, sɛnɛ minisiriso ka kɔlɔsili tilennen kɔnɔ. 

Kunnafoni labanw bɛ se ka tugu ɲɔgɔn kɔ ni kunnafonidilanw ye minnu bɛ kɛ fanga fɛ i n’a fɔ Moritani kunnafonidilaw ka tɔnba walima sɛnɛko ni dumuniko minisiriso ɲɛ.

Baarakɛnafolo ni porozɛ jɔnjɔnw Brakna (Zunikalo/Zuluyekalo san 2025)

Sɛgɛsɛgɛli ni kɔlɔsili taamaw : San 2025 zuluyekalo la, sɛnɛko minisiri (Amm Ould Bibat) ye foro lajɛ kɛ Boghé ni Bababé maraw la walasa ka sɛnɛko porozɛw sɛgɛsɛgɛ minnu bɛ senna, n’u kun ye ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲɛ ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw yiriwa.

Moritani gɔfɛrɛnaman ka bolonɔbila minnu kɛra sɛnɛko siratigɛ la Brakna mara la san 2025 cɛmancɛ la, olu sinsinnen tun bɛ jiko siratigɛ la, ani ka sɛnɛkɛlaw dɛmɛ walasa u ka se ka baloko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sabati, ka fara foro lajɛbaw kan walasa ka baarabolodalenw kɔlɔsi minnu bɛ senna.

Baarakɛminɛnw ni baarabolodalen jɔnjɔnw Brakna (Zuluyekalo san 2025)

Sɛgɛsɛgɛli ni kɔlɔsili taamaw : San 2025 zuluyekalo la, sɛnɛko minisiri (Amm Ould Bibat) ye foro lajɛ kɛ Boghé ni Bababé maraw la walasa ka sɛnɛko baarabolodalenw sɛgɛsɛgɛ minnu bɛ senna, n’u kun ye ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲɛ ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw yiriwa.

Brakna Tilebi jiko baarabolodalen : Baara bɛ senna sɛnɛyɔrɔbaw yiriwali la, o la, hectare 1500 labɛnni bɛ kɛ Malo sɛnɛni kama, ani hectare 110 bilala nakɔsɛnɛ kama musow ka Kafo ye. Dɛmɛni kɛli Ntamaro sɛnɛni na : San 2025, jamana ye jaabi sɔrɔ Ntamaroforo ɲumanba la yɔrɔw la minnu tɛ jigin jigin ye, o b’a jira ko gɔfɛrɛnaman ye dɛmɛ don sɛnɛfɛnw suguya caman sɛnɛni na laadala yɔrɔw kɔkan.

Sanjiba lakanani : Ka fɛɛrɛko ni mara jɛkuluw baara walasa ka sanjiba nɔfɛkow kɔlɔsi ani ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw lakana bajida maraw kɔnɔ, Brakna fana sen bɛ o la, walasa sɛnɛko wuli ka jɔw ka taa ɲɛ.

Sɛnɛko fɛɛrɛ siratigɛw san 2025 kɔnɔ

Baloko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sɔrɔli : Gofɛrɛnaman ye yɛrɛta sɔrɔli sigi senkan, k’a kɛ laɲini ye, k’a jira ko a bɛna se ka yɛrɛta 84% sɔrɔ nakɔfɛnw na san laban na.

Baara dɛmɛni : Ka bolonɔ bila bɛnkansɛbɛnw na minnu kun ye ka baara ni sɛnɛ dɛmɛ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la Brakna mara la, sɛnɛ minisiriso ka kɔlɔsili tilennen kɔnɔ.

Kunnafoni labanw bɛ se ka tugu ɲɔgɔn kɔ ni kunnafoniw ye minnu bɛ kɛ fanga fɛ i n’a fɔ Moritani kunnafonidilaw ka tɔnba walima sɛnɛko ni Baloko minisiriso ka ɲɛ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5335 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-21 07:33:30 CEST
Moritani ka taa Brakna la: Gofɛrɛnaman ka dɛmɛnw sɛnɛko siratigɛ la
14 zuluyekalo san 2025

Moritani gɔfɛrɛnaman ka bolonɔbila minnu kɛra sɛnɛko siratigɛ la Brakna mara la san 2025 cɛmancɛ la, olu sinsinnen tun bɛ jiko siratigɛ la, ani ka sɛnɛkɛlaw dɛmɛ walasa u ka se ka dumuniko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sabati, ni foro taama caman ye walasa ka tugu porozɛw kɔ minnu bɛ senna.
Interventions ni projets minnu ka bon kosɛbɛ Brakna (Zunikalo/Zuluyekalo san 2025)
Sɛgɛsɛgɛli ni tugu-tugu-taama : San 2025 zuluyekalo la, sɛnɛko minisiri (Am Ould Pibat) ye foro taama dɔ kɛ Boke ni Bababi maraw kɔnɔ walasa ka sɛnɛko porozɛw sɛgɛsɛgɛ minnu bɛ senna, n’u kun ye ka jamanadenw ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲɛ ani ka sɛnɛfɛnw yiriwa.
Tlebi Labrakna jiko porozɛ : Baara bɛ senna walasa ka sɛnɛyɔrɔbaw yiriwa, o la, ka hectare 1500 sɔrɔ kokura tiga sɛnɛni kama, ka sɔrɔ ka hectare 110 bila nakɔsɛnɛ na musow ka koperatifuw ye.
Ka dɛmɛ don jirisunw sɛnɛni na : San 2025, jamana ye jɔyɔrɔ sɔrɔ jirisunba sɛnɛyɔrɔ ɲuman na yɔrɔw la minnu tɛ oasi ye, o b’a jira ko gɔfɛrɛnaman ka cɛsiriw ye ɲɛtaa sɔrɔ sɛnɛfɛnw suguya caman sɛnɛni na laadala yɔrɔw kɔkan.
Lakanali sanjiba la : Ka fɛɛrɛko ni mara jɛkuluw baara walasa ka sanjiba nɔfɛkow lajɛ ani ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw lakana Cisjordanie jamanaw kɔnɔ, Brakna fana sen bɛ o la, walasa sɛnɛko kanpaɲiw ka taa ɲɛ. 

Sɛnɛko politiki siratigɛw san 2025 kɔnɔ
Dumuniko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sɔrɔli : Gofɛrɛnaman ye yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔli kɛ laɲini ye, bawo a b’a jira ko a bɛna se 84% ma nakɔfɛnw na san laban na.
Duniya jɛkuluw : Ka barow daminɛ ni diɲɛ jɛɲɔgɔnw ye (i n’a fɔ Sinuwa ani Itali) walasa ka porozɛbaw lakunu i n’a fɔ Ambane sɛnɛko porozɛ Labrakna.
Baara dɛmɛni : Ka bolonɔ bila bɛnkansɛbɛnw na minnu kun ye ka baara ni sɛnɛ dɛmɛ Brakna jamana kɔnɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la, sɛnɛ minisiriso ka kɔlɔsili tilennen kɔnɔ. 

Kunnafoni labanw bɛ se ka tugu ɲɔgɔn kɔ ni kunnafonidilanw ye minnu bɛ kɛ fanga fɛ i n’a fɔ Moritani kunnafonidilaw ka tɔnba walima sɛnɛko ni dumuniko minisiriso ɲɛ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5336 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-21 07:33:25 CEST

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5340 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-21 06:51:48 CEST
Jamanadenw ka cɛsiriw walasa ka yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔ sɛnɛko la Moritani Alzeri Maroko Arabu Sawudi Faransi Ameriki Turki Ukraine Irisi Sinuwa 2026

Sɛnɛ yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya cɛsiriw san 2026 kɔnɔ, o bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka sinsin kosɛbɛ kɛ ka dɔ fara jamana kɔnɔ suman sɔrɔta kan, ka fɛɛrɛ kuraw ta, ani ka nafolo sabatili yiriwa. Arabu jamanaw (Alzeri, Arabie Saoudite, Maroko, Moritani) b’a ɲini ka dɔ bɔ fɛnw dondonni na ni sirako kariti ye min bɛ se ka kɛ fɛn bɛɛ ye, k’a sɔrɔ fangabaw (Sina, Ameriki, Irisi, Ukraine, Turquie) bɛ u sinsin fɛnw sɔrɔli lakanani kan, sɔrɔ caman sɔrɔli, ani sɛnɛko fɛɛrɛ hakilitigiw. 

Arabu jamanaw ka cɛsiriw (2026) .
Alizeri : Sira 2026 siratigɛ la, a sinsinnen bɛ suman sɔrɔta caya kan, ka dɔnniya fɛɛrɛw ta, ka sɛnɛko wariko sariyaw lajɛ, ka “dugukolo di a baarabagaw ma”, ani ka sogo sɔrɔli teliya.
Arabu Sawudi : a ye kɛmɛsarada la caman sɔrɔ (71% kɔnɔw, 129% nɔnɔ, 100% kɔnɔ) san 2023-2026, wa a bɛ ka taa a fɛ ka wari bila seriw ni sɛnɛko fɛɛrɛw la walasa ka dumuniko sabati.
Maroko : A b’a sinsin jiko biɲɛdimi kan ani ka sɛnɛ cakɛda fɛɛrɛbɔlenw (legumes, nakɔfɛnw) yiriwa walasa ka waati jiginni kunbɛn.
Moritani: Sɛnɛ dugukolow labɛnni sabatili yiriwa bajida la walasa ka dɔ fara tiga ni malo sɔrɔli kan. 

Duniya fanga ni sɛnɛ hakilitigiw
Sinuwa: A b’a ka cɛsiriw bonya walasa k’a ka dumuniko lakana, k’a jira ko a bɛna fanga yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya ni sɛnɛko hakilitigiw hakɛ caya san 2026 kɔnɔ.
Irisi ni Ukɛrɛni: Ikomi u ye “diɲɛ buruburudaga” ye, u bɛ u sinsin fɛnw dilancogo ɲɛnabɔli kan ani ka fɛn dilanni caman kɛ hali ni dugukoloko gɛlɛyaw bɛ u kan.
Ameriki: Ka wari bila biyoteknoloji (GMO), sɛnɛko tigitigi, ani hakililata la walasa ka sɔrɔ yiriwa.
Türkiye: Sɛnɛkɛla misɛnninw dɛmɛ, ka jiko siraw ɲɛ, ani ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw feereli kan minnu bɛ se ka kɛ fɛɛrɛ ye.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5341 — User ka fasari yɛlɛma
Waati: 2026-02-21 06:51:38 CEST
Jamanadenw ka cɛsiriw walasa ka yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔ sɛnɛko la Moritani Alzeri Maroko Arabu Sawudi Faransi Ameriki Turki Ukraine Irisi Sinuwa 2026

Sɛnɛ yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya cɛsiriw san 2026 kɔnɔ, o bɛna kɛ sababu ye ka sinsin kosɛbɛ kɛ ka dɔ fara jamana kɔnɔ suman sɔrɔta kan, ka fɛɛrɛ kuraw ta, ani ka nafolo sabatili yiriwa. Duniya fanga ni sɛnɛ hakilitigiw

User ye fasari min ta, o marala:
Jamanaw ka cɛsiriw walasa ka sɛnɛko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sɔrɔ: Moritani, Alzeri, Marɔku, Arabu Sawudi, Faransi, Ameriki, Turki, Ukraniya, Irisila ani Sinuwa san 2026

Sɛnɛ yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya cɛsiri minnu kɛra san 2026 kɔnɔ, olu bɛ ka sinsin kosɛbɛ sigida suman sɔrɔli caya kan, ka fɛɛrɛ kuraw ta, ani ka nafolo sabatili yiriwa. Arabu jamanaw (Alzeri, Arabie Saoudite, Maroko, ani Moritani) b’a ɲini ka dɔ bɔ fɛnw na bɛ kɛ ni minnu ye jamana kɔnɔ, sirako bɛɛjɛfanga dɔ sababu fɛ, k’a sɔrɔ fangabaw (Sina, Ameriki, Irisila, Ukraniya, ani Turki) b’u sinsin fɛnw  lakanani banbanni kan, jaabi caman sɔrɔli, ani sɛnɛko fɛɛrɛ hakilitigiw.

Alzeri : San 2026 sirako bolodalen sinsinnen bɛ suman sɔrɔli caya kan, ka dɔnniya fɛɛrɛw ta, ka sɛnɛko wariko sariyaw lajɛ, ka "dugukolo di a  sɛnɛbagaw ma", ani ka sogo sɔrɔli teliya.

Arabie Saoudite : o ye kɛmɛsarada la caman sɔrɔ (71% kɔnɔw, 129% nɔnɔ, ani 100% fanw) san 2023-2026 kɔnɔ, wa a bɛ ka taa a fɛ ka wari bila sow yɔrɔ tagalen ni sɛnɛko fɛɛrɛw la walasa ka baloko Sinsin. Marɔku : O b’a sinsin jiko biɲɛdimi kan ani ka sɛnɛ nafa cakɛda fɛɛrɛw yiriwa (Nankɛfɛnw, nakɔfɛnw) walasa ka waati yɛlɛma kunbɛn.

Moritani: O bɛ sɛnɛyɔrɔw labɛnni sabati bajida la walasa ka dɔ fara Malo ni Alikaama sɔrɔli kan.

Duniya fangaw ani Sɛnɛ hakilitigi
Sinuwa: O b’a ka cɛsiriw fanga bonya walasa k’a ka Baloko lakana, k’a jira ko fanga yɛrɛmahɔrɔnyali ni sɛnɛko hakilitigiw bɛna caya san 2026 kɔnɔ.
Irisi ni Ukraine : U bɛ I n’a fɔ “diɲɛ buuru Segi”, u b’u sinsin fɛnw dilancogo cakɛdaw ɲɛnabɔli kan ani sɛnɛfɛnw donni ani bɔli bɛ kɛ kosɛbɛ hali ni dugukolofɛɛrɛko gɛlɛyaw bɛ yen.

Ameriki: O bɛ wari bila Fɛnɲɛnama fɛɛrɛko la(GMO), sɛnɛ tigitigi, ani hakililata la walasa ka sɔrɔ yiriwa.

Turquie: O bɛ sɛnɛkɛla misɛnninw dɛmɛ, ka jiko siraw ɲɛ, ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛn ɲumanw feereli kan.

Irisi ni Ukɛrɛni: Ikomi u ye “diɲɛ buruburudaga” ye, u bɛ u sinsin fɛnw dilancogo ɲɛnabɔli kan ani ka fɛn dilanni caman kɛ hali ni dugukoloko gɛlɛyaw bɛ u kan.
Ameriki: Ka wari bila biyoteknoloji (GMO), sɛnɛko tigitigi, ani hakililata la walasa ka sɔrɔ yiriwa.
Türkiye: Sɛnɛkɛla misɛnninw dɛmɛ, ka jiko siraw ɲɛ, ani ka dɔ fara sɛnɛfɛnw feereli kan minnu bɛ se ka kɛ fɛɛrɛ ye.

Gofɛrɛnaman ka cɛsiriw walasa ka yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔ sɛnɛko la Moritani Alzeri Maroko Arabu Sawudi Faransi Ameriki Turki Ukraine Irisila Sinuwa sisan

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5350 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-21 00:19:38 CEST
Gofɛrɛnaman ka cɛsiriw walasa ka yɛrɛdɔn sɔrɔ Moritani Alzeri Maroc Arabie Saoudite Faransi Ameriki Turki Ukraine Irisi Sinuwa sisan

Jamana minnu kofɔra ka tɛmɛ, olu bɛ baara kɛ ni fɛɛrɛ gɛlɛnw ye sisan walasa k’u ka dumuniko ni izini yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya sabati, minnu bɛ bila senkan dugukoloko politiki jiginniw fɛ ani gɛlɛyaw fɛ diɲɛ feereli cakɛdaw la :
Arabu jamanaw
Moritani: Gofɛrɛnaman ye “dumuniko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya” sɔrɔli sigi senkan, k’a kɛ a ka porogaramu kuntilenna jɔnjɔn ye fo san 2026. Cɛsiriw dɔw ye ka nakɔsɛnɛyɔrɔ dɔ sigi senkan “Tekkent” mara la, min bɛ sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli ni u marali fara ɲɔgɔn kan, ka sɔrɔ ka nakɔfɛnw sɔrɔli hakɛ kɔrɔta, o min tun bɛ 35-40% cɛ san 2025.
Alizeri : A b’a ɲini ka se ka yɛrɛdɔn dafalen sɔrɔ malo durum na san 2026. A bɛ “Sɛnɛko siraba 2026” ta, min sinsinnen bɛ jibɔyɔrɔw bonya kan ani ka baara kɛ ni fɛɛrɛ hakilitigiw ye walasa ka jiko gɛlɛyaw ni waati jiginni kunbɛn.
Maroc: a bɛ Afiriki jamanaw ɲɛfɛ yɛrɛdɔn na fɛn kuraw la (jiridenw, nakɔfɛnw, shɔw). Sisan cɛsiri minnu bɛ kɛ san 2025/2026 waati la, olu sinsinnen bɛ « danni tilennen » fɛɛrɛw kan walasa ka ja kɛlɛ, ni malo sɔrɔli bɛna caya ni 16,7% ye.
Arabu Sawudi : a ye dafalen hakɛ caman sɔrɔ sɛnɛfɛn caman na (don 119%, toro ni shɔ 107%, ani konkomɔri 102%). Vision 2030 laɲini ye ka yɛrɛdɔn hakɛ kɔrɔta kɔnɔw la ka se 60% ma, ka dɔ fara sigida ka sɛnɛfɛnw dɛmɛni kan dumuniko la. 

Duniya fangatigiw
Irisi: A ka cɛsiriw bɛ ka sinsin sisan yɛrɛdɔn dafalen kan kisɛw ni sɛnɛkɛminɛnw na walasa ka dɔ bɔ u jigi da tilebin jamanaw ka fɛnw kan.
Turquie: Turquie jamanatigi y’a jira san 2026 feburuyekalo la ko jamana sera a yɛrɛ magoɲɛfɛnw ɲɛnabɔli siratigɛ la lafasalitɔnw na (dronw, misiriw, pankurunw) a ka jamana lakanani hukumu kɔnɔ.
Sinuwa: Dumuni lakanani sariya min donna baara la walasa ka yɛrɛdɔn sabati suman jɔnjɔnw na, o bɛ ka t’a fɛ ka baara kɛ ni jamana lakanani fɔlɔ ye.
Ukraine: Kɛlɛ in bɛɛ n’a ta, cɛsiriw sinsinnen bɛ sɛnɛko cakɛdaw seginni kan ani ka jago siraw lakana walasa ka wariko ni dumuni sabatili sabati jamana kɔnɔ.
Faransi ni Ameriki : Politikiw bɛ ka taa “sɛnɛko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya” siratigɛ la, mikrotɛkinolozi ni fanga kura sɔrɔcogo siratigɛ la walasa ka dɔ bɔ kɛnɛyako la, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la ka bɔ Azi.

Waati: 2026-02-20 21:14:01 CEST
O fanga jiginni ofisiyali in, n’o kɛra jumadon feburuyekalo tile 16 san 2026, o ye fɛɛrɛ tigɛli ye Mali sɛnɛko bolofara bolo jiginni senfɛ.
Nin kɛnɛ in kunba minnu bɛ sɛnɛko minisiriso la, olu filɛ nin ye :
Ɲɛmɔgɔya kura : Dɔgɔtɔrɔ Ibrahima SAMAKE ye fanga ta foroba la sɛnɛko minisiri ye, ka kɛ minisiri Daniel Siméon KELEMA nɔ na.
Institutionnel reconnaissance : Minisiri fila ninnu y’u ka waleɲumandɔn jira Tɛmɛsira ɲɛmaa, sɔrɔdasi jenerali Assimi GOÏTA, ani minisiriɲɛmɔgɔ, Division jenerali Abdoulaye MAÏGA, u ka dannaya kosɔn.
Weelekan min bɛ taa ɲɛ : Minisiri min bɛ bɔ baara la, o y’a ɲini baarakɛlaw fɛ, u ka kantigiya ni cɛsiri kelen di a nɔnabila ma walasa jamana ka walew ka taa ɲɛ.
Sɔrɔko laɲini : Minisiri nata, n’o ye dɔgɔtɔrɔ SAMAKE ye, o y’a jira k’a b’a fɛ ka sɛnɛko sɛmɛntiya ka kɛ sɔrɔ yiriwali fɛɛrɛ lakika ye Mali bolo, k’a ta togodala diɲɛ nafolo belebelebaw la. 
Nin seli in, n’a taamasiyɛn ye dusudon ye, o b’a jira ko faamaw b’a fɛ ka nin baarakɛda nafama in sabati ani k’a lakunu jamana ka dumuniko yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya kama.
Yala aw b’a fɛ ka kunnafoni wɛrɛw sɔrɔ Dɔgɔtɔrɔ Ibrahima SAMAKE ka ɲɛnamayasɛbɛn kan walima sɛnɛko ɲɛtaa kunbabaw kan minnu ɲɛfɔlen don nin ɲɛnabɔli kura in kama wa?

ߥߟߏߟߌ : ߡߣߌߛߙߌ ߓߐߟߋ߲ ߦߴߊ ߢߣߌ ߓߙߊߞߍߟߊߥߵ ߝߍ ߎ ߞߊ ߞߊߣߎߦߊ ߣߌ ߗߍߛߙߌ ߞߋߟߋ߲ ߘߌ ߊ ߣߐ ߟߊ ߥߟߛߊ ߞߊ ߝߊ߲߬ߜ߭ߊ ߞߊ ߓߙߊߥߵ ߢߍߣߊߓߐ ߞߊ ߢߍ.
ߛߐ߬ߙߐ ߞߏ : ߡߣߌߛߙߌ ߣߊ ߕߊ ߑ ߘߜ߭ߕߙߐ߫ ߛߊߡߊߞߌ ߑ ߏ߬ ߦߴߊ ߖߌ߬ߙߊ߬ ߞߏ߫ ߊ߬ ߓߴߊ߬ ߝߍ߬ ߞߊ߬ ߛߣߍ ߢߍߟߍ߲ ߞߊ߬ ߞߍ߫ ߛߐ߬ߙߐ ߞߏ ߟߊߞߌߞߊ ߟߊߞߌߞߊ ߦߋ߫ ߡߊߟߌߛߌ ߖߡߊ߬ߣߊ ߞߣߐ߫ ߑ ߞߊ߬ ߕߜ߭ߏߘߟߊ ߖߡߊ߬ߣߊߥߵ ߞߊ ߛߋߞߏ ߓߊߥߵ ߟߊߓߊ߯ߙߊ߫. ߣߌ߲ ߦߋߗߜ߭ߏ ߢߎߡߊ߲ ߌ߲ ߓߋ߫ ߢߍߡߊߥߵ ߞߊ߫ ߗߍߛߙߌ ߦߌ߬ߙߊ߬ ߣߌ߲ ߦߙߐ ߌ߲ ߟߊߛߙߐ߬ ߊ߬ߣߌ߫ ߞߴߊ ߟߊߥߟߌ߫ ߑ ߏ߬ ߣߊ߬ߝߊ ߞߊߓߏ߲߬ ߖߡߊ߬ߣߊ ߞߊ߫ ߘߡߎߣߌ ߞߏ ߦߙߍ߬ߞߟߏ ߟߊߥߙߊ߬ߟߌ ߟߊ߫.

ߦߊ߯ߟߊ ߊߥߵ ߓߴߊ߬ ߝߍ߬ ߞߊ߬ ߘߐߣߌߦߊ ߗߊߡߊ߲ ߛߙߐ߬ ߘߜ߭ߕߙߐ߫ ߌߓߎߤߊߡߎ ߛߌߡߊߞߌ ߞߊ ߢߣߊߡߦߊ ߟߊ ߥߊߟߌߡߊ ߛߣߍ ߞߏ ߝߟߐߥߵ ߡߌߣߎ߬ ߟߊߓߍ߲ ߣߋ ߘߏ߲ ߣߌ߲ ߢߍߡߜ߭ߐ ߞߎߙߊ ߟߊ ؟

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5432 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-20 09:10:35 CEST
Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman
Feburuyekalo tile 15 nɛgɛ kanɲɛ 16 waati

Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara. Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔko jɔnjɔnw ni latigɛw bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɔnɔ:

✅ Denbayabaw bɛna taa a fɛ ka nafa kelen sɔrɔ ni u ka sɔrɔ ka ca dɔɔnin. Sarali bɛna janya san wɛrɛ kɔnɔ ni denbaya kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka sɔrɔ tɛmɛna magojira hakɛ kan, nka a tɛ tɛmɛ kɛmɛ kɛmɛ saarala tan kan. Nafa hakɛ bɛna kɛ kɛmɛ kɛmɛ saarala ni duuru ye marabolo ka balo hakɛ fitinin na denmisɛn kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye.

✅ Gofɛrɛnaman ka yɔrɔw sɔrɔli bɛna kɛ fɛn ye min bɛ se ka sɔrɔ ɲɛnayeli dɛsɛbagatɔw fɛ. K’a daminɛ Marisikalo tile fɔlɔ la, gɔfɛrɛnaman ka yɔrɔw bɛna kɛ ni Walan kalanbaga kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye minnu bɛna sɛbɛnniw kalan ni kanba ye walima k’u jira fɛn dɔ kan min bɛ se ka maga. Sɛbɛnni kunnafoniw fana bɛna kɛ wajibi ye ka kɛ fɛn ye min bɛ se ka bonya k’a sɔrɔ u ma nɔ bila yɔrɔw wɛb baarakɛcogo la, ani kunnafoni minnu tɛ sɛbɛnni ye, olu bɛɛ mago bɛna kɛ sɛbɛnni ɲɛfɔli wɛrɛ la.

Gofɛrɛnaman sɔnna  kɔrɔnfɛla yɔrɔjan jamanaden hakɛ fɛɛrɛkow fɛɛrɛ ma  fo ka se san bafila ni mugan ani bisaba ma, min bɛna t’a fɛ ka denbayaw dɛmɛ denw bɛ minnu bolo, ani ka marabolow ka bangekɔlɔsi wari sara wɛrɛw di den filanan bangeli kama. Baara bɛna t’a fɛ fana ka ɲɛsin sigidamɔgɔw ka fɛnsɔrɔsiraw dayɛlɛli n’u labɛnni ma.

Mikhail Mishustin ye ɲɔgɔnye kɛ ni LDPR ni Mɔgɔ kura kulu mɔgɔ dɔw ye ka kɔn gɔfɛrɛnaman ka san o san jaabi ɲɛ ka ɲɛsin jamana Duma ma. Gofɛrɛnaman ni tɔndenw bɛ ka baara kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ walasa ka jamanadenw ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲɛ.

Feburuyekalo tile 15 nɛgɛ kanɲɛ 16 waati

Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara. Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔko jɔnjɔnw ni latigɛw bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɔnɔ:

✅ Denbayabaw bɛna taa a fɛ ka nafa kelen sɔrɔ ni u ka sɔrɔ ka ca dɔɔnin. Sarali bɛna janya san wɛrɛ kɔnɔ ni denbaya kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka sɔrɔ tɛmɛna magojira hakɛ kan, nka a tɛ tɛmɛ kɛmɛ kɛmɛ saarala tan kan. Nafa hakɛ bɛna kɛ kɛmɛ kɛmɛ saarala ni duuru ye marabolo ka balo hakɛ fitinin na denmisɛn kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye.

✅ Gofɛrɛnaman ka yɔrɔw sɔrɔli bɛna kɛ fɛn ye min bɛ se ka sɔrɔ ɲɛnayeli dɛsɛbagatɔw fɛ. K’a daminɛ Marisikalo tile fɔlɔ la, gɔfɛrɛnaman ka yɔrɔw bɛna kɛ ni Walan kalanbaga kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye minnu bɛna sɛbɛnniw kalan ni kanba ye walima k’u jira fɛn dɔ kan min bɛ se ka maga. Sɛbɛnni kunnafoniw fana bɛna kɛ wajibi ye ka kɛ fɛn ye min bɛ se ka bonya k’a sɔrɔ u ma nɔ bila yɔrɔw wɛb baarakɛcogo la, ani kunnafoni minnu tɛ sɛbɛnni ye, olu bɛɛ mago bɛna kɛ sɛbɛnni ɲɛfɔli wɛrɛ la.

Gofɛrɛnaman sɔnna  kɔrɔnfɛla yɔrɔjan jamanaden hakɛ fɛɛrɛkow fɛɛrɛ ma  fo ka se san bafila ni mugan ani bisaba ma, min bɛna t’a fɛ ka denbayaw dɛmɛ denw bɛ minnu bolo, ani ka marabolow ka bangekɔlɔsi wari sara wɛrɛw di den filanan bangeli kama. Baara bɛna t’a fɛ fana ka ɲɛsin sigidamɔgɔw ka fɛnsɔrɔsiraw dayɛlɛli n’u labɛnni ma.

Mikhail Mishustin ye ɲɔgɔnye kɛ ni LDPR ni Mɔgɔ kura kulu mɔgɔ dɔw ye ka kɔn gɔfɛrɛnaman ka san o san jaabi ɲɛ ka ɲɛsin jamana Duma ma. Gofɛrɛnaman ni tɔndenw bɛ ka baara kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ walasa ka jamanadenw ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲɛ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5438 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-19 20:13:37 CEST
Irisi jamana ka gofɛrɛnɛman 

Irisi ni Madagasikari jamana sɛnɛko minisiriw ye baro kɛ jɛkafɔ yiriwali kan sɛnɛko siratigɛ la.

Oksana Luth ni Jose Rasatarimanana ka kumaɲɔgɔnya kɛra Irisi jamana sɛnɛko minisiriso la.

🔄Madagasikari bɛ jiidi ni jiridenw ye an ka jamana  yɔrɔw la minnu bɛ tu kɔrɔ,  kakawo kisɛw,nkanfin, ani vanili. Irisi jamana fana labɛnnen don ka dɔ fara jamana kɔnɔ fɛnw feereli kan, kɔnɔw ni suman kisɛw fana sen bɛ o la.

🌱Irisi ye bagaji minɛnw dilanni ni u feerela ŋana dɔ ye. Oksana Lut y’a jira ko se ɲuman bɛ yen k’u di jamana ka sugu la.

🍚Irisi labɛnnen don k’a ka dɔnniya ni fɛɛrɛbɔ yiriwaliw tila ɲɔgɔn na, i n’a fɔ Sigida Malo suguya caman, minnu bɛ bɛn Madagasikari waati cogoya ma.

🎓Madagasikari kalanden minnu bɛ ka kalan kɛ sɛnɛ minisiriso ka sɛnɛko kalansobaw la. Irisila labɛnnen don ka dɔ fara o jɛkafɔ in kan.

🤝Walasa k’u ka jɛɲɔgɔnya sabati ka taa a fɛ sɛnɛko siratigɛ la, ɲɔgɔn nafa yɔrɔw la, jɛkuluw ye baro kɛ walasa ka bɛnkansɛbɛn dɔ bolonɔ bila jamana fila ninnu ka sɛnɛko baaradaw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5440 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-19 20:03:16 CEST
🇷🇺🇲🇬Irisi ni Madagasikari jamanaw ka sɛnɛ minisiriw ye baro kɛ jɛkafɔ yiriwali kan sɛnɛko siratigɛ la.

Oksana Lut ni Jose Rasatarimanan ka kumaɲɔgɔnya kɛra Irisi jamana sɛnɛko minisiriso la.

🔄Madagaskar bɛ jiridenw, kakawo, cloves ani vanille di an ka jamana ma. Irisi jamana fana labɛnnen don ka dɔ fara jamana kɔnɔ fɛnw feereli kan, kɔnɔw ni sumanw fana sen bɛ o la.

🌱 Irisi ye bagaji minɛnw dilanni ni u feerela ŋana dɔ ye. Oksana Lut y’a jira k’u ka fɛnw bɛ se ka kɛ sababu ɲuman ye ka taa repibiliki sugu la.

🍚Irisi jamana labɛnnen don ka yiriwaliw tila ɲɔgɔn na dɔnniya ni seko ni dɔnko siratigɛ la, o la, ka tiga suguyaw ni tiga suguya caman di so kɔnɔ, minnu bɛnnen don Madagasikari waati ma.

🎓Kalandenw ka bɔ Madagasikari ka kalan kɛ sɛnɛ minisiriso ka sɛnɛko kalansobaw la. Irisila labɛnnen don k’o jɛɲɔgɔnya sugu bonya.

🤝Walisa ka jɛkafɔ sabati ka taa a fɛ sɛnɛko-sɛnɛko siratigɛ la, ɲɔgɔn nafa yɔrɔw la, jɛkuluw ye baro kɛ walasa ka bɛnkansɛbɛn dɔ bolonɔ bila jamana fila ninnu ka sɛnɛko baaradaw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5445 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-19 19:33:01 CEST
Gouvernement du Mali

#CIGMA #KUNNAFONIW | Communiqué du conseil des ministres/


O poste in bɛ kunnafoni ofisiyali dɔ tila min bɔra Mali minisiriɲɛmɔgɔso lajɛ la feburuyekalo tile 18 san 2026, n’o ɲɛmɔgɔya tun bɛ tɛmɛn jamanakuntigi Assimi Goïta bolo, n’o bɛ sariyasen fila ɲɛfɔ ka ɲɛsin baarakɛlaw ka baarakɛcogo sigicogo n’a dugukolo tilali ma bolifɛnko birow kama, ka fara marako sigili caman kan minisirisow kɔnɔ.
Kunnafoni kunbabaw b’a jira ko Mali jɔyɔrɔba bɛ Indaba minɛko lajɛba la, ka minɛnko sinsinni ni litiyamu ɲinini sabati, ka fara diɲɛ musow ka don labɛnni kan, musow ka josariyaw kan jamana min bɛ se ka muɲu.
Sigida lakanani gɛlɛyaw cɛma, lajɛ in bɛ kuma misisonya kɛlɛli jɛkafɔ kan Afiriki tilebinyanfan ka sariya kura dɔ sababu fɛ, ka dengue kunbɛnni dege, o b’a jira ko gɔfɛrɛnaman y’a sinsin sɔrɔko camanba ni foroba kɛnɛyako kan

O poste in bɛ kunnafoni ofisiyali dɔ tila min bɔra Mali minisiriɲɛmɔgɔso lajɛ la feburuyekalo tile 18 san 2026, n’o ɲɛmɔgɔya tun bɛ tɛmɛn jamanakuntigi Assimi Goïta bolo, n’o bɛ sariyasen fila ɲɛfɔ ka ɲɛsin baarakɛlaw ka baarakɛcogo sigicogo n’a dugukolo tilali ma bolifɛnko birow kama, ka fara marako sigili caman kan minisirisow kɔnɔ.
Kunnafoni kunbabaw b’a jira ko Mali jɔyɔrɔba bɛ Indaba minɛko lajɛba la, ka minɛnko sinsinni ni litiyamu ɲinini sabati, ka fara diɲɛ musow ka don labɛnni kan, musow ka josariyaw kan jamana min bɛ se ka muɲu.
Sigida lakanani gɛlɛyaw cɛma, lajɛ in bɛ kuma misisonya kɛlɛli jɛkafɔ kan Afiriki tilebinyanfan ka sariya kura dɔ sababu fɛ, ka dengue kunbɛnni dege, o b’a jira ko gɔfɛrɛnaman y’a sinsin sɔrɔko camanba ni foroba kɛnɛyako kan

#CIGMA #KUNNAFONIW | Kunnafonidila min bɔra Minisiriw ka tɔnba/



O Sɛbɛn in bɛ kunnafoni Forobayali dɔ tila ka bɔ Mali minisiriɲɛmɔgɔso lajɛ la feburuyekalo tile 18 san 2026, n’o ɲɛmɔgɔya tun bɛ tɛmɛsira jamanakuntigi Assimi Goïta bolo, n’o bɛ sariyasen fila ɲɛfɔ ka ɲɛsin baarakɛlaw ka baarakɛcogo sigicogo n’a dugukolo tilali ma bolifɛnko ɲɛmaasow ma, ka fara marako sigili caman kan minisirisow kɔnɔ.
Kunnafoni kunbabaw b’a jira ko Mali jɔyɔrɔba bɛ Indaba minɛko lajɛba la, ka minɛnko sinsinni ni litiyamu ɲinini sabati, ka fara diɲɛ musow ka don labɛnni kan, musow ka josariyaw kan jamana min bɛ se ka muɲu.
Sigida lakanani gɛlɛyaw cɛma, lajɛ in bɛ kuma misisonya kɛlɛli jɛkafɔ kan Farafinna tilebinyanfan sariya kura dɔ sababu fɛ, wa a bɛ dengue kunbɛnni dege, o b’a jira ko gɔfɛrɛnaman y’a sinsin sɔrɔko camanba ni foroba kɛnɛyako kan.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5463 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-19 10:07:44 CEST
Irisi jamana ka gɔfɛrɛnaman 
Feburuyekalo tile 15 nɛgɛ kanɲɛ 16 waati

Gofɛrɛnaman ka baara. Dɔgɔkun kɔnɔkobaw ni latigɛw bɛ sɔrɔ digest kɔnɔ:

✅Denbayabaw bɛna taa a fɛ ka nafa kelen sɔrɔ ni sɔrɔ tɛmɛnen ye dɔɔnin. Sarali bɛna janya san wɛrɛ kɔnɔ ni denbaya kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka sɔrɔ hakɛ cayalenba tɛmɛna magoɲɛta hakɛ kan, nka a tɛ tɛmɛ 10% kan. Nafa hakɛ bɛna kɛ 50% ye marabolo ka balo hakɛ fitinin na denmisɛn kelen-kelen bɛɛ bolo.

✅Gofɛrɛnaman ka baaradaw ka sitiw bɛna kɛ fɛn ye min bɛ se ka sɔrɔ ɲɛnayeli dɛsɛbagatɔw fɛ. K’a daminɛ Marisikalo tile fɔlɔ la, porogaramu kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bɛna bɔ gɔfɛrɛnaman ka sitiw kan minnu bɛna sɛbɛnniw kalan walima k’u jira fɛn dɔ kan min bɛ se ka maga. Ani fana, sɛbɛnni kunnafoniw bɛna se ka caya k’a sɔrɔ u ma bɔnɛ site web baarakɛcogo la, wa kunnafoni minnu tɛ sɛbɛnni ye, olu bɛɛ ka kan ka kɛ ni sɛbɛnni ɲɛfɔli wɛrɛ ye.

✅Gofɛrɛnaman ye kɔrɔnfɛla yɔrɔjan jamanaden hakɛ politiki fɛɛrɛ dabɔ waati kɔnɔ fo san 2030, o kɔnɔ, dɛmɛ bɛna taa ɲɛ denbayaw la minnu bɛ den sɔrɔ, ani marabolo ka bangekɔlɔsi waribon wɛrɛw bɛna sara den filanan wolotuma na. Baara bɛna t’a fɛ fana ka sigidamɔgɔw ka fɛnsɔrɔsiraw dabɔ ani k’u kɛ bi ta ye.

✅Mikhail Mishustin ye ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ ni LDPR ni “Mɔgɔ kura” kulu depitew ye, gɔfɛrɛnaman ka san o san jatebɔsɛbɛn ɲɛsigi don na, jamana Duma kɔnɔ. Gofɛrɛnaman ni paritidenw bɛ ka baara kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ walasa ka jamanadenw ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo ɲɛ.

JAMANAKUNTIGIYA

Kunnafoni kunbabaw b’a jira ko Mali jɔyɔrɔba bɛ Indaba minɛko lajɛba la, ka minɛnko sinsinni ni litiyamu ɲinini sabati, ka fara diɲɛ musow ka don labɛnni kan, musow ka josariyaw kan jamana min bɛ se ka muɲu.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5540 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-18 11:12:53 CEST
Jamanakuntigi ka kibaruya labanw: Moritani, Alzeri, Maroc, Arabie Saoudite, Faransi, Ameriki, Turquie, Ukraine, Irisila ani Sinuwa.


Jamanakuntigi ka kibaruyaw ni politikitɔn minnu tɔgɔ bɔra kosɛbɛ jamana kofɔlenw na, olu kuncɛlen filɛ nin ye i n’a fɔ a fɔra cogo min na san 2026 feburuyekalo la:
Maroc, Alzeri ani Moritani (Sahara ko)
Madrid ka kumaɲɔgɔnya: Feburuyekalo tile 9, san 2026, fɛn dɔ jiginna, n’o ye ko Maroko ni Alzeri jamana kɔkankow minisiriw sigilen bɛ kumaɲɔgɔnya tabali kelen kan Madrid, Ameriki ka dɛmɛ kɔnɔ, walasa ka kuma Sahara kɛlɛ kan.
Alzeri: Feburuyekalo tle 17, san 2026, jamanakuntigi Abdelmadjid Tebboune ye Nizɛri jamanakuntigi Abderrahmane Chiani bisimila, yɔrɔ min na Alzeri ka dɛmɛn Nizɛri ka yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya la, o y’a jira, wa Tebboune sɔnna weleli ma ka taa bɔ Nizɛri kɔfɛ.
Maroc : San 2026 Zanwuyekalo laban na, masakɛ Mohamɛdi VI y’a ka foli lase Maroko jamanadenw ma, a kɛlen kɔ ka Afiriki jamanaw ka ntolatanba kɛ ka ɲɛ, k’a jira ko Maroc ka kantigiya bɛ Afiriki gun kan.
Moritani: Jamanakuntigi Mohamed Ould Cheikh Ghazouani b’a ka foro baaraw t’a fɛ, k’a sɔrɔ a ye kuma fɔ Kaédi dugumɔgɔw ye feburuyekalo tile 8 san 2026. Kalataw fana kɛra walasa ka baarakɛlaw ka tɔnw ka birow kuraya Nouakchott. 
Ameriki ni Faransi
Etazuni: White House ye laseli ke feburuye kalo tile 12, san 2026, jamanakuntigi Donald Trump (min y’a ka fanga filanan damine san 2025 Zanwuyekalo la) ka lajɛba don min na ni Latin Ameriki jamana ɲɛmɔgɔw ye. Ameriki ka fanga bɛ cɛsiri jɔyɔrɔ la Sahara ka kumaɲɔgɔnyaw la ani Jenɛfu lajɛba la min bɛ kɛ Irisi ni Ukraine cɛ.
Faransi: Jamanakuntigi Emmanuel Macron donna “post-mandate” dakun na ni san 2026 baarakɛnafolo dabɔli ye, k’a sɔrɔ u bɛ ka sinsin kosɛbɛ Elyse siyako nataw kan ani tɔnw ka sɔsɔliw kan penisiyɔn ni baarakɛlaw ka bεnkanw kan. 
Irisi jamana ni Ukɛrɛni jamanaw
Jenɛfu jɛkafɔw : 2026 sàn feburuyekalo tle 17, jɛkafɔ saba dafalenw daminɛna Jenɛfu jamana na, irisila, Ukrayina ani Ameriki jamana ka cidenjɛkuluw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ, n’o kun ye ka kɛlɛ in ban, k’a sababu kɛ Krεmlin ka hakilisigi ye ko kumaɲɔgɔnya in na, jamanako ko bɛna Dòn a la.
Al-Maidan: Ukraine jamanatigi Volodymyr Zelensky y’a jira Munich jamana ka lajɛba la san 2026 feburuyekalo tile 14 ko Erɔpu jamanaw ka bɔli kumaɲɔgɔnya tabali kan, o ye filiba ye.
Irisi: Irisi jamana gofɛrɛnaman ye gazoli bɔli dabila fo ka se san 2026 feburuyekalo laban ma walasa ka sigida sugu dɛmɛ. 
Arabie Saoudite ani Turquie
Arabie Saoudite: Feburuyekalo tile 12, san 2026, masakɛ Salman bin Abdulaziz ye masakɛ ka yamaruyaw di minnu tun bɛ dankarili kɛ ani ka mɔgɔba dɔw sigi, i n’a fɔ wariko minisiri ani sariyatigiba. Masakɛ ka kiritigɛso y’a fɔ fana ko sanji delili ka kɛ Masaya yɔrɔ bɛɛ la.
Turquie: Feburuyekalo tile 15, san 2026, jamanakuntigi Recep Tayyip Erdogan ye taama bolodalen bila Arabu Emiratiw la, k’a sababu kɛ kɛnɛyako gɛlɛya dɔ ye min binna Emirati jamanakuntigi kan. 
Sinuwa jamana
Diɲɛ faabaw, Pari fana sen bɛ o la, ye Siniwaw ka san kura seliw ye san 2026 feburuyekalo daminɛ na, k’a sɔrɔ Pekin bɛ ka taa a fɛ k’a jɔyɔrɔ sabati diɲɛ sɔrɔko ni diplomasi siratigɛ la.

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5555 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-17 11:30:52 CEST
Jamanakuntigi ka kibaruya labanw: Moritani, Alzeri, Maroc, Arabie Saoudite, Faransi, Ameriki, Turquie, Ukraine, Irisila ani Sinuwa.


Jamanakuntigi ka kibaruyaw ni politikitɔn minnu tɔgɔ bɔra kosɛbɛ jamana kofɔlenw na, olu kuncɛlen filɛ nin ye i n’a fɔ a fɔra cogo min na san 2026 feburuyekalo la:
Maroc, Alzeri ani Moritani (Sahara ko)
Madrid ka kumaɲɔgɔnya: Feburuyekalo tile 9, san 2026, fɛn dɔ jiginna, n’o ye ko Maroko ni Alzeri jamana kɔkankow minisiriw sigilen bɛ kumaɲɔgɔnya tabali kelen kan Madrid, Ameriki ka dɛmɛ kɔnɔ, walasa ka kuma Sahara kɛlɛ kan.
Alzeri: Feburuyekalo tle 17, san 2026, jamanakuntigi Abdelmadjid Tebboune ye Nizɛri jamanakuntigi Abderrahmane Chiani bisimila, yɔrɔ min na Alzeri ka dɛmɛn Nizɛri ka yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya la, o y’a jira, wa Tebboune sɔnna weleli ma ka taa bɔ Nizɛri kɔfɛ.
Maroc : San 2026 Zanwuyekalo laban na, masakɛ Mohamɛdi VI y’a ka foli lase Maroko jamanadenw ma, a kɛlen kɔ ka Afiriki jamanaw ka ntolatanba kɛ ka ɲɛ, k’a jira ko Maroc ka kantigiya bɛ Afiriki gun kan.
Moritani: Jamanakuntigi Mohamed Ould Cheikh Ghazouani b’a ka foro baaraw t’a fɛ, k’a sɔrɔ a ye kuma fɔ Kaédi dugumɔgɔw ye feburuyekalo tile 8 san 2026. Kalataw fana kɛra walasa ka baarakɛlaw ka tɔnw ka birow kuraya Nouakchott. 
Ameriki ni Faransi
Etazuni: White House ye laseli ke feburuye kalo tile 12, san 2026, jamanakuntigi Donald Trump (min y’a ka fanga filanan damine san 2025 Zanwuyekalo la) ka lajɛba don min na ni Latin Ameriki jamana ɲɛmɔgɔw ye. Ameriki ka fanga bɛ cɛsiri jɔyɔrɔ la Sahara ka kumaɲɔgɔnyaw la ani Jenɛfu lajɛba la min bɛ kɛ Irisi ni Ukraine cɛ.
Faransi: Jamanakuntigi Emmanuel Macron donna “post-mandate” dakun na ni san 2026 baarakɛnafolo dabɔli ye, k’a sɔrɔ u bɛ ka sinsin kosɛbɛ Elyse siyako nataw kan ani tɔnw ka sɔsɔliw kan penisiyɔn ni baarakɛlaw ka bεnkanw kan. 
Irisi jamana ni Ukɛrɛni jamanaw
Jenɛfu jɛkafɔw : 2026 sàn feburuyekalo tle 17, jɛkafɔ saba dafalenw daminɛna Jenɛfu jamana na, irisila, Ukrayina ani Ameriki jamana ka cidenjɛkuluw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ, n’o kun ye ka kɛlɛ in ban, k’a sababu kɛ Krεmlin ka hakilisigi ye ko kumaɲɔgɔnya in na, jamanako ko bɛna Dòn a la.
Al-Maidan: Ukraine jamanatigi Volodymyr Zelensky y’a jira Munich jamana ka lajɛba la san 2026 feburuyekalo tile 14 ko Erɔpu jamanaw ka bɔli kumaɲɔgɔnya tabali kan, o ye filiba ye.
Irisi: Irisi jamana gofɛrɛnaman ye gazoli bɔli dabila fo ka se san 2026 feburuyekalo laban ma walasa ka sigida sugu dɛmɛ. 
Arabie Saoudite ani Turquie
Arabie Saoudite: Feburuyekalo tile 12, san 2026, masakɛ Salman bin Abdulaziz ye masakɛ ka yamaruyaw di minnu tun bɛ dankarili kɛ ani ka mɔgɔba dɔw sigi, i n’a fɔ wariko minisiri ani sariyatigiba. Masakɛ ka kiritigɛso y’a fɔ fana ko sanji delili ka kɛ Masaya yɔrɔ bɛɛ la.
Turquie: Feburuyekalo tile 15, san 2026, jamanakuntigi Recep Tayyip Erdogan ye taama bolodalen bila Arabu Emiratiw la, k’a sababu kɛ kɛnɛyako gɛlɛya dɔ ye min binna Emirati jamanakuntigi kan. 
Sinuwa jamana
Diɲɛ faabaw, Pari fana sen bɛ o la, ye Siniwaw ka san kura seliw ye san 2026 feburuyekalo daminɛ na, k’a sɔrɔ Pekin bɛ ka taa a fɛ k’a jɔyɔrɔ sabati diɲɛ sɔrɔko ni diplomasi siratigɛ la.

Ameriki ni Faransi

Ameriki ka fanga bɛ cɛsiri jɔyɔrɔ la Sahara ka kumaɲɔgɔnyaw la ani Jenɛfu kumaɲɔgɔnya lamini na Irisi ni Ukraine cɛ.
Faransi: Jamanakuntigi Emmanuel Macron donna “jɔkɔrɔtiɲɛ” dakun na ni san 2026 baarakɛnafolo dayɛlɛli ye, k’a sɔrɔ u bɛ ka sinsin kosɛbɛ Elyse ɲɔgɔndanko nataw kan ani tɔnw ka sɔsɔliw kan sarako ni baarakɛlaw ka bεnkanw kan.
Irisi jamana ni Ukɛrɛni jamanaw
Jenɛfu jɛkafɔw : 2026 sàn feburuyekalo tle 17, jɛkafɔ saba dafalen kura daminɛna Jenɛfu jamana na, irisila, Ukrayina ani Ameriki jamana ka cidenjɛkuluw cɛ, n’o kun ye ka kɛlɛ in ban, k’a sababu kɛ Krεmlin ka hakilisigi ye ko kumaɲɔgɔnya in na, jamanako bɛna Dòn a la.

Irisi: Irisi jamana gofɛrɛnaman ye gazoli bɔli dabila fo ka se san 2026 feburuyekalo laban ma walasa ka sigida sugu dɛmɛ.
Arabie Saoudite ani Turquie
Arabie Saoudite: Feburuyekalo tile 12, san 2026, masakɛ Salman bin Abdulaziz ye masakɛ ka yamaruyaw di minnu tun bɛ dankarili kɛ ani ka mɔgɔba dɔw sigi, i n’a fɔ wariko minisiri ani sariyatigiba. Masakɛ ka kiritigɛso y’a fɔ fana ko sanji delili ka kɛ Masaya yɔrɔ bɛɛ la.

Waati: 2026-02-17 11:29:04 CEST
Saudi Arabia sɛnɛko tigiyali dɛmɛ bi

Arabu Sawudi bɛ sɛnɛ dɛmɛ barikama di san 2026 kɔnɔ, porogaramuw sababu fɛ i n’a fɔ “Reef” (a bɛ se riyali ba 54 ma san kɔnɔ) ani dɛmɛni minnu bɛ di sɛnɛkɛla misɛnninw ma (i n’a fɔ riyali 30 jirisun kelen na). Lamini, jiko ani sɛnɛko minisiriso b’a fɛ ka dɛmɛ don jirisunw, jirisunw, baganmara, ani jɛgɛko siratigɛ la, wa dɛmɛ tilennen don a kɔnɔ ka ɲɛsin balawuw ma minnu tɔɔrɔla, o min bɛ sabatili ni dumuniko sabatili sabati.

Bamakɔ, Feburuyekalo tile 13, san 2026

K’a sɔrɔ kɔlɔsili sira dɔ cayara ka ɲɛsin sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli ni a tilali baara ma, DRCC jɛkulu minnu bɔra Bamakɔ mara la, olu ye sɛgɛsɛgɛli gɛlɛnw kɛ minisiriso suguba belebelebaw ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw la.

I n’a fɔ a bɛ kɛ cogo min na, Ramadan kalo ɲɛsigi don na, DGCC b’a ka laɲiniba baara walasa ka don o don fɛnw sɔngɔ n’u jogo kɔlɔsi.  

Kabini san tɛmɛnnen, sinsin kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen kɛra fɛnw kan minnu bɛ kɛ ka minfɛnw labɛn minnu dabɔra sunɔgɔ la, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la kinkiliba, bisipa, sɛnzɛri, tamarind ani limoni.

#CIGMA #KUNNAFONIW | Ramadan 2026 siratigɛ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen : DRCC bɛ sɛnɛfɛnw sɔrɔli kɔlɔsi ani fɛn nafamaw bɛ bɛn suguw ma 

Bamakɔ, Feburuyekalo tile 13, san 2026

K’a sɔrɔ kɔlɔsili sira dɔ cayara ka ɲɛsin sɛnɛfɛnw bɔli ni a tilali baara ma, DRCC jɛkulu minnu bɔra Bamakɔ mara la, olu ye sɛgɛsɛgɛli gɛlɛnw kɛ minisiriso suguba belebelebaw ka sɛnɛyɔrɔw la.

I n’a fɔ a bɛ kɛ cogo min na, Ramadan kalo ɲɛsigi don na, DGCC b’a ka laɲiniba baara walasa ka don o don fɛnw sɔngɔ n’u jogo kɔlɔsi.  

Kabini san tɛmɛnnen, sinsin kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen kɛra fɛnw kan minnu bɛ kɛ ka minfɛnw labɛn minnu dabɔra sunɔgɔ la, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la kinkiliba, bisipa, sɛnzɛri, tamarind ani limoni.

Kunnafoni wɛrɛw bɛ sɔrɔ gɔfɛrɛnaman.ml kan 

MIC (MIC) ye

TAAMASIYƐN NO. 5632 — Kuma fasaralen
Waati: 2026-02-16 01:49:27 CEST
Sinuwa jamanatigi ka dɛmɛn sɛnɛko la bi

Ka kɛɲɛ ni politiki hakili ye min bɔra san 2026 daminɛ na, Sinuwa jamanakuntigi b’a sinsin "sɛnɛ, togodaw ani sɛnɛkɛlaw" koɲɛw ɲɛnabɔli kan, k’a kɛ a ɲɛnako fɔlɔ ye, n’o ye ka togodaw lakununni bɛɛ lajɛlen yiriwa, k’a kɛ a kunba ye. Dɛmɛn sinsinnan ye : ka fanga di wale kura dɔ waleyali ma walasa ka dɔ fara suman sɔrɔli seko kan ni kilo miliyari 100 ye ani ka suman ni tulu sɔrɔli sabati ; ka suman sɔrɔ garanti sabati ani ka sɔngɔ, dɛmɛ, ani asiransi sariyaw yiriwa ; ka porozɛ piloti yiriwa ka taa a fɛ, n’o ye ka dugukolo bɛnkansɛbɛnw janya san bisaba wɛrɛ kɔnɔ.

Sinuwa jamanatigi ka dɛmɛn sɛnɛko la bi

Sinuwa jamanakuntigi ka dɛmɛn sɛnɛko la bi

Ka kɛɲɛ ni politiki laadilikanw ye minnu bɔra san 2026 daminɛ na, Sinuwa jamanakuntigi bɛ fɔlɔ ka « togodala ko saba » (sɛnɛ, togodaw, ani sɛnɛkɛlaw) ɲɛnabɔ, wa a b’a sinsin togodaw lakununni bɛɛ lajɛlen sabatili kan. Dɛmɛn yɔrɔ kolomaw ye : ka fanga di wale kura dɔ waleyali ma walasa ka dɔ fara suman bɔli seko kan ni jinɛ miliyari 100 ye (tɔn miliyɔn 50) ani ka suman ni tulu sɔrɔli sabati sɔrɔko garantiw sabatili suman sɛnɛbagaw ma ani ka sɔngɔ, dɛmɛ, ani asiransi sariyaw yiriwa; ani ka porogaramu piloti yiriwa ka taa a fɛ, n’o ye ka dugukoloko bɛnkansɛbɛnw janya san 30 wɛrɛ kɔnɔ.
